items.name: Waiting For the Edge

items.description: Dilas had witnessed her teacher make worlds. Her teacher never intervened and left decisions to fate and time.

items.name: Divine Light Blessing
items.description: If everything follows time, then what is the purpose of creation? Dilas never gave up the scepter of power.

items.name: Abyssal Scepter
items.description: Omnipotent, Dilas believes she will create a perfect world, and the obsession made her ignore people's cries.

items.name: Nameless Chapter
items.description: The world's cycles of destruction bore Dilas. Her power finally becomes shackled and the light of the scepter fades.

items.name: In a Moment
items.description: The teacher arrives again with no spite towards her failure, but teaches her kindly just like before.

items.name: Shadow Follows Light
items.description: The teacher let Dilas into her world and live as an ordinary mortal, only then can one create without arrogance.

items.name: Bright Night of Light
items.description: As a mortal, Dilas lost her powers. The world, previously so puny, now seems such a giant thing.

items.name: Clearing Moon
items.description: One day, the people of a town wake in the ruins and see the shadow of a spider walking away in the moonlight.

items.name: Wavebreaker
items.description: Whitney pushes open the doors of the tower again. The fishing families all like her and agree to take her to the sea.

items.name: Familiar Old Sea
items.description: It is her first time here but Whitney is familiar with all the islands and whirls. The sea feels like home.

items.name: Meeting Through Waves
items.description: The divine whale was attracted by the song and set a contract to appear whenever the song is sung by the ancestor.

items.name: Journey on Whale
items.description: The ancestor crossed the seas riding the whale and rested on the divine beast as they traveled over open water.

items.name: Song For a Friend
items.description: However, tricked by other people, the ancestor called for the whale, only for it to meet a cruel iron net.

items.name: Realization of the End
items.description: The ancestor realized this and, despite cruel punishments, broke the net to free the wounded divine beast.

items.name: Shackles of Guilt
items.description: The red blood and lamenting cries of the whale traumatized the ancestor. The man wrote the family creed and then died.

items.name: Fulfill Promises
items.description: Whitney decides to apologize to the divine whale for her ancestor. Her elders are shocked, but also agree.

items.name: Momentary Century
items.description: Whitney arrives at the Eternal Sea where her family had lived, and the crystal tower still stands in the water.

items.name: Ancient Spirit
items.description: But she has a premonition and is attracted towards the place of her hopes. All she needs is just a key.

items.name: The Promised Tide
items.description: Black waves roll up and only a small light is left with Whitney. She is not good at singing, but suddenly wants to.

items.name: Twirling Whale Song
items.description: With the girl's song, the ship rolls powerfully and a bright gold appears in the sea. Whitney falls down.

items.name: Reaching Thoughts
items.description: The divine whale answers with a song. This late apology is finally handed over to its rightful recipient.

items.name: Whale Legends
items.description: The fishing villages around the Eternal Sea still have tales about the divine whale that shimmers in the sea.

items.name: Oath of Time
items.description: Lifeforms continuously work to maintain the world, stagnating but also igniting with hope time after time.

items.name: Shelter From Wave
items.description: One day, the sea shook and the dragon princess protected others, then the oyster opened to provide refuge.

items.name: Floating Gems
items.description: The dragon princess returns to her routine, treasures the pearl oyster, and traverses the sea to help others.

items.name: Thousands of Jewels
items.description: The pearl gradually falls into her palm and shines brightly. The dragon explains this oyster is a test for her.

items.name: Dragon's Intentions
items.description: The dragon princess does not understand but the dragon only says she has to think it through herself.

items.name: Worldly Lights
items.description: The dragon told her the oyster contains a great pearl. For it to open, the princess needs a true heart.

items.name: Morning and Night
items.description: She cannot fathom what is a true heart, so she stops others from nearing the oyster, yet it doesn't open.

items.name: Momentary Chance
items.description: The animals are confused, but the turtle states the princess should not isolate the oyster, at the least.

items.name: Relieve Worries
items.description: The sea creatures crowd around the princess' bed, and she asks them what they think is a true heart.

items.name: Sea Dragon's Brilliance
items.description: All the sea creatures gossip that the playful princess no longer leaves the palace and only cares for the oyster.

items.name: Constant Thoughts
items.description: The dragon princess finally understands the dragon's intentions and becomes determined to protect the sea.

items.name: Floating Green
items.description: Bai Yin still likes to hum the songs of her childhood, though without anyone echoing her.

items.name: Couples Together
items.description: The boy in her dreams is far away. Huai Jin keeps reading the letters and manages to calm herself down.

items.name: Letters of Birds
items.description: The war is finally over but the boy does not return. Huai Jin keeps reading the letters, hoping he will return.

items.name: Dreamy Jewels
items.description: The afternoon wind with bright dusk gently touches her black hair as the beautiful girl stands.

items.name: Shining Snow
items.description: Thoughts for one's beloved fill every corner of life, and one only hopes to reunite with one's lover every year.

items.name: Accompany of Wind and Moon
items.description: How can she not worry? But she knows the boy always wanted to fight. She only smiles tearfully and bids him well.

items.name: Falling Azure Gems
items.description: He is the son of the general next door and came to visit when he did not hear laughter from her as per usual.

items.name: Light Cloud and Wind
items.description: As their destiny connects, they fall in love and imagine being together, only for war to call him away.

items.name: Floating Reeds
items.description: The horses come and go, taking away the boy and taking his letters back. These letters give her countless dreams.

items.name: Elegant Restraint - Ink
items.description: Everyone says she is mature now, but she is no longer concerned as she finds happiness in old literature.

items.name: Seeking Water - Ink
items.description: The open pages are like a door to a magic realm that slowly approaches a lost world, like a diver seeing gems.

items.name: Destined Match - Ink
items.description: The soft sound of knocking comes and Qingzhu recovers from her memories, gently closing the book in her hand.

items.name: Dreamy Mirror - Ink
items.description: A student walks in awkwardly and Qingzhu smiles when she sees the ancient literature textbook in her hands.

items.name: Elegant Restraint - Fog
items.description: Songs float in from the ocean and she seems to understand those words. The sky darkens and fog rises from the sea.

items.name: Seeking Water - Fog
items.description: Driven by curiosity, Qingzhu keeps swimming towards the fog to see a dragon spitting gems and mermaids dancing.

items.name: Destined Match - Fog
items.description: Water drops from the merpeople's tails. She catches one drop, discovering it is now a shining pearl.

items.name: Dreamy Mirror - Fog
items.description: Qingzhu stares at the sea in shock. When she wakes, she finds she is sleeping on an old book, Record of Blue Silk.

items.name: Elegant Restraint
items.description: The students stare and do not seem to believe her, but are fascinated by their teacher talking about her past.

items.name: Seeking Water
items.description: 'Does such a sea really exist?' Someone questions. Qingzhu listens to their query and recalls the sound of the sea.

items.name: Destined Match
items.description: She answers the students and then reads to them Record of Blue Silk. Every word is as beautiful as gems to her.

items.name: Dreamy Mirror
items.description: Qingzhu returns to the office and stares at her table, remembering the story about a dream, a sea, and a girl.

items.name: Time of Bloom
items.description: No need for complicated decorations. The flowers clipped into the girl's hair are already the best decoration.

items.name: Flipped Heart
items.description: No need for awkward invitations or testing words. Zoe and the youth smile at each other and decide to partner up.

items.name: Summer Handfan
items.description: Summer is sweet flowers, gentle breeze, bright dusk, and sparkling fireflies. Summer deserves to be treasured.

items.name: Throbbing Flowers
items.description: Joyful festivals brighten the summer night. Zoe pauses before a shop, as the round fan on sale fits her dress.

items.name: Time of Bloom - Vines
items.description: New flowers bloom and the boy laughs. Zoe lowers her head shyly and the flower falls into the boy's hands.

items.name: Flipped Heart - Vines
items.description: The boy puts the flower into Zoe's hair again. She blushes and turns her head away as he grins and they link hands.

items.name: Summer Handfan - Vines
items.description: The handmade fans are delicate. The boy fans Zoe, who is sleeping on his shoulder, and lets wind fly to her dreams.

items.name: Throbbing Flowers - Vines
items.description: The mountaintop is the best place to watch fireworks. Flowers bloom in the night and leave memories behind.

items.name: Time of Bloom - Afterglow
items.description: Their eyes reflect each other like the dreamy lake. Their encounters are always tied with lakes.

items.name: Flipped Heart - Afterglow
items.description: The boy is the first to say his affections. With summer passion, Zoe goes to meet her other star.

items.name: Summer Handfan - Afterglow
items.description: Summer contains many surprising encounters - gentle whispers, the boy's smile, and the girl's heartbeat.

items.name: Throbbing Flowers - Afterglow
items.description: Zoe lets her head down and the decorative flower is caressed in her hand, the boy's touch still lingers.

items.name: Colorful Vacations
items.description: 'Summer is the time to have chilled drinks! This tastes pretty good, Nikki. Do you want a try?'

items.name: Intense Fragrance
items.description: They have to dodge the maids and squeaking mice... This trip to the castle is fantastic.

items.name: Wildflowers
items.description: They manage to put together a map that shows that the Valley of Flowers is not far from the castle.

items.name: Deep Implication
items.description: Nervous and scared, Fingasie starts to sob, as someone hands her a handkerchief to wipe away her tears.

items.name: Aromatic Encounter
items.description: The girl is Laverne, an ancient painting-turned elf. Fingasie asks Laverne to take her back home.

items.name: Following Joyfully
items.description: Seeing how expectant Laverne is, Fingasie agrees, but before that, she must find a map.

items.name: Enchanting Destination
items.description: Her wings, which were painted on the canvas, have never tried to fly, but a promise is a promise.

items.name: Strong Craving
items.description: Fingasie tells her traveling stories, in which there are butterflies and flowers that fascinate Laverne.

items.name: Concealed Fragrance
items.description: The hound finally dashes toward the uninvited guests. Fingasie closes her eyes in despair.

items.name: Unfinished Journey
items.description: Fingasie looks forward to a new journey and meeting new partners along the way.

items.name: Misty Fragrance
items.description: They are upset that the map has long been torn up. Fingasie smells something like parchment.

items.name: Secret Wish
items.description: Laverne makes a secret wish to smell the sweetness of all flowers and to learn how to dance in the wind.

items.name: Ancient Painting Revival
items.description: The hound that has been tracking them reveals its fangs as Laverne decides to protect their new hope.

items.name: Gentle Dance
items.description: As if trying to get inspired by Fingasie's description, Laverne swings her wings but fails to fly.

items.name: Light Snuggling
items.description: Laverne cannot fly even with wings. She's never left the castle and cannot imitate the dance of a butterfly.

items.name: Dormant Memories
items.description: For years, no one would listen to Laverne. She doesn't want to see Fingasie in the same position.

items.name: Travel in the Air
items.description: Flowers don't just grow in flower beds but also all over the valley.

items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.description: Laverne decides to take the girl to the castle for the map. On the way, Fingasie tells her own story.

items.name: Vine's Guidance
items.description: Following her memory, Laverne travels through the castle until she collects all the map fragments.

items.name: New Journey
items.description: With the map, Laverne is so excited that she can see the flowers that are blooming in the mountains.

items.name: Light Companion
items.description: The butterflies gather around Laverne to welcome their new friend. They even start to dance joyfully.

items.name: Imminent Hope
items.description: Amid the flowers, Laverne smiles and looks forward to embarking on a new adventure with Fingasie.

items.name: Colorful Memories
items.description: Laverne takes Fingasie to the sky, where she sees mountains, streams, and beyond.

items.name: Titmice Chirping
items.description: The titmice are like elves in the forest, singing happily at treetops and calling out to their friends.

items.name: Harvest Season
items.description: The titmice are getting fledged, the squirrels are busy storing food. On the grain piles, Pine Cone drifts off.

items.name: Prayer to Flowers
items.description: In her dream, Pine Cone plucks a wildflower, which turns into golden wheat ears all over the mountain.

items.name: Golden Autumn's Gift
items.description: The basket is filled with bread made of fresh wheat flour, which attracts a naughty titmouse.

items.name: Entwined Leaves
items.description: Autumn is romantic. Pine Cone opens her treasure box to store the pinecone granted by the squirrel.

items.name: Sweet Berry Dream
items.description: The sweet berries are stewed into thick jams, the aroma of which fills the whole cabin.

items.name: Orange Melody
items.description: Perhaps the orange fruits on the branches will turn into warm lights that decorate Pine Cone's dream.

items.name: Letter from Hazelnut
items.description: The aroma of hazelnuts has given Pine Cone inspiration for cooking. But her friends are not interested.

items.name: Lantern's Signal
items.description: The berries look like clusters of small lanterns scattered in the forest, waiting to be collected.

items.name: Sweet Pistil
items.description: Fingasie feels regretful. She is worried that Laverne would be afraid to embark on a journey of her own.

items.name: Cute Little Bear
items.description: The little bear makes a wish to be even cuter. The next morning, it finds handmade bows on its round ears.

items.name: Red Berry Whispers
items.description: Rich milk and crispy bear-shaped cookies pair perfectly, filling the mouth with sweet aroma to start a lively day!

items.name: Cookie Sweet Dream
items.description: The girl enters a pastry world in dream. Cake houses, a fruit platter playground—even buns are cookie-shaped!

items.name: Endless Celebration
items.description: As night falls, countless stalls light up. After work, people gather here to enjoy the mellow beers.

items.name: Beer Carnival
items.description: Empty beer barrels lie on the ground, indicating the end of the wonderful night.

items.name: Light Chasing
items.description: The entrance to the square is packed with malt-colored balloons to invite guests.

items.name: Bottle Opening
items.description: After opening the bottle, she puts the bottle cap in her hair as decoration, which wins unanimous praise.

items.name: Center of Attention
items.description: The beer carnival is always held at this time of the year, during which she participates.

items.name: Fun Memories
items.description: The venue is dotted with distinctive stalls where you can win interesting souvenirs through games.

items.name: Cheerful Toast
items.description: Souvenirs obtained from the games are tied around her wrist to show off her achievements.

items.name: Night in Mountain
items.description: Dusk fades into a single string of light. It opens its eyes to a dark night of howling wind and starlight.

items.name: Amazing Views
items.description: So it remembers, just as the girl does. The girl laughs, and it turns its head to her, as if confused.

items.name: Departing Winds
items.description: The endless night is its domain, with the wind as its messenger. Rustling grass and cricket songs echo.

items.name: Dream of Future
items.description: Students crowd around her after class, talking about their dreams. 'Teacher! If I try hard, can I reach my dream?'

items.name: Holding Hope
items.description: 'Of course. I did.' She encourages the students with their eyes full of hope like her own teacher had done.

items.name: Soft Flower Words
items.description: Everything is so quiet. She closes her eyes and enjoys the moment. That is when she hears lilting music.

items.name: Unknown Encounter
items.description: She sees a boy in the corner. He stands next to a stone wall, holding a strange instrument. Music rings out.

items.name: Silence to the Ears
items.description: Maple bread is an autumn special, and chocolate doughnuts seem boring... The girl wants spring desserts.

items.name: Long-Haired Rabbit
items.description: She gazes far as she hopes for sudden inspiration for spring. Perhaps it might strike her this morning.

items.name: Silence to the Ears·Green
items.description: The rabbits on the lawn provide the shop's unique scenery. They have to be involved in a product for spring.

items.name: Long-Haired Rabbit·Green
items.description: The girl rubs the cute rabbit and touches the grass it frolicked in. She thinks she has a new plan.

items.name: Silence to the Ears·Purple
items.description: The big gaps between chairs are now full of customers tasting bunny mousse. Rabbits roll on the floor.

items.name: Long-Haired Rabbit·Purple
items.description: The girl behind the counter has a companion. The boy smiles and walks through the seasons with her.

items.name: Night Butterfly
items.description: Are butterflies purple? Rachel recalls the purple in her dream was soft, beautiful, calm, and mysterious.

items.name: Guided by Stars
items.description: Silvery moonlight flows through the night like silk. It decorates travelers' dreams and guides them.

items.name: Illusions in Time
items.description: The silent and quiet night is like spoiled ink, dissolving all color but fostering hope.

items.name: Radiance in Valley
items.description: Rachel finishes dyeing her skirt. Light as wings and sparkling like stars, she wears soft dreams.

items.name: Night Butterfly·Dawn
items.description: Dawn breeze should be the softest green, like new sprouts or the clear eyes of freshly awoken girls.

items.name: Guided by Stars·Dawn
items.description: The breeze parts new grass on spring lakesides and shows blooming flowers, bringing delight and radiant hope.

items.name: Illusions in Time·Dawn
items.description: The girl closes her eyes and thinks of the stars and butterflies in her dream. They give romantic dreams to all.

items.name: Radiance in Valley·Dawn
items.description: At the end, the girl records all the colors. Dreams fade, but hope grows. Colors bear the history of time.

items.name: Under Star Chapter
items.description: The one who saved her belongs to a mountain rescue team. He stays here and patrols to help and guide others.

items.name: Encounter in Frost
items.description: This clingy little snow fox was found with the girl. She hugs the fox and expresses her thanks.

items.name: Determined Heart
items.description: She decides no storm will make her hesitant or confused. She stands tall and steps onto her own path.

items.name: Under Star Chapter·Successor
items.description: The star on her hat shines as a testimony to Cynthia helping others, but she never slacks due to it.

items.name: Encounter in Frost·Successor
items.description: Fully awake, the snow fox leaps out and plays with the team. It grew with Cynthia and spent years with her.

items.name: Determined Heart·Successor
items.description: Cynthia always remembers the small but bright fire in the cave. She wants to be a light to continue the fire.

items.name: Virtual Illusions
items.description: Recently, a virtual game took the land by storm, allowing people to connect their minds to the game.

items.name: Blinding Rainbow
items.description: She never wants to be a hero or warrior in the game, satisfied with just putting her all into normal hobbies.

items.name: Speedy Charm
items.description: The last leaf falls as winter comes. The lonely girl starts the game and drowns herself in the virtual world.

items.name: New Challenge
items.description: After many failures, she lacks the courage to undergo more surgeries. She looks quietly from her wheelchair.

items.name: Virtual Illusions·Mirror
items.description: The virtual reality glass is now covered in dust. She once again finishes a round of tough rehab.

items.name: Blinding Rainbow·Mirror
items.description: Her attempts at music and roller skating all reach great outcomes. She finally understands she must face illness.

items.name: Speedy Charm·Mirror
items.description: The handheld stereo still plays a melody. She wants to keep going and gives this courage to everyone.

items.name: New Challenge·Mirror
items.description: A year later, an avatar lights up again. There are many new things she will challenge in the game with her friends.

items.name: Unique Gift
items.description: Skeleton and Phoebe make a strange scene. Some even feel the bones pull on the hem of her shirt for attention.

items.name: Demure Tea
items.description: Finally, some brave student touches the bones on Phoebe's hat. The bony hand happily waves back.

items.name: Passage of Time
items.description: Students say this friendly bony hand must be related to the strange adventure the professor never divulges.

items.name: Elegant Scholar
items.description: Phoebe is always holding her cane, which is polished by time. It accompanied her on many travels and jobs.

items.name: Unique Gift·Elegance
items.description: Phoebe believes their encounter is a gift. A friendship from the grave is always a precious memory.

items.name: Demure Tea·Elegance
items.description: When Phoebe became a professor, she sometimes wondered when she started taking history seriously.

items.name: Passage of Time·Elegance
items.description: Perhaps it was from the first encounter with Miss Skeleton. Phoebe realized history is the lives of bygone people.

items.name: Elegant Scholar·Elegance
items.description: When would she share this with her students? Probably when she retires. Phoebe wants to treasure it alone.

items.name: Unique Gift·Warmth
items.description: Phoebe read the story of a noble lady on the gravestone, who passed young and had nothing significant.

items.name: Demure Tea·Warmth
items.description: It was the first time Phoebe met the protagonist of a story. The bony hand jumped onto her knee, memories floating.

items.name: Passage of Time·Warmth
items.description: The bony hand slept for a long time till Phoebe arrived, and it thought about how not to scare her.

items.name: Elegant Scholar·Warmth
items.description: The cold words suddenly became more alive. Phoebe realized every historical piece contains a real human life.

items.name: Classic Memories
items.description: Some graves looked good as new, with legible words and even flowers before them. These had visitors.

items.name: Reminiscing
items.description: Yet some faded into obscurity, and cobwebs and weeds covered the name of the deceased. These were forgotten.

items.name: Fragrance of the Past
items.description: An older lady Madina knows is buried here. She loved bright colors and had a red rose by her window.

items.name: Eternal Rose
items.description: Madina didn't have colorful flowers. She made a fabric rose and placed it before the lady's grave.

items.name: Classic Memories·Gorgeous
items.description: Many people's lives are ordinary but also filled with emotions. How can a small gravestone contain all that?

items.name: Reminiscing·Gorgeous
items.description: Her youth, beauty, work, life, love, and all her fulfilled and unfulfilled wishes all disappear in memories.

items.name: Fragrance of the Past·Gorgeous
items.description: If possible, Madina wishes she can remember them for longer, and save those lives for as long as she can.

items.name: Eternal Rose·Gorgeous
items.description: Madina tidies up the grave, places a colorful bouquet at the lady's grave, then leaves to study.

items.name: Classic Memories·Rare
items.description: Madina helped many elders turn the memories they want preserved into intricate art.

items.name: Reminiscing·Rare
items.description: Madina also feels incredibly calm when her family passes away, as if it is only a normal farewell.

items.name: Fragrance of the Past·Rare
items.description: Lively colors appear on the roses she draws. She knows her mother loved colors, just as she does.

items.name: Eternal Rose·Rare
items.description: Madina uses her brush to portray past times, continuing the lives of the dead in a different way.

items.name: Classic Memories·Sunny
items.description: Some feel this represents the three stages of human life, some feel these are the three emotions people long for.

items.name: Reminiscing·Sunny
items.description: The three roses seem like codes Madina left for people, getting them to explore out of a desire for beauty.

items.name: Fragrance of the Past·Sunny
items.description: They are like epitaphs Madina made for herself, leaving their colors forever on history's blank slate.

items.name: Eternal Rose·Sunny
items.description: When Madina's color appears in a new design, it's like she touched the heart of others across time.

items.name: Classic Memories·Night
items.description: She sits before the window and tries to record everything with her brush, but she is carrying too much.

items.name: Reminiscing·Night
items.description: Even time is against her. Familiar faces fade in her head, and memories fade like tides.

items.name: Fragrance of the Past·Night
items.description: Three different roses are wildly scribbled on the canvas. Her mind is blank, and she is pouring everything into it.

items.name: Eternal Rose·Night
items.description: Nothing lasts forever. Madina sinks into eternal sleep with her residual regret and longing.

items.name: Data Collision
items.description: The sailors return to the sea and sing the songs written for the singer, who harmonizes from afar, echoing their sincerity.

items.name: Starlight in Waves
items.description: With the singer's protection, sailors no longer fear the unpredictable ocean. She is their undying starlight.

items.name: Starlit Guidance
items.description: On stormy nights, sailors would see her walking toward them with light above her head, pointing them in the right direction.

items.name: Bygone Lullaby
items.description: She would wave patterns of light upon the open seas. Fish and birds are her most loyal viewers, swarming to be by her side.

items.name: Data Ocean
items.description: Those she had helped spread the name of the mermaid singer on land and composed many touching songs for her.

items.name: Virtual Movement
items.description: The sailors who wanted to pay her back tried to take her to land, but she declined with a smile and disappeared.

items.name: Waves' Variations
items.description: Many lullabies are saved in the water-proof data chip. She keeps learning new songs for new visitors.

items.name: Windswept Slumber
items.description: Honeyberry would make all sorts of toys. All children come to the intersection of stories and reality.

items.name: Butterfly Murmurs
items.description: Lonely kids receive a partner. Crybabies get a laughing pumpkin. Those scared of the dark get a lamp.

items.name: New Moon Poetry
items.description: Honeyberry hopes her toys will stay with the children when they don't have family and give them warmth.

items.name: Time's Gift
items.description: Annie wants her own goat toy. She went to every shop, but not a single toy looks like her goat Fluffy.

items.name: Soft Protection
items.description: One day, Honeyberry sees a new visitor. She is a girl named Annie and has a surprising request.

items.name: Windswept Slumber·Gorgeous
items.description: Honeyberry often invites Annie over to pass a happy afternoon with tea, then asks Annie to write a story.

items.name: Butterfly Murmurs·Gorgeous
items.description: This story contains heroes and villains, with magic forests and elven lakes. Annie is immersed in this world.

items.name: New Moon Poetry·Gorgeous
items.description: But who is the protagonist? Honeyberry doesn't tell her until they've made a complete story.

items.name: Time's Gift·Gorgeous
items.description: The brave goat defeats the villains in the forest, leaving with her best friend Annie to a good end.

items.name: Soft Protection·Gorgeous
items.description: The relaxing time flows by and Honeyberry gives the story to Annie, and the protagonist is the magic goat Annabelle.

items.name: Windswept Slumber·Rare
items.description: A month later, Honeyberry leads children on an adventure. They huddle together in the dark castle.

items.name: Butterfly Murmurs·Rare
items.description: Honeyberry is prepared and has many carved pumpkins on the table. Other pumpkins light up the castle.

items.name: New Moon Poetry·Rare
items.description: Children discover in surprise that the castle has a feast inside. Was it prepared by the witch here?

items.name: Time's Gift·Rare
items.description: Honeyberry had prepared a special castle adventure in the last month. Every child is a brave soldier in the castle.

items.name: Soft Protection·Rare
items.description: The pumpkin lanterns wobble and the fear of the dark disappears. They explore seriously and find many toys.

items.name: Windswept Slumber·Berry
items.description: The girl lost many things growing up. Not everyone can be a protagonist. There was no magic in her life.

items.name: Butterfly Murmurs·Berry
items.description: An unknown lady helped her when the girl was at her lowest. She taught the girl how to make up for what's missing.

items.name: New Moon Poetry·Berry
items.description: Not every parting leads to reunion, and not every story ends well, but the time spent is the best memory.

items.name: Time's Gift·Berry
items.description: The girl became less sad and emulated that lady. That lady brought magic, and the girl now brings it to others.

items.name: Soft Protection·Berry
items.description: The lady gave the girl a teddy bear before she left, hoping the toy will be with the girl after she leaves.

items.name: Windswept Slumber·Maple
items.description: While with Honeyberry, Annie realizes the adults also send gifts, and they also harbor a fairytale.

items.name: Butterfly Murmurs·Maple
items.description: They helped Honeyberry prepare for the castle adventure. They clumsily carved pumpkin lanterns and enjoyed the fun.

items.name: New Moon Poetry·Maple
items.description: Meticulous jobs filled her boring days. Sometimes Annie feels she is weaving time for others and herself.

items.name: Time's Gift·Maple
items.description: Maybe a child will one day ask Annie to make a magic toy, and Annie will have the best magic by then.

items.name: Soft Protection·Maple
items.description: Children growing up in a fairytale start to help others. Annie takes on Honeyberry's mantle.

items.name: Sharp Bone Blades
items.description: The ageless priestess comes to the tribe on nights of the full moon, singing ancient songs and praying for peace.

items.name: Sealed Fantasies
items.description: They recreate the bonfire and try to beseech the gods with the same ritual, but no one can host the ceremony.

items.name: Gathered Light
items.description: What's so different about the priestess of the mountain? The youth regard rituals as superstition and ignore them.

items.name: Barren Wastes
items.description: As long as people sing the ancient songs, they will find the courage to face everything on their difficult journey.

items.name: Fading Oath
items.description: When those who lived through difficulties look back, they realize their children no longer have faith.

items.name: Searching for A Rose
items.description: The fertile land gradually cracks, the clear water becomes stained, and encroaching invasions destroy peace.

items.name: Reversed Time
items.description: Without the blessing of the god, this land shows its cruel face, sweeping the people before it.

items.name: Guidance of the Moon
items.description: The people build a new tribe at the oasis, lighting a bonfire every full moon to remember the guardian priestess.

items.name: End of Enigma
items.description: The elders recall how they first arrived here — it was the priestess' power that made crops grow and gave life.

items.name: Chanting Lament
items.description: As children cry at night, a tune suddenly rings out on the hills to soothe those who are suffering.

items.name: Pristine Protection
items.description: People try to visit her in regret, yet the priestess' house stands empty, forcing the tribe to abandon the land.

items.name: Broken Dawning Light
items.description: Closing their eyes, the tribe waits for final judgment, only for a silver light to pierce the darkness.

items.name: Unbroken Fate
items.description: In despair, the people gather and sing the ancient ritual song for the last time, remembering their peaceful days.

items.name: Fragile Rainbow
items.description: The priestess' figure fades with the sandstorm. Her final blessing appears as white flowers blooming on the path.

items.name: End of Eeriness
items.description: The people open their eyes in confusion, finding the priestess wielding her bow to calm this disaster.

items.name: Summer Sunlight
items.description: Xiaoqi recalls the summers of her childhood. Those memories are hidden in the depth of her mind.

items.name: A Ray of Sunlight
items.description: Xiaoqi used to believe that nothing would linger forever in her heart but has now changed her mind.

items.name: Flower Season Tour
items.description: The passing time seems to roam the streets with the wind.

items.name: Sunflower Island
items.description: Every day of the trip is so bright that the melancholy of separation is dispersed.

items.name: Ice Cream Cone
items.description: The taste of sweet strawberries and rich cream fills her mouth. The girl heads home accompanied by this pleasantry.

items.name: Ghostly Talisman
items.description: The scholar intended to greet that guy. But when he opened his eyes, he found himself in the Cloud Capital.

items.name: Unfulfilled Will
items.description: The owner of the mansion was Gu Ya, who detained evil ghosts in the mansion.

items.name: Hellish River
items.description: Ordinary people were all afraid of the ghosts in the mansion. Therefore, they would always take a detour.

items.name: Vermilion Reflection
items.description: A long time ago, a scholar passed by this place on his way to the Cloud Capital for the imperial exam.

items.name: Golden Scales
items.description: He did not dare to open his eye. Soon after, a male voice suppressed the creepy voices around.

items.name: Passage of Time
items.description: A horrifying cry petrified him. Amid the sands stirred up by the wind, he couldn't help but close his eyes.

items.name: Wind and Moon
items.description: But the closer he got to the river, the colder he felt. The silver-like river seemed to lead to hell.

items.name: Deserted Mansion
items.description: Mesmorized by the long river under the moon, the young scholar couldn't help but step forward.

items.name: River to Underworld
items.description: The water flew to the deep. Any mortal who approached it would be infected with an incurable disease.

items.name: Black Water
items.description: The river reminded him of an ancient legend. As he looked around, he found his surroundings changed.

items.name: From the Underworld
items.description: The scholar didn't know if they had a chance to meet again. Finally he bowed in the direction of Mt. Tai Chi.

items.name: Everything in the Dream
items.description: Since then, many people who heard the legend visited the mountain. Yet the Taoist never showed up again.

items.name: Song of the Heart
items.description: Step on fluffy clouds and seek stars. Even without crystal shoes, you can dance tonight when sweet dreams descend.

items.name: Wondrous Stars
items.description: The wondrous universe and the Milky Way appear - I want to explore distant worlds lightyears away and play with stars.

items.name: Colorful Memories
items.description: The wind becomes multi-colored after rain, and lights dance between clouds like stellar flowers in the sky.

items.name: Soft Sweetness
items.description: Fluffy clouds are made of the sweetest icing. Rest on them when you're tired, and sleep with the sweet scent.

items.name: Zephyr's Words
items.description: The pinwheel suddenly spins as sweetness infuses the air. Are you ready, friend? We're about to go on an adventure.

items.name: Double Achievement
items.description: Unlike in the arena and debate hall, Elaine reduces her shine when reciting poetry, becoming romantic and quiet.

items.name: Transparent Tag
items.description: At the start of the year, the poetry club invites everyone to write anonymous poems and vote for a winner.

items.name: Under the Glory
items.description: Submissions pour in and the best one soon emerges. It is gentle and charming, and all try to guess its author.

items.name: Cute Journey
items.description: Elaine covers the student's mouth and drags them toward the poetry club with a smile. She wants to read poems!

items.name: Good Times for Moon
items.description: Apart from normal moon balls, the girl also made some with new fillings. She arranges them and heads to her friends.

items.name: Splendid Rabbit
items.description: How can there be no rabbit lantern at this festival? The girl caresses it and puts her wishes into its decor.

items.name: Mannered Professional
items.description: A few years ago, Xie Jinghe's dearest brother contracted a disease, and the family could not get a cure for him.

items.name: Mid-Autumn Night
items.description: The storyteller changes the tone and indicates there may be some hope yet in this desperation.

items.name: Worshiping the Moon
items.description: In mid-autumn, the family offered goods to the moon and suddenly saw a rabbit with cassia twigs.

items.name: Floating Fragrance
items.description: The family was shocked to hear the rabbit speak and obeyed it. Soon, the man was cured, and this story was told.

items.name: Flaming Lilies
items.description: It thanked Xie Jinghe for helping a divine rabbit and says these cassia twigs used as tea will save the brother.

items.name: Cassia Fairyland
items.description: The story ends and everyone cheers for the good ending. Moonlit City is as busy as ever.

items.name: Dream Talking
items.description: Light silk drapes down for an otherworldly experience. All stress flies away in a soft comfy bed.

items.name: Bells in Valley
items.description: Leanne learns during her work that talented designers are not always good at marketing, and she runs into trouble.

items.name: Refreshing Spring
items.description: The fast-paced Apple Federation is different from Pigeon Kingdom. Efficient traders don't prioritize comfort.

items.name: Incoming Greenery
items.description: Greenery from distant kingdoms grows in the shop's garden, framed in the window like an ethereal painting.

items.name: Comforting Dreams
items.description: She wants to make the comfiest home and offer a respite for tired hearts! Lynn decides to be an interior designer.

items.name: Floating White
items.description: Lynn heads out to Apple Federation, hoping this trade paradise can help her fulfill her dream faster.

items.name: Embroidered Tassels
items.description: Inspiration overflows and Lynn smiles. Maybe this lady she had yet to meet will give her shop the pivot it needs.

items.name: Divine Bird
items.description: This medicine is marvelous and quickly cures the girl, but where is Qing? The girl decides to look for her.

items.name: Mystical Flowers
items.description: The girl dreams of Qing saying she is unwilling to leave, and promises the girl a future of freedom.

items.name: Tonight's Dream
items.description: The girl wants to tell Qing that her life still has good moments, the best being meeting Qing.

items.name: Moon on the Pavilion
items.description: The next evening, an elder suddenly visits, bringing a medicine Qing had created to cure the girl.

items.name: Fog on Mountain
items.description: The divine bird recovers in a month and the girl takes her back. The bird's teal form flies off.

items.name: Reasons of Lily
items.description: Later, someone knocks on the sick girl's door. She calls herself Qing and says she's a neighbor.

items.name: Genuine Heart
items.description: The girl is fascinated by the world Qing describes. Her sickly form can only go to the river before her door.

items.name: Moon in River
items.description: Qing asks the girl to see the world with her, but the girl smiles and says none can cure her body.

items.name: Confident Ascension
items.description: The girl grows frailer by the day, yet always smiles at Qing. Qing silently makes a decision.

items.name: Late Wind
items.description: The girl doesn't even wince when she drinks bitter medicine, saying she is used to this taste.

items.name: Song of Courage
items.description: A small blue flag finally pops up in the distance. It waves twice, then quickly disappears into the night.

items.name: Flame Breaking Dawn
items.description: Waiting is always hard. Agata and her army hide and feel excited despite the cold evening wind.

items.name: The Light of Victory
items.description: Soon, there's the sound of driving across ice. With no transport, League Tyr's logistics have to cross here.

items.name: Age of Glory
items.description: Agata looks more firm. She grabs her sword and listens to determine the distance. 50 meters... 30 meters...

items.name: Fearless Blade
items.description: The vanguard cannot come back, or League Tyr will notice. If they fail... the vanguard will be all that remains.

items.name: Scorching Fields
items.description: Agata sees blue light cover the sky. She knows what she will be facing, but she does not stop.

items.name: Ruler of Destiny
items.description: The vanguards find League Tyr. The small blue flags are concealed and can only be seen from certain locations.

items.name: Chilly Wind
items.description: Agata doesn't move, and the soldiers with her all remain as they are, as if they never saw anything.

items.name: Age of Honor
items.description: 'Crack.' The ice snaps. League Tyr troops fall into chaos as the ice unexpectedly starts to break.

items.name: Light Shining Night
items.description: That's all the alliance needs to surround them. The logistic troops don't even get to send a distress signal.

items.name: Elegant Form
items.description: Rae-Anne returns to her studio after a busy day, only daring to relax after the last assistant leaves.

items.name: Every Second Matters
items.description: Time is money in Apple Federation, the 'Commercial Paradise.' Rae-Anne's schedule is packed and always ready.

items.name: Shining Moment
items.description: All glamour in life depends on grounded, hard work. Only by shedding sweat and tears can one reach the pinnacle.

items.name: Ahead of Fashion
items.description: Cameras go off as Rae-Anne lifts her head. As long as she remains proud, she will be at the forefront of fashion.

items.name: Revitalizing Scent
items.description: Rumor says that Rae-Anne is very harsh with other people, and she does not allow even the smallest mistake.

items.name: Splendid Dreams
items.description: Rae-Anne wraps her cloak around herself. She thinks of her new home, which is only missing some interior design.

items.name: With the Times
items.description: Rae-Anne won't waste even one minute. She reads newspapers between projects to keep up with fashion trends.

items.name: Perfectionist
items.description: Rae-Anne must control everything. There is no 'passing grade' for her. She must make everything perfect.

items.name: Immaculate Aura
items.description: Rae-Anne views sites to quickly pick a designer. She just needs simple designs to meet her working-from-home needs.

items.name: Delightful Greens
items.description: Some tall plants quietly stand in the corner of the simple studio, showing aloof pride like their owner.

items.name: Latest News
items.description: Exhausted after the day, Rae-Anne dials the number, but the name she hears isn't the shop she expects.

items.name: Hymn of Dawn
items.description: Darkness seems to swallow all, and the silent night indicates death to all things. However, dawn will come.

items.name: Exuded Tenderness
items.description: No one knows if Yoyo studied that magic book... To get an answer, you may try to use dried minnows.

items.name: Unopened Chapter
items.description: Yoyo has a long way to go before she becomes the world's best, but she has done a lot to help others.

items.name: Fairy Tale Trip
items.description: The cat replied that it was going to the cloudy universe, which required more than 100 dried minnows.

items.name: Fantasy Murmurs
items.description: With the spell book left by grandma, she aspires to become the best magician!

items.name: Across Cloud Realm
items.description: The cat was attracted by Yoyo's promise to 'make every wish come true'.

items.name: Warm Morning Light
items.description: Yoyo was not able to fulfill its wish, of course. She could only buy a bag of dried minnows for it.

items.name: Sweet Gifts
items.description: Yoyo wondered why the cat needed so many dried minnows. Perhaps it was about to embark on a journey.

items.name: Magic Key
items.description: The cat stayed silent for a moment before it asked how Yoyo fulfilled people's wishes before.

items.name: Soft Cloud Voice
items.description: Yoyo failed to get dried minnows for the cat. But she guessed that grandma's book will be loved by the cat.

items.name: Secret Words of Time
items.description: The cat stayed in town. It may leave anytime, but it just couldn't leave Yoyo behind.

items.name: Wandering Mind
items.description: Sayu shared the spell book with the cat and assured it that the book includes the most powerful magic.

items.name: Fantastic Journey
items.description: When you see the cat, you can drop it a piece of dried minnow, so that it will take you to Yoyo.

items.name: Capricious Gemini
items.description: Over time, the girl's theatrical soul possesses a personality. She is able to talk, listen, or debate.

items.name: Truth in Dreams
items.description: The townsfolk are amazed by her perseverance toward theater but laugh at her 'other soul.'

items.name: Awakening Soul
items.description: Whenever she performs, the other soul would wake. It would move and change with the characters' moods and actions.

items.name: Prayer Manifestation
items.description: This soul should be connected to her passion and desire for theater, a manifestation of her dream to be accepted.

items.name: Breeze Brings Goodness
items.description: Every time she herds sheep to the mountains, the breeze passes her songs to the villagers and soothes them.

items.name: Flowers of the Heart
items.description: With the soul to help her practice, the girl is not alone in her pursuit and understands the art of the theater.

items.name: Admiration Song
items.description: She fully expresses her admiration toward gods. Every character, dance, song, and expression of hers is perfect.

items.name: Called by Divines
items.description: Light flows out of the divine mountain and wraps around the girl, taking her to the gods' realm as Gemini.

items.name: Melody of Berries
items.description: Interwoven colors and happy tunes create the fantasy she had recounted many times to her lover.

items.name: Stainless Heart
items.description: The girl finally sees the boy before the carousel. He shyly gives her a red flower, like he is offering his heart.

items.name: Willow Gazes
items.description: Her homeland's murmur echoes in her head. It is the night wind she alone heard and the ever-flowing water...

items.name: Floating Lamp Dreams
items.description: Then, the dawn comes and pours light on her. She says she will go far away to see new mountains and towns.

items.name: Embroidered Pouch
items.description: The unique symbol on the bag has a lovely story. It is a pure wish sewn from moonlight by a girl.

items.name: Evernight Prayers
items.description: Fog covers the moon, and night silently spreads. The girl prays in the empty hall for the wandering travelers.

items.name: Pitch-Black Style
items.description: Classic colors, simple shapes. This is the Apple Apparel Group's latest project, spearheading a different trend!

items.name: Evening Star Glitter
items.description: Under the moonlight, only a few stars glitter. The girl quickly traverses this silent city.

items.name: Flower in Time
items.description: Humans desire roses for their beauty and form, but none can pluck this one and claim it as their own.

items.name: Crystallized Jewel
items.description: But all roses die and beautiful faces grow old. Monesa is troubled by her fading and transient beauty.

items.name: Dreamy Rose in a Painting
items.description: Admiring the girl's beauty, famous artists of the capital paint her on canvas to ensure this rose never wilts.

items.name: Evenglow Halls
items.description: The young artist pours all his love into the white canvas, and a rose-colored bird passes through the spring air.

items.name: Fragrant Rosy Dreams
items.description: Monesa receives the painting. She and the girl on the canvas are equally beautiful as if the rose is a mirage.

items.name: Bizarre Pumpkin
items.description: Werid pumpkins were placed in yard. The girl put her beloved toy skeleton beside them. Let them enjoy party!

items.name: Encounter in Autumn
items.description: Brown fruits fall and make thuds on the ground. If you pick them up, will brave squirrels come seeking?

items.name: Forest Echoes
items.description: The burrow is full, and the squirrels are satisfied. They happily run in the forest in golden autumn light.

items.name: Sleep on Pillow
items.description: Frost descends and squirrels no longer travel the frozen land. They rub their eyes and return to their burrows.

items.name: Hidden Spring
items.description: The squirrels start to sleep. These fruits holding bright sunlight will accompany them till spring returns.

items.name: Traceless Feathers
items.description: A clear chirp rings out. Ming Shuiyuan looks up to see a bird gracefully spreading its wings toward the blue sky.

items.name: Clear Sight
items.description: A beam of inspiration disperses the mist in her heart. Her night-long work on the mech bird exudes unmatched charm.

items.name: Personality of Jade
items.description: Wind stirs petals across the courtyard. The wooden bird rests under the eaves as the girl focuses on new designs.

items.name: Letters of Dawn
items.description: Outside the window, a crow shot to the sky. Its wings cut the dark clouds, and light were shed upon the town.

items.name: Scarlet Legend
items.description: Everyone'd heard of the rumours, but no one had ever seen misfortune. The stories scattered in the boy's heart.

items.name: A Touch of Autumn
items.description: He's grown up, and it's time to solve the mystery. The boy gazed into the steaming syrup and made up his mind.

items.name: Red Moon Crystal
items.description: With full-moon high and maples red, the boy set off for the forest. He went lost in mist and almost fell off the cliff.

items.name: Exorcism Array
items.description: He thought of the elderly's saying: Sweetness may attract envy and evil, so maple town wasn't good for living.

items.name: Night Dream Feather
items.description: Misfortune did not happen. The boy opened his eyes to see the figure of a girl waving a thin fan, dispelling the mist.

items.name: Sweet Night Dreams
items.description: Not understanding her meaning, the boy fell asleep. When he woke up again, he was back home. It was dawn.

items.name: Interwoven Thoughts
items.description: The dreamweaving magician made many dreams and a sincere wish for herself. Ray finally fulfills her dreams.

items.name: Soft Sweet Dreams
items.description: The Magic League formalizes, and young magicians pick up their hope again. Ray wove the best dream.

items.name: Overlapping Dreams
items.description: The League's founder is mysterious, yet many have seen her magical vessel — a unique black cat plush.

items.name: Meow Messenger
items.description: A few years ago, Ray and some apprentices knocked on the Magic Association's door, but only the best were hired.

items.name: Duo-Colored Stars
items.description: Ray is the dreamweaving magician's apprentice. She fulfilled wishes and resolved regrets, just like her teacher.

items.name: Cloudy Imagination
items.description: The others were taken in, but Ray was surprisingly rejected. This outstanding magician then disappeared.

items.name: Flowing Light Wishes
items.description: All magicians long for the Magic Association. Its golden doors signal peerless power and glory.

items.name: Dream-Weaving Toy
items.description: Every year, magicians try their best to be admitted, yet the Association's golden doors gather dust.

items.name: Long Road of Time
items.description: The ancient power and complicated rules deter many, and the critical teachers scold youth and drive them out.

items.name: Meow Gifts
items.description: The genius Ray only managed to make a small dent in the history of magic, and her story was soon forgotten.

items.name: Meow Poet
items.description: Meanwhile, the mysterious Magic League starts up and welcomes all magicians. Many talents join and make it famous.

items.name: Meow Special
items.description: Tears and sweat soak her dreams, and only the black cat plush supports her. It sees Ray through difficult times.

items.name: Pristine Flower Crown
items.description: Driven by a desire to prove her parents wrong or to honor her younger self, Pololo keeps dancing.

items.name: Cloud in Prosperity
items.description: Pololo performs as a background dancer in her first-year showcase only for a few minutes, but her dream feels real.

items.name: Hanging Feather
items.description: Like an innocent swan, Pololo believes she will one day become the stage's protagonist.

items.name: Pristine Flower Crown - Gorgeous
items.description: Pololo is still a background dancer in a plain dress when she graduates, supporting the protagonist.

items.name: Cloud in Prosperity - Gorgeous
items.description: Pololo leaves with many regrets. She recognizes who she is and leaves the school with her dreams.

items.name: Hanging Feather - Gorgeous
items.description: Praise is always given to the protagonist. No one notices when a small swan leaves the stage.

items.name: Hanging Feather - Rare
items.description: When dancing is not a job but a hobby, the happy little swan can still feel joy.

items.name: Pristine Flower Crown - Rare
items.description: The protagonists wear the dresses Pololo designed and portray many romantic stories that enrapture people.

items.name: Cloud in Prosperity - Rare
items.description: Pololo also dances a little when she doesn't work. This isn't a performance — it is only for relaxation.

items.name: Hanging Feather - Dusk
items.description: A swan has left the stage, but it helps many other dancers to emerge. The swan will still be happy!

items.name: Cloud in Prosperity - Dusk
items.description: Pololo realizes she almost repeated her parents' mistake by forcing her own daughter onto a specific path.

items.name: Pristine Flower Crown - Dusk
items.description: 'I love dancing, but not as a career. If I work with Mom, I can show more people the beauty of dance.'

items.name: Time Illusion
items.description: You are...,' the boy seemed to understand. The girl turned, covering her smile with the feather fan, 'sorry. It's time.'

items.name: Calling by Name
items.description: Names mean nothing to the Winged. They live alone and have no need to address each other, ignoring names.

items.name: Breath of Nature
items.description: The Winged need no language or history. Their words come from birds and sounds of nature.

items.name: Glazed Memoirs
items.description: They spend their whole life writing one poem to record the views they see, and everyone hums a song to time.

items.name: The Last Eulogy
items.description: Death is a beautiful end of the story. Everyone will head to that silent end. The Winged want no regrets.

items.name: Newborn Prelude
items.description: Life is the first note that wakes everyone. The Winged wake alone and pay no attention to anyone else.

items.name: All Are Reborn
items.description: All magic medicines can be made by the Winged through the golden fire they control naturally.

items.name: Pitch-Black Ritual
items.description: When coarse and ugly notes interrupt songs, the Winged decide to change this situation, regardless of price.

items.name: Truth Untold
items.description: The birds can understand the Winged and know their desires. They are willing to fly with the Winged.

items.name: Gloom and Decay
items.description: Maybe there's more to life's poem beyond the black mist, or it is eternal silence. The Winged head to their goal.

items.name: Flowers in the Rainbow
items.description: With blooming purple lilies of the valley, the fairies fly over the rainbow to the human world in search of dew.

items.name: Genuine Tears
items.description: It is said that human tears form the holy dew, and fairies gain power from appeasing such sorrow.

items.name: Silent Days
items.description: The fairies keep bringing happiness to people on this bright land, and their necklaces finally fill with dew.

items.name: Crystal Clear
items.description: They gather the dew together and prepare to return home, but chance upon a blind girl dancing alone.

items.name: Fragrant Blooms
items.description: The children previously considered young and weak can now change the weather and bloom the flowers in the garden.

items.name: Jeweled Heart
items.description: The pinnacle of a fairy's journey is to have a diamond heart. Having seen mortal woes, their hearts indeed changed.

items.name: Bottle of Dreams
items.description: The girl is dressed in poor clothes yet does not make a wish to the fairies, only saying others need the help more.

items.name: Fleeting Mortal Ties
items.description: The Duan mansion finally falls into ruin. Those happy days rest deep in her memories with bygone poems.

items.name: Lonely Hill
items.description: As trouble goes on, the prune tree in the yard is no longer attended to, and the gardens fall into disrepair.

items.name: Poems of the Past
items.description: Duan Yue gradually understands her grandma's poems. Past glories fade into tiny streams as time flows.

items.name: Clouded Whispers
items.description: Young and naive, Duan Yue lives through dark times as cruel reality rushes at her without the glamour of wealth.

items.name: Steady Flower
items.description: Her heart is tenacious despite her spoiled childhood, and she becomes a famous antique dealer.

items.name: Fog on the Hills
items.description: Mere decorations are given profound meaning in the turmoils of the world, carrying human memories and lives.

items.name: Echoing Hills
items.description: Duan Yue moves on, knowing that all shall return to a simple end. Grandma would be proud of her.

items.name: Collected Beauty
items.description: Duan Yue takes good care of antiques, just like her grandma did. She had unconsciously taken up this hobby.

items.name: Card Battle
items.description: The cards the Red Queen scatters pick up sharp gems to make spears and line up to be her impressive guards.

items.name: Apple Castle
items.description: The red apple from her hand miraculously grows into tall castles that stand in the wind.

items.name: Flame in Snow
items.description: Roses do not bloom in winter, but because of the Queen's invite, all roses arrive and bloom in the castle.

items.name: Dancing Staircase
items.description: The dancing rose petals become girls in red as the Queen's wand touches them. They play music and dance.

items.name: Red Spade Crown
items.description: The Red Queen has many hair ornaments, but still wears her favorite ruby crown to show her power at formal parties.

items.name: Sparkling Gem
items.description: Sometimes, she wants to see red snow. She levitates a ruby and shines it on the snow.

items.name: Scarlet Secret
items.description: She prepares masks with red and white clothes for the visitors so as not to disrupt the colors in the hall.

items.name: Crimson Treasure
items.description: The marvelous gems on her fingertips are a memory of feasts. She gives them to visitors for a good memory.

items.name: Conductor's Hand
items.description: Snow fairies brush off snow from the visitors and lead them to the feast, tending to guests' every need.

items.name: Frost & Snow Magic
items.description: Invited guests arrive via flying chariot or teleportation portal, not leaving any signs on the snow.

items.name: Wand of Majesty
items.description: The Red Queen was born with her power, but she feels it looks more elegant and powerful to wave a wand.

items.name: Glorious Starfire
items.description: Even at night, her palace needs no light. Gems and snow reflect the moonlight and illuminate all corners.

items.name: Laughing Banquet
items.description: The wine glasses hold molten snow, and the guests converse elegantly as laughter rings over snow.

items.name: Magic Feast
items.description: After the feast, the Red Queen waves her wand and removes all traces of her miracle, but people remember.

items.name: Frozen Bloom
items.description: For the long-lived Animus, all appear naive. They do not look down on lives and equally love all.

items.name: Crystal-Clear Ice
items.description: There's an ancient myth in the Glazed World that black mist sits above the sky and will slowly corrode it.

items.name: Forgotten Snow Plains
items.description: The black mist also conceals a terrifying truth, and the masks will drive the mist to destroy the Glazed World.

items.name: Lost Butterfly Fog
items.description: Many races live in this art-like world, and they develop and grow into their different fates.
