items.name: Playing Tricks
items.description: Patty makes countless people laugh, but they can't remember her name, referring to her as 'the girl with red hair.'

items.name: Swinging Rope
items.description: Patty knows how to captivate the audience. She acts mysterious, then reveals surprises at unexpected times.

items.name: Agile Wings
items.description: The Magician unties her white hair ribbon and a snow-white dove flies to the Heiress, bringing her hope.

items.name: Unresolved Cliffhanger
items.description: The Heiress's escape ushers in the show's climax. As the audience gasps, the Magician jumps off the stage.

items.name: Comical Performance
items.description: The angry clown reaches out to grab the Heiress in vain, thwarted by the countless dolls conjured by the Magician.

items.name: Echoing Applause
items.description: The audience can't help but laugh. The theater is filled with joy as the applause rings out like thunder.

items.name: Ring of Faith
items.description: The Magician takes the Heiress's hand. They walk on the steel cable, releasing the free white dove together.

items.name: Curtain Call Afterglow
items.description: The Heiress and Magician were met with applause. Their journey had ended, but Patty and Merida's had only begun.

items.name: Countryside Tune
items.description: Ducky is a little duck who is familiar with the forest. He finds the best apples in the forest for Ninari.

items.name: Delicious Symphony
items.description: With every bite, the apples and crust perform a lovely symphony on your tongue, and the cream acts as an interlude.

items.name: Sweet Harvest
items.description: In the fall, the forest is full of ripe fruit. Ninari meets many cute animals as she searches for apples.

items.name: Red Apple Duck
items.description: With the help of her animal friends, Ninari picks out the most beautiful apples. She carves them into cute shapes.

items.name: Sweet Secret
items.description: What's wrong with red apples and heartfelt desserts? Ninari experienced failure before discovering the key.

items.name: Mental Cage
items.description: Merida uses the castle's windowsill to rehearse. Dancing until the moon appears, she is struck with inspiration.

items.name: Antique Marionette
items.description: Merida and Patty visit the legendary castle museum. Inspired by the structure, they make beautiful marionettes.

items.name: Midnight Whispers
items.description: A white dove falls into the Heiress's arms, transforming into a key. Its light radiates the temptation of freedom.

items.name: Threadbare
items.description: The Heiress tears off the threads, jumping out of the cage. Merida falls as the audience holds their breath.

items.name: Reason for Balance
items.description: Merida calmly hooked the steel cable with her foot as she fell. Her body spun slightly, then stopped in midair.

items.name: Scarlet Glory
items.description: The audience erupted in applause at Merida's incredible performance, praising the Heiress's courage.

items.name: Thread of Fate
items.description: No longer controlled by the thread, the Heiress takes the Magician's hand and steps onto the thin steel cable.

items.name: Continued Luminance
items.description: Cassia's determination is unstoppable! She plans to eavesdrop outside the classroom and read late into the night.

items.name: Bookworm
items.description: The words are intertwined with already possessed knowledge. Cassia has found joy in reading medical scrolls.

items.name: Studious Fanatic
items.description: Cassia begins to understand the way of recognizing greenery and continues her fight against illness.

items.name: Unbound Obsession
items.description: Sometimes Cassia falls asleep while reading. She will wake up to find a blanket over her and the lights put out.

items.name: Fluttering Horseweed
items.description: It's nice being human. Cassia decides to never wander the wild again and permanently stay at Farewell Pharmacy!

items.name: Enchanted Divinity
items.description: Yunshi is cold and distant, but after some time, Cassia finds her to be hard on the outside and soft on the inside.

items.name: Dedicated Academics
items.description: Unable to say no, Yunshi agrees to take her as an apprentice if she finishes ten books in the allotted time.

items.name: Priceless Words
items.description: The only word Cassia can write is her name. Yunshi is the one that taught her. Medical scrolls will be a challenge.

items.name: Hidden Wisdom
items.description: Humans engraved pictures on bamboo strips to represent various meanings. Cassia is amazed by what she sees.

items.name: Numbed Heart
items.description: Experiencing many goodbyes, Yunshi thought she'd never feel again. The sight of an ill young man still saddens her.

items.name: Cabinet of Treasures
items.description: Yunshi can feel the life in every herb. After processing, even ordinary herbs thrive.

items.name: Unexpected Cure
items.description: Before Yunshi's transformation, death was normal for her. She became conscious and learned of the cruelty of time.

items.name: Farewell, My Love
items.description: Yunshi holds his frail hand and sees her reflection in his eyes. No questions were asked. He knew her sacrifices.

items.name: Breeze of Kindness
items.description: Yunshi became curious about the world after hearing the young man's stories. She sets out to see the world.

items.name: Measured Time
items.description: As she travels, she returns to the pharmacy every few years. The young man has never lost the smile on his face.

items.name: Priceless Formula
items.description: The pharmacy has a special place in Yunshi's heart. The two can talk about medicine all day and still feel content.

items.name: Bitter Lifesaver
items.description: Greenery usually return to their roots, but Yunshi views her 'roots' as Farewell Pharmacy instead of the mountains.

items.name: Chest of Wishes
items.description: The city-state was powerless in the end. The final survivor went to the temple, wanting to turn back time.

items.name: Midnight Heart
items.description: Deserters spread rumors about the temple, attracting other rulers. They secretly formed armies to investigate.

items.name: Abyssal Shadow
items.description: The survivor realized that unless he killed the girl, everything he did would still lead to the same conclusion.

items.name: Hand of Desire
items.description: Some rushed to make wishes, some fled the city. It was as if the devil's hands were manipulating everything here.

items.name: Winter's Chant
items.description: The girl sat in the temple, emotionless. The sound of singing and dancing could be heard from the capital's square.

items.name: Sleep Talking
items.description: Merchants realized they didn't have to work to make money. No one wanted to serve the rich and powerful anymore.

items.name: Unexpected Storm
items.description: Those in power blocked off the temple, and others secretly acted as guards to obtain this priceless power.

items.name: Chaotic Path
items.description: Countless people were killed, then revived by magic. The magnificent capital was in chaos.

items.name: Shifting Undercurrent
items.description: Money had no meaning. Only those in power could make wishes, and the desires of others turned into bloody crimes.

items.name: Sweet Heartbeat
items.description: The girl pushes open the shop's door and sees the boy standing in the alley. She boldly takes his hand.

items.name: Bird Shepherd
items.description: After the swallow's injury recovered, her mate came to her. Lady Lashani held a feast to send them off.

items.name: Flower Bed
items.description: Legend says a mysterious witch, Lady Lashani, lives in the mountains. She can communicate with plants and trees.

items.name: Floral Pillars
items.description: Spring comes to an end. Lady Lashani looks upon withered roses in her garden and whispers the swallow's song.

items.name: Crown of Light
items.description: Lady Lashani is alone in everything she does. She enjoys afternoon tea in the garden, watching the roses by herself.

items.name: Speechless Radiance
items.description: Lady Lashani slowly studies the language of plants. She has a long time to listen to each flower's tiny voice.

items.name: Floral Beauty
items.description: The swallow sings every song she knows for Lady Lashani. With the roses' translation, the Lady understood.

items.name: Frolicking Rhythm
items.description: A stage showing wondrous places with music appeared in Bona's plans. She wants to express her feelings herself.

items.name: Wandering Chapter
items.description: The echoing music made her think. Music records people's hopes for the future, and technology realizes them.

items.name: River of Notes
items.description: Luminescent lights appear whenever Bona's conductor's baton waves. Bona smiles and weaves rivers of music.

items.name: Mechanical Pipes
items.description: Bona leads people across time and space with music and traverses new eras. The future is vibrant and delightful.

items.name: Iridescent Stars
items.description: 'Future' draws people to Bona's performances. Lights and stellar butterflies combine to give shape to the future.

items.name: Incredible Thoughts
items.description: She's been tasked with programming since childhood, and Bona always revolutionized her delivered projects.

items.name: Art of Display
items.description: Music is a singer's language, like code for a programmer. Bona lays out rows of code and completes the stage.

items.name: Rhythmic Guidance
items.description: Bona collects many music pieces to develop the acoustic module, entrancing her in her small studio.

items.name: Gap in Reality
items.description: The virtual Bona is a popular idol, while Bona in reality is a coder from Ruin Island skilled at programming.

items.name: Dazzling Butterflies
items.description: A future full of possibilities contains countless hope, which is what draws people to Bona's songs.

items.name: Transparent Thoughts
items.description: Bona is refreshed in classical music and rejuvenated in pop, seeing infinite hope in different genres.

items.name: Wings of Future
items.description: The wings behind the idol Bona also represent the programmer's dream that hope will carry humans into the future.

items.name: Spacetime Imprint
items.description: Bona sings. The butterfly's wings shiver and people take on new travels to hyperspace in its breeze.

items.name: Frost Blade
items.description: The first dragon rider had lost her companion, and many other lives were lost in the never-ending battle.

items.name: Final Frostbone
items.description: The long war left the land in ruins. One day, a glowing, skeletal creature appeared on the battlefield.

items.name: Prayer of Light
items.description: Time went by, and her little dragon grew up. Many people learned the language of the Dragon Clan.

items.name: Sound and Shadow
items.description: Dragons love shiny things, and Zoe's dragon stared at the jewel in her palm as her tail wagged.

items.name: Mirrored Dawn
items.description: War descended as Zoe's dragon mourned its fallen friend. Zoe tried to stop the conflict, but people turned on her.

items.name: Deep-Sea Revelation
items.description: Humans cannot bear the wrath of dragons, and the dragon knight's warning had been lost, dooming the land.

items.name: Midnight Light
items.description: Greedy evildoers trapped a lone dragon in search of treasure. A group of dragons came at the sound of its cries.

items.name: Aqua Pearl
items.description: The children playing by the city walls are taken home by adults, wondering why they can't approach the dragon.

items.name: Divine Robes
items.description: Zoe ordered her dragon to leave, but it disobeyed her and rushed toward the crowd attacking her.

items.name: Fresh Supreme
items.description: A day goes by in the blink of an eye. Time is fleeting, but no matter what, the silent love remains intact.

items.name: Truthful Protection
items.description: His sacrifices continue in silence. It's only when we grow up and look back do we hear the unspoken words of love.

items.name: Tireless Trek
items.description: The stacks of homework and notebooks are the most precious souvenirs from all those years of hard work.

items.name: Words of Resolution
items.description: Written in the words are the memorized answers and years of diligence and aspiration for a bright future.

items.name: Jar of Wishes
items.description: The raccoon shook its head and spun thrice. In a flash of color, the girl gasped—a wondrous scene appeared.

items.name: Nectar Essence
items.description: The orchard gleamed. Fruit hung full, juice flowed through stones, and the girl heard the trees softly sing.

items.name: Crisp Enchantment
items.description: As dusk fell, the girl packed up alone. Then, in the orchard’s corner, something flashed and vanished.

items.name: Harvest Melody
items.description: She welcomed her first harvest. That day, a gentle autumn breeze brushed her hair—just like her grandmother's touch.

items.name: Delicate Sweetness
items.description: She bonded with the trees and learned her grandma’s cake recipe—to share with a special friend.

items.name: Warm Embrace
items.description: It was a fluffy raccoon with a striped tail—wait, it had Grandma’s handmade apron in its mouth!

items.name: Crystal Sweetheart
items.description: The apple was bright red—just like those Grandma once grew. The girl glanced at the raccoon, puzzled and curious.

items.name: Faerie Voyage
items.description: The girl chased it into the woods. Just as she pressed on, the raccoon stopped and tossed her an apple.

items.name: Blossom Pact
items.description: During a break, a raccoon brought her a fragrant cake. She took a bite—it was Grandma’s fruit mille-feuille!

items.name: Silky Splendor
items.description: A bamboo basket floated down the glittering river, and upon a closer look, Anya saw a bunny lying in it.

items.name: Gleaming Fluff
items.description: The basket floated up and down with the weak bunny quivering helplessly inside. Anya immediately held it in her arms.

items.name: Lovely Snowball
items.description: The bunny lay in her arms, trembling unconsciously. Anya's heart ached when she saw a ghastly wound in its leg.

items.name: Silky Splendor - Heart
items.description: The bunny suddenly stood up, the worn cushion anew in a flash of light and twirling around her in the air.

items.name: Gleaming Fluff - Heart
items.description: Anya felt the worry in the bunny's tone and nodded. It patted her, a starlight mark appearing in the palm of her hand.

items.name: Lovely Snowball - Heart
items.description: Anya and the talking bunny teamed up. She even sewed a cape for it and set out with it riding on the flying cushion.

items.name: Dream-Weaving Flowers
items.description: Peachy tulle flowers decorate the white dress with gorgeous shape and movement, showcasing the designer's skill.

items.name: Childhood Innocence
items.description: With much wine in her stomach, she strode confidently to challenge the girl but fell asleep in the backyard instead.

items.name: Artless Shifting
items.description: She sneered at the free lunch, head held high, but still gorged on the food before falling asleep soundly.

items.name: Brisk Chime
items.description: In her dreams, she was still a naughty tanuki a few months ago. No one could keep a rein on her despite her pranks.

items.name: Dangling Leaves
items.description: The girl was always friendly to her and even gifted her a leaf umbrella, which sheltered her from many rains.

items.name: Clear Moonshine
items.description: She strode to the village when the girl smiled and shared food and wine with her instead. She was drunk in no time.

items.name: Bamboo Dewdrop in Breeze
items.description: She didn't live in the bamboo shelter the girl built because of pride, but she would often take naps inside.

items.name: Springwater Relish
items.description: It was the tanuki's prized homebrew with an intoxicating smell, a treasure only shared with true friends.

items.name: Guardian Tanuki
items.description: The clever girl caught her in one try and then set her free after knowing she didn't mean harm. What a peculiar human.

items.name: Fuzzy Sway
items.description: Seeing the girl in her sleep, she blushed, aborted the plan to pull pranks, hopped out of the window and ran home.

items.name: Wisteria Charm
items.description: Mira used to make childish designs with wisteria, which sparked her decision to leave home and pursue her dream.

items.name: Ripple of Vines
items.description: Her parents have sent a letter with wisteria blooms. Away from home, Mira shares the same beautiful view with them.

items.name: Echoes of Truth
items.description: Mona loves the town and her life. It's quiet and peaceful, as if the world was filled with goodness at every moment.

items.name: Puzzle Solver
items.description: Through thin clouds, the silver moon shines on the empty streets, as she pursues the truth among the shadows.

items.name: Case Breakdown
items.description: The culprit is in handcuffs when she catches up, and a handsome officer tips his hat, 'Detective, you're late again.'

items.name: Brocade in Spring
items.description: Walking through the alleys with friends at dawn, sounds can be heard from the academy. Spring is a time to study.

items.name: Enchanting Zither Song
items.description: The strings of the zither tangle as kites fly low. One suddenly breaks, floating in the wind, then disappearing.

items.name: Splendid Cut
items.description: Sadness is a farewell, and melancholy is common. Why try to grow up when you can fly kites and look at the sky?

items.name: First Blossom
items.description: Some sigh, but some children celebrate that the kite is free. A childlike heart is something unique to this world.

items.name: Drifting Butterfly
items.description: Paper butterflies can surf the wind and land on clouds. Joyful and happy, they return to dance like flying fairies.

items.name: Song of the Fairies
items.description: Colorful kites float into the sky. Ever present is the desire to be a bird kite, soaring over rivers and mountains.

items.name: Devout Blossom
items.description: Elba immersed herself in books, where she saw rivers and seas, deserts and forests, like blooms scattered in text.

items.name: Dozing Grace
items.description: Elba received interviews and commissions as her words had spoken to many, but it was then she hit writer's block.

items.name: Forgotten Chapter
items.description: The once fluent flow of words was no more and the fascinating ideas turned into single notes that made no tunes.

items.name: Reverie Brushes
items.description: Elba would stay in her room for a whole day without progress, to the point where she considered giving up writing.

items.name: Wondrous Fantasy
items.description: Her friend brought her the latest product of the Apple Apparel Group, said to create beautiful dreams for the user.

items.name: Devout Blossom - Dream
items.description: Fragmented stories pieced together the only truth. Elba came to her fictional world and met the protagonist, Sui.

items.name: Dozing Grace - Dream
items.description: It was a time of war and conflicting ideas, breeding worries, but also hopes and heroes in the dark before dawn.

items.name: Forgotten Chapter - Dream
items.description: Elba moved from place to place, as thrilling scenes from her books unfolded before her own eyes.

items.name: Reverie Brushes - Dream
items.description: She followed Sui through gunfire in alleyways and over towering mountains, feeling as free as a bird.

items.name: Wondrous Fantasy - Dream
items.description: In dreams, Elba walked the earth and grew alongside Sui in battles, blossoming like a flower atop mountains.

items.name: Devout Blossom - Still
items.description: Every word she wrote hopped out and glowed the brilliance of dream and freedom as if they came to life.

items.name: Dozing Grace - Still
items.description: Elba tightened her grip on the pen with a clear answer in mind. She would write the most fitting ending for Sui.

items.name: Forgotten Chapter - Still
items.description: She will never give up writing. Her stories will continue on with a bright future for every character she has created.

items.name: Reverie Brushes - Still
items.description: A weakened doesn't trap a free soul, and even the tiniest seed burgeons under the sun one day.

items.name: Wondrous Fantasy - Still
items.description: Elba thanked her friend for bringing her hope, who then pulled her into a hug and held her hands as encouragement.

items.name: Sound Asleep
items.description: Imogen doesn't know what the dream will be about. Busy with work, she hasn't had a good sleep or dream for a while.

items.name: Infinite Memory
items.description: The pillow floated away like a cloud, leaving nothing to support Imogen as she fell into the dream world.

items.name: Sound Asleep - Repose
items.description: Her grandma held Imogen's hand, telling her to pursue her dream and that she had always been proud of her.

items.name: Infinite Memory - Repose
items.description: The familiar words questioned Imogen's sense of reality. Which version of her is the truth?

items.name: Sound Asleep - Peace
items.description: Even though her grandma's hat no longer warmed her, the words of love would forever be the greatest power in her.

items.name: Infinite Memory - Peace
items.description: Imogen still dreams of the past, but she never indulges in them. There is an old dream that she must chase.

items.name: Nightfall Dance
items.description: People roamed the streets at sunset before heading home. Dressed luxuriously, the girl walked into an evening dance.

items.name: Chaste Blossoms
items.description: Jade and blossoms in her hair and a warm smile on her face, she stands elegantly in the snow.

items.name: Flowery Flair
items.description: As the saw-wings return in early spring, raindrops gather in puddles, heralding the burgeoning of lives.

items.name: Floral Luster
items.description: Above the hazy water chirp the finches, as flowers bloom on the banks, like the fine lady in the mirror.

items.name: Azure Plume
items.description: In a plain dress with feather-like frills, she recalls the departure of a friend under blooming flowers at sundown.

items.name: Autumn Stroll
items.description: Golden leaves glisten under the autumn sun. The girl and the fox saunter around and watch every sunset.

items.name: Cherry Candy
items.description: The aroma and ample flesh of the cherry linger at the tip of the girl's tongue. She will forever remember the taste.

items.name: Dearest Friend
items.description: They share the purest love. The girl hugs the fox and smiles, promising it will never be alone again.

items.name: Cherry Messenger
items.description: The girl has roamed the world and walked paths unknown, but now she is willing to stay in the bright autumn.

items.name: Leisure in Woods
items.description: As the twilight fades and the foggy forest rustles in the wind, the girl and the fox fall asleep in the moonlight.

items.name: Lasting Longing
items.description: Even though once tainted with lies, the lamp of longing never dims, guiding the lost souls home.

items.name: Candid Hope
items.description: Departure leads to growth while reunion brings hope. She continues to seek truth, stronger with each passing day.

items.name: Kindred Echo
items.description: The memories turn into journals as she writes them down, leading to the fortress where she protects her world.

items.name: Jovial Moments
items.description: Every encounter is worth remembering and sharing, and every page is a pleasant memory of a precious soul.

items.name: Rainbow Candy
items.description: The candy's flavor fills your mouth. The iced sweet and sour soda tastes like rainbow after summer rain.

items.name: Truest Thoughts
items.description: Away with the old boring sayings. There is no room for frustration and regret. I am free and unbound.

items.name: Spicy Sweetheart
items.description: Put forth your infinite passion for creativity and enjoy life's every moment. I am ready for a brand-new adventure.

items.name: Colorful Release
items.description: Say goodbye to your old self. Each day is a breath of fresh air. The colors of the sun invigorate my story.

items.name: Dark Lightning
items.description: The blackbird is a serious opponent, its black feathers cloaked in sunlight, its small body packed with power.

items.name: Above the Clouds
items.description: Her elegant and powerful broom flight awes many. Like a happy little bird, she dashes toward the big blue sky.

items.name: Proof of Strength
items.description: The Starlight Magic School principal left behind important notes. Yunnie is able to return them in no time.

items.name: Flight Regulations
items.description: After completing the impossible quest, the principal not only pays Yunnie, but also offers her a job.

items.name: Pure Pursuit
items.description: 'But I have nothing to teach the children. All I can do is fly as fast as I can.' Yunnie says, embarrassed.

items.name: Forest Encounter
items.description: The principal stands up and pats Yunnie on the shoulder: 'Then teach them to enjoy flying as you do.'

items.name: Birds of Dusk
items.description: Even the broom in Yunnie's hand wants to challenge the confident opponent. Who's faster, Yunnie, or the proud bird?

items.name: Moon Seeker
items.description: Not many can keep up with Yunnie's speed. Still, a flap of the blackbird's wings is enough to match the fastest winds.

items.name: Gentle Shadow
items.description: The Magic Biology Studies classroom is outside the old school castle. The children are excited to be here.

items.name: Gentle Courtesy
items.description: There are various magical creatures here, ranging from cute snowflake hares to giant armored wolves!

items.name: Wavering Blossom
items.description: 'Hey! Look! Someone is getting close to a fluffy sheep!' A child shouts in surprise as his classmates glance over.

items.name: Fragrance in the Wind
items.description: That's too dangerous! The children's faces fill with worry. 'We should get the teacher...' says one of the kids.

items.name: Soft Clouds
items.description: Soon, the students realize that the fluffy sheep wasn't aggressive — she was the teacher, Professor Ronna.

items.name: Star Magnificence
items.description: 'Oh, right! Today's the freshmen's first class.' Ronna turns around and is stunned to see the students.

items.name: Stargild Night
items.description: The first class has ended. The students have a new opinion of Ronna. She's forgetful, cute, and very intelligent.

items.name: Magical Flower Paper
items.description: Although Ronna is clumsy and forgetful about herself, she never forgets anything about the magical creatures.

items.name: Magic of Time
items.description: The freshmen all want to know the secrets within but find a witch in a black long dress casting a spell instead.

items.name: Phantom Lullaby
items.description: The freshmen carefully make their way through the castle corridor. Their footsteps echo through the hall.

items.name: Shackles of Time
items.description: The corridor remains dark as the walls block the sunlight, there is only light from the candle holders to the side.

items.name: Silent Wish
items.description: The stories from the upperclassmen echo. The corridors are eerie and daunting, even in the company of friends.

items.name: Cage of Darkness
items.description: However, the frightening days quickly come to an end. The candles start to light up whenever they pass through.

items.name: Soundless Prayer
items.description: The small magic circle emits a powerful light. The witch contently turns around... Ahh! It's Professor Miranda!

items.name: Soundless Blessing
items.description: Proud as always. The keen children notice something different... The slow-paced footsteps are now in a panic.

items.name: Childhood Glee
items.description: Squares drawn on the ground with crayons send us back in time to the childhood free of worries.

items.name: Joyous Colors
items.description: 'Momo, why did you draw the pink balloons?' 'They're not balloons! They are grilled fishes shaped like balloons!'

items.name: Erudite Mind
items.description: After reading a book on dreams, Misha heard that the Apple Apparel Group was recruiting testers for a new fabric.

items.name: Astral Dream
items.description: It is said that whoever wears a blindfold made of this fabric will experience the best dream they can wish for.

items.name: Blessed Chance
items.description: Her dream came true! One week later, inside Misha's mailbox lay a reply letter and a blindfold for the trial.

items.name: Erudite Mind - Orange
items.description: She didn't know what to do or why her dream would be like this. Misha couldn't believe this was what she wished for.

items.name: Astral Dream - Orange
items.description: Misha's rainforest adventure didn't get off to a good start, but she managed to find a place for rest before dark.

items.name: Blessed Chance - Orange
items.description: Misha finally built a simple stone hut, where the smell of roasted mushrooms emanated from a small campfire.

items.name: Erudite Mind - Red
items.description: Sitting on the back of the tiger under a starry sky, Misha realized for the first time that she could be so brave.

items.name: Astral Dream - Red
items.description: She roamed freely in the jungle and even learned to swing like a monkey. Here, she could do anything she wanted.

items.name: Blessed Chance - Red
items.description: This was a life that Misha had never experienced. She made up her mind to go out to see the world after waking up.

items.name: Flowery Swing
items.description: The birds led the way for Rhea as they talked the whole way to the forest. In front of her was a swing of flowers.

items.name: Ivy Crown
items.description: A beautiful red bird fell in the yard. Rhea scooped it up in her palms and built a warm new nest with twigs and hay.

items.name: Warbler's Message
items.description: Rhea had been getting more requests since then, surrounded in the yard by birds chirping to tell her their wishes.

items.name: Dreamy Handwriting
items.description: Color has no boundaries. She is a traveler in the kingdom of dreams, composing a poem with magnificent colors.

items.name: Pen of Memories
items.description: She's seen the greatness of mountains, streams, and the sky. Her favorite is the unexpected flower of friendship.

items.name: Transparent Feelings
items.description: She met a girl with a pure heart, reflecting worldly essence. However, her courage inside still shines.

items.name: Colorful Shadows
items.description: She has seen the gentle winds above the clouds. An infinite amount of imagination pours from her heart and fingers.

items.name: Weaving Inspiration
items.description: Groundbreaking designs all come from a moment of sudden inspiration derived from consolidated experiences.

items.name: Sound of Chess
items.description: That person cheated more than just the merchant. There hasn't been any evidence until this ledger.

items.name: Files and Ranks
items.description: The scammer was sent to the authorities and the debts are cleared. The merchant's business takes off immediately.

items.name: Talking to Oneself
items.description: However, something looks different... He notices an old booklet that wasn't there before. It's a ledger!

items.name: Unexpected Breakthrough
items.description: The merchant is a little confused and returns to find Ping but only finds the chest board and cooled tea...

items.name: Ping's Words

items.name: Darkened Sky - Hidden
items.description: Under the sunlight, she finished a move with a quick slash of her spear. She wiped off her sweat and smiled.

items.name: Light in Dark - Hidden
items.description: A few kids imitated her moves, yelling loud as if they were in a real fight. She saw justice and bravery in them.

items.name: Battle of Dawn - Hidden
items.description: She learned the spear book by heart and practiced every day. Now, she didn't practice to kill, but to protect.

items.name: Dream Blossoms
items.description: A breeze blows through the gate, and the flowers start to dance. Inside, Flor is basking in the sun on her swing.

items.name: Graceful Dance
items.description: Young fairies love to play in Flor's yard. They clean up Flor's lawn and roof, and Flor tells them about the forest.

items.name: Tranquil Yard
items.description: Humans have to pass the test of the forest to get here. They'd take Spirit Fruits and leave payments in the yard.

items.name: Sunlight View
items.description: The beautiful houses exist in harmony with nature. Flor'd take a good rest there after a day of strolling.

items.name: Fragrance of the Wild
items.description: Flor appears a lot in the legends of Pigeon, and no one knows which forest she actually lives in.

items.name: Gentle Melody
items.description: Humans often bump into Flor in the wilderness but can hardly find her if they ever look for her.

items.name: Warm Heart
items.description: Based on historical materials and folklore, scholars have argued that 'Flor' may not refer to any specific fairy.

items.name: Lost Legend
items.description: Fairies love nature and do not constantly interact with humans, let alone tell them their names.

items.name: Dance of Butterflies
items.description: Over the years, the humans who were helped by fairies began to call them 'Flor' and record their stories.

items.name: Stellar Mist
items.description: She composes music in the wheat fields and plays upbeat tunes when young people dance around the campfire.

items.name: Distant Dream
items.description: One of her peers once said that music was noble and elegant, and should only serve higher purposes.

items.name: Resonant Notes
items.description: It's believed that God gifted music to the noble, and that ordinary people were excluded from true music.

items.name: Dreamland Blossoms
items.description: But the girl believes that music belongs to all, and that beauty is inclusive and can be shared by all.

items.name: Moon Slumber
items.description: She left her luxurious life and began her travels. She drew inspiration from nature and spread music across the world.

items.name: Wish Crystal
items.description: The girl traveled alone day and night, spreading music across the land and teaching people about this beautiful art.

items.name: Light Symphony
items.description: No one knew her. She talked with everyone and related to them, and then she'd soothe them with her music.

items.name: First Sound
items.description: Her music was like an oasis in a desert and enlightened people, who began to see beauty in their own eyes.

items.name: Golden Resonance
items.description: The sounds of music are like gentle breezes. Where there's a breeze, there will be music.

items.name: Music Romance
items.description: She continued her journey with more and more people joining her, spreading their music even farther.

items.name: Dreaming Arclight
items.description: Lorelle spreads her black curtain before people sleep and gently covers the sky to bring dreams to all.

items.name: Starlit Dust
items.description: Those dreams are stopped by the curtain and weave into bright stars in the sky.

items.name: Dream-Catching Bottle
items.description: Lorelle travels between stellar rivers on her feather ship, picking her preferred dreams to add to her bottle.

items.name: Lunar Feather Ship
items.description: The memories of the multitude are too heavy. Lorelle floats above it in a lunar feather ship among souls' lament.

items.name: Lunar Crown
items.description: Some ancient dreams of great ambition will continue to spark on Lorelle's screen even after their owners fade.

items.name: Incredible Dreams
items.description: Some fragile dreams contain fleeting inspiration, forgotten upon waking. Lorelle will collect these.

items.name: Honest Wings
items.description: Some fantastical dreams full of innocence might be destined to be discarded, but are forever kept by Lorelle.

items.name: Brushing Dreams
items.description: Lorelle treasures her collections and dusts ancient dreams to make them glow brighter over time.

items.name: Night Revealed
items.description: If Lorelle sees sad memories and tangled nightmares, she'll open the curtain a little and let them escape forever.

items.name: Shooting Star Staff
items.description: People call those tidy patterns constellations, imagining how Lorelle organizes her collection on the curtain.

items.name: Starlit Vessel
items.description: The silvery band traversing the sky seems to be Lorelle's route, her ship leaving wandering traces in the river.

items.name: Fantastical Dreams
items.description: Lorelle would send stars of inspiration into dreams and return innocent dreams to their owners.

items.name: Stars' Revelation
items.description: People can see Lorelle through their dreams, but that memory is kept in the sky and they will not remember.

items.name: Dawn Unveiled
items.description: Lorelle will roll up her curtain as people wake from dreams, then float to the next land with dreams.

items.name: Sparkling as Ever
items.description: At some point, a girl began following Leida around. Leida takes her to see the castle flowers and enjoy autumn fruits.

items.name: Fantastical Rhyme
items.description: The girl isn't alone anymore. At dusk, she and Leida sit on top of the clock tower and watch the sunset together.

items.name: Pearly Dawn
items.description: The elf knows the castle's secrets and leads the girl to explore. The world changes through stained-glass windows.

items.name: Naughty Guest
items.description: As the girl grows, she spends more time with her parents. But when she comes home, Leida's candy is under her pillow.

items.name: Time Travel
items.description: The girl still tells Leida everything, but her eyes are no longer as pure. She sometimes falls asleep as she talks.

items.name: Become Like New
items.description: One day, the girl leaves the castle for a long time. Leida hears that she went far away to fix her family's hardship.

items.name: Mysterious Years
items.description: She didn't say goodbye to Leida, but she left behind a painting of the sunset they watched together. The elf is alone.

items.name: Windy Fantasy
items.description: Suddenly, someone takes the flowers from Leida. The sunset shines on her smiling face, just like when she was a child.

items.name: Secretive Language
items.description: After fixing the problem, the girl returned to the castle. She will never lose the sweetest candy that Leida gave her.

items.name: Mystic Shadow
items.description: Yuli implored the hero to be his master. But having seen too many of his kind, he refused Yuli without hesitation.

items.name: Illuminance Realm
items.description: Boys like him were full of romantic impressions of the world and ignorant of the harsh realities.

items.name: Vernal Breeze
items.description: They thought the world was all about life, death and friendship, but knew nothing of the troubles of a lonely soul.

items.name: Flash Sword
items.description: Yuli didn't give up and followed the hero. The hero said nothing, because he knew he couldn't talk the boy out of it.

items.name: Lunar Song
items.description: Yuli came to realize the complexity of the world. There was love as well as hate, reunion as well as departure.

items.name: Cirrus Chant
items.description: Yuli realized the spirit of a hero was far more complex than he thought, and that he had a long way to go.

items.name: Verdant Time
items.description: As she heads back to school the next year, Leiah walks under the shade of green trees, her memories flooding back.

items.name: Shining Note
items.description: The girl who shined on stage last year brought out Leiah's bravery. Now, the once-immature Leiah can sing confidently.

items.name: Past and Present
items.description: Leiah and the girl hold hands on the stage at the homecoming dance. Leiah pours strength into her tender singing voice.

items.name: Depart towards the Future
items.description: Leiah sees a girl in the crowd that reminds her of her old self. Her eyes shine as she listens to Leiah's song.

items.name: Memory of Idol
items.description: She heard the question and looked pensive. 'I wanted to be an idol a long time ago...'

items.name: Stage Highlight
items.description: 'Did you grow up dreaming to be an idol?' The host asked. She smiled and pushed a pink strand of hair behind her ear.

items.name: Avid Dream
items.description: 'Yeah, singing was hard for me in school. I practiced a lot but couldn't improve. I got reprimanded a lot for that.'

items.name: Stellar Melody
items.description: 'One day on my way home, I heard a famous idol singing and watched the performance. That cheered me up.'

items.name: Starlight Wish
items.description: Singing can really light people up! I wanna be like her!' A charming smile appeared on Yan's face, her eyes glowing.

items.name: Toward the Stars
items.description: 'No wonder your performance is always so uplifting. It's because you want to encourage people wholeheartedly.'

items.name: Heartfelt Feeling
items.description: The girl was singing on the stage, her voice gentle but powerful. At this moment, she was the center of the world.

items.name: Leisurely Seagulls
items.description: Let go of exhaustion, enjoy the bright sunshine, sip pure coconut milk — a seagull's life has more than dreams.

items.name: Enchanting Wind
items.description: Yuli stayed true to his heart wherever he went. Before his death, he finally understood the spirit of a hero.

items.name: Floral Fence
items.description: As the whirligig spun on and on, she fell asleep to the gentle chimes of wind bells and her mother's gentle voice.

items.name: Fragrance Memory
items.description: Her mother stuck a few morning glory flowers on her hat, enveloping her in a light fragrance.

items.name: Floral Ornament
items.description: When she left, she was uneasy and yet excited. Now she returned and had grown up after the journey she'd taken alone.

items.name: Desolate Restricted Area
items.description: Dorothy discovers a little bear lying next to her, waiting for her to pick him up like she once did.

items.name: Lost Treasure
items.description: Dorothy follows Katie to the park, memories flooding back. Her dad bought the bear for her 12th birthday here.

items.name: Childhood Secret Base
items.description: Dorothy follows Katie all over, her toy box slowly filling with faraway memories from her childhood.

items.name: Feline Dreams
items.description: Katie has left already; only a black tail flashes past the window. Was tonight real, or simply an echo of the past?

items.name: Search at Nightfall
items.description: They visit a deserted kindergarten and find Dorothy's first medal, still stuck on the blackboard as time goes on.

items.name: Mouth-Watering Grilled Fish
items.description: Dorothy opens her eyes to see a girl with cat ears in a cloak at her window. It's Katie! She is ready for adventure.

items.name: Calamity Reborn
items.description: Flames ravaged the earth and devastated the world. She chanted a spell and repelled an evil spirit charging at her.

items.name: Hollow Lament
items.description: She tried to help survivors with her magic. She'd use black magic to attack and white magic to defend and heal.

items.name: Distant Journey
items.description: Some accused her of evil purposes because of her bloodline. But she paid no attention and focused on her path.

items.name: Illuminated Night
items.description: She defeated the evil spirit dwelling on the peak after an arduous fight, and smiled as the river was turning clear.

items.name: Resolute Will
items.description: The decrepit academy had stored many ancient tomes. She studied them carefully and her magic improved a lot.

items.name: Entangled Fates
items.description: She'd travel during the day and sleep in old churches at night, and sometimes she'd even meet congenial travelers.

items.name: Journey of Faith
items.description: Once again, she set off on her journey toward the evil spirits' den. Victories would take sunshine back to their land.

items.name: Shift in Times
items.description: People repaired the ruins and built new structures. They would never repeat mistakes of the past.

items.name: Glowing Skies
items.description: Ella thought archery was all, but when the Love God showed her the long roster of names, she instantly fled away.

items.name: New Moon
items.description: At last, the Love God got Ella back and gave her a good talking to. But Ella's response was a yawn.

items.name: Oath in Breeze
items.description: The Love God told her that names carried expectations for the people, and their job was to realize them.

items.name: Lost Heart
items.description: Ella hesitated when asked about her idea of happiness. Sleeping in and eating cakes, that was happiness for her.

items.name: Destined Wind
items.description: The Love God wasn't angry; instead, she patted the angel's head tenderly because she knew her heart was pure.

items.name: Land of Wish
items.description: That was the best time for the angels. There was always a breeze in the divine land, and their life was hopeful.

items.name: Starlit Plumes
items.description: The angels would hold many tea parties among themselves, where they ate cakes and whined about the harsh Gods.

items.name: Remains of Dream
items.description: Ella still had a lot to learn, but she was sure the happiness meant sleeping in and staying with her best friends.

items.name: Glowing Skies - Evergreen
items.description: The angel helped Ella sort out the roster and her head was spinning in the end. But soon, she became Ella's friend.

items.name: New Moon - Evergreen
items.description: Just like every senior she'd met, Ella now had her pupil. While she was giving orders, her little angel yawned.

items.name: Oath in Breeze - Evergreen
items.description: The angel resembled Ella in her youth. She'd lay her head on the desk and watch Ella turn words into lights.

items.name: Lost Heart - Evergreen
items.description: The angel could be a good fit for the job. Once she'd got proper training, that is. Ella patted her head and smiled.

items.name: Destined Wind - Evergreen
items.description: Ella came to know that Gods and angels had the same mission: They must protect the divine land.

items.name: Land of Wish - Evergreen
items.description: Ella stood in the corridors alone in the gentle breeze. The angel laid her head on the roster, waiting for her return.

items.name: Starlit Plumes - Evergreen
items.description: The Love God didn't worry about Ella when she left, because she knew that Ella had become a full-fledged angel.

items.name: Remains of Dream - Evergreen
items.description: The god gave Ella her bow and arrows. Now Ella no longer needed her help and could get the job done on her own.

items.name: Glowing Skies - Dawnlight
items.description: Ella tried to calm down and hold back her emotions, but now even the aura above her head had dimmed.

items.name: New Moon - Dawnlight
items.description: The Love God smiled when she looked at the confused angel. Ella had got enough time to learn before she grew up.

items.name: Oath in Breeze - Dawnlight
items.description: It was an unspoken rule in the divine land that the seniors should teach and encourage the younger ones.

items.name: Lost Heart - Dawnlight
items.description: Despite her hard work, Ella never skipped any tea parties. As they grew up, their parties became more interesting.

items.name: Destined Wind - Dawnlight
items.description: They'd still talk about dreams, troubles and also funny stories. A young angel stole an arrow from Ella and suchlike.

items.name: Land of Wish - Dawnlight
items.description: After the party, Ella returned to the Love God and couldn't wait to share with her the anecdotes she'd heard.

items.name: Starlit Plumes - Dawnlight
items.description: Ella finally found out how she'd lost an arrow. It was because the angel wanted to find herself a lover.

items.name: Remains of Dream - Dawnlight
items.description: The angel in charge of sunlight cast a golden glow on the land, and the one in charge of painting recorded the view.

items.name: Direction of Wind
items.description: The wind fairy told Faye about changes of weather. She turned the hand on the weather clock to its original position.

items.name: Silence of Time
items.description: As time went by, the wind no longer spoke. But Faye still held the key and guarded the land in the rain.

items.name: Direction of Wind - Mist
items.description: The wind fairy told Faye about changes of weather. She wiped the dust off the clock, waiting for the next cycle.

items.name: Silence of Time - Mist
items.description: As time went by, the wind no longer brought messages. But Faye still held the key and guarded the land in the mist.

items.name: Direction of Wind - Sunny
items.description: The wind fairy told Faye about changes of weather. She wound up the weather clock, waiting for the next cycle.

items.name: Silence of Time - Sunny
items.description: As time went by, the wind no longer spoke. But Faye still held the key and guarded the land in the sunset.

items.name: Eternal and Immortal Stars
items.description: Angie lit up the sky upon the ruins with the divine fire. From then on, the people began to rebuild their homes.

items.name: Vague Light
items.description: People admired her power and were also afraid of that. The divine fire was a blessing, but only after destruction.

items.name: Old Promise
items.description: Some people had come to her for help because they thought the lamp was omnipotent. But she never responded.

items.name: Divine Lanterns
items.description: She was used to being alone with the divine light, and had better stay that way as the divine envoy.

items.name: Eternal and Immortal Stars - Midnight
items.description: The war was hard, but the girl never backed down and stood by her words: She would never let her city fall.

items.name: Vague Light - Midnight
items.description: Perhaps luck was on her side and she repelled the enemy. Stars gleamed in the sky just as they did years ago.

items.name: Old Promise - Midnight
items.description: Looking into the brilliant stars, the girl suddenly realized that it wasn't luck; it was Angie's blessings for her.

items.name: Divine Lanterns - Midnight
items.description: The envoy left the stars here years ago, and now they were shining as this city of hope survived the fight.

items.name: Eternal and Immortal Stars - Sky
items.description: Angie created a little mirage for the girl to see the night sky better. They walked on and on until the sun rose.

items.name: Vague Light - Sky
items.description: The light of hope never died. Angie seemed to hear the girl telling her that she would protect this city.

items.name: Old Promise - Sky
items.description: Angie had seen too many beautiful, unfulfilled promises. The girl's promise wasn't such one. Angie believed her.

items.name: Divine Lanterns - Sky
items.description: Then, Angie continued her journey, as the city began to prosper. Time would witness promises, she'd think.

items.name: Beach Party
items.description: Unfortunately, she had just found a small beach when the waves rolled in and the rain poured down.

items.name: Shell Collection
items.description: The rain was too heavy for the sun hat she just bought. She rushed toward the shore to get out of the rain.

items.name: Ocean of Mind
items.description: She had just hidden herself when she realized she'd left her bucket with stones and the wood shovel on the beach.

items.name: Happiness Found
items.description: And the crab leader was holding her wood shovel in its hand. Bella was over the moon and smiled.

items.name: Childhood Relived
items.description: As she panicked, the bucket slowly moved toward her: A cast of crabs was carrying it back to her.

items.name: Praise to Harvest
items.description: Red fruits were hanging on the branches like glowing rubies, symbolizing the vitality of nature.

items.name: Best Berries
items.description: Miss Candy believed that her fruits were the sweetest in the world and that everybody should have a taste of them.

items.name: Farming Song
items.description: It was another busy day. Miss Candy sowed the seeds, hoping that new seedlings would soon grow up and bear fruits.

items.name: Sweet Magic
items.description: Candy and Maple exchanged their fruits. 'It's so delicious!' They exclaimed at the same time.

items.name: Warm Invitation
items.description: Now they had both moved from their original homes to the center of the forest to grow fruits together.

items.name: Perfect Formula
items.description: What kind of reaction would magic and hard effort work out together? It must be the most delicious fruit ever.

items.name: Fantasy Praise
items.description: Juicy fruits were all over the lab. Even the pot smelled sweet as if there were sugar in it.

items.name: Red Berries
items.description: Maple believed that no fruit was better than her strawberries. If there were indeed such fruits, she must have a try.

items.name: Exploration Gift
items.description: Magic was unfathomable. Maple gave it her all to improve her magic and make strawberries sweeter every day.

items.name: Backward Flow
items.description: In the past, these ruins used to be a temple, where hymns were sung and glory was remembered.

items.name: Spotlight of Time
items.description: Countless eyes peered in the dark at Viola's struggles, until the Mercury Group announced that she was one of them.

items.name: Glorious Return
items.description: The rumor spread fast about the acrimony at the party. People thought Viola was arrogant and would pay the price.

items.name: Thunder Speed
items.description: Things changed with time. Viola was praised and then disdained, but her belief in victory never wavered.

items.name: Swift Silhouette
items.description: But soon, her company began going downhill. The overnight fame vanished like a dream.

items.name: Undying Shine
items.description: Viola was in a dilemma: She'd been recognized and received several offers, but she knew they led to deeper trouble.

items.name: Glories Crossed
items.description: Money and power were dangerous. The 19-year-old Viola faced this problem, and people were almost sure that she'd fail.

items.name: Dazzling Figure
items.description: The 12-year-old Viola crawled out of the box with biscuit crumbs on her dress. She was playing a dragon slayer.

items.name: Beautiful Lie
items.description: Viola went to the banquet. But to everyone's surprise, she rejected the offer and left straight away.

items.name: Eternal Guardian
items.description: Perhaps destiny was decided the moment she met the ferryman. And only till the end could she know.

items.name: Cycle of Praises
items.description: The prison called 'the Eternal Mirror' was destroyed, and the fairies living by the lake were finally free.

items.name: Splendor of Clouds
items.description: This place was forgotten. These old ruins could only wait for the end of time, except for the Prophecy Fountain.

items.name: Sand of Time
items.description: She peered into the Prophecy Fountain and saw the familiar yet strange land, where there was the cycle of seasons.

items.name: Critical Judge
items.description: The pink-haired girl came to the snow mountain with the knight in search of the source of the mysterious power.

items.name: Illusive Trap
items.description: The cycle was only one day. The Prophecy Fountain was drying up. Water fell from the break and vanished in mid-air.

items.name: Stellar Fracture
items.description: The Snow Fairy longed for the lively world. So she left the mountain, hoping she'd meet the black-haired girl soon.

items.name: Eternal Dust
items.description: The arrow wasn't shot. She swung her arm and plucked the strings on the first instrument of the world.

items.name: Fair Judge
items.description: The words appeared before her with a divine glow and vanished as she read. Soon, she learned about the whole thing.

items.name: Absolute Order
items.description: The angel left the divine land with her instrument. She would bring the music from the divine land to the world.

items.name: Fallen Deity
items.description: Those angry gods exchanged their opinions and, when they saw her, raised their voices so that she could hear.

items.name: Monument of Truth
items.description: She'd sing along with the hymn every now and then, and soon, a crowd of angels would gather outside the door.

items.name: Mist of Heaven
items.description: Their short wings made them look like round little chickadees, and their faces were as lovely as birds.

items.name: Blade of Glory
items.description: The divine land became even better with the flowers, magnificent structures and enchanting melodies.

items.name: Glorious Merits
items.description: Until the day when she heard a muffled bell. She must instantly go to the divine court and make a judgment.

items.name: Twinkling Star
items.description: It'd been a long time since she last heard it. Angels huddled outside the court and a few gods fumed with anger.

items.name: Ultimate Oracle
items.description: At the center stood the angel to be judged. Her hair was golden and her wings white. She stared at the ground.

items.name: Dream Path
items.description: 'She's here!' 'She's going to punish her!' 'No one should betray us. She won't let her get away!'

items.name: Glorious Chapter
items.description: The distressed angel opened her mouth, as if she wanted to say something, but didn't. She knew it'd be in vain.

items.name: Fallen Prophecy
items.description: As the music started, the angels sang along. And more voices joined. Together, they were gentle but firm.

items.name: Silent Stars
items.description: Her belief in justice had never wavered over the years, and she had given it her all to uphold it.

items.name: Phantom Moves
items.description: The stars moved rapidly in the sky. The winners marched on, while the losers fled in all directions.

items.name: Disaster Unseen
items.description: The cycle of fate never stopped. Tempted by fame and power, living beings repeated their history once and again.

items.name: Chronicle of Time
items.description: Even with the advantage in arms, an army indulging in pleasures was no match for an opponent with a firm conviction.

items.name: Ring of Fate
items.description: Soon, people wanted more gold and more power. Those things they'd already owned couldn't satisfy them.

items.name: Undying Flames
items.description: They served fruits in bowls of gems and drank wine with golden glasses. For them, those were the utmost pleasures.

items.name: Stellar Seal
items.description: The first war started at dusk and the nearby city fell in no time; the second ended at dawn with the sound of horns.

items.name: Echoes of Soul
items.description: People were singing all over the city. They celebrated the victory with fruits and wines and sang praises for her.

items.name: Endless Illumination
items.description: The cat ran back and forth in the temple. Some believers even bowed to it because the cat was her emissary in legends.

items.name: Fate Manifestation
items.description: Temple was lit up and the priestess prayed. They didn't know if they should march as they were running low on wealth.

items.name: Reversed Fate
items.description: The cat sat by the window, staring at the night sky. After a long time, it stood up and left this magnificent temple.

items.name: Starlit Festival
items.description: The cat watched them from the shadows. The priestess raised the golden scepter and announced her approval.

items.name: Epilogue of Fate
items.description: People burned down the temple, because they believed she had tempted her believers and turned them into greedy beasts.

items.name: Fallen Stars
items.description: History alternated between order and chaos. As long as desire governed the world, the gods would be reborn one day.

items.name: Floating Lights
items.description: This wasn't the Time Emissary's intention. She wasn't good with people but surely never intended to hurt anyone.

items.name: Phantom Glaze
items.description: She'd seen too many times people who lost hope or got saved in despair, and her heart had grown cold.

items.name: Starlit Journey
items.description: Sometimes, people would come to her for help, hoping she'd tell them what to do, but could only get vague answers.

items.name: Threads of Fate
items.description: She wasn't troubled by this. Instead, she preferred being alone because that allowed her to see the truth of fate.

items.name: Star Sequence
items.description: Even the most senior god had asked her to help an envoy, who was exiled from the divine land for a serious mistake.

items.name: Silent Ripples
items.description: She'd always been aware of her duty: to observe and record the hidden course of the world, rather than change it.

items.name: Wordless Chapter
items.description: But she didn't reply, which was no surprise. The old god knew she should not do anything to change the fate.

items.name: Dreamland Lights
items.description: But if she had intervened, the land would collapse and the ocean would be destroyed just like what she'd observed.

items.name: Star Praise
items.description: She thought this name was appropriate, because the history was comprised of the rises and falls of civilizations.

items.name: Deep Skies
items.description: She irritated many people. They called her 'The Eye of Calamity', because anything she saw was doomed to destruction.

items.name: Fallen Night
items.description: If she stood by, the divine land would collapse. If she intervened, everything would go as planned.

items.name: Swaying Waves
items.description: Soon, she held the threads of fate, unless... The course of stars was reversed with a loud noise.

items.name: Drowned in Sea
items.description: Even the gods feared the fate. Was it wrong to fight against one's fate? Now she had the answer.

items.name: Sweetness of Mind
items.description: 'What's better than an air-conditioned room in summer? A room full of ice creams! I'll have two ice creams this time!'

items.name: Spring Awaits
items.description: As the familiar figure and the birds disappeared, the workshop was silent again. But Ivy felt a little lonely.

items.name: Sunken Wood
items.description: One day, Ivy was working as usual when magpies flew in. The curtain fluttered just like when she first met the boy.

items.name: Dreaming Blossoms
items.description: Ivy came to know that the boy came from a merchant family and could talk to magpies. That screen was a gift for him.

items.name: Sky Brocades
items.description: As the work was almost done, she realized the boy hadn't been here recently, then she heard about his engagement.

items.name: Magpie Brocade
items.description: He was engaged to a girl from an equally wealthy family. Ivy felt great distress and even pricked her finger.

items.name: Dead Leaves
items.description: Rosaline was frustrated and looked at the butterflies enviously. What was the meaning of life for a moth in the dark?

items.name: Spring Whispers
items.description: Rosaline was crying in the forest at night when she suddenly heard sobs in the distance. Was someone else also crying?

items.name: Labyrinth Trip
items.description: When the night came, the forest turned into a maze for the other fairies, but Rosaline could still navigate her way.

items.name: Flower Lantern
items.description: 'Follow me, I'll show you the way.' She sprayed phosphor from her wings and illuminated the lily flowers.

items.description: Renya slipped and fell. She tried to encourage herself and saw a band-aid handed over: Her friends were here!

items.name: Strawberry Bear
items.description: After the game, Renya ran toward the bear dolls in the audience, who celebrated the victory with her.

items.name: Course of Stars
items.description: The audience cheered. Renya hit a home run and sealed the victory for her team!

items.name: One Last Hit
items.description: She clenched her teeth and hit the ball the opponent threw at her. The ball flew into the sky like a shooting star.

items.name: Orange Bear
items.description: Renya felt a pain in her wrist and was a little overwhelmed. Suddenly, she saw a few bear dolls in the audience.

items.name: Tender Heart
items.description: Tears welled up in her eyes. She didn't want to let them down but wasn't sure if she could beat such a strong team.

items.name: A Sound Sleep
items.description: She was tired and soon fell asleep, with the bear doll in her arms. She dreamed about playing baseball with the bear.

items.name: Clear Vision
items.description: The bear doll was her favorite cartoon character. She loved how brave it was and got into baseball because of it.

items.name: Lovely Bear
items.description: Her parents thought it was just a whim and that she would give it up in a few days. But her friends supported her.

items.name: Candy Bat
items.description: The match had come to a critical moment. Renya cooperated with her teammates, but the opponents had good defense.

items.name: Sweet Moment
items.description: Renya exercised alone after school. There wasn't a baseball club, so she adopted the training methods she read.

items.name: Scattered Stars
items.description: 'Prove yourself to us one more time!' The bear doll handed the bat to Renya and gave her a high five.

items.name: Untold Lie
items.description: It breathed fire, roared like thunder and forbade trespassers. Granny Rianne's arm was injured because of it.

items.name: Memory of Thrills
items.description: 'Granny, how did you escape?' Reshia loved listening to Rianne's story, and her answers were always different.

items.name: Sincere Pledge
items.description: 'I shall venture into the woods and challenge the dragon!' Reshia promised as she blew out her birthday candles.

items.name: Innocent Days
items.description: As time went by, Reshia grew up and Granny Rianne aged more. Reshia made a decision the day she came of age.

items.name: Dearly Remembered
items.description: She trained her body and will in the woods, but she also needed strategies against the dragon.

items.name: Fearless Quest
items.description: Reshia was dying to know the truth. Did Granny escape because of her wits or the stupidity of the dragon?

items.name: Untold Lie · Blue
items.description: The darkness swallowed the light from Reshia's lantern. She groped in the dark and suddenly felt jewels and gems.

items.name: Memory of Thrills · Blue
items.description: The stolen treasures! Indignantly, Reshia put them down and continued when suddenly, the lights came back.

items.name: Sincere Pledge · Blue
items.description: 'Are you Rianne's friend?' the young man asked with hope in his eyes, 'She came here a long time ago.'

items.name: Innocent Days · Blue
items.description: He looked kind but pale and weak, the shadow of a snake curling around his left arm like silk.

items.name: Dearly Remembered · Blue
items.description: The snake fairy kept watch over the treasures in the mountains, but he would grow weak on full moon nights.

items.name: Fearless Quest · Blue
items.description: 'My apologies. I thought you were an invader.' A handsome young man stood in the luxurious hall, smiling sheepishly.

items.name: Viridescent Frost
items.description: The doctors and their prescriptions were of no use against the plague, so people could only pray for a miracle.

items.name: Moonlit Linger
items.description: She trekked across mountains and woods and never gave up on finding a way to save her family from the plague.

items.name: Palace Melancholia
items.description: She turned and realized she and the herbalist were among the stars and clouds, away from the realm of mortals.

items.name: Midnight Shroud
items.description: She visited hermits in the woods and asked anglers by bubbling brooks. None knew where the moonlight peony was.

items.name: Windswept Glide
items.description: One day, a herbalist told her the moonlight peony grew only on a snow-covered peak where no one ventured.

items.name: Silken Breeze
items.description: She climbed one peak and saw the next towering in the clouds, but nothing could deter her now.

items.name: Wintry Haze
items.description: Many never returned from the snow-covered mountains teeming with ferocious beasts, but she was determined.

items.name: Splendor Cluster
items.description: The Mountain Spirit protected the precious flower and tempted or threatened her to leave.

items.name: Evanescent Wish
items.description: It was a full moon when she finally reached the peak and saw the peony, blooming in its moonlit grace.

items.name: Blooming Viridity
items.description: The plague stopped. People built a temple to worship her, and eventually the village became the Moonlit City.

items.name: Faded Candlelight
items.description: As flowers bloomed in the snow, the herbalist, dressed in gilt robes, revealed himself as an immortal.

items.name: Moonlit Return
items.description: She saw it in a vision that the city would be destroyed in a flood, so she sacrificed herself to keep it safe.

items.name: Wilting Cirrus
items.description: She lived in solitude in the Moon Palace and helped those in need praying most sincerely for her assistance.

items.name: Oceanic Haze
items.description: She looked most forward to leaving the mountain, even though the fox would always beat her with its tricks.

items.name: Traceless Squall
items.description: But one year, her mentor seemed distracted and said she could no longer stay if she lost the fight.

items.name: Billowing Mist
items.description: She befriended spirits and still felt inadequate. The fox didn't care and always called her its servant.

items.name: Cliffside Terrace
items.description: One day she overheard that the herbalist had to cut all secular ties to seek the truth of cultivation.

items.name: Veiling Mist
items.description: She bowed and announced her name when the fox attacked her by surprise, saying there were no rules between spirits.

items.name: Cloudless Rhymes
items.description: The fox had a mesmerizing smile and pink fur between its brows. She stared until the fox took her hand to play.

items.name: Somber Yearning
items.description: Life flourished in the green mountains. It was miles of green and blooms that she had never seen before.

items.name: Virid Serenity
items.description: As the herbalist grew busier, she was often left alone on the snowy mountain, missing the lushness and the fox.

items.name: Callous Withering
items.description: Spirits would compete for the treasured jade and the champion would become the ruling Mountain Ghost.

items.name: Swathing Haze
items.description: She lost the fight. Her mentor let her go when the Spirit Herb shook its leaf and took her as its second disciple.

items.name: Ethereal Strings
items.description: She stopped sobbing and asked, 'Am I the eagle?' The fox yawned and leaped down, 'Who knows? It's just a story.'

items.name: Vernal Evergreen
items.description: Thunder blasted for three days and when she woke again, there was no grass or mentor to be found.

items.name: Mirrored Ripples
items.description: A few days later, the spirits gathered early for the contest. She usually enrolled but stayed silent this time.

items.name: Spring's Whisper
items.description: It told its mentor about everything outside the cave, and its mentor would always say it was slacking off.

items.name: Moonlit Longing
items.description: It became the Spirit Herb's disciple and it never expected that its mentor was the Mountain Ghost.

items.name: Doleful Glance
items.description: On the Spring Equinox, it picked a peach blossom and raced all the way back to show its mentor.

items.name: Rejuvenated Verdancy
items.description: Her mentor saw her in her human form and smiled, 'So you made it, even though you were always slacking off.'

items.name: Eons of Delight
items.description: Her mentor said that she was gorgeous by the standard of humans and promised to gift her something later.

items.name: Pavilion of Verdure
items.description: Since then, she would make jokes about how her mentor's leaves hadn't grown much for so many years.

items.name: Idyllic Breeze
items.description: Her mentor seemed to have never taken it to heart, but she would see mist around her mentor's leaves late at night.

items.name: Fallen Pearl
items.description: When thunder struck, spirits all hid behind rocks, but she rushed up the mountain to be with her mentor.

items.name: Dashing Star
items.description: She saw a beautiful woman in front of the cave when lightning struck. Then everything went quiet, and she fainted.

items.name: Pendant Amore
items.description: Her mentor asked amusedly what she would do if her mentor finally turned human and became even prettier than her.

items.name: Thawing Blooms
items.description: She thought to herself that her mentor would be prettier than her when it finally turned human.

items.name: Ribbon of Frost
items.description: A group of birds offered her a gauzy gown on the day of the contest. She put it on and everyone praised her in awe.

items.name: Sylvan Zephyr
items.description: It felt it wasn't running fast enough and realized it was running on human feet, which were far slower than a fox's.

items.name: Color of the Soul
items.description: As the soul grows and the light changes, it makes sense that one's reflection in a mirror looks familiar yet strange.

items.name: Fashion Elements
items.description: Some think she's only seeking attention, but Rise doesn't care. She chases every idea in her mind and realizes it.

items.name: Flashy Visuals
items.description: Despite her boldness, Rise has some timid fans. They face many obstacles in their pursuit of dreams.

items.name: Colorful Ending
items.description: Rise likes that characters in black-and-white films eventually live colorful lives, so she chases her dream.

items.name: Fashionable Trends
items.description: Rise believes that every style has a meaning. The most honest pursuit of a dream has the beauty of a great story.

items.name: Everlasting Connection
items.description: Some beauties are destined to last. They are framed in time and last for evermore in fleeting moments.

items.name: Fashion Storm
items.description: Rise tirelessly encourages her fans to find and express themselves and to ignore the criticisms and malicious attacks.

items.name: Foretime Recall
items.description: As her sister petted the kitten, Minna gently put her handmade cat-ear beanie on her sister's head.

items.name: Farewell Present
items.description: An elegant pink dress with blue flowery patterns. Minna would forever cherish her sister's present.

items.name: Guiding Morningstar
items.description: The morning star shines at dawn, guiding seafarers like her through waves and storms.

items.name: Tide Chaser
items.description: The ship cleaves a way through turbulent waves, as she steers it confidently in the face of challenges.

items.name: Bygone Songs
items.description: When a new day dawns, a warm breeze awakens me from my dreams. I write this letter to share the story with you.

items.name: Gaze of Curiosity
items.description: Adventurers use it to gaze at the land afar. Inside its view is the great unknown, waiting to be explored.

items.name: Terrene Bloom
items.description: After the flood, they rebuilt their houses and planted plume trees, the blooms of which were as soft as feathers.

items.name: Euphoric Marvel
items.description: Jane woke up to rain seeping through the windows. They packed up in haste and silence, ready to evacuate.

items.name: Floral Orison
items.description: Jane waded the currents when a wave toppled them off the ground. Jane tried to get up but only floated further away.

items.name: Rueful Lament
items.description: The older generations believed a flood was coming. Jane still remembered the terrible disaster in her childhood.

items.name: Ardent Fervor
items.description: The rain stopped, but all plume blooms withered overnight. Jane and the other villagers all went to thank the trees.

items.name: Fervent Devotion
items.description: The world suddenly went quiet. Jane felt the currents turning slow and gentle, even carrying a floral fragrance.

items.name: Blooming of Life
items.description: She opened her eyes to a golden beam shining from above. The storm stopped and the water turned into plume blooms.

items.name: Spirit Companion
items.description: Angelia looks up: the glazed window shines still. The mirage is gone, but she can feel the angel's gaze on herself.

items.name: Silent History
items.description: She wears the same necklace as the angel. Although she only caught a glimpse of the mirage, she's sure she's right.

items.name: Descending Stars
items.description: 'I've seen it, Angelia.' The girl speaks shortly after. The kids and the teacher can't help but laugh kindly.

items.name: Glistening Crown
items.description: The teacher's story arouses laughter among the kids, but Angelia only looks up to admire the glazed window.

items.name: Letter in Courtyard
items.description: A relic from the past, still impressive as it had ever been, seems to show her a real starry sky with a faint glow.

items.name: Stellar Cycle
items.description: Silence sets in, and the twinkling stars illuminate the path to the past and future amidst the hazy clouds.

items.name: Radiant Reflection
items.description: In the sea of stars, Angelia sees a little angel, who waves her feathers and smiles at her.

items.name: Vaporizing Dream
items.description: Angelia feels warmth in her heart: the angel looks familiar, but she only hears laughter when she focuses on thinking.

items.name: Flame Brilliance
items.description: Seeing Angelia still at a loss, the teacher asks, 'Did you see anything extraordinary in the glazed window?'

items.name: Tender Buds
items.description: As the kids gather, the mirage disappears after the little angel smiles, signaling Angelia to keep it a secret.

items.name: Destined Dream
items.description: Is that angel Angelia's future self, or a shadow from a past life, offering guidance in her present life?

items.name: Echoes of Dreams
items.description: Angelia closes her eyes and feels as if she were back at the window. An age-old mystery awaits her answer.

items.name: Firmament Haze
items.description: When Becky delivers medicine to the girl, she realizes the cats made the wish as they meow to thank her.

items.name: Kitten Fluff
items.description: Becky walks to the room and sees two cats lying beside a sick girl, meowing in a hurry to beckon her inside.

items.name: Kitten Wisdom
items.description: To Becky's surprise, no one exclaimed over her miracle. Then she hears a weak cough from inside the room.

items.name: Fairytale Trance
items.description: Stars speak endless wishes: dwarves wishing for treasure, princesses wishing for peace, poets wishing for love.

items.name: Cordial Faith
items.description: Mages in fairytales always help those in need. Becky wanted to help too, but her cleaning magic couldn't do much.

items.name: Guileless Wish
items.description: 'A wish to keep the house always clean,' while the stars make this simple wish, Becky is already on her way.

items.name: Magic Duster
items.description: Becky lands in front of a house and summons her white duster, waving it with her magical dance steps.

items.name: Astral Echo
