items.description: The evening breeze sometimes shares whispers of the stars, and maybe a story about a Dusting Pixie and cats.

items.name: Florescent Journey
items.description: Snow melted into brooks, carrying the Queen's message everywhere. Leaving the castle, she embraced a new kingdom.

items.name: Burgeoning Dream
items.description: The girl was a seed sent by the Goddess of Spring. She would bloom every year on this colorful land.

items.name: Hedge of Thorns
items.description: Flowers even bloomed on the royal guards' swords. They took off their helmets and saw each other for the first time.

items.name: Snowmelt Mirth
items.description: Melted snow flowed by everyone's feet. They could feel their hearts and minds warm up like the coursing water.

items.name: Billowing Buds
items.description: Kesha met the flower girl with a cold face, but the girl ran to her excitedly and shoved the basket into her arms.

items.name: Candescent Dream
items.description: When the girl held Kesha's hand, she saw a sunlit meadow full of life, with deer leaping over bubbling creeks.

items.name: Snowmelt Ardor
items.description: The girl described a charming spring vista, captivating the officials and bringing warmth to the iron palace.

items.name: Emerald Torsade
items.description: The castle shook violently as snow fell, revealing a dark grey that was soon covered by brighter colors.

items.name: Dewdrop Bloom
items.description: The fragrance soothed the Queen. She touched the petals and felt the dew on her fingertips.

items.name: Flowery Braids
items.description: Then the girl presented a wreath to the Queen. With a clear ring, the ice covering the Queen's heart started to melt.

items.name: Sylvan Hymn
items.description: Maybe only change would bring hope and prosperity. Opportunities would pass by for a heart buried in the snow.

items.name: Bedewed Bloom
items.description: The Queen returned to her throne in the wreath instead of her crown. Flowers gathered around to offer her tribute.

items.name: Sprouting Rebirth
items.description: Burgeoning grass drove away the last bit of cold. Together the people walked into a new life in a green kingdom.

items.name: Twilight Silhouette
items.description: Only her brothers had the chance to show their talent. As time passed, Vena learned her heart's desire.

items.name: Dust Evanescence
items.description: She learned to do a lot of things, to know the world, to fight, take, conquer, and to get everything she wanted.

items.name: Transient Dream
items.description: Vena knew that she wasn't born to rule the world. She was taught to follow rules, not to fight for power.

items.name: Foregone Past
items.description: Soon rumors fell quiet. People realized the duke's wealth seemed to end up in the hands of one person, Vena.

items.name: Hazy Greensward
items.description: The duke's two fledgling sons had their ambitions. They tried to control every aspect of Vena's life.

items.name: Elegy of Glimmers
items.description: Vena couldn't care less about their fight. The love letters she received were full of empty promises and cheap love.

items.name: Hidden Floriography
items.description: 'Love is the most useless in our family.' the duke and Vena's brothers told her so, and deep down Vena agreed.

items.name: Eternal Florescence
items.description: 'My daughter, I will pick the most suitable suitor for you!' the duke waved one letter after another at her.

items.name: Dubious Oath
items.description: Vena only stared in silence as usual. She always appeared obedient to her father's and brothers' orders.

items.name: Nighttime Aroma
items.description: One by one, the sons got into accidents during a fight and a hunt. Their businesses went downhill while they rested.

items.name: Unanswered Riddle
items.description: The family's fate started derailing when the duke was involved in a serious political scandal.

items.name: Night Bell
items.description: Melissa watches the people among her crimson roses as they leave. The bell on the tower rings as a new day starts.

items.name: Final Cure
items.description: People leave with relief and their emotions nurture the roses. Melissa collects a few of them in a glass container.

items.name: Eternal Secret
items.description: A girl, looking haggard, falls to her knees and asks Melissa to rid her of the love that's distorted her mind.

items.name: Pain Redemption
items.description: A medic cries and asks Melissa to let her forget those she couldn't save and give her the courage to face life again.

items.name: Shackles of Revenge
items.description: A pallid boy asks Melissa to remove the hatred in his mind which has exhausted him so that he can regain peace.

items.name: Crimson Mark
items.description: Emotions can never be restored once removed. Melissa always makes sure if that's what people really want.

items.name: Tender Crimson
items.description: When Melissa finishes her work, people will open their eyes again and enjoy the peace of their new lives.

items.name: Fiery Rose
items.description: People have broken free of the exhausting love, the unbearable sorrow, and the overwhelming hatred and moved on.

items.name: Fall of Dawn
items.description: The one lying out there is the ghost hunter. Solace knows nothing of her intention and prepares herself to fight.

items.name: Final Path
items.description: The ghost hunter had some trouble and came here for help, but she thought Solace's master was still the owner.

items.name: Night Talks
items.description: It's not until Solace lifts the formation that the ghost hunter realizes that she's been maintaining the temple.

items.name: Final Dust
items.description: The fight is intense. They attack each other with mesmerizing spells and later stones. No one dares to come near.

items.name: Whirling Stars
items.description: She's come to visit an old Taoist, but she's surprised to find that many people haven't heard about the temple at all.

items.name: Glowing Spell
items.description: Despite her calm nature, Solace excels at spells. She keeps a low profile and takes on nearby evil spirits alone.

items.name: Voice of Soul
items.description: What will they do after that? Perhaps they'll come back to the temple. Someone needs to take care of it, after all.

items.name: Boundless Snow
items.description: The ghost hunter senses the formation surrounding the temple and decides to stay here and wait for the owner.

items.name: Life of Dream
items.description: Days ago, Solace learned of a stone in the mountains that could enhance the formation and went in search of it.

items.name: Future Oracle
items.description: Now she's obtained the stone and come back, only to find someone with an aura around her lying in front of the temple.

items.name: Star Swirl
items.description: She knows it has a long history and used to be a bustling place, so she wonders how it ended up like this.

items.name: Dim Glow
items.description: With such a low-key leader and the exuberant trees around, the temple is almost forgotten. Peace seems only natural.

items.name: Dream Thoughts
items.description: This story is the only one about Solace in Tales of the Shadows, but has become one of the classics.

items.name: Miracle Spell
items.description: She isn't ignoring her master's request but has a more important task: to sort out the literature left at the temple.

items.name: Dessert Hunter
items.description: Keep the spell in your mind and grab the fork in your hand. Let's go find the best dessert in this feast!

items.name: Midnight Repose
items.description: There was no green in Kesha's kingdom. The people grew numb in the dreary snow and only worked day after day.

items.name: Spirit Wind
items.description: Flowers glow with dim blue in the cold light of the moon. Liz's skirt flutters in the wind as she dances with Vanis.

items.name: Perfect Dance
items.description: A perfect dance with Vanis has become Liz's dream. And Liz has made up her mind to confess her love after that dance.

items.name: Final Departure
items.description: The sorcerer, who hurt Vanis' wings, suddenly appears and enchants Liz's mind with spells, making her a puppet.

items.name: Dream Weaver
items.description: The butterfly with a pair of glowing wings can transform, too. To cure him, Liz has asked a lot of friends for help.

items.name: Wind Whisper
items.description: Liz talked a lot with Vanis during their time together. Vanis has seen a lot and everything he says is amazing to Liz.

items.name: Graceful Wind
items.description: The leaves flutter in the wind and the birds perching on the nearby branches watch the lovers with joy.

items.name: Nocturnal Dance
items.description: Vanis has fully recovered. As Liz hesitates to ask him to stay, she hears him ask her to dance in the moonlight.

items.name: Enthralling Heart
items.description: Liz, who's never danced before, takes Vanis' hand, determined to try her best, but can barely control her legs.

items.name: Mist of Dream
items.description: After the dance, Liz can't remember how many times she stepped on Vanis and apologized, but Vanis only smiled.

items.name: Dance Mirage
items.description: They dance to the sounds of cicadas for countless days after that. Liz has improved a lot under Vanis' teaching.

items.name: Shared Wish
items.description: 'Next time, I'll try harder and won't step on you again, I promise.' 'Alright, let's try together. We've got time.'

items.name: Mark of Past
items.description: Liz can always feel peace of mind when she's with Vanis, even when they do nothing and simply watch the clouds.

items.name: Fluttering Skirt
items.description: In the moonlight, the pale spider weaves the web mechanically. Those who get caught can only accept their fate.

items.name: Thoughts on Web
items.description: Sometimes Vanis feels that his heart was tied to Liz the moment he fell into her web.

items.name: Love Rapture
items.description: The sorcerer rages at what happened in vain: Liz ties him to the center of the web. Punishment awaits him.

items.name: Heart to Heart
items.description: 'You'll have to look after me again...' Vanis holds Liz's hands, his voice feeble. Liz wipes off her tears and nods.

items.name: Final Content
items.description: It's the dance that they did on the first day they met. But this time, Liz's moves are so smooth and elegant.

items.name: Glowing Wings
items.description: Liz always thinks she's a bad dancer, but Vanis tells her that it's the person who he dances with that matters.

items.name: Pairs and Couples
items.description: The clouds have dispersed and revealed the bright moon in a clear sky, celebrating the reunion of the lovers.

items.name: Decisive Dance
items.description: He wishes he could dance with Liz forever, and that she would love dancing and finally understand him.

items.name: Downturn Melody
items.description: His dream fails when the sorcerer, who's been hunting him down, breaks into this tranquil mountain.

items.name: Eternal Memory
items.description: The sorcerer controls Liz to weave toxic webs to hunt the prey. What should Vanis do to save her?

items.name: Soul Seizure
items.description: Vanis manages to get away, but the sorcerer takes Liz's soul instead and makes her a puppet, and Vanis is heartbroken.

items.name: Memory Crate
items.description: The shop owner made fluffy marshmallows for the grandpa that reminded him of his long-forgotten childhood.

items.name: Amorous Reunion
items.description: A happy smile is sweeter than candy—gummy bears that protect children's teeth, diamond rings wrapped up for lovers.

items.name: Rejoicing Moment
items.description: They would chuckle when kids came trick-or-treating and put the most popular sweets in their baskets.

items.name: Parting Gift
items.description: It was time for the girl to leave. The shop owner locked herself in the kitchen to make a special candy for her.

items.name: Sincere Ardor
items.description: Melted sugar was poured into different molds and then stored in colorful glass jars shaped like the shop sign.

items.name: Magic Candy
items.description: The girl scooped a handful of candy as the shop owner wished her happiness and a hopeful future.

items.name: Wicked Tail
items.description: The girl stared at the colorful candy, as if her wonderful memories at the candy shop were forever saved in time.

items.name: Treasured Collection
items.description: The candy tasted sweeter than ever. The girl left the last one in the jar and carried it around at all times.

items.name: Signal of Glee
items.description: If you also like strolling around Candy Town, you may have stumbled upon a candy shop that sells happiness.

items.name: Token of Felicity
items.description: Kids would see smiling faces on the coins. They aren't enough for toys, but they can pass on happiness.

items.name: Cubic Merriment
items.description: Nika lost the piggy bank after a house move. She no longer collected coins, but still felt empty and frustrated.

items.name: Buoyant Piglet
items.description: The yellowed piggy bank would look at Nika with its never-changing smile. It always cheered her up.

items.name: Childhood Echoes
items.description: Finally the piggy bank became too full and heavy for another coin, so Nika took all out to buy her favorite toy.

items.name: Sweet Concord
items.description: Her mother's encouragement and friends' envious looks were nothing compared to the moment she bought the toy.

items.name: Untroubled Hope
items.description: As Nika grew up, she could finally afford things she wanted and fill up her room with cute toys.

items.name: Gunfire Thrill
items.description: Nika worked in an amusement park and always led parades. She would hold up a toy gun and shoot coins into the sky.

items.name: Fairyland Bestowal
items.description: Nika was the kids' favorite performer who always gave the kids what they wanted and brought them the purest joy.

items.name: Innocent Calling
items.description: Happiness has always been within reach. It's in the kids' quirky presents and their genuine smiles.

items.name: Waterlily Breeze
items.description: The Prankster's Day is a picture book that teaches kids to do simple tasks such as brushing their teeth!

items.name: Faerie Guardian
items.description: Alouette remembered the whole town would be here for the school chorus the next day and regretted pulling the prank.

items.name: Jovial Renewal
items.description: One day, Alouette chanced upon a delicious black magic candy that had one small side effect.

items.name: Crystalline Wish
items.description: It would dye everything black! But to Alouette, it was a perfect present from the god of pranks, so he hatched a plan.

items.name: Magic Coagulation
items.description: He sneaked it to school and mixed it in the afternoon desserts. All classmates exclaimed, 'Monster!' after eating it.

items.name: Vernal Meadow
items.description: Everyone's mouth was dyed black, revealing black teeth and tongue. 'Hahaha!' Alouette burst out laughing.

items.name: Cleansing Rebirth
items.description: After sharing a laugh together, his friends started to frown and sigh over an important event the next day.

items.name: Sparkling Cosmos
items.description: There was a new girl in the arcade center. She always kept to herself with the visor of her cap low.

items.name: Fateful Fervor
items.description: Venian wanted friends, but as a newcomer in town, she was always on edge and standing awkwardly in corners.

items.name: Quirky Gashapon
items.description: Kids liked to pile up their toys and imagine that they had made a lot of new friends as they grew up.

items.name: Bear Gashapon
items.description: After her parents passed away, Venian moved to a new town and felt insecure and lonely in her foster family.

items.name: Sunward Flight
items.description: It was Venian's first birthday there. The shopkeeper gave her a game coin, but she shook her head and ran away.

items.name: Fortune Spark
items.description: One ordinary night, Venian decided to leave town and return to her homeland which was buried deep in her memories.

items.name: Quirky Pastime
items.description: Warm light shone from the Bunny House. Venian stood in front of the toy machine and put in her only token.

items.name: Infinite Auspice
items.description: Hesitantly Venian opened a toy ball, when a golden light shone through and pulled her into the world of toys.

items.name: Prismatic Wish
items.description: A teddy bear in a helmet showed up, 'Are you the friend I've been waiting for? Great! Come and join my adventure!'

items.name: Favorable Chance
items.description: Venian thought she'd used all her luck after surviving the fire. Could she really become friends with a cute toy?

items.name: Sincere Silence
items.description: The Mouse King Momo orders the little mice to take away Nutcracker Nikki: she'll cook grilled fish only for him.

items.name: Frosty Wishes
items.description: The Deer waves goodbye to Nutcracker Nikki. Debbie hasn't said a word throughout the ball to maintain her persona!

items.name: Melody of Mirth
items.description: As the birds tweet amongst themselves, the curtain rustles in the breeze and wakes up the world.

items.name: Departing Wings
items.description: People started building canals and finally, rain fell on the parched land. The silversmith felt the rain and smiled.

items.name: Springtime Pendant
items.description: The silversmith saved a white swallow that fell from the sky when a naughty child hit its left wing with a slingshot.

items.name: Indigo Tinge
items.description: The people prepared to set up an altar and pray for the Sparrow God, who brought rain to sincere worshippers.

items.name: Cloudward Chirp
items.description: Sparrows chirped and hovered over the altar before a white one descended, transforming into a young man.

items.name: Guiding Chime
items.description: On the day of the ritual, sparrows hovered over the altar and a white one flew down and turned into a young man.

items.name: Plumed Brocade
items.description: The silversmith gazed as the white sparrow flew away. The corner of her lips curved as she whispered, 'It was you.'

items.name: Ethereal Chant
items.description: A song for the sea inspired by nature. Felien, famed for her imitation of sea creatures, is showing her latest work.

items.name: Earthen Descent
items.description: In a slow and lilting song, dancers in gauzy sapphire dresses float down like ethereal fairies from the sky.

items.name: Twiddled Ripples
items.description: Felien waves one hand as silver ribbons spread out in an instant, like water rippling in the shimmering sea.

items.name: Fluorescent Dream
items.description: One by one, Felien and the dancers throw umbrellas into the air, capturing people's imagination like fishing nets.

items.name: Azure Breath
items.description: As if the theater were submerged in water, dresses take on an azure hue like moon jellies chasing the light.

items.name: Delirium Dive
items.description: The light changes color again. Moon jellies' tentacles can sting, creating beautiful dreams or horrible nightmares.

items.name: Duet Interlude
items.description: An elegant yet dangerous and untouchable creature, it ascends from the sea, creating endless awe and fascination.

items.name: Moonlit Tide
items.description: Finally, she reached Aram in its slumber. Her tireless search for a way to awaken Aram turned fruitless.

items.name: Midnight Glaze
items.description: The man grew old as his youthful face started to wrinkle, but he returned to the shore every day without fail.

items.name: Swirling Surge
items.description: She returned and told the man she had found Aram. He was beyond excited, listening intently to her story.

items.name: Bejeweled Ride
items.description: Fascinated by the legend, Coraline began searching for Aram, as she could easily explore where no man ventured.

items.name: Luminous Pearl
items.description: As promised, Coraline would ride the tide at dusk and meet with the man near reefs where no one could see them.

items.name: Lucent Chapter
items.description: Coraline wiped the stone clean and wished for the prophecy to come true that mermaids could live among humans.

items.name: Temporal Grandeur
items.description: Rivers coursed through Aram, where sea creatures swam freely within, and mermaids lived among humans.

items.name: Starlit Nocturne
items.description: The man smiled and turned to Coraline. If the prophecy was true, maybe they could have a happy ending after all.

items.name: Lucent Rhyme
items.description: The human had a wonderful voice and told Coraline that there was an ancient kingdom called Aram in the distant sea.

items.name: Pristine Gleam
items.description: The island shook and started to sink with the violent changes in the ocean. A devastating disaster for Aram.

items.name: Mossed Abyss
items.description: Gardenia was the golden-tailed daughter of sea and the queen of Aram, revered as an almighty goddess by her people.

items.name: Oceanic Swim
items.description: In the heavy storm, people gathered around the once-clean square and looked with hope at the woman on the throne.

items.name: Foregone Ruins
items.description: But one day, the rain kept bucketing down as if the sky was poked open, covering the kingdom in a gray shade.

items.name: Whirlwind Wave
items.description: 'You can leave if you want to.' Gardenia's voice was calm, without a hint of panic in the face of the disaster.

items.name: Mermaid Echoes
items.description: Humans and mermaids lived together in Aram as friends, lovers and families... They loved each other and the country.

items.name: Fateful Ripples
items.description: 'I swear to protect Aram until it resurfaces thousands of years later. Then we will reunite in the new world.'

items.name: Aureate Shells
items.description: Mermaids didn't fear the fall of the island as their home was the sea. They stayed because they were part of Aram.

items.name: Pearl of Time
items.description: The storm raged on as rain blurred everyone's vision. They looked to Gardenia, waiting for her last command.

items.name: Hazy Wreath
items.description: Gardenia finally spoke in a soft but determined voice, unwavering in the storm, 'Sleep now, my people.'

items.name: Mended Mirror
items.description: So the people of Aram all sank into dreams, where humans and mermaids all became beautiful fish.

items.name: Abysmal Swim
items.description: Unlike the rest of Aram, Olivia had eternal life. She once felt lost, but luckily Aram accepted her unconditionally.

items.name: Brocade Scales
items.description: She would return to the sea and find a quiet corner for slumber. The ocean would grant her a new life.

items.name: Whirlpool Journey
items.description: Her people were gone when Olivia looked back at the sea. Those glowing jellyfish dived deeper into the ocean.

items.name: Glazed Effulgence
items.description: The light was golden scales' dream. The mermaid queen's song gave Olivia a soul and accepted her into Aram.

items.name: Pearl Gloria
items.description: When she awoke and swam excitedly to the surface of the sea, she saw nothing but water where Aram had been.

items.name: Tidal Echoes
items.description: Olivia didn't know what happened to Aram or where she should go. She wandered and searched in vain.

items.name: Sunlit Tempest
items.description: As sails flapped in a raging tempest, a stranded sailor was finally rescued by Olivia after days out on the sea.

items.name: Dewy Breeze
items.description: But Gardenia's prophecy said that Aram would resurface thousands of years later and all its people would be reunited.

items.name: Iridescent Frost
items.description: Knowing Olivia's confusion, the sailor told her that Aram was engulfed in water centuries ago.

items.name: Glistening Haze
items.description: Olivia had her answer and sent the sailor to shore. There he would find a small town, bustling unlike the cold sea.

items.name: Effulgent Crystal
items.description: One day, she felt the sea's calling and bade farewell to her friends, before returning to peaceful slumber again.

items.name: Primeval Echoes
items.description: —An excerpt from The Old Epochs: The Lost Kingdom, archived in the United Library of Pigeon Kingdom.

items.name: Lingering Tides
items.description: The weather at sea can be cruel but it's always beautiful after a storm. Sailors have learned to respect nature.

items.name: Coral Fairytale
items.description: Caravans passing through here enter an underwater world in their sleep, where fish dance and corals shine like gems.

items.name: Seashell's Murmur
items.description: 'Oh the lively fish and beautiful shells; oh, everything so wonderful there.' The sailors' song represents their hope.

items.name: Legend of Sea Deity
items.description: The sky darkens as clouds overhead grow gloomy. Sea birds fly low; all signs indicate that a storm is coming.

items.name: Distant Calls
items.description: In the storm, a staff breaks through the rain and clouds, sending forth a powerful light, illuminating the world.

items.name: Flowing Spindrift
items.description: Was that just a dream? Or is this a reward for the truly brave souls? The sailors gaze at the sea, not having a clue.

items.name: Festive Feast
items.description: Even evanescent fireworks last forever in memories, and happiness will eventually arrive with beautiful dreams.

items.name: Temporal Memento
items.description: Journey through the meadow of time, and in a gentle breeze, the brightest moments will be imprinted in her memory.

items.name: Glutinous Snowball
items.description: The koala felt as smooth as velvet and so warm in my arms. It looked up at me, its eyes full of curiosity.

items.name: Daydream Respite
items.description: The koala soon fell asleep on my shoulders. It was like a torch in the dreary winter, driving away the lonesome chill.

items.name: Wooden Repose
items.description: Don't fret if you missed the vernal breeze, summer blooms or autumn harvests. Nature has something else in store.

items.name: Origin of the Journey
items.description: Zhu Ruosheng: It's a beautiful idea to record the feelings at the moment in a video. Happy birthday, Nikki.

items.name: Shadow Prism
items.description: Nancy: I'd still be trapped in the memories if it weren't for you. Thank you, Nikki, and happy birthday.

items.name: Time Envoy
items.description: Bestt & Besan: The location of the gift is hidden in the password at the top of the video. Figure it out!

items.name: Trace of Spacetime
items.description: Annabelle: I drew this cute little cartoon for you, Nikki, because you're the cutest one in Miraland.

items.name: Tacit Moment
items.description: Ace:My sister and I picked these roses for you in our garden. I hope you'll like them. Happy birthday!

items.name: Bright Rainbow
items.description: Mr. Lancelot: Meeeeeow! Meow-meow, me—

items.name: Crystal Stream
items.description: Mela: The lyrics could've been improved, but I'll write you a better one next year. Happy birthday!

items.name: Eternal Fondness
items.description: Yue Qianshuang: Happy birthday, Nikki! I'm sorry I can't be with you because of work, but I've got a gift for you!

items.name: Miraculous Exploration
items.description: Winter: I like this way of sending wishes! Hold on, let me check the lines again. I've got so many people's wishes.

items.name: Sincere Bond
items.description: Timi: Glad to have met you and seen so many miraculous designs. Happy birthday and stay passionate!

items.name: Adorable Wink
items.description: Aron: It's the City Square behind me, can you see that? Join me in jogging next time. Happy birthday!

items.name: Heart in Heart
items.description: Starlet: Go, go on with your journey. You won't be lost for the stars will shine for you.

items.name: Reverse Prism
items.description: She knew neither her appearance nor the meaning of her existence. She called out, many times, to no avail.

items.name: Reverse Prism - Virus
items.description: The larger world she yearned for was quietly opened to her. All the information that flooded in fascinated her.

items.name: Wandering Feather
items.description: The girl in crystal shoes leaned on the gunwale and raised her glass to the trapped sailors with a faint smile.

items.name: Effulgent Orb
items.description: 'Call that ship!' the sailors cheered and slowly navigated to the ship, planning to follow it out of the fog.

items.name: Endless Swirl
items.description: The giant ship cast a long shadow over the lost sailors, and like a warning, the smile vanished from the girl's face.

items.name: Wandering Feather - Golden
items.description: A century ago, a rich man built a cruise ship for his daughter's birthday that vanished in a heavy fog.

items.name: Effulgent Orb - Golden
items.description: Did they see the cruise ship that was lost for a hundred years or was it just a mirage in the fog?

items.name: Endless Swirl - Golden
items.description: Nobody knew the answer, and the encounter at sea became a new myth as time passed.

items.name: Wandering Feather - Green
items.description: The scene was so eerie that the sailors stopped the ship. Someone tried to call for help, but the girl shushed him.

items.name: Effulgent Orb - Green
items.description: A mysterious force stopped them from calling for help. Then the girl whisked them away as if to direct them.

items.name: Endless Swirl - Green
items.description: Should they trust the girl or risk it? The captain made the decision to leave and saw sadness in the girl's eyes.

items.name: Stellar Pearl
items.description: The special fabric drew the attention of many traveling merchants and was finally sold at an exorbitant price.

items.name: Cirrus Wreath
items.description: It barely left a ripple in her life. She still sat by the sea and gazed up to capture more beautiful clouds.

items.name: Stellar Pearl - Purple
items.description: To everyone's surprise, the painting turned blank the night it was stolen, as all the colors returned to the sky.

items.name: Cirrus Wreath - Purple
items.description: The girl never thought of selling her paintings and only wished to show these tranquil views to everyone.

items.name: Stellar Pearl - Blue
items.description: The miraculous beauty was meant to be shared, so people offered it to the king, leaving the blue in an art museum.

items.name: Cirrus Wreath - Blue
items.description: The girl didn't accept any reward. All she wanted was for more people to appreciate the beauty of the peaceful sky.

items.name: Oceanic Core
items.description: Sailors navigated the sea following their fathers' footsteps. It was where they came from and would eventually rest.

items.name: Seashore Chant
items.description: Through peaceful water and stormy waves young sailors found the courage and resilience in their souls.

items.name: Tempest Shadow
items.description: A steam whistle announced the departure of a giant ship. No one thought it would be dangerous until the storm came.

items.name: Oceanic Core - Golden
items.description: The sailor remained quiet and looked down. The golden scale had vanished at some point, and no one knew when.

items.name: Seashore Chant - Golden
items.description: The sailor traveled many seas and became a reliable veteran. Only sometimes he would space out gazing at the sea.

items.name: Tempest Shadow - Golden
items.description: Young men on board were all intrigued by his experience, so the story in the storm traveled with him.

items.name: Oceanic Core - Azure
items.description: The sailor fought the angry waves with all his strength, but the sea pulled him into a darker and colder embrace.

items.name: Seashore Chant - Azure
items.description: The sailor heard the creature in the myth sing and saw the golden scale gleam faintly on his chest.

items.name: Tempest Shadow - Azure
items.description: He passed out in the golden light. His grandpa gave him the scale for good luck, saying it was a gift from the sea.

items.name: Sweetheart Companion
items.description: Though the past's bustle had faded, Yonie was not alone—she whistled, and flower-sniffing pups leapt into her arms.

items.name: Cartoon Sticker
items.description: As Yonie traveled, she embraced new sights, realizing the past was behind her—new wonders always waiting ahead.

items.name: Adorable Partner
items.description: With each stroke, Yonie turned memories into pages—her story with the pups became a picture book to share with all.

items.name: Puppy's Choice
items.description: Suddenly, Yonie heard a faint whimper. Following the sound, she found two weak spotted pups in a worn cardboard box.

items.name: Gleaming Surprise
items.description: Feeling their fur, Yonie was moved by their warmth. She took the pups home and cared for them with gentle devotion.

items.name: Traveler's Bags
items.description: Yonie decided to travel with the pups to burn off their energy. Seeing her pack, they spun excitedly around her.

items.name: Fluffy Buddy
items.description: New to pet care, Yonie was often flustered. But the pups trusted her, patiently waiting as she prepared their meals.

items.name: Florid Wish
items.description: Ace brought a rose from the royal garden, still blooming in this season like Nikki who never feared challenges.

items.name: Sincere Gifts
items.description: Inside the gift boxes were friends' best wishes. Kimi even designed a package that matched her gift.

items.name: Bow of Wishes
items.description: Bobo tied ribbons and laces around her box. A carefully tied bow stands for one's good thoughts and wishes.

items.name: Dream Compilation
items.description: Momo showed precious photos that were taken without anyone noticing, jogging everyone's memory.

items.name: Timeless Bloom
items.description: Winter and sisters made bookmarks from fallen blooms, forever beautiful like Nikki's smile.

items.name: Rosy Timekeeper
items.description: Starlet's pocket watch lay quietly in the box, symbolizing the stars' wish that Nikki would never lose her way.

items.name: Chocolate Cube
items.description: Debbie designed a party popper filled with rose petals. She would surprise Nikki with a shower of flowers.

items.name: Pearl of Memory
items.description: The past was not only precious memories but a guide for Nikki's future—an especially bright and hopeful one.

items.name: Scented Envelope
items.description: Mela played Nikki a special birthday song while Bestt drummed and made faces behind her back.

items.name: Fervent Boon
items.description: Nikki felt every carefully wrapped present with her hand. They filled the room with her friends' good wishes.

items.name: Whispered Ardor
items.description: Bai Jinjin sent unique paper cranes with beautiful wishes written beneath their wings.

items.name: Heavenly Abode
items.description: Back then, she was just a set of data, a virtual character showing the music and dance of the Cloud to visitors.

items.name: Lotus Altar
items.description: She didn't know the name people gave her: 'Lotus Fairy'; all she knew was the girl who called her 'Sister Fairy'.

items.name: Digital Illusion
items.description: She learns of the beauty of music and dance from visitors' emotions. And she meets the girl who sees her as a deity.

items.name: Grand Vision
items.description: The little girl with braids grabbed her garment, insisting that she was a celestial being living above the skies.

items.name: Enchanting Deity
items.description: Some scorn 'Lotus Fairy,' saying it's all thanks to technology. But a sage responds, 'One who saves lives is a fairy.'

items.name: Celadon Grace
items.description: Her data transforms magically as the girl gazes at them. An initial negation is rephrased, 'The time is not yet ripe.'

items.name: Cool Moon
items.description: Sick in bed, the girl often tells her mythical tales: the fairy who seeks rain and the fairy who awaits its friend.

items.name: Auspicious Grass
items.description: 'You dance exactly like the fairies! Mom says only fairies know where the healing herb is. Can you show me?'

items.name: Kitten Selection
items.description: The girl rolls up her sleeves to build a cat tower. When she finishes, kittens have already claimed it as their turf.

items.name: Starlit Skyline
items.description: Mimisi collects the cat hair and crafts it into needle-felted cats. Her works are quite popular among her customers.

items.name: Childhood Friend
items.description: After she finally recreates the kitten from her memories, she chokes up a little petting the doll's head.

items.name: Relived Dream
items.description: Mimisi is trimming a kitten's nails when a messenger waves outside her window and passes her a curled-up envelope.

items.name: Origin of Memories
items.description: As Mimisi grows older, the kitten seems more like a distant memory, a tiny dot at the back of her mind.

items.name: Warm Corner
items.description: As design guides fill her desktop, her memo-filled books about pets are pushed to the side but never covered in dust.

items.name: Promised Day
items.description: On her graduation day, Mimisi tells her parents about her plan, who show their support with warm and knowing smiles.

items.name: Lazy Afternoon
items.description: The girl hurries to take the letter before the cat can shred it to pieces: 'To Mimisi... in Ten Years?'

items.name: Unique Dream
items.description: Mimisi finally decides on the cat cafe's location. Soon, there is soft decor and unique yet friendly kittens around.

items.name: Undying Vigor
items.description: In the flickering green light, she found that it could be refined into purer metal to make more tools for survival.

items.name: Chime Messenger
items.description: The scrap was made into a copper bird to scan for resources nearby and sound an alarm when it detected danger.

items.name: Fluorescence of Hope
items.description: The navigational beacon was modified into a pair of wings that could carry her to find materials in the woods.

items.name: Wasteland Workshop
items.description: When the ship crashed, she saved the tools, recycled everything in the rubble, and made them into her workshop now.

items.name: Refinery Goggles
items.description: She would think of her old friends and wondered if they were living a new life now after jumping off the ship.

items.name: Furnace Shield
items.description: She made careful preparations before exploring a new area. Her tools helped her survive all kinds of situations.

items.name: Symphony of Gears
items.description: In deep caverns she found clean spring water with green orbs floating above, driving away the darkness.

items.name: Bizarre Wheels
items.description: She collected these orbs in flasks and poured them into a glass tube. They shimmered like fireflies at night.

items.name: Skillful Artisan
items.description: Planning to return home in the near future, she worked hard to collect resources and save food and energy.

items.name: Steam Chapter
items.description: After studying the samples, she realized it was a special source of energy that could power the workshop.

items.name: Metallic Wings
items.description: The steam from the metal wings pushed her up in the air. She held her scanner to explore deeper into the woods.

items.name: Mechanical Wings
items.description: In a remote forest stood a workshop. A survivor from an air crash had created a world of her own.

items.name: Wilting Flowers
items.description: A year on the earth passed by quickly, but the joys and sorrows were forever ingrained in her heart.

items.name: Aura of Death
items.description: The central stardust was white like a cloud made of stars, governing death.

items.name: Merciful Savior
items.description: It was another cycle of the seasons. She walked the wheat fields in the countryside and gazed at the world in silence.

items.name: Immortal Ascent
items.description: From behind her mask she saw trees and flowers budding in spring breezes and children flying kites.

items.name: Gloom Echo
items.description: The evening breeze carried a ring to her ears, like a sorrowful windchime from days of yore.

items.name: Nostalgic Rhyme
items.description: She saw carps swim and cicadas buzz in shadows of the deep green and under the scorching summer sun.

items.name: Frosty Jade
items.description: The last streak of green was wiped away from the frigid soil, leaving only the color of life in crystal-clear jade.

items.name: Quaint Whisper
items.description: In the wind was another clear clang that was a distant promise between mankind, the stars and the seasons.

items.name: Prism Variation
items.description: The band changed the tempo for the next movement. The princess sauntered among the crowd like a fluttering butterfly.

items.name: Aureate Stairway
items.description: The princess danced cheerfully to the band's rejoicing melodies and became the center of attention.

items.name: Rain of Flowers
items.description: Friends threw petals up in the air while a bird carrying a crown in its beak put it gently around the princess's head.

items.name: Ballad of Fantasy
items.description: She talked excitedly about her long journey. All the fascinating encounters became a chapter of fun adventures.

items.name: Chapter of Turmoil
items.description: Everyone was touched by those fateful encounters, while the dangerous accidents put them on the edge of their seats.

items.name: Sunlit Seasons
items.description: The introverted girl grew into a self-assured lady. She would forever treasure the experiences along the journey.

items.name: Journey Companion
items.description: 'Where are we going next?' the little one says, 'You're right, the customers' smiles are really the best reward.'

items.name: New Gift
items.description: No one knows how the merchant got those goods, except her long shopping lists, filled with cherished memories.

items.name: Journey Through Memory
items.description: A lively figure rushes into the little girl's arms. The merchant smiles, 'It got lost, but you guided it back home.'

items.name: Silken Box
items.description: Neon lights cast a vibrant glow over the goods. The merchant, wearing a shawl, strolls down the street amid the crowd.

items.name: Astral Blaze
items.description: As silver stars strew the velvety sky, the princess saw her friends off and silence returned to the palace.

items.name: Future Aspiration
items.description: A new journey would begin soon. Imagining what could happen, she smiled and fell sound asleep under the moon.

items.name: Fluffy Bunny Pom-poms
items.description: A white pom-pom with two rubies makes a cute bunny hairpin! As always, her sisters can't wait to put them on.

items.name: Charming Snowball
items.description: Mao Ling styles her customers' hair to match the hairpins. Almost every girl wears a bunny hairpin on Long Street.

items.name: Daydream Whisper
items.description: All the headpieces are sold out. Mao Ling knows she could see her sisters' smiles when she gives them the lanterns.

items.name: Gluttonous Bunny
items.description: 'Life's flavors are in each bite and sip,' Mao Rui starts her lecture, though others are too busy eating her skewers.

items.name: Midjourney Yearning
items.description: On her travels, Mao Rui met many who loved poetry and skewers, but she most enjoys her sisters' company.

items.name: Aspiring Dream
items.description: As more tourists flock, Mao Rui keeps her eyes on the bunny lanterns, perfect gifts for her skillful sisters.

items.name: Sugar-sweet Berry
items.description: Mao Rui also makes sweet and tangy tanghulus for her customers, a refreshing treat after spicy skewers.

items.name: Heavenly Reunion
items.description: She sees the two most familiar faces at the ceremony. The three tie for first, sharing a knowing smile on stage.

items.name: Zephyr Companion
items.description: The three sisters hang the bunny lanterns at the gate. The light shines on their love for their family.

items.name: Tendril Glimmer
items.description: As the train picked up speed, she stood up—the girl chased the train, her pink dress flowing in the wind.

items.name: Entwining Bloom
items.description: When she said she'd pick the prettiest tulip, the boy shook his head, saying he liked flowers in their natural state.

items.name: Soundless Echo
items.description: The girl had long had a crush on him and decided to tell her feelings when he gave her the prettiest flower.

items.name: Floweret Parable
items.description: The girl left the manor for the first time when he left. The train station was crowded but he was all she could see.

items.name: Spectral Blossom
items.description: But before she received the prettiest flower, the boy came to bid her farewell as he was needed at home.

items.name: Game of Snow
items.description: Unlike humans, the squirrel didn't like the food stored underground; instead, it preferred nuts.

items.name: Warm Hearth
items.description: When Ella didn't feel like cooking, the squirrel would hop onto her lap, which always lightened her up.

items.name: Breath of Frost
items.description: The squirrel didn't like sleeping in the fallen leaves; it would hop around Ella's bed and sleep beside her pillow.

items.name: Sun Chaser
items.description: In this forest devoid of warmth, Ella and the squirrel would dance in the sunshine as it cast through the leaves.

items.name: Wilderness Trip
items.description: One morning, they strayed a little too far from home and lost sight of their hut when the sun was setting.

items.name: Wild Berries
items.description: Ella wanted to return, but the squirrel ran into the depths of the forest and picked some berries for her.

items.name: Glint of Spring
items.description: In the squirrel's company, Ella had brightened up and, one day, finally left the forest and saw the distant fields.

items.name: Cordial Invitation
items.description: Behind was the misty forest, where she had spent all her life; before her were the fields, where spring was in bloom.

items.name: Furry Warmth
items.description: As Ella hesitated, she felt warmth on her cheek — the squirrel was rubbing against her, encouraging her to move on.

items.name: Journey Together
items.description: Ella reached out her hand, feeling the warmth of the sun, and decided to embrace the world with her little friend.

items.name: Breath of Wind
items.description: The sun cast its light on the meadow and the flowers, but only a faint touch of warmth could penetrate the forest.

items.name: Departing Melody
items.description: Their laughter and songs dissipated into the sunlight. The sweet days that wouldn't last were Nehemia's final gift.

items.name: Golden Deer
items.description: Now a graceful young lady, Ella failed to grasp the spells, and Nehemia's face was devoid of traces of time.

items.name: Flowery Utterance
items.description: Nehemia tried to teach Ella spells, but however hard she worked, she couldn't establish a connection with the snow.

items.name: Verdure Cypress
items.description: While Nehemia was busy, Ella had put on ribbons and bells on the tree in the yard and decorated their little hut.

items.name: Dazzling Heart
items.description: To help Ella, Nehemia consulted the Ancient Tree, who answered all the questions, but Ella didn't understand a word.

items.name: Frosty Crystal
items.description: Nehemia went back and made some scrolls, which, miraculously, enabled Ella to cast a few basic spells.

items.name: Prelude of Finality
items.description: Nehemia said that human life would end at the age of 100. Much like snow melting, Nehemia would one day be gone.

items.name: Radiant Shadows
items.description: 99 — Nehemia wrote down her age in the snow and told Ella that she must find a way to leave the forest.

items.name: Sole Star
items.description: What were humans? And what was the curse? Ella knew nothing, except that she wanted to stay with Nehemia.

items.name: Dance of Snowflakes
items.description: Nehemia got carried away with her work, and Ella strolled in the forest alone and shared her stories with Nehemia.

items.name: Silence of Snow
items.description: The unrelenting snow had stopped. Ella ran back to tell Nehemia, only to find her collapsed in the Circle.

items.name: Finale of Night
items.description: Another snowy dusk. Ella was on her way back when she saw a gleam from the hut, illuminating the entire forest.

items.name: Prepared and Ready
items.description: She had even attached a nametag on each seat for the guests. But surely this was no surprise.

items.name: Cypress in Bloom
items.description: Her well-tended red flowers echoed with the evergreens, adding a wonderful touch of nature to the stage.

items.name: Chime Variation
items.description: Ria had carefully chosen a selection of music. Whatever the tempo, she was confident she would have a perfect dance.

items.name: Sweet Infatuation
items.description: Lady Ria, admired and loved by all, also had a loved one, whom she met at last year's ball and immediately fell for.

items.name: Winter Love
items.description: As Ria danced alone to the upbeat music, she glanced at the young man and caught a hint of surprise in his blue eyes.

items.name: Hope of Reunion
items.description: Ria didn't know if he was a resident of the town. So, she planned for this year's ball, just to meet him again.

items.name: Cheerful Tune
items.description: As the music cheerfully floated in the air and the snow gracefully fell, she finally saw that familiar figure.

items.name: Destined Meet
items.description: A faint smile crossed Ria's face—she was hoping that the young man, whom she had only met once, would love her dance.

items.name: Blooming Life
items.description: The most attractive red flower, however, was burning on her chest, making her the only star of the night.

items.name: Endearing Moment
items.description: The yearly ball had always been the most exciting event in the town, and this year, Lady Ria would be the host.

items.name: Walking in Light
items.description: Let the rising sun witness my change as I chase my dream and compose the song of a brighter future.

items.name: Springtime Imprint
items.description: We trace the path of time as leaves drift in a gentle breeze, moving into the embrace of spring and blooming flowers.

items.name: Poised Moment
items.description: She held me next to the fire and dried my fur. Since then, she has let me stay by her side for many years.

items.name: Spring Strawberry
items.description: Time flew as we sat by the fire watching seasons change in the yard. Strawberries in spring were the best for wine.

items.name: Dune Mirage
items.description: Scorpions from the sand answered the girl's whistle and swarmed toward the soldiers, breaking them apart instantly.

items.name: Scorpion Heart
items.description: The girl rushed home only to see soldiers in the village, a sword raised high and swung at an innocent villager.

items.name: Predator Scorpion
items.description: The scorpion in her palm pointed its stinger at the mayor's throat. In fear the mayor swore to never do it again.

items.name: Dreadful Shadow
items.description: Being forced to pay heavy taxes, the hopeless villagers had to seek help from the girl living in the mountains.

items.name: Mist of Illusion
items.description: They begged the girl to drive away the soldiers like how she fought off robbers, but the girl did not answer.

items.name: Aureate Crescent
items.description: The next morning, the girl showed up at the mayor's manor and claimed to have intelligent scorpions to show him.

items.name: Dreamland Marvel
items.description: The mayor only showed interest in the scorpions and patronized the naive-looking girl, inviting her to stay.

items.name: Astral Glory
items.description: The girl protected the village again and gave them courage. Together they ended the dark night and welcomed dawn.

items.name: Myriad Echoes
items.description: Qiu Ren goes off, leaving Qiguan Yu speechless with the piece of paper signed by Qiu Ren which weighed a ton.

items.name: Gold Silk
items.description: The guard snaps, 'Why did you promise him those benefits? You wouldn't be wronged if it wasn't for the Qiu family!'

items.name: Silk Embroidery
items.description: The master of the Qiu family has been ill. The family, entrenched in internal strife, is on the verge of collapse.

items.name: Deep Pockets
items.description: Soon, footsteps approach the door. A middle-aged man walks in with a hunch. 'I'm Qiu Ren. You were looking for me?'

items.name: Encircling Haze
items.description: Qiguan Yu sighs, 'Eventually, the truth can be revealed.' 'What about the Qiu family? Do we just let them get away?'

items.name: Glittering Earring
items.description: Qiguan Yu smiles, 'Qiu Ren is shortsighted. With him being the new head, the family will fall apart soon.'

items.name: Gleaming Bead
items.description: The guard seems to have more to say but Qiguan Yu waves him off. After examining the books, he turns to the innkeeper.

items.name: Sealed Night
items.description: The innkeeper takes the books and leaves the room. He feels puzzled — no one had known Qiguan Jin had a brother.

items.name: Stellar Fields
items.description: The innkeeper probes, 'Are you from the Zephyr Hall?' Qiguan Yu only hands over the books, 'No mistakes, well done.'

items.name: Thriving Orchid
items.description: As night falls, the bustling city quiets down. But the sound of wheels comes as a carriage stops before the Grand Inn.

items.name: Moon in Hand
items.description: It's a clear, cool night. Qiguan Yu steps into the garden; a woman is standing under the trees, staring into the sky.

items.name: Stirring Seas
items.description: The flute resonates through the clear night. As it concludes, Qiguan Yu sheaths his sword and looks back at Ji Tu.

items.name: Daylight Lanterns
items.description: 'He must have had other names than Kong Kong'er; he could be one of the seniors, trying to conceal his true identity.'

items.name: Distant Dreams
items.description: Another asks, 'Where is Kong Kong'er?' Ji Tu smiles, 'Must be laying low for a while.'

items.name: Exquisite Brocades
items.description: 'He's always been quite proud of himself: he returned the design and gave us evidence. He thinks we're even now.'

items.name: Clear Rainbow
items.description: They leave the estate shortly after having achieved their goal and return to the Grand Inn without any delay.

items.name: Spot of Red
items.description: Once he's gotten our letter he'll surely come to witness the truth of this matter, using a different identity, though.'

items.name: Echoes of Years
items.description: Ji Tu starts writing to the Mayor of Luoyan City — Kong Kong'er has been wanted by the Mayor for many years.

items.name: Melancholic Moon
items.description: A disciple hesitates, 'Although we've sent out invitation letters, what if no one comes? What should we do then?'

items.name: Crimson Silk
items.description: 'We've been preparing for years,' Ji Tu replies with finality, 'Don't overthink it; I know what I'm doing.'

items.name: Tinkling Bracelet
items.description: With solid evidence in hand, the slander against Qiguan Jin and the Zephyr Hall will come to an end tomorrow.

items.name: Spare No Expense
items.description: Invitations have been sent to martial sects, prominent families and even the government — everyone they can think of.

items.name: Daylight Crown
items.description: The long performer's block almost cost all her faith. She's suddenly afraid she'd never enter the great hall of music.

items.name: Faith Adrift
items.description: She puts her cello aside as if she lost her soul, when a voice suddenly urges her to a journey of self-discovery.

items.name: Space Resonance
items.description: Two musicians communicate in the grand symphony a century apart, their souls infinitely close.

items.name: Lightyear Ramble
items.description: She returns to the start of everything, turning into the child that first learned the beauty of music decades ago.

items.name: Lilt of Time
items.description: Perola plays the tune gently with her eyes closed, the sonorous sound of cello reciting the poetry of time.

items.name: Echoes in Time
items.description: Applause only sounds after a long stunned silence. Someone has finally claimed this crown of classical music.

items.name: Silent Eulogy
items.description: The first time Perola heard the variation, she felt like floating in space, her heart struck by the infinite grandeur.

items.name: Mellow Wonder
items.description: Who could refuse such a customer? She invited the bunny to sit and thought she might wake up anytime now.

items.name: Snowcream Hare
items.description: She opened her eyes to see the familiar bedroom. As the wind blew, she saw a crystal snowflake on the window sill.

items.name: Dazzling Meteor
items.description: Felicia finally found the girl's star among numerous sparks. She flew toward it and scooped it up.

items.name: Ephemeral Radiance
items.description: Countless memories flooded in: all the rehearsals, the anticipation for the show, and suddenly falling ill...

items.name: Tranquil Breeze
items.description: Felicia flew between shooting stars. She would pass by wishes that glowed brightly and flew further up the sky.

items.name: Lilting Chant
items.description: Felicia remembered how she made a wish on her birthday this year that she would become a great actress on stage.

items.name: Dreamcatcher Net
items.description: The star net could only be used once, so Felicia kept searching for the girl's wish that she promised to realize.

items.name: Feline Violinist
items.description: A cat plush looked around, puzzled. Then, a girl stepped onstage and handed it a wooden violin.

items.name: Feline Trombonist
items.description: It felt like magic—plush toys floated down with instruments, lifting fuzzy paws to wave at the crowd.

items.name: Genuine Courtesy
items.description: “Welcome to the Laurel Puppet Show.” The girl turned, tipped her hat to the crowd—and cheers rose as the spell broke.

items.name: Seating Etiquette
items.description: The girl removed her hair bow and tossed it high. It spread into a canopy above—as seats filled the plaza below.

items.name: Snowfall Viridescence
items.description: Snow blocked by the canopy, warmth filled the air. The girl tossed her emerald—and the bare stage bloomed with green.

items.name: Fluffy Stamp
items.description: The audience felt that Laurel's greatest magic was this: bringing warmth and joy, letting music soothe weary hearts.

items.name: Score of Wonder
items.description: Lights flared like fireflies, scattering then circling back to Laurel's palm—forming a scorebook and a baton.

items.name: Beats of Magic
items.description: Laurel raised her baton, tapping each puppet's head. The playful toys quickly lined up, instruments ready to play.

items.name: Spotlight Spell
items.description: Flowers dressed the stage. As Laurel spun, her citrine crystal flashed, casting dazzling light across amazed faces.

items.name: Sweet Endearment
items.description: Young love is often tested with time. When beauty and youth are no more, will love still be the same?

items.name: Fond Infatuation
items.description: The Love God's arrow is the key to opening hearts, awakening one's feelings as they take the first step to true love.

items.name: Heartfelt Fancy
items.description: Feelings turn into songs at the Love God's fingertips, watering souls like morning dew and warming hearts like sunset.

items.name: Budding Affection
items.description: The Love God's magic doesn't always work, not on a kitten who only cares about fish or a certain dorky little dwarf.

items.name: Manifesto of Love
items.description: Love can sometimes be a trap, and when the trapped one sees through the lies, they'll grow and embrace a new life.

items.name: Arrow of Devotion
items.description: With gems of laughter and tears on her arrows, the Love God draws stars and lovers' dreams with gentle moonlight.

items.name: Eternal Love
items.description: Love can be fleeting or last a lifetime, but true love stands even the test of death and becomes eternal.

items.name: Passion Spell
items.description: The magic of the arrows comes from the heart. Never forget to seek inward for answers and love yourself.

items.name: Sweet Enchantment
items.description: Love can be subtle poems or grand gestures. The Love God likes all forms of endearment brimming with love.

items.name: Magic Assistant
items.description: Through poisonous swamps and thorny bushes, Tritty finally sees the rumored witch's violet mushroom house.

items.name: Messenger of Joy
items.description: Tritty's unannounced arrival startles the eccentric witch, as she almost trips and falls into her brewing pot.

items.name: Dancing Blossoms
items.description: Tritty doesn't want to miss any chance, even if hope is like a firework in the dark sky, brilliant yet distant.

items.name: Wishing Strings
items.description: The witch is still upset after Tritty's apology, because she doesn't have enough energy of joy for the ideal potion.

items.name: Emerald Streak
items.description: Tritty proposes to the witch, 'If I could perform at the festival, I might be able to gather energy of joy for you.'

items.name: Eureka Fountain
items.description: With the witch's potion, Tritty turns into a pretty girl, but whatever she does, she can't hide her beautiful tail.

items.name: Quilled Wand
items.description: To hide her tail, she takes inspiration from parade dancers and designs a gorgeous dress with feathery fleeces.

items.name: Echoing Wishes
items.description: Before that, she wants to join the festival with Tritty. What is it like? The witch couldn't help her curiosity.

items.name: Warbling Finch
items.description: Gwen could understand the white bird's changing chirps and imagine a broader world through its singing.

items.name: Everlasting Bloom
items.description: In spring, wisteria would grow into cascades of purple around Gwen's home, guiding the white finch when it returned.

items.name: Ceaseless Cycle
items.description: As long as Gwen's magic and beautiful things existed, her spinning wheel would never stop working.

items.name: Embroidered Nest
items.description: Gwen and the white finch were always together. She weaved the finch a warm and beautiful nest next to the wisteria.

items.name: Canopied Woodland
items.description: She had an idea to make fallen leaves into translucent gauze and weave it into a beautiful dress of nature.

items.name: Buoyant Blooms
items.description: She also made flowers brought by the white finch into fragrant brocade that changed color with the seasons.

items.name: Beaded Fragrance
items.description: The white finch was Gwen's only friend in the secluded forest. They talked from flowers to the secrets of color.

items.name: Finch's Bloom
items.description: The white finch would help Gwen weave, either picking up a thread or singing to the rhythm of the spinning wheel.

items.name: Honeypot of Dreams
items.description: The colorful sweets in the bear's pocket are sour, sweet or refreshing. She's always looking forward to the next one.

items.name: Bubble Glitter
items.description: When the last bubble breaks, she wakes up to her usual room, the doll smiling at her on her night stand.

items.name: Carefree Companion
items.description: She dances with the bear as the sunflowers sing. The bear is happy to make a new friend and accept her honey gift.

items.name: Blossom Choir
items.description: She follows the sound to see sunflowers rejoicing in the sun. She lies among the blooms as they share their stories.

items.name: Heartwarming Aspiration
items.description: If she could stand again, would her life be as colorful? She dozes off in the warm sunlight with such hope.

items.name: Joyous Melody
items.description: Her wheelchair is somehow gone. She tries to take a step, her feet in ballet shoes, leaping briskly on the ground.

items.name: Haven of the Soul
items.description: She's now wearing the doll's white dress, with a sea of sunflowers like the fairyland in her imagination.

items.name: Colorful Fairyland
items.description: She dances in the fragrant breeze and blooms, as colorful bubbles float and decorate the field as a fairyland.

items.name: Sunlight Streak
items.description: She lies on the grass and basks in the warmth of the sun, as butterflies whisper secrets to her ears.

items.name: Gilded Rainbow
items.description: She rides the wind above the clouds, collects golden candy in the rain and rests sometimes on the rainbow bridge.

items.name: Free Saunter
items.description: She feels the ground tremble from afar and passes a portal to see a crowned bear in her handmade overalls.

items.name: Future Marvels
items.description: She plans for the next picture book with hopes for the future, an interesting and joyful story forming in her mind.

items.name: Shards of Dreams
items.description: A sound of sleds broke the silence of winter as a couple emerged from the dark and dusted snow off their clothes.

items.name: Elysium Star
items.description: Maggie woke up and found that the snow had stopped. She ran downstairs and saw the goddess' gift by the fireplace.

items.name: Snow Feather
items.description: Before going to sleep, Maggie made her wish innocently. Then she dreamed about her parents, holding her in their arms.

items.name: Auspice of Snow
items.description: Maggie unwrapped the gift, her grandma lovingly watching her, and saw a beautiful scarf and a star-shaped hair clip.

items.name: Hug in Snow
items.description: Maggie put on her new scarf and waited for her parents, who didn't show up even when the stars had risen.

items.name: Starry Gift
items.description: Tears welled up in Maggie's eyes. Looking at the frozen forest, Grandma patted her back, but she refused to go to bed.

items.name: Dream Watch
items.description: And the stars had indeed been the best gift, for they had guided innumerous souls in the darkness of winter nights.

items.name: Stellar Ceremony
items.description: When the snow stopped, Maggie's parents decided to hurry back. In the vast snowland, the stars had been their guide.

items.name: Sweetest Hope
items.description: All kinds of sweets wrapped in colorful packages with adoring affection. Special gifts for the special person.

items.name: Blooming Years
items.description: As she skates down the shaded street, her hair flutters in the wind; every turn she takes becomes part of her memory.

items.name: Hues of Adolescence
items.description: The gentle spring sunlight casts on her skateboard and her classmates wait for her to join the graduation ceremony.

items.name: Mellow Zephyr
items.description: Stars scattered across the sky as the evening breeze sang. Children closed their eyes, falling into beautiful dreams.

items.name: Veiled Scorpion
items.description: The grateful villagers offered the girl a beautiful bouquet. She held it in her arms and gently touched the petals.

items.name: Whirling Clouds
items.description: An elder Zhu, aided by a servant, took out a manuscript, revealing the man in red in the painting as his uncle.

items.name: Ode to Love
items.description: People dismissed the story. Mr. Spring was a person of arrogance and solitude, never treating others with hospitality.

items.name: Ink Painting of Tiger
items.description: Years later, the Zhu family shocked their guests at an event by revealing the other half of Ban Yin.

items.name: Yin Yang Harmony
items.description: The painting revealed another mystery: two figures in white and red admiring the red plum blossoms.

items.name: Azure Waters
items.description: I heard a mountain under the Bay of Cang River shared my name I became hopelessly lost'

items.name: Circling Clouds
items.description: The person who saved me wore a calm nonchalance on his face before introducing himself as Mr. Spring.'

items.name: Encaptivating Words
items.description: I'm invited to his residence. I was impressed by the stacks of fragrant scrolls and the vivid drawing of red plums.'

items.name: Destined Encounter
items.description: Mr. Spring showed equal interest in my travels. We became friends as we shared an admiration for each other.'

items.name: Faraway Ambition
items.description: Everyone in my tribe believed that east was the direction where one would find truth and the gods.'

items.name: Mountains and Rivers
items.description: Following this creed, I traveled to White Rock City and Rolterdan. As I journeyed, I found another also headed east.'

items.name: Magical Journey
items.description: Mr. Spring and I promised a reunion each year, a promise that we have always kept no matter how far we were.'

items.name: Lifetime Story
items.description: The elder and his uncle were close. Upon his uncle's passing, he found these travelogues that mentioned Mr. Spring.

items.name: Soaring Hearts
items.description: You are intrigued by the afar, while I am fascinated by the mountain. We simply share the same love.'

items.name: Plum Blossom to Give
items.description: I chose not to persuade further. As I left, he gifted me a painting of plums. It's been my treasure ever since.'

items.name: Silent Utterance
items.description: The two halves of Ban Yin were finally reunited, displaying its beauty to all those who beheld it.

items.name: Painting of Hearts
items.description: Insight can gained from observing Forward. Unlike Surel's early work, this one does not depict the Vien Manor.

items.name: Eternal Blossom
items.description: The large waves and dark colors accentuated the sole sail in the tempest using seemingly useless brushstrokes.

items.name: Inseparable Companion
items.description: The conversation between Surel and the fairy is so mysterious that even her parents didn't mention it in their memoir.

items.name: Magnum Opus
items.description: On this special afternoon, when Surel uncharacteristically put down paintbrush, her magnum opus, Forward, was born.

items.name: Rural Beauty
items.description: Her work covered every inch of Vien Manor. From the pond of still water to the midsummer night trail.

items.name: Esteemed Fame
items.description: As Surel's work gained fame, so did the manor, welcoming countless guests to behold its beauty.

items.name: Country Tale
items.description: Surel smiled at her parents with her easel on her back. Perhaps a polite fairy will ask her for a portrait today.

items.name: Midnoon Adventure
items.description: No cicada chirp or fluttering of wings could interrupt Surel from painting, until she felt a pat on her shoulder.

items.name: Fairy Dwelling
items.description: The forbidden palace of the Fairy King was illuminated last night in its full glory.

items.name: Mirage of Life
items.description: The young girl frowned as she stared at the man's pointy ears. He bowed and apologized politely for interrupting her.

items.name: Wintry Surge
items.description: No longer being at a loss, Satiel would still choose those silvery figures as she secretly returned to the hill.

items.name: Perceptive Deer
items.description: The birds and the gentle zephyr would play with her braids as she hung the decorations on the Ashen Deer's antlers.

items.name: Glacial Summit
items.description: The villagers, believing it to be a divine sign, braided her hair and wrote the name Satiel onto her palm.

items.name: Woodland's Depths
items.description: Satiel had a difficult time understanding the human tongue as she tried her best to mimic their moves and words.

items.name: Grace of Nature
items.description: Before Satiel realized it, the night had already fallen. Panicked, she ran toward the village at the hill bottom.

items.name: Enlightened Radiance
items.description: Seeing Satiel and the Deer emerge from a bush sent relief to the anxious faces of the villagers searching for her.

items.name: Tale of Life
items.description: The Spirit Birds and the Ashen Deer helped the villagers forage, while Satiel would often bring them a lot of food.

items.name: Dawn Till Dusk
items.description: Satiel's stomach growled. The villagers held her hand as they took the journey back on the torch-lit trail.

items.name: Circle of Life
items.description: Even as Satiel grew up, she still trod between the deer pack and the village, almost like a bridge connecting them.

items.name: Eternal Dream
items.description: Satiel never had to speak in front of the Ashen Deer and the Spirit Birds. When she did, she felt strange.

items.name: Bells of Old
items.description: The villagers sat by the dying flame, unsure where to go next. Yet, idle waiting would only spell certain death.

items.name: Endless Snow
items.description: That day, the snowstorm became ceaseless, slowly enveloping the mountain and blowing aside the meager tents.

items.name: Enchanting Ceremony
items.description: Every time the villagers invited Satiel to perform, she would bury her face into a deer's soft fur with a blush.

items.name: Glimmering Candlelight
items.description: The Holy Maiden braided the young girl's hair as she whispered into her ear, her eyes glimmering as she nodded.

items.name: Echoes of the Void
items.description: The table shuddered as the girl embraced the young woman, making her father look both embarrassed and flustered.

items.name: Steps of Wishes
items.description: The little girl could hold her curiosity no longer. 'O' Holy Maiden. What hast the gods whispered to thy ears?'

items.name: Majestic Crown
items.description: The child leaned on her father's shoulder and asked what the divine gods had revealed with their revelations.

items.name: Veiled Mist
items.description: Doves flew across the sky. As the crowd admired the flock, a girl, clad in white, began to walk toward them.

items.name: Divine Whispers
items.description: The child's father stroked her hair as the crowd laughed, jokingly telling her to ask for herself at the ceremony.

items.name: Concert of Shadows
items.description: She needed no introduction. To everyone, she was the definition and the indisputable image of the Holy Maiden.

items.name: Ashen Hymn
items.description: The girl radiated with a divine radiance as she chanted the story about a divine ship heading to the east.

items.name: Between Light and Darkness
items.description: The Holy Maiden sat at the feast, patiently and lovingly answering the questions from the crowd gathered around her.

items.name: Silent Prayer
items.description: The young lady walked toward the candle-lit podium, gently lowering her head as she beckoned toward the crowd below.

items.name: Crown of Nights
items.description: The young lady walked onto the podium basked in the sound of pious prayers and the shimmering candlelight.

items.name: Veil of Dreams
items.description: The young lady knew where she came from, and she also knew where she should lead her people.

items.name: Secrets of Divinity
items.description: With her hands clasped together, she whispered her yearnings and devotion to the true deities residing in her heart.

items.name: Waters of Clarity
items.description: Under the distant chants, the young woman began to dance under the veil of stars, her eyes shimmering like the ocean.

items.name: Stellar Path
items.description: As the world fell into a hush, the young woman and her companions dove into the night as they chased the morning sun.

items.name: Spiritual Enlightenment
items.description: The young woman stood under the stars, the wind swept through her hair and brought her the secrets hidden by time.

items.name: Symphony of Stars
items.description: The young woman finally broke her shackles and retrieved her soul. She now yearns to be reunited with her friends.

items.name: Silent Questions
items.description: The man followed the army into the snowy North Kingdom, only the stars in the sky knew of his true destination.

items.name: Secret of Ages
items.description: The once foreign girl was not closely intertwined with this land, her eyes resolute and glimmering with confidence.

items.name: Fortune's Signs
items.description: The diligent queen and her sister would sometimes lie in each other's embrace as they gazed into the stars.

items.name: Stellar Brilliance
items.description: Each card glowed with an inscrutable intent. Let fate guide your hand, and the stars will reveal the secret within.

items.name: Flowering Romance
items.description: Returning guests would often share the location of flowers with the smiling girl. Soon, a voice called out to her.

items.name: Blooming Patience
items.description: Mina always paused to listen to these stories, her flowers standing as a silent witness to sincerity and affection.

items.name: Dream of Blossoms
items.description: Mina always carried a small basket of flowers for each season. She firmly believed in waiting for a flower's bloom.

items.name: Flowering Romance - Indigo
items.description: The young girl who would often buy the small flower fell ill, her face pale as snow when Mina visited her.

items.name: Blooming Patience - Indigo
items.description: The girl spoke feebly to Mina, hoping to once again feel the touch of the yellow flower she first received from Mina.

items.name: Dream of Blossoms - Indigo
items.description: Yet, those delicate flowers would only blossom in summer. What should Mina do to fulfill her wish?

items.name: Flowering Romance - Warmth
items.description: A moment of brilliance erupted on Mina's face. She kissed her mother before rushing to her little greenhouse.

items.name: Blooming Patience - Warmth
items.description: Euphoria washed over Mina as the yellow petals broke through the bud. She placed the flower in her embrace and ran.

items.name: Dream of Blossoms - Warmth
items.description: The little girl awoke to find the yellow flowers in front of her, vibrant and filled with comforting solace.

items.name: Driving Thunder
items.description: Zhichen commanded the power of nature. People believed that the echoes of clapping thunder were his wrathful roar.

items.name: Into the Clouds
items.description: Inspired by the thunderclap, craftsmen added bear paws and eagle claws to the statue to exude its divine might.

items.name: Soaring Dragon
items.description: Commanding the rain, the craftsmen also added aquatic elements, in the form of winding whiskers and glimmering scales.

items.name: Glimmering Scales
items.description: Zhichen would call down rain in times of drought, as he would protect the city in stormed by a raging tempest.

items.name: Mountain of Fortune
items.description: Curious about his image in the people's minds, Zhichen often came as he observed the puny creatures and big creations.

items.name: Idyllic Pavilion
items.description: Crafting a statue the size of a mountain was a generational endeavor, with each craftsman adding details bit by bit.

items.name: Dragon's Descendants
items.description: The most skilled craftsmen were chosen as they trekked from far and wide to work on this colossal statue.

items.name: Kaleidoscope of Clouds
items.description: Each worker devoted their life to the statue's making, manning every task with almost pious diligence.

items.name: Fortune's Evanescence
items.description: Centuries have come and passed, the once barren mountain was slowly transformed into its new form.

items.name: Serene Quietude
items.description: The statue's unique appearance pleased Zhichen, who imprinted his form upon the stone outcrop.

items.name: Azure Expanse
items.description: The statue slowly began to take shape. Its mysterious appearance is accentuated by the mountain's misty veil.

items.name: Unseen Lurker
