items.description: The statue towered into the clouds, leaving only its majestic claws visible for the mortals to behold its grandeur.

items.name: Divine Genesis
items.description: The statue took many forms, the antlers of deer, the scales of carps... It was like an amalgamation of nature itself.

items.name: Empyrean Soar
items.description: Suddenly, mountains shattered to reveal the glimmering scale underneath Zhichen leaped into the air in his new form.

items.name: Cosmic Destiny
items.description: With his new form, Zhichen soared through the heavens, displaying his grandeur to those who helped shape him.

items.name: Lunar Floriography
items.description: The fairies tried to stop Elina. Without Lake Bovaly, there were terrible dangers lurking in the depths of the woods.

items.name: Wishful Tolls
items.description: Elina's songs were filled with hope and excitement, 'Do not worry for me, for the moon will bestow me with courage.'

items.name: Aria of Sorrow
items.description: Elina departed into the strange forest under the worrying gaze of her friends as the flowers waved her goodbye.

items.name: Aureate Touch
items.description: Standing at the mist-enveloped entrance, Elina stopped to ask a wandering goose for directions.

items.name: Symphony of Petals
items.description: Elina did not feel lonely in the forest. Moonlight guided her as she sang with the flowers and the chirping birds.

items.name: Effulgent Gossamer
items.description: The Jungle of Thorns offered little reprieve. Elina followed the river forward until she finally saw moonlight.

items.name: Effulgent Dream
items.description: Across the river and through the thorns, where the moonlight quietly awaits the next adventurer.'

items.name: Wondrous Odyssey
items.description: It's said that the Moonlight Flower only blossoms at the river's beginning, blessing those who see it with courage.

items.name: Ballad of Love
items.description: The young woman's song could cure the body and soothe the soul, winning the heart of a sailor who heard her song.

items.name: Tale of Ripples
items.description: Isabelle would meet her love from dawn till dusk, not even the ocean could separate their beating hearts.

items.name: Pearly Tears
items.description: The tempest subsided, but her lover would never return again. Tears of sorrow streamed down Isabelle's cheeks.

items.name: Cirrus Lament
items.description: The lantern was stolen and her lover was gravely injured. As Isabelle slowly sank, even the sea wept tears of sorrow.

items.name: Plumes of Reunion
items.description: To awaken Isabelle, the sailor traveled far and wide, eventually finding a way from the mouth of a witch.

items.name: Call of Sincerity
items.description: The sailor rowed his lonely boat as he braved the waves and the thunderstorm, feeling no fear in his heart.

items.name: Plumed Memento
items.description: Without the protection, the sea bellowed ceaselessly, destroying all ships that dared to venture too close.

items.name: Radiant Promise
items.description: The sailor possessed a lantern that exuded divine powers in Isabelle's hands, drawing malicious eyes upon it.

items.name: Poem of Reunion
items.description: Ships once again began to frequent these waters. Isabelle once again surfaced, this time singing the sailor's song.

items.name: Agate Crystal
items.description: The closer she came to home, the more familiar faces greeted her along the way.

items.name: Sweet Nectar
items.description: She rushed into the arms of her grandmother, who sat smiling outside the decorated house.

items.name: Plump Fruition
items.description: Spring buds bloom in summer. Autumn fruits hang from branches, ripening into red persimmons by winter.

items.name: Persimmon Lantern
items.description: The persimmon-shaped lantern casts its warm glow, guiding people into a dreamy wonderland as they soundly sleep.

items.name: Nightmare Resurgent
items.description: The priestess chant continued until a beam of light pierced through the clouds like the sharp edge of a blade.

items.name: Guarding Oracle
items.description: Eons had passed, yet the seed of hope traded with countless lives had long taken root in these lands.

items.name: Sanguine Rose
items.description: As the chants faded, the priestess fell from the altar, charred plumes turned into roses as darkness became light.

items.name: Nocturnal Rhythm
items.description: She would walk from table to table with a smile, her affectionate personality radiating toward each delighted guest.

items.name: Euphoric Rhythm
items.description: The bar had a large round table, large enough for all guests to sit around Matina as they chattered among themselves.

items.name: Silent Cosmos
items.description: Matina had a knack for creating drinks from seemingly unrelated ingredients, often resulting in unforgettable tastes.

items.name: Glowing Star
items.description: The guests' eyes fell upon Matina, who stood up with a small shrug.

items.name: Midnight Melody
items.description: That time of the day again? Very well. One more drink and I'll share a few encaptivating tales.'

items.name: Moonlit Veil
items.description: Fatigue was nonexistent on Matina's face, her eyes glimmering as she spoke with an affectionate smile.

items.name: Nocturnal Rhythm - Rose
items.description: It was a long time ago,' she said, 'a fortune teller told me that I should stay away from music for my own good.'

items.name: Euphoric Rhythm - Rose
items.description: I did not believe her. To prove her wrong, I began to sing in her shack. Gave her quite a scare.'

items.name: Silent Cosmos - Rose
items.description: I sang with my heart. I didn't care whether it was going to bring me misfortune. I wasn't scared one bit.'

items.name: Glowing Star - Rose
items.description: I told her that music has brought me joy my entire life. That's why I will never give up singing!'

items.name: Midnight Melody - Rose
items.description: Matina smiled confidently. 'I am the performer of my own life, after all. Only I define its magnificence.'

items.name: Moonlit Veil - Rose
items.description: Little did I know, my song attracted a lot of guests to the shack. I ended up making quite a pretty penny that day.'

items.name: Nocturnal Rhythm - Fragrant
items.description: But the feeling didn't last,' Matina continued mysteriously, 'because I found a way. I returned to school.'

items.name: Euphoric Rhythm - Fragrant
items.description: What?' Shock rang through the crowd as Matina explained the thick tree growing just outside her classroom window.

items.name: Silent Cosmos - Fragrant
items.description: It started out well. The leaves were thick, and nobody noticed me hiding just outside the window.'

items.name: Glowing Star - Fragrant
items.description: But that didn't last. One day, I fell from the cracked branch.' Matina continued.

items.name: Midnight Melody - Fragrant
items.description: That's how my teacher found out about me. She paid for my treatment and let me back inside the classroom.'

items.name: Moonlit Veil - Fragrant
items.description: Give me some snacks and a bottle of water and I could sit in a classroom learning for days.'

items.name: Fishy Contemplation
items.description: Between leisurely pleasures, she would sneak a peek at the worshipers here to piously make their wish.

items.name: Calming Nonchalance
items.description: The Fish Spirit believed that wishes were a sign of greed and true happiness is only gained by those with few needs.

items.name: Fateful Romance
items.description: Excited, the Fish Spirit lined up. When she met the Stargazer, she learned that a tale of love was about to unfold.

items.name: Destiny's Beckon
items.description: But she didn't want to be part of a love story. Yet, the stargazer smiled and told her that fate cannot be defied.

items.name: Fishy Contemplation - Crimson
items.description: One day, the tranquility of the temple was broken by thieves, who laid their eyes on the beautiful carp.

items.name: Calming Nonchalance - Crimson
items.description: Just as the Fish Spirit pondered, the bamboo on the bank lashed out and struck the thieves.

items.name: Fateful Romance - Crimson
items.description: Pleased with the outcome, the Fish Spirit stared at the bamboo as a realization struck her.

items.name: Destiny's Beckon - Crimson
items.description: The bamboo shifted slightly before taking up the shape of a person. The Fish Spirit smiled. Fate was one step ahead.

items.name: Fishy Contemplation - Cerulean
items.description: She almost tripped and fell until someone saved her, the pleasant smell of bamboo drifting into her nose.

items.name: Calming Nonchalance - Cerulean
items.description: The Fish Spirit thanked her savior. The young man nodded as he shook a fan with bamboo drawn across it.

items.name: Fateful Romance - Cerulean
items.description: The dog said that meeting a person repeatedly is fate at work. This was the third time that their paths had crossed.

items.name: Destiny's Beckon - Cerulean
items.description: The young man yielded the candy to her. Watching him leave, she quickly blushed and ran off with the sugar painting.

items.name: Auspicious Clouds
items.description: People admire the plum blossoms while drinking tea. They invite Kiri to join them, but she smiles and then leaves.

items.name: Charm Earring
items.description: She strokes the plum blossoms and plucks petals from the branches—she's going to make honey plums for the festival.

items.name: First Snow
items.description: When dusk falls, Kiri has a full basket of petals. She waves goodbye to the others and sets off on her way home.

items.name: Eternal Prosperity
items.description: Kiri is also a famous cook in the town: the unique flavor of her rice cakes and cookies is her trademark.

items.name: Abundant Blessings
items.description: She makes pastries for her friends every year and also receives the best cuisine and scented pouches in return.

items.name: Fragrance Hall
items.description: The townsfolk love sharing things with each other, and a joyful mood has filled up the air across the town.

items.name: Festive Scents
items.description: Smoke rises from the town. As soon as Kiri arrives, she's engulfed by the smell of pork and fish...

items.name: Longing Vignettes
items.description: The girl told Jin Meng that she was leaving soon. Jin Meng expressed regret that she had yet to prepare a present.

items.name: Spring of Wonders
items.description: She told Jin Meng that meeting her was the best present she could ever receive.

items.name: Carp of Fortune
items.description: It was the holidays again as Jin Meng and the girl walked hand in hand, just like the first time they met.

items.name: Glimmering Opulence
items.description: To repay her, she cast a spell and turned all the rice in her house into glittering gold.

items.name: Auspicious Wisdom
items.description: At the moment of farewell, Jin Meng gave the girl her prized goldfish pendant and decided to continue her training.

items.name: Sunset's Veil
items.description: When the young girl discovered the gold, she bowed to the sky and vowed to share this gift with the less fortunate.

items.name: United Perseverance
items.description: The girl was soon appointed as Sikong, praised and loved for her diligence and devotion to the people.

items.name: Joyous Reminiscence
items.description: Jin Meng gasped, she revealed herself and explained what had happened, to which the girl only smiled faintly.

items.name: Ebbing Ripples
items.description: It's said when a carp grows to a century old, it will be able to morph into a human. Jin Meng was such a curious carp.

items.name: Sylvan Rhythm
items.description: The girl wanted to be a minister and help the people. Despite being friends, Jin Meng did not know how to repay her.

items.name: Current Tracing
items.description: Jin Meng did not leave. She made up an excuse so she could stay by her side and find out her true aspirations.

items.name: Night of Solace
items.description: As she handed her present to him, she suddenly noticed a beautiful hairpin lying in his palm.

items.name: Night of Joy
items.description: As she walked toward the old bridge under the beautiful fireworks, she saw his figure walking slowly toward her.

items.name: Blissful Chant
items.description: As dawn neared and the crowd thinned, she said her farewells to him beside the bridge where they first met.

items.name: Preordained Fate
items.description: It was a new year, and Long Street was decorated anew. This year, she was determined to tell him her true feelings.

items.name: Emerald Verdure
items.description: She would often remember that night as the exchanges in letters between him and her became increasingly frequent.

items.name: Distant Reminiscence
items.description: She would place her tender thoughts into each gift, careful to not reveal too much affection in each one.

items.name: Gilded Brilliance
items.description: Goddess flickered her hand, in a mere instant, they were both thousands of miles away.

items.name: Baroque Lantern
items.description: She traveled with Goddess, her amazement turning into disarray as she witnessed the desolation across the land.

items.name: Misty Lotus
items.description: She approached Goddess, only to be stunned by the beautiful jade pedestal she was sitting on.

items.name: Undying Light at Night
items.description: Goddess grinned, tapping her on the forehead. Instantly, she levitated as if a weight was removed from her body.

items.name: White Phoenix
items.description: Is this real?' She nodded. 'I want to help them.' Her voice trembling with emotions.

items.name: Spinning Plumes
items.description: You should do something. I know you can.' Goddess stroked her hair gently. 'Come. We should head back.'

items.name: Sparrow's Shadow
items.description: Back in the capital, it was a different scene. The city was shining opulently, as if no suffering ever existed.

items.name: Radiant Pearl
items.description: She stared at the most opulent building inside the palace and asked Goddess who lived there.

items.name: Divine Omnipotence
items.description: Goddess stared at her, asking who she thinks could live in a place more extravagant than the emperor's own residence.

items.name: Radiant Extravagance
items.description: She suddenly felt a rush of air brushing past her as she closed her eyes to the nauseating sensation.

items.name: Silent Radiance
items.description: As she went to bed, something weighed on her heavily. She knew she had to do something.

items.name: Cosmic Splendor
items.description: Cosette was determined to swim against the current and make a name for herself in this city.

items.name: Brilliant Beyond
items.description: Starnight Hotel was Cosette's great work. Today was its grand opening, and every famous name was going to be there.

items.name: Lustrous Trail
items.description: She lived by the creed 'Go out, walk forward.' She started as a mere waiter and slowly accumulated her success.

items.name: Night City
items.description: Many years ago, Cosette was just a farm girl. Yet unlike her peers, she harbored great ambitions and a big dream.

items.name: Radiant Chrome
items.description: There are many girls just like Cosette in the city. They became friends in life and partners in their pursuits.

items.name: Silent Tide
items.description: Cosette had a shrewd business mind. Despite the hardships, she built one of the most successful brands in the city.

items.name: Effulgent Year
items.description: Cosette's affluent friends came to congratulate her, each a testament and success story in their pursuit of dreams.

items.name: Nightly Stars
items.description: The road to success is often paved with failures. The perseverance burning in Cosette was unyielding.

items.name: Paean to Time
items.description: Standing at the summit of success, Cosette's eyes shimmered slightly as she gazed resolutely into the distance.

items.name: Eternal Chapter
items.description: There are many women who came to this city in search of success, and Cosette was the most known out of them all.

items.name: Radiant Altar
items.description: People dared not look into those resolute eyes under the crown, nor stare into the burnt skin underneath those robes.

items.name: Sorrowless Crown
items.description: Pain and suffering often go hand in hand. When the king died, Serena became the one to shoulder the burden of war.

items.name: Glacial Identity
items.description: Dauntless, her bravery exceeded even that of her father. Yet even such high praises did not move Serena one bit.

items.name: Northern Prophecy
items.description: Serena still remembers the day her father died. It was a quiet evening, a flock of ravens were flying across the sky.

items.name: Overwhelming Might
items.description: That night, Serena charged into the enemy's ranks and ignited the enemy's banner into a fireball of light.

items.name: Medal of Fire
items.description: Serena charged with unmatched ferocity, her might seemingly unstoppable as swung her blade.

items.name: Badge of Thunder
items.description: As the arrow pierced the heart of the enemy's general, so did Serena's name echo through countless ears and hearts.

items.name: Sun's Descent
items.description: The enemy fell back. The once invincible seemingly melted away as Serene unleashed an arrow filled with vengeance.

items.name: Crimson Ember
items.description: Some say a cold throne can only be warmed by a compassionate heart beating for the people.

items.name: Burning Resilience
items.description: As Serena ascended the altar, the priest bestowed her father's scepter of power solemnly into her waiting grasp.

items.name: In Her Name
items.description: As Serena's just crusade gained fame, many factions sought to ally themselves with Queen Serena.

items.name: Supreme Protection
items.description: Even as the struggle for power raged on in the North Kingdom, Serena's sword will always fight for peace and justice.

items.name: Verdant Gleam
items.description: When war was waged, she helped to quell the strife and restore peace. Cheers echoed throughout the land.

items.name: Ominous Sign
items.description: As the pandemic loomed, she dispersed people's fear and grew herbs in their soil, bringing forth hope.

items.name: Plume Hat
items.description: During the Light festivals, people hold grand parades and sing prayers in the bells. She, too, blends into the crowd.

items.name: Slumber Veil
items.description: Those who trace her steps would seek the darkness; for she always stays with those in need and fosters hope in them.

items.name: Dark Messenger
items.description: Blackbirds are usually ominous, but for the blessed, birds with green feathers from the darkness are a strand of hope.

items.name: Dawn of Tomorrow
items.description: No matter the hardship, always remember that the darkest nights always prelude the brightest dawn.

items.name: Echoing Sea
items.description: The idyllic tunes seemed to slow the passage of time as they danced elegantly in a sea of wondrous dreams.

items.name: Seaside Adventure
items.description: Swimming into the glimmering light and guided by the cerise whale, reaching for the bright and brilliant beyond.

items.name: Dream's Embark
items.description: Once she had made a decision, Cosette would see it through, no matter how tempting any alternatives may seem.

items.name: Mystic Dream
items.description: The glimmering stars and the dashing neon lights quietly shone for the girl who turned nothing into everything.

items.name: Chapter of Destiny
items.description: The stars beckoned toward the future and the past as the chapters of fate unfolded under a starry sky.

items.name: Special Gift
items.description: This bag takes inspiration from a gift bag. The classic colors mixed in with a dash of red fit it perfectly.

items.name: Poetic Elegance
items.description: Despite only releasing for a week, the new fan from the Apple Apparel Group has made it the latest fashion hit.

items.name: Velvet Bunny
items.description: Her arrival drove away Cintra's solitude. Unlike Cintra, her cousin was a carefree flower, blooming in vibrance.

items.name: Graceful Elegance
items.description: She took Cintra to a cherry grove, where they found an injured rabbit, likely abandoned by its owner.

items.name: Heartwarming Secret
items.description: They patched up the rabbit before hiding it inside her cousin's room. For Cintra, it was a wish come true.

items.name: Wishful Future
items.description: When she left, her cousin told Cintra that the friendship and courage the little rabbit signified would never fade.

items.name: Velvet Fun
items.description: Unwilling to separate the puppies, Ira handed Chinchel some persimmon treats as he quietly thanked her.

items.name: Trail of Hearts
items.description: Surprised by his courtesy, she turned to see his cheeks blush. She quickly turned away, blushing slightly.

items.name: Auspicious Occurrence
items.description: Hearing a bark, Nini ran to the sound. Turned out Chinchel brought back a dog. The two of them instantly got along.

items.name: Chasing Laughter
items.description: If Ira pretended not to hear, a pebble would land squarely beside her foot, giving her a startle each time.

items.name: Longing Solitude
items.description: Ira would often enjoy the evening sitting in the yard. Chinchel would often use this chance to call out her name.

items.name: Youthful Love
items.description: The two would pull tricks and pranks between each other, slowly growing up with no clear winner.

items.name: Ebbing Heartstrings
items.description: 'He's not my best friend. He's a troublemaker!' Chinchel froze uncharacteristically at the sound of Ira's words.

items.name: Unspoken Feelings
items.description: Chinchel slowly became reserved and began to avoid Ira, as if trying to hide something from her.

items.name: Gentle Warmth
items.description: Ira's mother delegated persimmon treats to her again this year. Hesitant, Ira still left the house with Nini.

items.name: Long Street Persimmon
items.description: Nini always walked in the front, and her loving nature won the hearts of everyone in the neighborhood.

items.name: Happy Trick
items.description: Stay wise, use your creativity and enjoy the festival! Forget about your worries and spread laughter across the world.

items.name: Faraway Longing
items.description: The Cloud, Pigeon Kingdom, and Wasteland... Wherever the young man went, he would send a postcard to Kiri.

items.name: Prismatic Love
items.description: He'd tell Kiri his next destination so she could write back, sharing fun stories and views.

items.name: Special Sincerity
items.description: Every postcard seemed like a bridge between them, and Kiri now looked forward to receiving her own letters.

items.name: Endearing Vow
items.description: Kiri had to run her shop and the photographer continued his journey, but postcards became a bond between them.

items.name: Reminiscent Time
items.description: The young man would send postcards with travel logs or photos, all of which Kiri treasured with heart.

items.name: Fond Echo
items.description: 'A new letter's here.' Kiri heard a knock and looked up to see the man holding a postcard with a bright smile.

items.name: Wood Fairy
items.description: As she slept, Abby felt something small and furry crawling up to her knee before squeezing into her arms.

items.name: Tree of Dreams
items.description: Abby smiled as she read the poems from the past.  Basking in the warm afternoon sun, she began to feel drowsy.

items.name: Graceful Petals
items.description: When she and Tara were young, they built a secret tree house that none of the adults knew about.

items.name: Sunny Aria
items.description: Even after Tara moved, Abby would still sometimes come here by herself and spend the night under the stars.

items.name: Spring Breeze
items.description: Abby squeezed into the tree house as wind flipped through the pages of slightly yellow pages of a poetry book.

items.name: Special Companion
items.description: The spine read: 'To my best friend Abby. May we never separate. – Tara.'

items.name: Misty Umbrella
items.description: Blushing in the warm breeze, Shuangyi and the young man finally shared their thoughts on poetry.

items.name: Aromatic Expanse
items.description: In a grove of peaches, they talked from noon to dusk. Shuangyi was impressed by his talent and sentiment.

items.name: Peachy Warmth
items.description: A student of her father's had exceptional talent. He could always think of the most beautiful rhyme on the spot.

items.name: Blossom Mirage
items.description: The students exchanged looks when they saw Shuangyi. Though the young man didn't look back, his ears had reddened.

items.name: Longing Lament
items.description: Shuangyi picked a peach blossom as a hair accessory that filled the grove with aroma, ready to compose a poem.

items.name: Sunlit Blossoms
items.description: But after two lines, her mind went blank, until a voice from the forest picked up her rhymes.

items.name: Promised Years
items.description: Shuangyi would come to the forest in the afternoon. She liked the clusters of blooms in spring there.

items.name: Basket of Dreams
items.description: Shuangyi followed the voice behind the tree and bumped into the young man from her father's class.

items.name: Resplendent Tint
items.description: Shuangyi quickly turned away and left before her father could scold her. He was very strict in class, after all.

items.name: Wistful Longing
items.description: The young man never gained any titles but left famed poems and paintings, of which Shuangyi was always the subject.

items.name: Echoes of Destiny
items.description: The war finally broke out. Hostility filled the once peaceful woods and fond memories shattered like glass.

items.name: Lonesome Moon
items.description: Instead of leaving with family, Eric hid in the dark ruins where the moon didn't shine, waiting for the promised time.

items.name: Midnight Promise
items.description: They promised to leave the world behind and spend the rest of their lives in a valley where they could be together.

items.name: Sinful Embrace
items.description: Generations of hatred might have put a wall between them, but couldn't stop the pull they felt.

items.name: Moonlit Embrace
items.description: 'If only bones remained of my hands, how should I invite you to a dance under the moon?'

items.name: Hollow Lake
items.description: At the end of her life, she returned to the moonlit lake, ignoring the feud between fairies and the sanguine.

items.name: Starlit Meadow
items.description: The buoyant songs stopped and the young man lowered his hand as the fairies' chattering sound came closer.

items.name: Unclouded Moonlight
items.description: She waited for the night, listening to the footsteps of patrolling fairies, and believed Eric would keep his promise.

items.name: Ethereal Slumber
items.description: She lifted her hem and danced as stars shimmered on her dress, igniting this long night that would last forever.

items.name: Pale Moon Shadow
items.description: The young man invited her to a dance, as the stars twinkled in the lake and faded away in the everlasting night.

items.name: Fading Starlight
items.description: Celestine waited by the lake until dew wetted her dress and stars faded away, but the young man didn't come.

items.name: Eternal Starshine
items.description: How could a fairy and a sanguine live together? Hatred kept them apart until their promise was forgotten in time.

items.name: Starfall Dream
items.description: The patrol fairies found a few sanguines in hiding and killed them before they could fight back.

items.name: Astral Recall
items.description: She hoped that Eric didn't keep his promise and moved into the Shadow City, instead of being killed by a cold arrow.

items.name: Boat of Return
items.description: Celestine finally felt the candle of her life burning out, all her regrets and love coming to an end.

items.name: Starlit Promise
items.description: To Olivian's surprise, a man resembling the knight was waiting for someone by the fountain.

items.name: Cosmic Vastness
items.description: True love stood the test of time, as starlight traversed the vast universe only to reach you.

items.name: Starlit Destiny
items.description: In the starlit garden, Olivian clasped her hands and sincerely wished for peace for the nation and its people.

items.name: Stellar Hope
items.description: A valiant knight brought the people a new hope. Olivian thought maybe he could save the kingdom.

items.name: Veiled Fantasy
items.description: Her dreams continued every night. As war broke out, worry began to grow in Olivian's heart.

items.name: Radiant Gleam
items.description: It was a long tale of love and death, but the details had been lost in the years of retelling.

items.name: Midnight Ritual
items.description: The knight led their army to victories. In his accolade ceremony, his armor shone brighter than the stars.

items.name: Starlight Tears
items.description: The knight returned to battle, but the invaders began plotting against him by bribing his servant.

items.name: Veiled Starlight
items.description: 'It's you...' they spoke at the same time. The two stars finally crossed paths again, leaving no regrets.

items.name: Stairway to Victory
items.description: The knight won the war but died during his return. Tears rolled down her cheeks when she saw his bloodstained emblem.

items.name: Distant Lovesong
items.description: Every flapping of wings is a heartbeat. Together with the wind they write a love song only the sky understands.

items.name: Enduring Brilliance
items.description: The rainbow connected the world with its gentle arms. Every color is a story of love and longing.

items.name: Trace of Promise
items.description: The birds flap their wings, leaving a trace of love, of silent promise that echoes in the sky.

items.name: Fluffy Birth
items.description: The broken shell marks the start of a new life. A brace embrace of the world despite the teetering steps.

items.name: Scent of Sunlight
items.description: Someone put a giant crepe with a chicken fillet...on his head? The girl stared wide-eyed at the school gate.

items.name: Pastoral Delight
items.description: The class went outside the city to help harvest crops. Whichever team picked the most fruits would receive a prize.

items.name: Budding Legume
items.description: The girl got a new idea from the bitter melon sunglasses she won and drew a design sketch for a bag.

items.name: Virescent Charm
items.description: Cloudria lifted the hem of her dress to catch fish in the lake, but the figure on her mind was nowhere to be seen.

items.name: Summer Flare
items.description: Who was the man? Did she know him? Cloudria threw a lotus to draw his attention but hit the back of his head instead.

items.name: Elegant Poise
items.description: As the crowd sang and cheered, Cloudria looked around curiously and a figure among the lotus leaves caught her eyes.

items.name: Exuberant Ripples
items.description: The man turned with a confused yet not angry look, asking who threw the lotus, his face unfamiliar yet handsome.

items.name: Jubilant Leap
items.description: His voice drew everyone's attention. Cloudria blushed with embarrassment, but thankfully, her sister helped her out.

items.name: Lotus Rendezvous
items.description: Cloudria rowed under a lotus leaf and saw the man again. She offered freshly picked lotus seeds as an apology.

items.name: Pisces Embroidery
items.description: Cloudria returned with an empty basket. Lotus roots were still muddy, but she refused to say where they came from.

items.name: Fragrant Dream
items.description: Cloudria had cuts on her fingertips but still insisted on gathering lotus seedpods from the lake.

items.name: Lakeside Nelumbo
items.description: The next day, Cloudria rowed out again to look for the man, but he had already set out on his way home.

items.name: Stop Motion
items.description: She never defends herself and only answers with her work. She's always on the road, looking for the shining moments.

items.name: Flap Fluff
items.description: It was the first time she looked closely at a bee. It didn't have pretty wings, but it was cute in its own way.

items.name: Nest of Wonder
items.description: Shadie woke up to the warm sunlight. She walked out, rubbing her eyes, and saw her mom packing up for her.

items.name: Sunward Relish
items.description: The sun shone on the rusty gate of the botanical garden, while the thriving plants around drew all the attention.

items.name: Tendril Stretch
items.description: Lined inside the factory were glass jars of golden and sticky honey that filled the room with a sweet aroma.

items.name: Sylvan Spring
items.description: Shadie followed her mom down a path shaded by evergreen trees, while birds chirped among the leaves.

items.name: Brimming Glee
items.description: 'Do you want to meet the goddess of spring?' Her mom winked at her and took her on a bus to the botanical garden.

items.name: Momentary Flare
items.description: Shadie ran to a beaten trail in the daisy field for her mom to take a photo, when she suddenly heard a buzz.

items.name: Breezy Garland
items.description: Shadie held the camera to photograph the bees. 'Look, a honey factory!' she noticed an amber-colored building.

items.name: Ambrosial Bloom
items.description: Past a pebble stone road was a large field of daisies, their white petals like clouds and yellow florets like amber.

items.name: Honey Torsade
items.description: Ah, the bees! Shadie noticed some collecting nectars in the field. Quietly, she got closer without alarming them.

items.name: Azure Sunbeam
items.description: In a brilliant show, the glory isn't just for the lead; every honeybee deserves the audience's applause and cheers.

items.name: Summoned Eagle
items.description: Natasha's friend, a beautiful eagle, circled above to guide the tribe so they wouldn't get lost in the desert.

items.name: Distant Totem
items.description: The tribe drifted from place to place and many died, as the desert seemed to provide no shelter for them.

items.name: Natural Habitat
items.description: No priestess was born after the last one died decades ago. They lost the blessings of nature and spiritual guidance.

items.name: Oasis Search
items.description: 'Let's go back!' one night, Natasha spoke, 'We'll go back where we came from! It's where we belong!'

items.name: Scattered Seal
items.description: 'We'll contact the other tribes.' Natasha's voice was determined, 'Let's unite our powers, and we can win!'

items.name: Iridescent Glimmer
items.description: People had lost hope and didn't believe Natasha's words, but they had no choice but to fight for one last chance.

items.name: Blade of Time
items.description: They were not the only banished tribe, and those that stayed lived in constant fear and dread.

items.name: Voyage of Nature
items.description: Unlike the other priestesses, Natasha wasn't spiritually blessed, but she gave people courage and hope.

items.name: Graceful Swirl
items.description: Without a spotlight or orchestra, the dancer moved with the rhythms in her heart, each step full of life and grace.

items.name: Curtain Call
items.description: It was a dance with no audience but the stars in the night sky. Now a golden dawn awaited her.

items.name: Stellar Stream
items.description: The dancer tiptoed on the stars' reflection in the theater fountain, dancing with a delicate rose in her hand.

items.name: Swan Suite
items.description: The dancer's shadow would leave on quiet nights, tiptoeing and gyrating like a flower blooming under the moon.

items.name: Soaring Plume
items.description: Birds would often perch on the dancer's hair or arms. She envied them for being able to soar freely with wings.

items.name: Everlasting Ardor
items.description: One day a senior came from afar and put a red rose into the dancer's palm. 'May your wish come true.'

items.name: Graceful Shadow
items.description: The dancer had seen many dances, the classical ones in the theater or children's freestyle. They all fascinated her.

items.name: Cinema Wonder
items.description: In a sea of stars, the audience would see a rose-like stardust through a porthole and hear the protagonists' cheers.

items.name: Wish of Tomorrow
items.description: A young warrior roamed the desert as a ballad played under a starry sky. This time, he had the audience by his side.

items.name: Chord Focus
items.description: What's a perfect ending? Everyone has their own answer. People leave the theater, imagining what works for them.

items.name: Outside Pictures
items.description: A swordsman walked into a theater, a genius girl wandered in a supermarket, while a superhero had to go to school.

items.name: Crunchy Magic
items.description: People asked the staff member how to make the magical popcorn and only got the answer that it was a secret.

items.name: Starlight Shimmer
items.description: Popcorn would be finished when the movie ended. People would wave goodbye and forever remember the experience.

items.name: Drifting Sorrow
items.description: As time passes, only she stands still with a heart of sorrow, listening to the flute song and waiting for a reunion.

items.name: Plum Elegance
items.description: Rivers deep and mountains high, yet the longing remains unchanged. Plum trees will bloom again when snow falls.

items.name: Tracing Breeze
items.description: The rain and the sun take turns to nourish the wilderness. Where there is rain and sunlight, there is life.

items.name: Raindrop Journey
items.description: The kids were fascinated and described their own idea of it to the teacher, bringing a smile to Lilitha's face.

items.name: Clouded Guardian
items.description: Her mood brought clouds to the sky as rain fell and children dispersed, which made Lilitha feel even worse.

items.name: Azure Glaze
items.description: It rained for days in the forest until the sunshine elf came to console Lilitha, bringing a rainbow over her clouds.

items.name: Rainbow Drop
items.description: A musician wrote a rhyme inspired by the rain that children would sing while stepping in the splashing rain puddles.

items.name: Eternal Cycle
items.description: The sunshine elf followed Lilitha around the globe and witnessed the cycle of water from the sea to rainfalls.

items.name: Drizzle Ripple
items.description: The tree that they planted together waves its leaves to greet them. It wouldn't grow up without the sun or the rain.

items.name: Circle of Winds
items.description: The wind slowly carried the cloud away, as Lilitha hummed and floated with the humid air on a journey of freedom.

items.name: Viridescent Whisper
items.description: Cuckoo, sun's up and no more rain. Cuckoo, time's up and don't stay.' Ms. Lisa was stopped by the owl's puzzle.

items.name: Longing Vines
items.description: Ms. Lisa quickly asked the wise turtle for help. 'Home is wherever you are missed.' it answered mysteriously.

items.name: Spring Tranquility
items.description: Ms. Lisa asked what it meant, but the turtle only shook its head. As the animals left, silence returned to the woods.

items.name: Mellow Fairytale
items.description: Sorry I startled you.' the girl apologetically patted Ms. Lisa on her fluffy head and kissed her pink nose.

items.name: Emerald Aroma
items.description: The tea party ended in the scarlet twilight. The balloons were gone, but the sweetness of desserts still lingered.

items.name: Woodland Path
items.description: It was time to go home, but the way Ms. Lisa came from was now blocked by shrubs. She couldn't find her way home.

items.name: Sylvan Whisper
items.description: As the sky darkened and the wind whooshed, Ms. Lisa walked alone among the menacing shadows of the trees and shrubs.

items.name: Intertwining Vines
items.description: Thick vines blocked her way. Suddenly, a loud boom came from somewhere, startling her like thunder.

items.name: Lemon Essence
items.description: Ms. Lisa rubbed her eyes and realized she was still on the terrace at home, the smell of fresh lemon in the air.

items.name: Lemon Aroma
items.description: The sunshine? Ms. Lisa asked. The owl nodded. She sat at the table and the crab chef served her a piece of lemon cake.

items.name: Rich Fragrance
items.description: Before Moria came of age, her sister had made her wine's recipe, with a rich aroma and refreshing floral fragrance.

items.name: Sloshing Wine
items.description: The wine, Moonlight Rose, would be shared for the first time at Moria's coming-of-age party her sister prepared.

items.name: Rosy Spotlight
items.description: On Moria's birthday, the chateau owner greeted everyone in a stunningly beautiful gown of white roses.

items.name: Dazzling Star
items.description: When asked who designed the dress, the owner waved at the center of the dance floor and gently called 'Moria.'

items.name: Lonesome Night
items.description: Moria danced her way to her sister and held her arm dearly, explaining confidently her inspiration for the dress.

items.name: Moonlit Woe
items.description: A professor from an art school offered to take Moria in as a student. Her sister felt genuinely happy for her.

items.name: Moonlight Rose
items.description: Appraisers felt honored to take a sip of the Moonlight Rose, garnering more fame for the esteemed chateau.

items.name: Redolent Scroll
items.description: The scholar offered all his earnings from painting and said he'd write a proof of loan to pay back double.

items.name: Distant Emerald
items.description: The scholar's wife fell ill soon after their wedding. He spent all their life savings to save her but in vain.

items.name: Ink Stained Petal
items.description: The painter sighed and shook her head. She didn't want to lie and told him the truth: the rumor wasn't all true.

items.name: Hazy Willow
items.description: The scholar lowered his basket of money and paper. He refused to leave, begging the painter to paint his dead wife.

items.name: Lonesome Blossom
items.description: Vim's creations were only shapes and forms with no souls. They would melt into ink in water.

items.name: Ephemeral Dew
items.description: The painter asked hesitantly if the scholar would still want a replica of his wife, even though it couldn't speak.

items.name: River of Mist
items.description: The scholar only shook and cried after knowing there was no hope of reunion. Then he threw himself into the river.

items.name: Reflection of Time
items.description: Lifting the hem of her dress, the puppet invited her to a dance. With a mix of emotions, Andrea brought her home.

items.name: Splendid Flare
items.description: Andrea felt close to the puppet that couldn't dance anymore due to broken parts as the shopkeeper told her.

items.name: Tour of Wonder
items.description: It was a quaint shop with shelves of delicate puppets, and a dancer in a blue fluffy dress drew Andrea's attention.

items.name: Moonlit Crown
items.description: Sleepy-eyed, Andrea saw in the bright moonlight the puppet dancing to the music wafting from outside the window.

items.name: Crystalline Sound
items.description: It was a simple dance that the puppet couldn't finish. Still, she basked in the gentle moonlight and danced on.

items.name: Lambent Heart
items.description: One night, Andrea woke up to some rustles on the balcony and an indistinct song drifting inside the room.

items.name: Stellar Duet
items.description: The dance with a puppet became a special staple of the December Troupe, inspiring those in the face of adversity.

items.name: Onstage Elegance
items.description: Andrea didn't turn down the troupe's invitation this time. Inspired by the puppet, she choreographed a new dance.

items.name: Intricate Heart
items.description: Thanks to years of practice and an open mind, Andrea found joy again from dancing in repeated rehearsals.

items.name: Dream-chaser Wing
items.description: The moonlight shone on the puppet for the unique solo performance. Andrea felt her eyes brimming with tears.

items.name: Creative Vision
items.description: Unlike traditional dances, the unique and captivating performance won a standing ovation from the audience.

items.name: Fledgling Dream
items.description: She didn't dance for fame or fortune. It was her love for dancing and pursuit of a better self that made her.

items.name: Jovial Concerto
items.description: Despite the imperfection, Doreen's song was free and colorful, kindling the sparks in his heart.

items.name: Visionary Duet
items.description: With Doreen's inspiration, the conductor laid a sheet of paper on the desk and decided to compose again.

items.name: Stage Infinity
items.description: After the accident, the conductor thought his love for music was forever gone with his damaged hearing.

items.name: Inspired Variation
items.description: A few days after an elegant customer took the puppet, another walked in and noticed Doreen.

items.name: Close Companion
items.description: He was a conductor who had hearing loss from an accident and brought Doreen home after learning her story.

items.name: Consonant Echo
items.description: A joyful song wafted out of the window, leaping in the flowing moonlight and adorning the quiet night.

items.name: Lingering Lilt
items.description: The last lilt lingered in the empty room. The conductor stared at Doreen and reached out to gently touch her baton.

items.name: Fervent Chapter
items.description: Despite the dissonance in the unusual performance, the life in the song captivated the conductor's heart.

items.name: Tune of Dawn
items.description: Afraid her performance had frightened the conductor, Doreen remained still, but instead, he wound up the music box.

items.name: Sparkling Song
items.description: As if brought to life, Doreen forgot all worries and allowed buoyant sounds to flow freely in the room.

items.name: Fateful Reunion
items.description: After a show, the conductor rested Doreen on a table backstage, next to a puppet lifting the hem of her fluffy dress.

items.name: Fluttering Rhythm
items.description: With his new compositions, the conductor returned to the stage, bringing with him his muse, Doreen.

items.name: Daylight Melody
items.description: An all-new attempt and a different song. The conductor forgot all disappointments and immersed himself in music.

items.name: Splendid Plume
items.description: Surprisingly, the boy had rabbit ears. He spoke sheepishly and asked the girl about her thoughts on the gallery.

items.name: Breezy Dream
items.description: The girl praised the gallery, saying that she had felt as if on a special journey since she walked in.

items.name: Serene Fantasy
items.description: As their shoulders brushed, the boy blushed and invited the girl to go to the world of fairytales with him.

items.name: Rabbit Mask
items.description: A painting of a beautiful rose hedge was hanging on the wall beside them. The gate was open, beckoning them inside.

items.name: Springtime Prelude
items.description: In a golden light, she put her hand in his and closed her eyes. Together they stepped into a world of wonder.

items.name: Springtime Overture
items.description: Everything she saw felt extremely familiar, as though she had experienced it all a long time ago.

items.name: Splendid Plume - Poem
items.description: The moment she picked up her paintbrush, it felt alive and naturally recreated every wonder in this world on canvas.

items.name: Breezy Dream - Poem
items.description: The garden, tea party, and animals were all worth painting, but only the Hedge of Roses eventually showed on paper.

items.name: Serene Fantasy - Poem
items.description: 'It is our secret. Maybe...' the girl blinked and flashed a smile, '...we'd meet again here one day!'

items.name: Rabbit Mask - Poem
items.description: After a dizzy spin, the girl and the boy were back in the gallery. The gate in the painting was closed again.

items.name: Springtime Prelude - Poem
items.description: The boy wasn't human. Perhaps he had waited for countless springs for this eventual reunion.

items.name: Springtime Overture - Poem
items.description: The boy stared shyly at the girl while she looked dazed. They had met once a long time ago.

items.name: Natural Tunes
items.description: She lay under the stars as soft tunes wafted by in the evening breeze, feeling her heart melt in nature.

items.name: Floral Festival
items.description: Under the twinkling stars, people lit the bonfire, sending sparks and brightening every smile around.

items.name: Vivid Spring
items.description: People would dress up like wild animals for the festival and share the bright and warm spring with cute animals.

items.name: Hopeful Longing
items.description: In songs and sounds of laughter, friends would hold her hand, telling her their beautiful hope for the future.

items.name: Pastel Green
items.description: Budding grasses kissed her naked ankles, as the wind caressed the hem of her dress, inviting her to a dance.

items.name: Vernal Embrace
items.description: She danced holding hands with her friends, their songs and laughter the loveliest sounds of spring.

items.name: Spring Sweetness
items.description: In the shade of a tree, she took a bite of the flower cake, feeling the sweetness of spring between her teeth.

items.name: Spring Inebriation
items.description: She took a sip of the wine brewed in fresh spring water, letting the chilly sweetness bloom at the tip of her tongue.

items.name: Oceanic Hymn
items.description: Lofn would sing beautiful tunes under the moon, her voice as pleasant as soft waves, cleansing every heart.

items.name: Aureate Treasure
items.description: Filda's favorite was Lofn's O Jolly Times because it always made her feel a magical warmth.

items.name: Aromatic Rum
items.description: Lofn offered to teach Filda to sing, but even the patient girl would feel frustrated with Filda's wandering mind.

items.name: Looming Storm
items.description: Slowly Filda learned to sing in tune, but before she could finish the whole song, the calm sea was hit by a storm.

items.name: Spiral of Fate
items.description: The ship sailed in the storm as merciless waves hit the hull, but whirlpools pulled it close again and again.

items.name: Valorous Resolution
items.description: Humans were powerless against nature. Filda led everyone to the rafts while she prepared to sink with the ship.

items.name: Sigh of Departure
items.description: Filda gripped the coin as water gushed in. If she was to die on the ship, at least let her bid farewell to Lofn.

items.name: Melodious Solace
items.description: The coin let out a soft glow as she was losing consciousness. Again she heard a mermaid's gentle and comforting song.

items.name: Tender Cuddle
items.description: O Jolly Times was sung softly in the storm, and each note in the cheerful tune felt full of power.

items.name: Lazy Dreams
items.description: 'Sorry, but this will be our last lesson. Dear Filda, I'm glad to have met you and you'll always be in my heart.'

items.name: Miraculous Reunion
items.description: Filda fell asleep in a numbing warmth. It was Lofn's love and blessing, saving her across time and space.

items.name: Seaward Cruise
items.description: Filda woke up in the crew's calling as the wind blew on her face. The storm passed, leaving no injury on the ship.

items.name: Kindred Spirits
items.description: Lofn and Filda shared everything with each other, their hearts growing closer even if they had never met.

items.name: Ethereal Tune
items.description: Hearing that Filda loved the song she hummed, Lofn shook her tail and told Filda that the song was O Jolly Times.

items.name: Merry Moments
items.description: Lofn would flap her tail hearing Filda's jokes and then hope she could splash water on Filda's face in retaliation.

items.name: Billowing Dance
items.description: Filda practiced swordsmanship to protect her crew, and when asked, Lofn proudly said she had powerful magic.

items.name: Gleeful Scales
items.description: The first time they talked, Lofn knew there was not only space between Filda and her, but a great amount of time.

items.name: Inseparable Dream
items.description: Lofn was also interested in the treasures from Filda's hunts and hoped to join her squad if possible.

items.name: Starlit Bond
items.description: The last light in the sea died out with the storm. The mermaid closed her eyes and awaited the eternal slumber.

items.name: Casual Chatter
items.description: Filda would return with fascinating stories, putting Lofn on the edge of her seat or making her laugh hysterically.

items.name: Sterling Heart
items.description: Filda laughed, clearly skeptical. Infuriated, Lofn swam back and forth, mumbling she'd prove it to her one day.

items.name: Silent Rainfall
items.description: Lofn felt an endless source of power overflowing, her face pale as she almost lost her grip on the coin.

items.name: Sunken Treasure
items.description: Lofn decided to teach Filda the song, but the captain would sing out of tune and try to brush it off with jokes.

items.name: Everlasting Hope
items.description: Our time together will forever be in my heart. May sunny days and cozy wind be with you on every voyage.

items.name: Notes of Nature
items.description: The girl wanted to tell her granny every detail in the forest and gestured to explain what the flower looked like.

items.name: Vines of Vow
items.description: Prairie opened her eyes to find a new notebook on her nightstand, the cover shining under the morning sun.

items.name: Seal of Time
items.description: On the card was a familiar handwriting: To my dearest Prairie, and to collecting every secret in the forest.

items.name: Blossom of Dreams
items.description: The girl leaped off the bed, kissed her granny on the forehead, and ran to the forest with the notebook.

items.name: Surprise Invitation
items.description: When Prairie heard back from an interested publisher, she jumped in excitement and gave her granny a big hug.

items.name: Wildlife Love
items.description: Prairie was never tired of painting a plant or lying on a rock for a day to record the daily routine of a bird.

items.name: Genius Interest
items.description: Prairie learned a lot about animals and plants from books and fleshed out her notes with accurate details.

items.name: Loyal Reader
items.description: Prairie's grandma was still her most loyal reader, but now she needed glasses to read slowly between naps.

items.name: Warm Moments
items.description: Prairie proudly showed her notes in her grandma's warm embrace who would never miss a sentence or sketch.

items.name: Homeward Wonder
items.description: Prairie never made her grandma worry. She would hurry home at sunset, humming a cheerful song slightly out of tune.

items.name: Tempest Howl
items.description: Lofn worried when she heard Filda's ship was caught in a storm. Filda commanded her crew while gripping the coin.

items.name: Fluttering Tune
items.description: In the forest, Purin hummed and danced like a fluttering butterfly and talked to every bunny she saw.

items.name: Deer Astray
items.description: Purin heard a faint whimper and followed it to find a lost baby deer. Its eyes shone with hope when it saw her.

items.name: Viridescent Path
items.description: It was finally her chance! Mom asked Purin to send the new apples to her aunt living in the forest to make tarts with.

items.name: Symphony of Life
items.description: Why did the ears and tail come out again? Embarrassed, Purin looked into the deer's eyes and saw her own reflection.

items.name: Woodland Witch
items.description: Did you get lost? Purin petted the deer, but it was too scared to say anything and only shuddered in her arms.

items.name: Basket of Fruits
items.description: Purin gave the deer an apple and helped it home. They walked cheerfully together, forgetting all their worries.

items.name: Forest Blessing
items.description: A quiet voice sounded when Purin was about to give up. It turned out the deer snuck out of its home and got lost.

items.name: Woodland Wonder
items.description: Purin pressed her forehead against the deer's head to listen to its heart. Please, tell me what happened.

items.name: Frolicking Fun
items.description: Purin failed to turn back again. Then she saw the deer frolicking after her tail and decided to give up now.

items.name: Mechanical Glider
items.description: Maddie's friends built a mechanical glider to help her flee, but she dived straight into more danger.

items.name: Brief Report
items.description: Maddie always had her notebook and pen at hand, because she believed good news was meant for the prepared.

items.name: Spark of Dream
items.description: Maddie had friends from all walks of life to bring her information. Sometimes a good story is hidden in everyday jobs.

items.name: Special Article
items.description: Maddie could conduct in-depth investigations and interview people for months for an exclusive article.

items.name: Critical Comment
items.description: Maddie had written countless articles, and no praises or criticisms had changed her in the slightest.

items.name: Mirror of Truth
items.description: Maddie not only revealed ugly truths but also praised honest and brave souls and let their good deeds be known.

items.name: Investigative Journalism
items.description: 'People deserve the truth. I will find it even if I have to go through fire and water.'

items.name: Light of Wisdom
items.description: The text on the board is gone. Where did all the equations go? 'They are all in my mind!'

items.name: Triangle of Fun
items.description: All the sweat and tears turn into courage for a new chapter of adventures. The ship of dreams is about to sail away.

items.name: Frisky Gleam
items.description: A frozen lake is best for skating. The girl imagined it as a dance party where she would skate elegantly in the snow.

items.name: Frosty Satin
items.description: She lost herself in the waltz of snow, as doves tied a shiny and soft ribbon on her and snow adorned her dress.

items.name: Melting Snow
items.description: She'd sometimes recall that dance when she sat under twinkling stars, fantasizing about a more magical time.

items.name: Winter Starwish
items.description: The lake must have magic. Otherwise, why would her reflection be holding a wand in a snow-white dress?

items.name: Midwinter Dream
items.description: The sun dropped below the horizon, leaving a rosy streak. Imre closed her eyes to feel the gentle breeze.

items.name: Tethered Kite
items.description: Imre spanned the spool to control the kite with a string. She imagined spreading her wings and soaring in the air.

items.name: Benevolent Guardian
items.description: In the war-torn land, the nun stuck to her beliefs, treated the wounded and helped the homeless find shelter.

items.name: Divine Blessing
items.description: The nun appeared where she was most needed, leading teams daily in the search for food and medicine.

items.name: Salvation of Light
items.description: The nun stood in the holy light with praying hands. People never saw any god, but they still prayed with her.

items.name: Hymn of Faith
items.description: People sang psalms with the nun's lead. As long as they had faith and hope for peace, the land would be born again.

items.name: Eternal Hope
items.description: Every quiet night, the nun would patrol the church with a flickering candle, bringing hope to lost wanderers.

items.name: Benevolent Guardian - Heal
items.description: How to heal a wounded heart? The nun wasn't sure, but she guided the girl to seek the light of hope in the dark.

items.name: Divine Blessing - Heal
items.description: On her night patrol, the nun heard the girl crying in her sleep and left a handmade bunny toy by her pillow.

items.name: Salvation of Light - Heal
items.description: Orphans who stayed became her helpers. The girl learned much about medicine and decided to leave to help more.

items.name: Hymn of Faith - Heal
items.description: The church grew powerful enough to negotiate peace with the other forces. Peace might finally be dawning.

items.name: Eternal Hope - Heal
items.description: The war ended. Lilies outside the church bloomed again. Vagabonds returned while the nun welcomed them with a smile.

items.name: Bloom of Bond
items.description: The rich aroma lulled the girl into a dream, where she felt the embrace of her family and the calling of her friends.

items.name: Starlit Hope
items.description: The girl left the garden, walked steadfastly in the northern storms and listened to ancient prophecies in the desert.

items.name: Adventure Echo
items.description: The wheel of time keeps turning. The girl waved goodbye to her past and ventured into a bright future.

items.name: Innocent Echo
items.description: The girl already formed a deep connection with the land. It strengthened with every friend she met along the way.

items.name: Honored Promise
items.description: Hesitate never for the darkness ahead. I shall always be by your side, as we advance to a brighter future.

items.name: Untainted Heart
items.description: Despair filled the town. Why work hard restoring the farmlands when you could get a free lunch at the shelter?

items.name: Song of Tomorrow
items.description: Alice's gentle yet firm voice echoed across the field, inspiring people to rebuild their homes.

items.name: Rebirth of Hope
items.description: New houses were built above the ruins. People hummed Alice's new song and threw themselves into hard work.

items.name: Untainted Heart - Dream
items.description: Faith and smiles were the most needed after disasters. Alice stood again on stage, inspiring those who had lost hope.

items.name: Song of Tomorrow - Dream
items.description: Alice's voice carried the seeds of hope in the air that would bloom into brighter flowers upon the ruins.

items.name: Rebirth of Hope - Dream
items.description: Limelight shone once again in the ruins, as Alice cheerfully performed the greatest show for the audience.

items.name: Family Outing
items.description: Let's not waste such fine weather! Momo sat in the stroller, put on a mantle, and yelled, 'To the park!'

items.name: Yummy Moment
items.description: The girl stared at the roast chicken, asking her father for the third time, 'Is it ready?' and got a chicken thigh.

items.name: The Whiskers
items.description: She found an old prop from a stage play she did as a child. It was handmade and inspired by her father's beard.

items.name: Rainbow Feeling
items.description: When the sun shined again after rain, a rainbow bridge would appear and cheer everyone up.

items.name: Pursuit of Light
items.description: Life has countless possibilities. She chased her dream in gales and storms and held her head up high.

items.name: Barren Myth
items.description: Ancient hymns lingered in the air. The dragon nestled in her arms, his desire for destruction and death no more.

items.name: Bloom of Dawn
items.description: Flowers of love and hope bloomed again. Life returned, children cried no more, and hate cleared where she walked.

items.name: Celestial Aurora
items.description: Sunshine became her crown, as the blessings she chanted passed on messages from the river of fate.

items.name: Oracle Blessing
items.description: Beauty, eternal life, wealth... she heard wishes, whispered and gathered into a glowing river that led to no end.

items.name: Rebirth of Fate
items.description: When love and hope faded in the long night, she would return once again to sow a seed of miracles.

items.name: Aureate Ode
items.description: The flame of war spread with despair, until she planted a flower of miracles that would grow in love and faith.

items.name: Moonshine Glow
items.description: She offered the land a divine blessing: the light of hope would never die out whether in war or disasters.

items.name: Radiant Reverie
items.description: When she felt worn out by work, she'd put on the most gorgeous get-up and throw herself into a music festival.

items.name: Sparkling Promise
items.description: She flows to the beat with the crowd, as the dazzling light on stage shines like a rainbow on her face.

items.name: Dazzle Motion
items.description: The crowd was still humming as they left. She took the streamer off of her shoulder and kept it as a souvenir.

items.name: Jovial Escapade
items.description: A fairy born from a white lotus voiced dissent: darkness would never leave; their concession wouldn't lead to hope.

items.name: Hopeful Rebirth
items.description: But the hope was fleeting. Darkness resurged like the tides, destroying all their efforts. All became pointless.

items.name: Verdant Woods
items.description: The fairies tried to fight back with magic. They chanted spells to make flowers bloom and trees bud again.

items.name: Shadow of Time
items.description: As the dark spread, fairies and humans had to leave their homes and wander aimlessly with worry and sorrow.

items.name: Shaded Blossom
items.description: The fairy believed in the hope of light and decided to venture into the land of rot alone for a way to end the dark.

items.name: Silk Spiral
items.description: Her journey was arduous. The deeper she went, the thicker the air. She had to resist the rot with all her strength.

items.name: Chirping Charm
items.description: She was exhausted when she reached the core. In the suffocating pressure, she fell like a withered leaf.

items.name: Scented Shadow
items.description: She offered her feathery wings as the voice asked for more. At that, the wings were torn from her back.

items.name: Misty Florescence
items.description: In a daze, she heard a mysterious voice in the dark, asking, 'What would you give to repel the darkness?'

items.name: Floral Sparkle
items.description: 'And you will never have light or hope. Only that proves you are praying for everyone else and not yourself.'

items.name: Serene Slumber
items.description: Every recount brings out more awe in people. They wish for the divine; for the god's blessing.

items.name: Autumn Memories
items.description: She tells how humans are trapped in a vicious cycle of hate, passing down anger and pain for generations.

items.name: Autumnal Whisper
items.description: She tells how war never ends. As long as some fight for ambitions and greed, tragedies will ensue.

items.name: Honeyed Dream
items.description: Sometimes her friends would visit and sit around her, listening to tales that have been buried in time.

items.name: Afternoon Elegance
items.description: When the squirrel climbs down, she will tell how the divine brilliance lights every corner of the world.

items.name: Pinecone Harvest
items.description: The gods not only have infinite power, but they represent wisdom and justice, guiding all that is lost.

items.name: Autumn Hoard
items.description: Like an aurora in the long night, divine power lights up the dark sky and fills everyone who sees it with awe.

items.name: Squirrel Mischief
items.description: God's wisdom is a carefully designed labyrinth: the path may be winding, but it eventually leads one to the goal.

items.name: Playful Squirrel
items.description: Life is a leaf in the wind, flimsy and shaky. The squirrel sits on a branch, waiting for the next falling leaf.

items.name: Galloping Stallion
items.description: An information department was formed, but they needed more funds and had to work on these interest groups.

items.name: Cycle of Fate
items.description: A gun was fired when she opened the car door. 'It'll work... next time...' the prime minister murmured.

items.name: Coronet of Crystal
items.description: The playwright wrote from inside stories to social commentary, and she was always the star of his stories.

items.name: Lonesome Star
items.description: His new play offended the wrong person and got him in jail. She danced one last time, 'There'll be next time.'

items.name: Scoop of Snow
items.description: The corporate head went to jail for tax evasion—another they brought down since the prime minister's inauguration.

items.name: Flame of Void
items.description: The shield formed of courage and willpower thinned as cracks spread like a spider web and chaos loomed.

items.name: Skyward Blaze
items.description: She gave her power to the successors of the royal blood, hoping it would keep the country safe and peaceful.

items.name: Abyssal Karma
items.description: However, every battle in the human world reminded her that a desire for greater power was rooted deep down.

items.name: Divine Retribution
items.description: Varsha never fully recovered her power. Summoning her not only exhausts the summoner but also depletes her power.

items.name: Gilded Wings
items.description: Varsha remembered being born with her sister at the beginning of time. Her sister wasn't so mischievous then.

items.name: Boundless Peace
items.description: Varsha and Scarlet are two of a kind who live off each other. War and peace are a cycle that repeats itself.

items.name: Mind of Ingenuity
items.description: The existence of war makes peace precious; but if war never ends, the victor's rules would be meaningless.

items.name: Breeze Adrift
items.description: Varsha had to find another way to stop the return of war. Now her power was scarce, there seemed to be only one way.

items.name: Crystal of Fate
items.description: The four wills floated away from the formation and turned anew—Scarlet would return to her original state.

items.name: Spotless Jade
items.description: Even if it meant Scarlet would forget all about their past, Varsha still didn't hesitate to make the choice.

items.name: Burning Chaos
items.description: Her power was dwindling despite her effort to seal her sister. The once unbreakable formation was slowly shattering.

items.name: Cloudward Crow
items.description: She would be overjoyed for stealing a celestial peach and celebrate proudly for catching a shooting star.

items.name: Reigning Peace
items.description: 'No one can separate us again, sister.' Varsha heard her sister's voice right before the formation was finished.

items.name: Cloud Streaks
items.description: A prophecy from the start of time was carved on a stele. Few set foot here and remembered the stele.

items.name: Fateful Turn
items.description: The first time the young artist was invited to the ball, he couldn't tear his gaze away from the undying rose.

items.name: Pastoral Sunshine
items.description: The aroma of blooms wafted in a warm breeze of early summer. The girl lowered her lips to kiss the one in her arms.

items.name: Dream Voyage
items.description: The carriage rode away without her noticing a gentle gaze that followed, like the ones she felt in the other balls.

items.name: Shade of Rose
items.description: Doted on by her parents, the highborn girl was praised as an undying rose for her grace and beauty.

items.name: Flickering Dream
items.description: The balls seemed to never end in the castle. Candles shone on swirling dresses as well as every young soul's dreams.

items.name: Kiss of Zephyr
items.description: Her presence would light up the room for even the most ordinary ball, as eyes followed her graceful steps.

items.name: Glamorous Bouquet
items.description: The girl would run with the children in an open field, lying on the grass as they inhaled the floral fragrance.

items.name: Celestial Crimson
items.description: The goddess of yore lives a secluded life. All is but a butterfly's dream, leaving no trace or shadow behind.

items.name: Electro Shark
items.description: Sylvia took every photo in this thick album herself. They were the most precious treasures to her.

items.name: Time Illustration
items.description: Sylvia gave each toy shark a special identity and mission, as they followed her on adventures in the deep sea.

items.name: Mellow Dream
items.description: In the azure ocean, fish blowing bubbles swam by her. Sylvia crossed a forest of algae to a blend of fantastic colors.

items.name: Naughty Bubble
items.description: Next is the usual shark party before sleep!' Sylvia pulled all the toy sharks on her bed into her arms.

items.name: Aquatic Innocence
items.description: Sylvia woke up to see the detailed shark report already printed out. She stretched and carefully examined the report.

items.name: Sweet Devotion
items.description: Rich cream with fresh berries. It's your sweet surprise, promising delight like never before.

items.name: Kitten Candy
items.description: 'I'll have you know that this special present took me quite some time to make! It'll be as tasty as grilled fish!'

items.name: Frosty Glimmer
items.description: The princess's heart was pure and strong as crystal. She believed that if she worked hard, she'd not fear the fate.

items.name: Crystal Illusion
items.description: From lifelike animals to dreamy palaces, the princess's magic ice sculptures attracted tourists to the kingdom.

items.name: Brave the Storm
items.description: Tourism brought wealth to the remote kingdom, but also envy of a neighboring state. They sent an army to attack.

items.name: Frigid Guardian
items.description: When the soldiers arrived in a storm, the princess welcomed them with her wand, fending them off with frozen arrows.

items.name: Harbinger of Snow
items.description: The princess made her name in the battle. Many wished to challenge her, including a wandering crimson dragon.

items.name: Spell of Frost
items.description: The princess gladly agreed. She was no longer chained by fate and fear. The world awaited her exploration.

items.name: Moonside Sparrow
items.description: Unlike the day, the river at night was serene and quiet like a painting, except for the occasional bird chirps.

items.name: Verdant Stream
items.description: A small boat drifted by, sending ripples ashore. Flowers and leaves danced in the breeze, as the moon watched above.

items.name: Poetic Indulgence
items.description: Inspired by the scene, Coralie hurriedly wrote in the pale moonlight: the river shimmers below, the moon glows above.

items.name: Hazed Canoe
items.description: As her friends left one by one at nightfall, Coralie sat in the boat, contemplating her unfinished poem.

items.name: Pristine Gloam
items.description: Lost in poetry, Coralie heard a sudden call for help and saw a gentle scholar waving from the shore.

items.name: Moonlight Glamour
items.description: Coralie moored the boat and learned the scholar's mother needed care, but he couldn't find a boat to cross the river.

items.name: Emerald Dewdrop
items.description: Coralie let the scholar onto the boat. It rocked violently, but luckily he caught her scattering manuscripts.

items.name: Longing Cruise
items.description: The scholar's mother recovered days later, so he visited Coralie with ink, paper and rare manuscripts to thank her.

items.name: Glaucous Haze
items.description: The young scholar read all of Coralie's work and kept praising her talent in poetry, completely in awe.

items.name: Veiled Grace
items.description: The young scholar slowly quieted down and started blushing. Coralie chuckled, veiling her smile with a fan.

items.name: Feather Beacon
items.description: Aileen is the best guide in the tribe. With Staro's help, she dares to venture into the unknown and find new paths.

items.name: Roaming Steps
items.description: Wounds and scars are unavoidable for a guide. They are like medals for her, symbolizing each adventure.

items.name: Guardian Bow
items.description: Aileen shoots arrows as markers with her favorite bow. It helps her navigate the vast expanse of sand.

items.name: Wildland Breeze
items.description: Staro takes to the air and gazes at the ground, a vigilant gleam in its eyes, guiding Aileen to safety.

items.name: Blessing of Wind
items.description: Aileen comes and goes like a wind. People believe that her tattoo is the secret to her speed, guarding her travels.

items.name: Feather Beacon - Cyan
items.description: Aileen led the caravan to the tribe. The merchant noticed the rare herbs and handicrafts and brought fortune there.

items.name: Roaming Steps - Cyan
items.description: No one knows for sure where Aileen is. She is an untraceable wind, but she is always where she is needed.

items.name: Guardian Bow - Cyan
items.description: Aileen's favorite bow emits a lingering sound when the string is plucked. It's a symbol of hope for many travelers.

items.name: Wildland Breeze - Cyan
items.description: The wind praises Aileen's name. She's a beacon of hope in the desert, leading one forward and finding a way home.

items.name: Blessing of Wind - Cyan
items.description: Even those who haven't seen Aileen draw similar tattoos, wish to receive her guide and never lose their way.

items.name: Totem's Pillar
items.description: In silence, blood dripped into the sand. Her noble blood awakened the lupine god from slumber.

items.name: Lupine Dream
items.description: As death loomed, Henutawi only regretted that she didn't finish her vengeance, instead of fearing the long slumber.

items.name: Marvel of Gems
items.description: The guards watched as Henutawi fell among the wolves in a pool of her own blood, so they left to report to Celti.

items.name: Radiant Shine
items.description: Henutawi's heart was more valuable than any treasure on the scales. Under the sun, the god offered her an accord.

items.name: Veil of Shadow
items.description: The god would lend her his powers to finish her revenge. Then she would offer her flesh and soul as sacrifice.

items.name: Faded Twinkle
items.description: Henutawi agreed to the deal and transformed into a gorgeous woman traveling in white veils.

items.name: Bright Glory
items.description: Henutawi returned to the bustling streets of the capital as a mysterious merchant who held immeasurable fortune.

items.name: Cerulean Dream
items.description: Henutawi played both sides: she contacted her loyal followers, while her fortune attracted those greedy for more.

items.name: Emerald Wings
items.description: No nobles in the palace could refuse the rare spices and gems she brought. Soon, she became an esteemed guest.

items.name: Pearl of the Dune
items.description: Henutawi looked up at the hanging moon and closed her eyes. The lupine god smiled, claiming two noble hearts.

items.name: Solar Scorch
items.description: The wolves howled at the moon every night, breaking the dark silence and striking fear into everyone's heart.

items.name: Veiled Visage
items.description: Henutawi spread rumors that the wolves were seeking revenge on Celti. Soon it sparked fear in the man.

items.name: Sincere Companion
items.description: The little fairy was too shy to make new friends, so Annia wondered how she could keep her company for long.

items.name: Colorful Folds
items.description: Annia had grown from a naughty kid into a young adult, but the little fairy stayed the same.

items.name: Picture Book
items.description: It was a book of fairytales and proof of Annia and the fairy's friendship, recording the time they spent together.

items.name: Sylvan Outlook
items.description: She sat in front of the window and let the wind flip her diary to the day when she first met the little fairy.

items.name: Endearing Memory
items.description: 'Do you live around here?' Annia extended a friendly hand to the little fairy, 'Wanna hang out with me?'

items.name: Mellow Fantasy
items.description: Annia made a special friend. They would watch the flowers, feed the animals and enjoy the beautiful days together.

items.name: Serene Fairytale
