items.description: Young Annia didn't know the difference between humans and fairies. She was sincere and passionate about everything.

items.name: Dawn Zephyr
items.description: For the first time reality hit Annia hard - compared to fairies, human lives are too short.

items.name: Ink of Dreams
items.description: She found a solution! She picked up a pen and started writing her story: a little girl's adventure with a fairy.

items.name: Prismatic Dream
items.description: As she grew older, Annia noticed the difference between them - time meant nothing to the little fairy.

items.name: Butterfly Grace
items.description: If you didn't know what you wanted, she would gently guide you to express your ideas.

items.name: Bloom of Wings
items.description: After deciding on the color and pattern, you'd hear Lanier clap her hands and then a rustle behind.

items.name: Butterfly Dream
items.description: Instead of going right to work, Lanier would pour a warm cup of flower tea first and ask your thoughts in detail.

items.name: Blossom Fantasy
items.description: Lanier would place your hands on a velvet pad, and the butterflies would flutter to a box of nail polish.

items.name: Fluttering Butterfly
items.description: Before you could turn around, you'd see beautiful butterflies fly around you, flapping their wings.

items.name: Glowing Rebirth
items.description: Lanier would apply a special top coat for you and put away the tools—you'd see butterfly patterns on the bottles, too.

items.name: Secret of Butterflies
items.description: Clip, clean, polish, color, and ornaments—the butterflies would soon finish a marvelous set of nails!

items.name: Stainless Satin
items.description: The butterflies didn't need Lanier's directions to work, as if they could either read her mind or yours.

items.name: Carefree Waves
items.description: The deep sea was always an azure serenity despite the storms above. The carefree days became boring after a while.

items.name: Echoing Glass
items.description: Besha traveled with fish as the currents brought words from afar. She followed the sea and could always find her way.

items.name: Invaluable Experience
items.description: The old turtle had left the sea and ventured onto land. Besha asked him, 'What is life like for girls on land?'

items.name: Shimmering Sea
items.description: They'd travel with friends and try different cuisines. From every leaf and snowflake, they'd learn something unique.'

items.name: Ocean Pearl
items.description: Besha began her journey alone across narrow, dangerous trenches and found underwater ruins with a telephone booth.

items.name: Embrace of the Waves
items.description: Besha's call actually reached someone. After learning she was in the sea, a girl named Arina asked what it was like.

items.name: Pure White Spindrift
items.description: There were bubbling volcanos and secret caves in the depth. For the first time, Besha learned the wonders of the sea.

items.name: Murmuring Heart
items.description: Besha would tell Arina what she saw while Arina painted it down. The telephone booth connected the girls.

items.name: Overlapping Surges
items.description: Besha was beyond thrilled to hear a voice from outside, so she looked around and told Arina her truest feelings.

items.name: Curious Vision
items.description: Arina hadn't left the studio in days. She stared at the ocean through the window until a call came.

items.name: Gloomy Cloud
items.description: Arina wiped the dry paint off of her arms and rested against a tree. She flipped through her paintings in frustration.

items.name: Unfinished Painting
items.description: Frustrated that she couldn't capture the best moment of the sea, she heard the waves lapping as if beating her heart.

items.name: Sapphire Peace
items.description: Arina had painted the sea from its most peaceful moment, to surging waves and dark undercurrents.

items.name: Whisper of Sincerity
items.description: Drawn by Besha's sincerity, Arina tried to talk to her and realized she had been living in an uncharted ocean.

items.name: Pure Emotion
items.description: The caller remained quiet for a while before speaking, 'Hello, I'm Besha. Are you living on land?'

items.name: Flash of Genius
items.description: Besha yearned for land, while Arina wished to know more about the sea, hoping to get new ideas for her art.

items.name: Fantastic Picturebook
items.description: 'How should I describe it to you.' Besha muttered. Arina heard murmurs of the sea and felt like floating in the deep.

items.name: Aureate Sparkle
items.description: Arina saw the ocean in her mind clearly as Besha described it—fish swam by in schools, glistening like floating gems.

items.name: Feathery Stroke
items.description: Sunlight turned the sea into a wonderland. Arina leaped above the surface with dolphins and saw the unique blue.

items.name: Vision of Art
items.description: Besha enlightened Arina with knowledge of the sea. With her understanding of the ocean, Arina finished a masterpiece.

items.name: Ocean Mosaic
items.description: The colorful scroll of the ocean unfolded in her mind with green algae dancing in waves among the corals.

items.name: Dolphin Dance
items.description: The dormant sea looked tranquil in the pale moonlight. The dolphins playfully tossed a few strange balls around.

items.name: Astral Brilliance
items.description: A crisis loomed in the shadow. As the visitors talked about the show, someone was planning their heist of treasures.

items.name: Gemstone Waves
items.description: A kid woke up at night and thought Vivienne was playing with the dolphins, not seeing the rage in her eyes.

items.name: Rejoicing Cloud
items.description: Vivienne commanded the dolphins on the beach. They worked perfectly together as if they'd done it countless times.

items.name: Feather of Romance
items.description: The sea embraced everything. The Tulliranians got used to the new life soon as smart dolphins guarded the bay.

items.name: Silent Aqua
items.description: No wonder the dolphins understand me!' the kids screamed. Vivienne closed the book and said it was time for dinner.

items.name: Transparent Cube
items.description: Tourists also come to the Tulliranian Bay for Vivienne's Dolphin Inn. It's famed for its location and novel cuisine.

items.name: Minty Chill
items.description: Vivienne never ran out of creativity. She added a special mint and sea salt flavor to the cake that every kid liked.

items.name: Creamy Sweetness
items.description: Vivienne blew the seashell as dolphins elegantly leapt above the water, leaving a fantastic curve in the air.

items.name: Bayside Festival
items.description: People gathered around the bonfire on the beach. A special summer show began with the strum of a guitar.

items.name: Feather of Fantasy
items.description: The princess paid her price. She couldn't die and continued to roam the forgotten land she loved in the long years.

items.name: Aqua Promise
items.description: Time slowly erased the sorrow in the princess's heart. She found a path to the future with her love for the land.

items.name: Flowers of Wonder
items.description: Pages of tears and growth turn as time passes, but the morning of the blooming flowers shall never be forgotten.

items.name: Blossoming Hedge
items.description: The girl dozed off in the afternoon sun. Inside every morning glory growing on the hedge was a loveable dream.

items.name: Feathery Petal
items.description: Each blossom was a song of the season. She had always loved the morning glory and wrote down notes of their growth.

items.name: Daydream Slumber
items.description: The summer sun shone on her notebook and dyed the beautiful handwriting golden, placing her dreams inside each bloom.

items.name: Silken Zephyr
items.description: Purple elegance dotted the green vines. From the elegant blooms the girl found inspiration for growth and dream.

items.name: Evanescent Bloom
items.description: The flowers bloomed and adorned the season. Even if one day they wilted, their brilliance would always be remembered.

items.name: Diary of Blooms
items.description: She knew every flower and recorded their growth, as if the blooms wrote down a romantic diary with her hand.

items.name: Skyward Sprout
items.description: The blooms seemed fragile but never ceased to reach the sky. Like them, she never stopped to chase her dream.

items.name: Wooden Boardwalk
items.description: The fish seemed to bid her farewell when it left, but she didn't know their language and could only flash a smile.

items.name: Holiday Leisure
items.description: She couldn't dive to explore deeper. The bay was busy, and Jennia almost forgot about the stranded blowfish.

items.name: Golden Vision
items.description: Another blowfish got stranded—like tumbleweed, it was rolling towards Jennia with seaweed caught in its spines.

items.name: Innocent Fairytale
items.description: She wondered if it was the same blowfish. Then it pouted at her, as if it was a secret signal between them.

items.name: Bubble Ring
items.description: To return the favor of the seaweed, she picked some blooms and braided a garland for the pouting blowfish.

items.name: Castle of Sand
items.description: Make the bow hairpin into a little flag atop the castle and decorate it with seashells—the Ocypode Castle is complete!

items.name: Cooling Shade
items.description: 'The 1st Beach Art Festival is in full swing! Grab a drink and start the journey of your dream design.'

items.name: Starlit Whimsy
items.description: Event banners were everywhere on the beach. Bona felt her hairpin—on it was a ghost crab waving its claws.

items.name: Moments of Wonder
items.description: When Bona came to Mimit Bay with her family, she loved watching ghost crabs digging holes in the sand.

items.name: Holiday Plan
items.description: Bona would start middle school after the summer. It was time to protect the crabs herself! Bona made up her mind.

items.name: Ocypode Medal
items.description: Dig a hole, shape the sand with water, and build slowly. Fully focused, the girl worked to realize her grand plan.

items.name: Floral Midsummer
items.description: The last step was especially hard: the castle needed a beautiful spire, so she had to carefully shape and steady it.

items.name: Seaside Awe
items.description: The castle was half done when a crab scurried by and hid in a rock, looking cautiously at her with its beady eyes.

items.name: Cerulean Wish
items.description: Her travel dream came true after years. The virescent woods and glistening rivers captivated Vivisha.

items.name: Cloud Remembrance
items.description: Her handwritten diary slowly grew thicker, and the cloud kept Vivisha's company in every photo.

items.name: Voyage of Dream
items.description: Early in the morning, Vivisha lit the flame of departure. With a cheer of surprise, the cloud flew afar with her.

items.name: Tender Wish
items.description: Vivisha and the cloud became friends. They started preparing to journey the world, for it was their shared dream.

items.name: Journey Onward
items.description: I can ride the hot air balloon to faraway lands. With hope for the future, Vivisha carefully mended it anew.

items.name: Rainbow Moment
items.description: As the cloud suggested, Vivisha opened the warehouse and saw an old hot air balloon lying in dust and spider webs.

items.name: Unveiled Dream
items.description: Miya hadn't taken a day of rest for years. She never halted her steps, determined to achieve greater things.

items.name: Blooming Farland
items.description: As the golden sunset sank to the sea, Miya lay on the soft bench and fell asleep in the fragrant sea breeze.

items.name: Glamorous Lantern
items.description: After a full day of work, Miya returned to her office and saw a colorful flyer that stood out in black and white.

items.name: Heart's Perch
items.description: Summer was a good time for a holiday. Miya was told to consult a travel agency and see if she liked any resorts.

items.name: Pristine Brocade
items.description: The ticket to the Kradle Resort in her palm was like an invitation from the sea and sun, urging her to set out now.

items.name: Refreshing Blueberry
items.description: Miya arrived at the Kradle Resort. The sun shone bright and the gauze curtains flapped in the wind as she imagined.

items.name: Shimmering Hope
items.description: After a nap, Miya woke up to the sound of waves. She was fully relaxed, the joy of freedom bubbling inside.

items.name: Forget Me Not
items.description: Hesitantly, Miya joined the travel agency's lucky draw and couldn't believe it when told she won the first prize.

items.name: Longing Flower
items.description: After graduation, Miya joined a famous fashion design company and became the team leader for her outstanding talent.

items.name: Fanciful Years
items.description: The letters have remained in the mailbox for years. Opening them unlocks memories sealed in time.

items.name: Embellished Memory
items.description: The last sun fades as dusk descends. Amid evening whispers of the breeze, moonlight begins the night's chapter.

items.name: Lemon Delight

items.name: Guardian of Piety

items.description: She lets the kittens choose their favorite flowers from the garden; soon each one's got a vibrant flower crown.

items.name: Virescent Gate
items.description: One day, a kitten returns with two friends hoping for Shauna's blessing. She happily crafts flower crowns for them.

items.name: Dewdrop Garden
items.description: Shauna once thought she'd scared the kittens away, but before long, three little heads popped up on the garden wall.

items.name: Bouquet of Blooms
items.description: The beauty is beyond words and reminds the kitten of the sunset glow and shining ripples on the lake.

items.name: Strings of Spring
items.description: The kitten, enchanted by the flowers, finally asks, 'What are these?' Shauna looks around but sees no one.

items.name: Weave of Youth
items.description: Seeing the kitten's eager nods, Shauna laughs and decides to crown the kitten with a floral wreath.

items.name: Foxy Spell
items.description: 'Each flower carries a different blessing: some for longevity, others for purity, or for wealth,' explains Shauna.

items.name: Spring Frost
items.description: 'Are you looking for me?' The kitten tugs at her skirt, 'I'm here!' Shauna soon realizes it's the kitten!

items.name: Graceful Bloom
items.description: 'Pick flowers, match them, and place them on your head—there you have your hairpiece.' Shauna points at her head.

items.name: Peaceful Years
items.description: 'We have different flowers for all seasons, but our good wishes stay the same.'

items.name: Foxy Enchantment
items.description: Anyone passing by is drawn to the sight of a young girl wearing a floral crown, surrounded by playful figures.

items.name: Frigid Breath
items.description: The fairy stays silent as a staff forms in her hand. Under the boy's gaze, frost slowly shifts into a delicate rose.

items.name: Glorious Coronet
items.description: She understands what the boy seeks but knows all too well that in this frozen land, there's no rose blooming forever.

items.name: Dusk Snowfall
items.description: She's always been in the snowfields as she remembers—until she found the boy unconscious at the edge of the tundra.

items.name: Frost Glimmer
items.description: He comes for a legend, one that fairies could not comprehend.

items.name: Pristine Vow
items.description: They walk together through icy lakes, deserted valleys, and snow-covered plains, but find nothing.

items.name: Frosted Rose
items.description: Finally, the boy stops, a bitter smile on his face. 'There's no such rose, is there? Just a foolish fantasy.'

items.name: Splendor of Frost
items.description: The fairy hands him the rose. 'There is. But you need a fairy's approval. Didn't your legend mention that?'

items.name: Promise of Frost
items.description: Then the fairy falls into slumber and traces of the boy disappear in the snowfields. It's as if no one had ever come.

items.name: Astral Guide
items.description: In the daytime, the girl leads the villagers in the early construction. At night, she goes over her plans alone.

items.name: Vivid Mind
items.description: When the project is finally completed, the village chief offers her a reward. The girl smiles and shakes her head.

items.name: Radiant Path
items.description: Though the drought in this village has been alleviated, others still suffer. She knows it's time to set off again.

items.name: Glowing Glimmer
items.description: There is no one-size-fits-all solution to drought. She does research and crafts the best plan for each village.

items.name: Limpid Mirror
items.description: Wherever she goes, clear streams nourish the earth and green shoots sprout from once barren lands.

items.name: Infinite Source
items.description: The implementation is difficult but the people who have suffered from drought share her belief and work with her.

items.name: Spring of Aroma
items.description: She proves the feasibility of her plan to the chief. In return, the chief gives her full support.

items.name: Foliage Whisper
items.description: 'Coo, coo,' Glenna holds her breath, listening intently to the squirrel. 'Help, please help!' She understands it!

items.name: Lost in Dreams
items.description: It turns out that the squirrel wandered out of the forest and got lost. 'Let me take you home!' Glenna volunteers.

items.name: Aromatic Embrace
items.description: 'Here, here!' Two big squirrels come running. Glenna puts the little squirrel down and it runs toward its family.

items.name: Dream Captor
items.description: As a river blocks Glenna's way, her basket magically grows larger, allowing her and the squirrel to float across.

items.name: Pasture Breeze
items.description: Time flows quietly, and these bright scenes become cherished memories. She smiles and moves toward the future.

items.name: Feast of Delight
items.description: Perhaps it's the wine, Darcey thinks. An idea crosses her mind: what if she brews wine from osmanthus flowers?

items.name: Heavenly Brew
items.description: Darcey tries to brew it. But no matter how she alters the recipe, she can't quite capture that scent from her memory.

items.name: Rich Redolence
items.description: Before she can fully smell, she wakes from her dream. But the rich, heavenly fragrance lingers in her mind.

items.name: Moonlit Drinking
items.description: While drinking alone has its own charm, Darcey is still troubled by her failed brewing attempts.

items.name: Shadowy Elegance
items.description: Darcey notices the reflection of the palace in her cup. A rabbit is gathering osmanthus flowers to brew wine.

items.name: Glass of Nectar
items.description: Startled, Darcey looks up but only sees the moon. She looks down again, only to see an osmanthus petal in her wine.

items.name: Dream Chime
items.description: In her dream, Anno is filled with unease as she can't find the little lamb however hard she searches.

items.name: Soft Companion
items.description: As the sky lightens, the dream fades. Anno raises her staff to summon the sheep but finds one of them is missing.

items.name: Misty Search
items.description: What dangers might the little lamb face without her? Anno waits for the night, the time feeling excruciatingly long.

items.name: Outside Visitor
items.description: As a fairy shepherd, Anno rarely speaks to humans, yet when she reveals her identity, Rinya shows no surprise.

items.name: Dream Revisit
items.description: When night falls, Anno quickly returns to her dream and finds the dreamer amidst golden fields of wheat.

items.name: Innocent Encounter
items.description: The farm girl, brimming with energy, greets her warmly. She mentions seeing a lone lamb on the hillside in daytime.

items.name: Harmony of Chimes
items.description: The little lamb somehow crossed over into the real world? Worried, Anno soon finds the answer through Rinya.

items.name: Spirit Radiance
items.description: Seeing Anno's joyful face, Rinya smiles with relief. To express her gratitude, Anno decides to give her a gift.

items.name: Nature of Wonder
items.description: As the dreamer's mood changes, the golden wheat fields give way to neatly planted fields and Rinya's small cottage.

items.name: Joy of Embrace
items.description: Beyond the low fences, a joyful lamb runs toward Anno. She kneels and embraces the lamb tightly in relief.

items.name: Virtual Bond
items.description: 'Song of the Windmill' mentions harvest and dreams, as well as a story of two girls bridging dreams and reality.

items.name: Dream Reunion
items.description: Guiding her sheep, Anno continues to explore the dreamland. And she always sees Rinya waiting for her in the fields.

items.name: Fluffy Briquette
items.description: 'Ah!' 'Meow-meow!' A lone traveler is startled by a cat and yells in surprise; the cat seems just as frightened.

items.name: Adorable Phantom
items.description: A pitifully small ghost always dreams of proving itself but never musters the courage to do so.

items.name: Ambrosial Osmanthus
items.description: A basket full of osmanthus flowers, as well as soft petals and adorable little rabbits, catches Momo's attention.

items.name: Windward Dance
items.description: Anno looks anxious and Rinya reassures her. The lamb they found at the farm is actually a messenger of dreams.

items.name: Aureate Field
items.description: The girl is Anno, a fairy shepherd who lives between reality and dreams. She lost one of her lambs here.

items.name: Fruity Harvest
items.description: These lambs feed on dreams; without Anno's guidance, they might start eating people's dreams.

items.name: Song of the Windmill
items.description: By the warm fire, Rinya falls into a sweet dream of a bountiful harvest, and a worried girl comes to her.

items.name: Heartfelt Will
items.description: To put Anno at ease, Rinya focuses her thoughts. The wheat fields fade away, and the lamb's location appears.

items.name: Reunion Delight
items.description: Seeing the lively lamb, Anno opens her arms. Rinya watches with relief, feeling the joy of something lost now found.

items.name: Wishing Windmill
items.description: As the windmill turns, dreams turn into reality. Rinya thanks Anno for her kindness, waving goodbye.

items.name: Fervent Heart
items.description: It was a simple favor, and Rinya didn't expect anything in return, but Anno insisted on giving her a mini windmill.

items.name: Aroma of Grains
items.description: In 'Song of the Windmill', the genuine friendship between Rinya and Anno captivates the children the most.

items.name: Floral Fantasy
items.description: Tying her hair up with a fluffy scrunchie, Ophelia hummed a new song and started to pick her bath bomb for today.

items.name: Elegant Dream
items.description: Childhood dreams were fairytales that she could no longer return to, but Ophelia still wrote them into songs.

items.name: Silvermoon Lilt
items.description: Mermaids had beautiful singing voices. Perhaps they would lean against reefs and sing gentle tunes under the moon.

items.name: Bubbly Waltz
items.description: Ophelia once dreamed of being a mermaid or a cloud above the sky, turning dreams into rainbow-like bubbles.

items.name: Breezy Florescence
items.description: Ophelia's dream bubbles would break with the first ray of light, as her mother woke her up from the rainbow dances.

items.name: Silken Lullaby
items.description: Hayden wrote fairytales for the children of Lilith. Ophelia wanted the same, telling stories with songs of bubbles.

items.name: Duck's Song
items.description: Ophelia named every duck swimming in the water. They would adventure in the sea of clouds and sing the Duck's Song.

items.name: Coral Seashell
items.description: Ophelia's tattoo wasn't a siren's song or the mermaid's fairytale. It was just a symbol of her childhood dream.

items.name: Misty Fairytale
items.description: Clouds had their personalities in the fairytale. Ophelia's favorite was the white cloud that played songs of nature.

items.name: Bubbly Cloud
items.description: Ophelia used to pour half of a jar of bath salt to make bubbles and fantasize about swimming in fluffy clouds.

items.name: Fantasy Shower
items.description: Prismatic bubbles would float out of the shower, dancing with Ophelia and lifting her to the kingdom of bubbles.

items.name: Jovial Peace
items.description: For Ophelia, the happiest moment of the day was singing in the bathroom with the toy duck as her loyal audience.

items.name: Duck's Dream
items.description: In Ophelia's cute dreams, she saw a special duck that would sway as bubbles floated up in front of her very eyes.

items.name: Guiding Light
items.description: Having tried countless materials and watched them melt, Youell clenched her teeth and put the last one in place.

items.name: Spark of Genius
items.description: Youell dreamed of waking up in the warmth of glowing bulbs, surrounded by fairies and fluorescent butterflies.

items.name: Spotless Gaze
items.description: 'It's over.' the mother touched the girl's cheeks, 'Princess Youell's courage brought warmth and light to the night.'

items.name: Warm Shelter
items.description: Youell's story filled her with courage. She listened to her mother's tales and explored the world with imagination.

items.name: Circle of Electricity
items.description: Her mother kissed her tenderly, 'You will find endless power from the tales and search for your own undying light.'

items.name: Undying Hope
items.description: The bulb shone on, brightening her eyes. All she could think of now was to share the eternal light with everyone.

items.name: Shivering Shimmer
items.description: Having lost her sight, Youell could only be an adventurous princess in her mother's stories. 'Is it over?' she asked.

items.name: Energy Search
items.description: The fairy made a bulb to brighten the island at night, but the heat of magic would melt any lighting materials.

items.name: Radiant Conversion
items.description: The story came to an end, but Youell's adventure had just begun. Her world would be full of hope even in the dark.

items.name: Effulgent Glow
items.description: The fairy said, 'If you can keep the darkness away at night on the island, you will be the princess here'

items.name: Fanciful Radiance
items.description: The clever fairy of light twirled and woke up as the bulb glowed. Would she know how to become a princess?

items.name: Precious Sparkle
items.description: Whenever new land is to be cultivated, the girl is always at the forefront and faces every challenge head-on.

items.name: Spring of Stars
items.description: Wherever the young girl passes, life returns. The villages that suffered from drought are now teeming with life.

items.name: Midnight Invite
items.description: The pumpkin soup was served, its aroma becoming richer. 'Perhaps.' Pepena took a sip and answered with a wink.

items.name: Candy Burglar
items.description: In fact, the imps aren't as scary as they may sound, but they do have a habit of stealing candy on this night.

items.name: Impish Trick
items.description: Pepena passed the imps with a basket of pumpkin candy, luring them to the outskirts with the aroma.

items.name: Foregone Shadow
items.description: Shuji began cultivating a new peony species with rubescent petals and aureate filaments like a majestic lady.

items.name: Florid Garden
items.description: To breed new species, Shuji traveled afar, discussing the characteristics of flowers with like-minded enthusiasts.

items.name: Flowering Splendor
items.description: The new governor secretly levied heavy taxes and collected treasures and antiques from the people.

items.name: Virescent Leaves
items.description: Shuji invited the governor to dinner and offered him two chests: one full of treasures, the other her new peonies.

items.name: Jade Luster
items.description: Overjoyed, the governor took the chests and praised Shuji for her generosity, offering her a post in the government.

items.name: Brocade Veil
items.description: The governor offered the chests to Prince Yong on his tour. The act aroused the prince's suspicion instead.

items.name: Nostalgic Vision
items.description: Not sure where to begin, Prince Yong received evidence from Shuji proving the governor's corruption.

items.name: Blooming Grandeur
items.description: The chest of peonies was hard evidence that only Shuji could breed them. It was Shuji's plan all along.

items.name: Devoted Guide
items.description: After her grandma passed, she would gaze at the sky, imagining her grandma's voice. At least, she still has the cat.

items.name: Kitten Binoculars
items.description: It all started from the day the cat brought a broken map to her. Fanara frowned, remembering her grandma's words.

items.name: Sparkling Gaze
items.description: Grandma told her the map hid an important tale. Fanara followed its lines—until the trail simply vanished.

items.name: Mellow Fellow
items.description: Fanara looked around and saw no other pieces of the map. The cat, however, discovered some fish cans.

items.name: Feline Companion
items.description: Fanara gathered the map pieces and embarked on her journey across the desert and tundra to an ancient forest.

items.name: Carving of Notes
items.description: Broken stone slabs here were carved with words of yores—rhymes and stories passed down through generations.

items.name: Path to Treasure
items.description: The past was brought back to life. Fanara touched the engravings and felt as if her grandma was smiling at her.

items.name: Voyage Planning
items.description: It didn't dissuade Fanara. She started going to libraries and visiting scholars for clues about the other map pieces.

items.name: Fluffy Wish
items.description: The cat never left her side and warned her of danger. After an arduous journey, she arrived at an ancient building.

items.name: Stamps of Yore
items.description: The post office is now back in business. Olitha rides on the country roads, sending letters of love from afar.

items.name: Lingering Years
items.description: In the refurbished post office, Olitha now checks the post box daily and delivers letters to their destination.

items.name: Tender Echo
items.description: Some asked her why she chose to manage an old post office. She only smiled, a hint of regret flashing in her eyes.

items.name: Distant Yearning
items.description: Olitha learned her grandma's death at the age of 16, and a few days later, she received a letter from her hometown.

items.name: Wondrous Recount
items.description: The letter was sent a few days before her grandma's death. The writings were filled with her longing for Olitha.

items.name: Bygone Causerie
items.description: The development of the internet facilitated communication, but also left people behind in the past.

items.name: Framed Memory
items.description: Tears blurred the handwriting as a gentle breeze brushed her hair. The letter reached her, but it was too late.

items.name: Harvest Promise
items.description: By the long table filled with food, people cheer and toast to the harvest in the sound of laughter and singing.

items.name: Pastoral Aroma
items.description: The crops bask in the golden twilight, as people return after a day's work with a heart full of hope.

items.name: Autumn Encounter
items.description: Versha's shop is full of memories. The sewing machine is from her mother, and the couch used to be Grandma's seat.

items.name: Spiny Cuteness
items.description: The hedgehogs are Versha's helpers. They move around the shop, bringing colorful balls of yarn to her feet.

items.name: Fairytale Blanket
items.description: The carpets are handmade. Versha gathered fabric scraps and sewed them together according to color and pattern.

items.name: Mellow Moment
items.description: Versha also furnished the shop with wooden window frames and a warm fireplace, making all customers feel at home.

items.name: Cluster of Dreams
items.description: She spun wool into an elegant shape and dried the colorful flowers. Together they made a hat of beautiful wishes.

items.name: Ensemble of Roses
items.description: Versha gave the hat to the boy for free and told him that he could always come back if the hat needed any repair.

items.name: Ribbon of Oath
items.description: Versha would sometimes think of the boy and his mother and hope that the hat had brought them warmth and strength.

items.name: Weave of Affection
items.description: Then the boy visited again and told Versha that his mother loved the hat. She was so happy and slowly recovering.

items.name: Fallen Warmth
items.description: Versha's life returned to normal. Word of mouth brought her customers despite the remote location of the shop.

items.name: Tender Souvenir
items.description: The perfect match of strawberry and chocolate makes it unique. A juicy, sweet strawberry wrapped in a bitter coating.

items.name: Sweetened Invite
items.description: This is an invitation from the baker. Are you ready for the dessert party with cakes, biscuits and candy?

items.name: Serene Tune
items.description: One by one, beautiful tunes filled the magnificent concert hall. She listened and immersed herself in music.

items.name: Patchwork Elegance
items.description: It was a perfect birthday! The black-and-white pouch wasn't expensive, but it was still carefully chosen.

items.name: Brocade Pouch
items.description: A wisp of scent ascends from the pouch to the moon; Loongs and phoenixes sing as cranes dance amidst the bloom.

items.name: Magic Collection
items.description: When the cloud shrouded the moon, the witches in waiting silently flocked to the empty castle hall.

items.name: Astral Candlelight
items.description: The darkness tried to stop her advance. As Morino raised her hand, a candle floated above, moving with her.

items.name: Gloom Cloister
items.description: Along the endless corridor were closed doors. As the others vanished behind, Morino also pushed one open.

items.name: Lunar Enigma
items.description: To pass the test, one must reach the highest terrace in time, but the path leading to it was different for everyone.

items.name: Twilight Encounter
items.description: As doors opened and closed, Morino felt she was getting closer, but her eyes widened when the next door opened.

items.name: Promised Vision
items.description: Morino solved the puzzle in the room with ease. The door opened again, revealing a flight of stairs leading up.

items.name: Bewitching Spell
items.description: The girl in the room looked the same as her down to every detail. Morino frowned and chanted the strongest spell.

items.name: Delicate Dream
items.description: The other Morino grinned and started chanting the same spell. Their voices overlapped into one in the empty room.

items.name: Spectral Gleam
items.description: After a few rounds, the other Morino seemed unfazed, lifting her hem and greeting Morino with a smile.

items.name: Eternal Gaze
items.description: 'Give up, Morino. Close your eyes and rest.' 'Give up? No... Never.' Morino whispered under her breath.

items.name: Law of Magic
items.description: Unspeakable fear and confusion seized Morino's soul like a tightening vine, as tears and sweat dropped to the ground.

items.name: Midnight Tale
items.description: The wind kissed her hair as she opened the door to the terrace. In front was a lantern, glowing quietly for her.

items.name: Spectral Mischief
items.description: It's said mischievous specters hide in the book. Flip a page and they may jump out and bump your head.

items.name: Candlelit Terror
items.description: Spider webs on the shelves. Eerie shadows on the wall. Quicken your steps and brace yourself for the adventure.

items.name: Quirky Honeypie
items.description: What's that sound? Don't worry! It's the specter's surprise—put it on and you'll be the star of the night.

items.name: Guiding Glow
items.description: On a gloomy night, Hetta was on her usual hunt and found a special specter in a hidden corner instead.

items.name: Splintered Vision
items.description: Hetta didn't sense menace from the translucent girl. She floated in the air like a fading fog.

items.name: Ominous Horns
items.description: The girl died not long ago. On her deathbed, she promised her young sister that she'd spend her birthday with her.

items.name: Silent Vestige
items.description: The girl lingered, never harming a soul, so Hetta enveloped her in a bundle of energy to keep her from fading away.

items.name: Regretful Longing
items.description: Disease eventually took her from her sister. She remained in spirit form, as she hadn't kept her promise.

items.name: Blade of Judgment
items.description: The girl felt safe with Hetta despite her cold demeanor, as she protected her from evil spirits until the birthday.

items.name: Glazed Fragrance
items.description: The garden darkens, while in an ill-lit alley, a velvet lavender lies in the children's palms, glowing ever brightly.

items.name: Redolent Trace
items.description: Velvet lavenders have become exclusive to nobles, but even with attentive care, they rarely bloom in gardens.

items.name: Nocturnal Snow
items.description: It's said that darkness once took over the world until a deity cast seeds of velvet lavenders that lit the dark.

items.name: Frosty Grace
items.description: Nobles seek after the flower for its fragility, but others are skeptical, 'It lit the dark. How could it be fragile?'

items.name: Midnight Bloom
items.description: The kids gathered in a lane, still mesmerized by the blooms. 'What's this?' Someone takes a bud off a girl's hair.

items.name: Rosy Entrapment
items.description: The God of Sea created an unescapable illusion for Helena, forever trapping the young man in a beautiful cage.

items.name: Lucent Tears
items.description: Helena realized she had fallen for him, but the man did not feel the same. Helena grew worried and smiled less.

items.name: Moonlit Seashell
items.description: The young man weathered the storms. Helena saw light in his determined eyes that even the moon paled in comparison.

items.name: Swan's Grace
items.description: Swans from afar spread their white wings to welcome the young man home, every feather shining the light of freedom.

items.name: Decadent Love
items.description: Helena picked the brightest rose at dawn for the man and sang under the moon to express her love.

items.name: Thistles' Whisper
items.description: But it couldn't change the man's heart. He grew ever more depressed until he turned into a dying swan.

items.name: Forlorn Saga
items.description: Helena could feel the looming death. The swan's feathers lost their sheen, and those roses of love had long withered.

items.name: Lunar Shimmer
items.description: She decided to tell the God of Sea to let him go. The illusion broke, and he could finally return to his kind.

items.name: Lament of Solitude
items.description: Seafarers either wear white swan pendants for Helena's blessing or see it as a taboo, fearing they'd be lost at sea.

items.name: Seaside Slumber
items.description: Helena stared for long after the swan left before turning back into the sea, never again returning to the shore.

items.name: Olden Squall
items.description: The tides rise and fall in the constant flow of time. A wind from the past blows, carrying tales of yore.

items.name: Cirrus Adrift
items.description: With new-found power, the ruthless god vented the anger within, ravaging the earth and planting seeds of horror.

items.name: Plumed Serenade
items.description: He was born gentle and derived his power from people's joy, but in a devastated world, the joy was almost extinct.

items.name: Luxuriant Charm
items.description: Lacking allies, Serra's brother lost and turned into a white peacock, robbed of his singing voice and colors.

items.name: Mortal Dreamscape
items.description: The peacocks couldn't stand and watch despair take the world. Eventually, Serra's brother challenged the god.

items.name: Sunlit Lushness
items.description: When all lives fell to despair, Serra stood up with determination in her eyes and challenged the god to a duel.

items.name: Jade Plumage
items.description: Serra also gained power from pain, but unlike the god, she only felt sorrow instead of joy from her power.

items.name: Aureate Glamor
items.description: Her connection with all lives filled her with power. After defeating the old god, Serra became the Goddess of Art.

items.name: Owl's Message
items.description: Startled from sleep, she saw the owls arrive with a letter—the first she'd ever received from strangers.

items.name: Desolate Scent
items.description: It was a letter from the humans! Ambelle opened the letter, relieved that her nightmares didn't come true.

items.name: Sylvan Rebirth
items.description: 'Dear Goddess, without your guidance, we still follow your teachings. We learn, observe time, respect life...'

items.name: Ravaged Sanctum
items.description: Ambelle fell asleep again and dreamed that humans were easily killed in disasters without strong bodies or wings.

items.name: Crowned Shadow
items.description: 'It was a terrible winter, but we made it through. The kids were growing stronger, and none of us fell to the cold.'

items.name: Rustling Blooms
items.description: 'A sage read the stars and predicted a disaster. We fought the flood and saved our food using what you taught us.'

items.name: Echoes of Green
items.description: Ambelle was pleased. Humans might be weak, but they were determined to learn and protect their families.

items.name: Future Brilliance
items.description: She was wise enough to understand the new language. In the last moments of her life, she decided to write them back.

items.name: Ephemeral Wonder
items.description: Ambelle realized that the letters weren't her language but one created by humans themselves.

items.name: Dream Recall
items.description: She chanted a spell, turning back time. The old carpenter no longer felt back pain and became nimble-handed again.

items.name: Chirping Chorus
items.description: A mother came to sell furniture to treat her daughter's illness. The carpenter gifted her the watch and paid double.

items.name: Heart Toll
items.description: 'If only I could turn back time and be young again, even if just for one day. Or am I doomed to not finish it?'

items.name: Fondness Echo
items.description: The carpenter threw himself into his work and forgot time. When the sun rose again, an exquisite sculpture was born.

items.name: Earnest Support
items.description: As the watch slowly opened, she saw the girl lying in bed, still trying to console her mother despite her illness.

items.name: Dream Murmur
items.description: She overheard the girl talking in her sleep, 'If only I could be better sooner so that Mother would cry no more.'

items.name: Blissful Harmony
items.description: As the watch hands turned, the girl recovered miraculously. When they hugged each other, she felt warm inside.

items.name: Chime Beyond
items.description: The girl grew up and fell in love. Together they traveled the world and prepared to challenge a snow mountain.

items.name: Eternal Promise
items.description: No longer trapped in the watch, she opened an antique shop of her own and offered help to anyone in trouble.

items.name: Free to Roam
items.description: A sudden avalanche separated the girl and her lover, and the pocket watch swung violently in the backpack.

items.name: Symbiont Wings
items.description: One sunny afternoon, a pocket watch clicked for the first time. She watched the newborn fairy with a hopeful smile.

items.name: Heartfelt Concern
items.description: Hadia refused to let go of her grandpa's hands, fearing she'd lose him forever. He patted her head to reassure her.

items.name: Entwined Sentiment
items.description: On Hadia's birthday, her grandpa gifted her a net with flowers that kept nightmares away and protected her in dreams.

items.name: Soul Blossom
items.description: Grandpa made preparations for Hadia in the event of his death, but a terminal illness took Hadia away unexpectedly.

items.name: Lonesome Promise
items.description: People bought flowers for the day of spirits. Grandpa packed them alone, as the flowery net swayed in the wind.

items.name: Sparkling Candle
items.description: Hadia followed the flower petals and candlelight home. She only wished to gently touch her grandpa's hand.

items.name: Olden Cadence
items.description: Spirits danced in the flickering light. Hadia waited for her grandpa to fall asleep: dreams would reunite them.

items.name: Reunion Dream
items.description: She sneaked past the net and fell into her grandpa's dream. Overjoyed, she ran into his arms in a sea of flowers.

items.name: Grape Whispers
items.description: The cheering crowd opens a sealed barrel as wine swashes inside. All the tiredness is washed away by the scent.

items.name: Rejoicing Chant
items.description: The girls chat with the poet. 'Hope you're having a great time!' 'Of course. It's like a symphony of joy here!'

items.name: Emerald Shadow
items.description: The poet takes a sip of wine and savors the sweet aftertaste. She decides to praise it in her new song.

items.name: Fruity Aroma
items.description: Sweet jam bubbles in the pot while the aroma of the pumpkin pie fills the air, waiting to be served with fresh salad.

items.name: Ethereal Resplendence
items.description: The emperor respected Shuji's choice and granted her treasures and the title: Master of Peonies.

items.name: Dewdrop Aroma
items.description: It's said that when Shuji passed away, all the peonies bloomed. She is remembered as the Peony Goddess even now.

items.name: Tireless Toil
items.description: The delicate bamboo hat shields the girl's face from the sun. The fine weave is a precious and lasting legacy.

items.name: Stormy Ambition
items.description: The girl rests against a tree and hums again to the babble of the crook. It is a song dedicated to the land.

items.name: Sketch of Inspiration
items.description: A special pen lies quietly on a stand. It is said to be most precious to Arianna and creates world-changing patterns.

items.name: Timeless Echo
items.description: On the wall are newspaper clippings she gathered from sea monsters to floating cities—a fantasy world in her dreams.

items.name: Burgeoning Hope
items.description: In her own design, Arianna twirls in a room full of mirrors, reflecting infinite possibilities with every step taken.

items.name: Pastel Motion
items.description: A tap of the pen is a dancer's leap. Each motion is irreplaceable, freeze-framing the mix of reality and dream.

items.name: Epistle of Yore
items.description: The desk is scattered with design drafts, each a sketch of a different world, demonstrating her unique vision.

items.name: Silent Timekeeper
items.description: Arianna sometimes stares at the old clock late at night, letting her thoughts run wild through time for inspiration.

items.name: Crimson Nocturne
items.description: On full-moon nights, the witch roams the thorny woods as ravens shriek warnings to keep wanderers away.

items.name: Thorny Nightmare
items.description: The child's sob stilled the witch's anger. Even her low-brimmed hat couldn't hide the surprise on her face.

items.name: Birth of Terror
items.description: Her hands, wrapped in black satin gloves, only brewed potions. Purple bubbles rose as the child watched.

items.name: Raven Wand
items.description: Children's cry was the worst spell of all. The witch conjured up stars and singing ravens to cheer him up.

items.name: Fateful Bond
items.description: Life had its unexpected interludes, and the witch shared a brief chapter of her long life with the innocent child.

items.name: Eternal Treasure
items.description: The clumsy bear lost coins all over the fairyland. Nanaki busied around the park and filled her pouch with coins.

items.name: Stellar Balloon
items.description: A starlit balloon tied with coins was stuck in a tree. Nanaki found it but was too small to reach the prize.

items.name: Soothing Solace
items.description: Frustrated, Nanaki felt a fluffy paw on her shoulder. She turned around to see a cute bear mascot.

items.name: Childhood Gems
items.description: Mr. Bear looked exactly the same as the one Nanaki wanted! He gave her a hug and put the coins in her palms.

items.name: Blooming Boon
items.description: The kid who collected the most coins by sunset would win the special prize—a soft little toy bear.

items.name: Wilting Blossom
items.description: 'Did you win the toy bear?' the curious reporter asked Nanaki, now the park's beloved manager.

items.name: Moonlit Nectar
items.description: Nanaki faked a frustrated sigh, 'Unfortunately, I didn't win the game, but I found the treasure I wanted the most.'

items.name: Wreathed Dream
items.description: Nanaki hopes to give children experiences as magical as hers, to help them cherish innocence as they grow up.

items.name: Nocturnal Tinge
items.description: Her singing helps plants grow, including the dreamshroom. Fina sits under the tree and gently watches the plants.

items.name: Breath of Dew
items.description: Flowers stretch their leaves in the evening breeze, rejoicing and dancing to Fina's cheerful song.

items.name: Obscure Imprint
items.description: Fina loves plants but isn't fond of outsiders. If you ever run into her, don't disturb her time with her plants.

items.name: Nocturnal Tinge - Dream
items.description: Travelers are all careful not to hurt the plants in the forest, in case they anger Fina and get thrown out.

items.name: Breath of Dew - Dream
items.description: Another group arrives in the depths of the forest, gazing in awe at the fairy standing alone under the moon.

items.name: Obscure Imprint - Dream
items.description: The fairy's singing flows in the veins of every leaf. Plants shiver in the silent night, telling stories of yore.

items.name: Crimson Chant
items.description: The witch brushed her hair as the raven brought a gem necklace. The hat fell on her head with a wave of her wand.

items.name: Mushroom Stew
items.description: Ripe dreamshrooms are precious ingredients to be cooked in the simplest way—boiled and served with fine salt.

items.name: Mushroom Stew - Fresh
items.description: 'Wait, it hasn't boiled.' When someone asks worriedly, the mushrooms are already rolling around, 'Not ready!'

items.name: Undercooked Mushroom
items.description: The inside of the mushroom looks like 'zzz', so people call it the dreamshroom, sleepshroom, or snoreshroom.

items.name: Photosynthesis
items.description: Mushrooms can't photosynthesize without chloroplasts, so the colorful mushrooms complain, 'That's not a right name!'

items.name: Photosynthesis - Dream
items.description: 'But the mushrooms have turned into lamps, so we can help other plants synthesize!' The mushrooms wonder.

items.name: Red Muscaria
items.description: 'They look like us, but these aren't edible!' The mushrooms speak at once, 'There will be huge trouble!'

items.name: Purple Muscaria
items.description: 'That's worse!' The mushrooms jump up and down anxiously. 'I'm not eating it. I can tell that from the way it looks.'

items.name: Sugar Overload
items.description: 'Nikki, is this a world without you...' 'Momo, do you need help?' 'Y-yes... I can't get out meow!'

items.name: Bear Fluff
items.description: She can't leave the forest and values every chance to talk to outsiders. Don't be shy if you see her on your tour.

items.name: Bear Fluff - Mocha
items.description: 'Of course!' Kokia makes her entrance, fluffy ears popping out of the bush, 'Strawberry, chocolate, or milk?'

items.name: Wicked Fluff
items.description: A furry little creature in a cute outfit stands in front of the adventurers. They can't tell who it is for a second.

items.name: Fairytale Gate
items.description: Beyond the leaves stands a quaint cabin. In front of it is a small garden full of blooming flowers.

items.name: Blooming Palisade
items.description: After some discussion, they decide to follow the voice. Of course, they will keep a safe distance from the character.

items.name: Sylvan Glade
items.description: 'But this is an immersive play. It can't be too dangerous. Why don't we take a look?' one of them suggests.

items.name: Bunny Caper
items.description: It seems another group has arrived sooner. They stand in the garden, shielding a girl in a red cape behind.

items.name: Gourmet Basket
items.description: The adventurers let out a sigh of relief, share a look, and decide to go out and join the other team.

items.name: Redolent Satin
items.description: The fluffy animal scutters away soon with a roar. The team members stand in a circle, comforting the girl.

items.name: Cutesy Costume
items.description: Seeing the mascot head Nikki prepared for the guessing game, Momo commented, 'Everyone will know who you are.'

items.name: Broken Clues
items.description: With a low hiss, the lights in the hall suddenly went out. The music paused as the crowd began to panic.

items.name: Puzzling Cinders
items.description: 'Beep—' The passcode to a storage room away from the hall was decrypted. A figure approached the sleeping gem.

items.name: Blinding Alarm
items.description: 'Don't panic!' 'Don't run. Watch your steps!' Staff members tried to maintain order while a figure left in silence.

items.name: Mind Labyrinth
items.description: Shouldn't the security guards be keeping order in the hall? The Gem Burglar was puzzled, 'Why are you here!?'

items.name: Mystery Paradox
items.description: 'You've been caught in the act. Save your breath for the police.' Colis handed the Burglar over to the police.

items.name: Revealing Moment
items.description: 'I've tracked this case since the first theft and noticed the same MO,' Colis explained patiently.

items.name: Extraordinary Grace
items.description: 'Thank you, Ms. Colis,' the host said gratefully, though curiosity about her methods lingered in his mind.

items.name: Insightful Theory
items.description: Colis first checked the security details for tonight and believed this would be the best moment for arrest.

items.name: Gamble of Minds
items.description: Colis never feared enemies in the dark. She would find herself in dangerous situations and never back down.

items.name: Ingenious Scheme
items.description: Detectives have their own styles—and so do burglars. The Gem Burglar was known for exploiting security flaws.

items.name: Suspect Analysis
items.description: The Gem Burglar was suspiciously calm after the arrest and smirked when he walked by Colis.

items.name: Drifting Mind
items.description: More importantly, the dreamshrooms are extremely delicious no matter how it is prepared and cooked.

items.name: Mushroom Whimsy
items.description: The cafeteria of Pedmon School grew them in greenhouses and created a specialty dish that soon captivated the world.

items.name: Drifting Mind - Dream
items.description: Shroomoo has been staying in the forest for research. Adventurers lucky enough may run into her on their tour.

items.name: Mushroom Whimsy - Dream
items.description: She is a friendly character who will actively approach adventurers. If you need any help, don't hesitate to tell her.

items.name: Gentle Companion
items.description: The fluffy white creature looks as calm and gentle as its master, but the girl knows it is a fleet-footed hound.

items.name: Romantic Confetti
items.description: 'What's wrong?' The clamor ceases at the sound of the voice as people step aside. The girl looks up curiously.

items.name: Everlasting Glory
items.description: The name Nakoya means undying light. Even time favors her, granting her extraordinary maturity and grace.

items.name: Breeze of Bloom
items.description: As Duchess Nakoya approaches her, her heart beats faster and faster, before she bows on one knee with all sincerity.

items.name: Elegy of Glamour
items.description: A sergeant? Some guests look her up and down, their murmurs like an off-key song, destroying the harmony in the room.

items.name: Crimson in the Night
items.description: Who would dance with her? Someone raises their voice, but she doesn't argue with them. All she cares is that...

items.name: Stellar Affection
items.description: As Nakoya and Selly step onto the dance floor, the gentle tune turns into passionate notes to start the ball.

items.name: Fairytale Carousel
items.description: In her dreams, Tatasie rode on a wooden horse on clouds as stars weaved her a shimmering rainbow-like cape.

items.name: Rainbow Starlight
items.description: Reluctant to leave, a star clung to Tatasie's hem, swaying with her steps and urging her onward with each twinkle.

items.name: Fantasy Stairway
items.description: Clouds formed a stairway to the festival. Tatasie waved goodbye and stepped up, lifting her hem as she went.

items.name: Dewy Zephyr
items.description: Tatasie stepped into a fairyland where the sweet wind brushed her hair and told her stories under the blue sky.

items.name: Cirrus Chorus
items.description: Stars slid down the rainbow bridge, eagerly offering Tatasie their handmade, masterpiece treats.

items.name: Ethereal Shimmer
items.description: Tatasie could still see the colors when she woke up. Inspired, she rushed to her desk — she now had a design!

items.name: Skyward Invitation
items.description: After renovation, the fairyland reopened. The carousel of stars and clouds invited everyone to the sky.

items.name: Traces of Inspiration
items.description: The assistant opened the studio door to see Tatasie finally smiling again—with a finished carousel blueprint in hand.

items.name: Wishing Fairy
items.description: Iset brings a unique wish bottle that grants any wish written on a slip of paper in the near future.

items.name: Awakened Rebirth
items.description: Ace and Elle bring the morning lavender from the Pigeon Kingdom that symbolizes awakening and rebirth.

items.name: Moment of Amazement
items.description: Nikki is surprised when she walks out of the room. Momo jumps on the table and hands her a cute hammer with a ribbon.

items.name: Fuzzy Feeling
items.description: Nikki gently cracks open the chocolate egg brought by the Iron Rose. Inside is a birthday cake adorned with stars.

items.name: Brilliant Blossom
items.description: The pillow from her friends in the Cloud is embroidered with flowers, symbolizing their great wish for her happiness.

items.name: Enwreathing Aroma
items.description: When the first ray of light shone through the mist, Waverly set out to find water despite the treacherous path.

items.name: Ambrosial Carriage
items.description: It hadn't rained in months this year. The ground dried up, and even the flourishing apple tree looked withered.

items.name: Floral Vitality
items.description: As leaves fell and branched dried, Waverly couldn't stop worrying. She didn't want to lose her longtime friend.

items.name: Gentle Haze
items.description: Tender flowers and leaves formed an oil painting. Waverly lay in the shade, watching the clouds shift.

items.name: Cherished Hope
items.description: Deep in a remote valley, Waverly found a small but clear crook, as if nature had prepared an answer for the brave.

items.name: Scarlet Delicacy
items.description: Overjoyed, Waverly carefully scooped water into her bucket and began her journey home at sunset.

items.name: Lingering Redolence
items.description: On quiet evenings, Waverly would sit by the apple tree as usual, sharing her day or singing a gentle song.

items.name: Blooming Aspiration
items.description: Though fetching water was tiring and repetitive, Waverly never complained—she only wished for the tree's recovery.

items.name: Redolent Ballad
items.description: One morning before departure, Waverly was surprised to see new sprouts on the apple tree's branches.

items.name: Emerald Magic
items.description: A plump red apple fell into Waverly's arms. She took a bite from the tree's present, and it began to work wonders.

items.name: Afterglow Leisure
items.description: Its refreshing aroma bears witness to Waverly's friendship with the tree, watching over her innocence and kindness.

items.name: Feline Receptionist
items.description: The cat grew fond of Saki's mother, rubbing against customers' legs and allowing gentle pets from familiar hands.

items.name: Delightful Treat
items.description: To spoil the cat, her mom baked its favorite food—fish cookies. People started calling it Fish since then.

items.name: Exclusive Devotion
items.description: When her mom was baking cakes and fish cookies, Fish would sit quietly by her side, awaiting its special meal.

items.name: Pastry Guardian
items.description: As time passed, Fish became the guardian of the shop, patrolling the pantry, kitchen and tables every day.

items.name: Cordial Atmosphere
items.description: Worried Fish might occupy a dining spot, Saki offered discounts at tables where Fish chose to nap.

items.name: Convivial Treat
items.description: Saki refurnished the shop after she took over. On reopening day, she baked a new flavor of cookies for Fish.

items.name: Delicious Compensation
items.description: Fish now loves sleeping under tables, and customers lower their voices to avoid disturbing the beloved old cat.

items.name: Elegant Elephant
items.description: The elephant carried Mikari to a wonderland. Here, she was no longer a lonely girl but a brave adventurer.

items.name: Plaited Clouds
items.description: Seeing Mikari upset, her grandma lovingly crafted toy elephants with her warm, dexterous hands.

items.name: Adventurous Anecdote
items.description: Beyond the soft clouds lay the magical park in the sky, where wonders awaited the curious young girl.

items.name: Liberating Venture
items.description: Mikari and the elephants cleared challenges and found treasures hidden in the park. She never felt such joy before.

items.name: Frosting Badge
items.description: Mikari shared the dream with her grandma, who patted her on the head, 'I hope you'll always smile like this.'

items.name: Devout Wish
items.description: Mikari looked at the mirror behind her grandma and saw the upward curve of her own lips, her eyes shining with joy.

items.name: Innocent Dreamland
items.description: She adored the toy elephants, naming each one and crafting creative clothes and accessories just for them.

items.name: Hook of Luck
items.description: Inside the dark forest are heavy mist, strange mushrooms, and bubbling swamps... Infinite wonders abound.

items.name: Underwood Memory
items.description: Lorora's interest was piqued. She asked where the creek was and set out to find the fish first thing in the morning.

items.name: Medal of Courage
items.description: They came to a glade in the forest where a huge tree towered over them. Lorora stepped closer and asked nicely.

items.name: Tacit Support
items.description: Lorora and her cat feared no difficulties, but as they adventured farther, they started to lose their direction.

items.name: Adventure Fellowship
items.description: 'Follow where my tallest branch points, and you will find the deepest creek.' The tree praised their courage.

items.name: Treasure Voucher
items.description: Lorora parted vines and finally saw the creek. The special red fish swan gracefully in the shimmering water.

items.name: Rekindled Dream
items.description: How did Tiya know what she wanted? She tasted the pudding and felt joy for the first time after Tiya left.

items.name: Candlelight Twinkle
items.description: She felt empty inside after Tiya left with her mother. Now there was no one to share dreams with.

items.name: Golden Sconce
items.description: On her birthday, she received an unexpected gift—a strawberry pudding with the letters 'Happy Birthday' on it.

items.name: Crown of Faith
items.description: She continued to learn art and design. The dream of becoming a designer with Tiya was her guiding light.

items.name: Tomorrow Fantasy
items.description: She would receive the same candle before her birthday. On her 16th birthday, she wished to get into her dream school.

items.name: Candle Bloom
items.description: A magic circle glowed beside a desk of books and manuscripts. The girl's face was lit by the candle flame.

items.name: Enduring Vow
items.description: 'Candle Fairy, share Sana's wishes with me! Even if we're not together, I want to realize a wish for her every year.'

items.name: Poetic Fragrance
items.description: The garden became alive—lilacs and roses turned into fairies and held Laruna's hem, inviting her to an adventure.

items.name: Illuminating Insight
items.description: Laruna floated up in the evening breeze. The dark sky seemed within arms' reach, as if she could touch the stars.

items.name: Crescent of Dreams
items.description: She rode the golden crescent along the river of stars, each whispering a secret of the past.

items.name: Midnight Palisade
items.description: Laruna took a step ahead and saw a ferry to the sky river. In the shimmers berthed a golden crescent boat.

items.name: Sparkling Blossom
items.description: Stars jumped into Laruna's boat with drops of water, sharing brilliant ideas with her. The girl smiled with joy.

items.name: Chorus of Strings
items.description: She reached into the river of stars and found shimmering verses. As she chanted them, the stars shone even brighter.

items.name: Nostalgic Ballad
items.description: Through thick clouds, the boat suddenly shook violently. Laruna with the stars and verses all plummeted below.

items.name: Stellar Ripples
items.description: The crescent boat flowed and left ripples in the river. Laruna arranged the verses into a brilliant chapter.

items.name: Serene Frolic
items.description: Nobody knew how the cave was formed. Tavania speculated that an overwhelming power had been sealed within the forest.

items.name: Shattered Memory
items.description: Tavania began looking for a solution. She opened a rift in the seal of the forest, slowly releasing the power within.

items.name: World of Yore
items.description: The phantoms around Tavania were lives lost in the cave. They weren't even spirits, just projections from the past.

items.name: Nightmarish Bloom
items.description: Immense power brewed in the sealed realm until the cave formed, enveloping the forest in a looming shadow.

items.name: Verdant Renewal
items.description: Soon, because of the rift, a human explorer discovered the forest. She was the first visitor in a thousand years.

items.name: Evening Zephyr
items.description: Tavania is glad with the result. The corrupting power is slowly dying, while humans bring new life to the forest.

items.name: Shades of Time
items.description: Sometimes Tavania feels lonely, too. She is shy and a bit timid, so she only has very few friends.

items.name: Pacific Storm
items.description: It makes Tavania sad that due to the cave and her mysterious power, explorers are afraid of running into her.

items.name: Crystalline Glow
items.description: If explorers come here, I'll politely tell them not to go near the cave. Tavania wonders if they'll be her friends.

items.name: Hazy Hoar
items.description: Tavania lives alone near the cave in the depths of the misty forest, where humans and other animals seldom visit.

items.name: Loyal Audience
items.description: Sheryl is an important character who appears early in the tour. She's pure-hearted with a love for dance and music.

items.name: Fountain of Magic
items.description: Sheryl is a fairy living in the forest who's equally friendly to everyone instead of only adventurers.

items.name: Curtain of Wonder
items.description: At the end of a show, she might ask adventurers to gather materials for her to design new decorations for the stage.

items.name: Burgeoning Mirage
items.description: No matter the result, Sheryl would compliment anyone who helped her and gift them some adorable souvenirs.

items.name: Hymnal Blossom
items.description: Sheryl has made friends with the bunnies, bears, hamsters, and more. She would make your adventure extra fun!

items.name: Serene Chapter
items.description: As the wind and music die down and light illuminates the stage, the audience realizes the show has ended.

items.name: Silent Whisper
items.description: If you have Sheryl's approval, she'll give you a small gift—a flower bookmark, leaf envelope, or mushroom badge.

items.name: Effulgent Wonder
items.description: Adventurers seeking close interactions with Sheryl may be disappointed—she's quite busy.

items.name: Galactic Bond
items.description: If you run into any trouble, don't hesitate to blow Sheryl's whistle. Her friends will come to your aid at the sound.

items.name: Euphoric Flutter
items.description: In the pale moonlight, Sheryl waves her hands—and this time, her friends join the dance too.

items.name: Wings of Vision
items.description: After the adventurers arrive at the last scene, Sheryl often appears in the distance before the final departure.

items.name: Loyal Companion
items.description: She gives adventurers simple but fun quests, such as helping her animal friends choose their outfits.

items.name: Murmuring Bloom
items.description: Flowers sway in the breeze by the sides of the forest trail. Every bloom has its own story to tell.

items.name: Chef's Hat
items.description: The custom-made chef's hat is adorned with colorful dessert patterns. Every kid gets to have one for free.

items.name: Ingenious Craft
items.description: Sweetness helps release stress. If you are feeling down, head to the Bear's Bakery for fun and satisfaction.

items.name: Sprouting Meadow
items.description: Mornian only realized it was midnight when she finished work. The prettiest flower was still blossoming alone.

items.name: Ardent Blossom
items.description: The first customer knocked on Mornian's door and bought a white lily for the Goddess. The second chose the iris...

items.name: Devoting Dream
items.description: Mornian awoke to a graceful woman in a hazy light, her gorgeous hair shining like the glow on the mountain peaks.

items.name: Daydream Boon
items.description: It was morning when Mornian woke up again. She came to the garden and noticed that the prettiest flower was gone.

items.name: Sunrise Sparkle
items.description: Overjoyed, Mornian offered the prettiest flower to the Goddess, who accepted it as the petals kissed her fingertips.

items.name: Gentle Revelation
items.description: The woman thanked Mornian's work with a gentle smile. Still in a daze, Mornian suddenly realized who she was.

items.name: Budding Dream
items.description: How she wished to offer the flower to the Goddess. But the festival had ended. Mornian went to sleep with regrets.

items.name: Midwinter Bliss
items.description: Birds brought peculiar objects to adorn Tana's windowsill, from star-shaped hair pins to colorful pebbles.

items.name: Fateful Nocturne
items.description: The fox had a bigger task. A magician lived by a hot spring in the deepest of the woods where no animal ventured.

items.name: Magic Insignia
items.description: The spring was said to cure all illnesses. On the holy night, the fox set out on its journey to find the spring.

items.name: Purest Dedication
items.description: The squirrels wove twigs into a big basket, filled it with their best acorns and placed it in front of Tana's home.

items.name: Rejoicing Snowman
items.description: 'Tana was ill? That's terrible.' the white-bearded magician had heard her singing, too. 'Give her the spring water.'

items.name: Ephemeral Dream
items.description: From gentle speaking to lively motions, Luoyun taught the kitten how to disguise as a human and hide herself.

items.name: Shadowy Verdure
items.description: Overly excited, the kitten let out her tail accidentally caught the new crystal chandelier, and shattered it.

items.name: Ethereal Odyssey
items.description: The crystal chandelier was key to the show. In a panic, the kitten thought of Luoyun's brush that could fix anything.

items.name: Rosebud Shadow
items.description: The kitten worked hard and went to the dance hall early to clean it. Luoyun leaned on the cupboards and listened.

items.name: Spiritual Embrace
items.description: The brush on the desk fixes anything; the lamp can turn back time; the old phone is one call away from other worlds.

items.name: Tender Greetings
items.description: Luoyun explained that some had sentimental value and weren't for sale, so the suspicion gradually went away.

items.name: Ingenious Marvel
items.description: The last customer left as the night fell. Luoyun blew out the candle and suddenly heard the sound of crashing beads.

items.name: Archaic Artistry
items.description: Luoyun went upstairs and saw the bead curtains swaying. A girl was lying on a chair with tears on her cheeks.

items.name: Twilight Haze
items.description: She learned some basics about human behavior and language from an older waitress and managed to stay here.

items.name: Wishful Echo
items.description: 'Please Luoyun... Help me.' Before the girl finished her words, two cat ears popped out and a tail dangled behind.

items.name: Jade Iridescence
items.description: Holding a cup of tea, the girl explained how she found a waitress job in the Jasmine Hall nearby.

items.name: Gem Dazzle
items.description: The kitten begged and promised she'd bring the best jewel one day. She just needed Luoyun's brush and her help.

items.name: Ethereal Shadow
items.description: Crowned by the night as the master of dreams, she saw visions and heard every secret wish and silent hope.

items.name: Crescent Whisper
items.description: Lovers reunited. Those consumed by fear or pain worried no more. Sorrow faded into oblivion.

items.name: Drifting Haze
items.description: A river of stars carrying hopes and memories flowed through dreams, driving out terrors with a harmonious finale.

items.name: Feathery Breeze
items.description: The audience was a group of blind kids. Their teacher hoped that music could show them the beauty of the world.

items.name: Dream Timbre
items.description: The show started on time. There was no spotlight or Arya's dream stage, but a sky full of twinkling stars.

items.name: Dream Embrace
items.description: The children sat quietly in their seats, with the most attentive and touching look of anticipation for the performer.

items.name: Lustrous Bloom
items.description: In her singing, stars were musical notes dancing under the sky, while fireflies shimmered in the serene, open wild.

items.name: Starlit Glide
items.description: The singing turned into pairs of invisible wings, carrying the children to the boundless sky of shining stars.

items.name: Candid Embrace
items.description: Since then Arya has been to many places for shows, but she still remembers the night and those meaningful tunes.

items.name: Stylistic Solo
items.description: The unique guitar has been with Chilu for long, from his loneliest moments to his achievements under the spotlight.

items.name: Metallic Hum
items.description: After a short break, it's time for the mysterious guest. The stadium erupts into cheers when the audience sees Kaja.

items.name: Opposing Wings
items.description: Chilu explains to Cali his inspiration for the concert, 'Contradictions make up the world and our lives.'

items.name: Dance of Strings
items.description: Day and night, front and back, black and white—the audience dances and cheers as the melodies and beats clash.

items.name: Drifting Warble
items.description: The praise of life never stops. Be it day or night, spring or winter, the melodies flow with endless passion and joy.

items.name: Euphoric Beats
items.description: A musical score floated in the air. With Melodie's guide, the students soon noticed the incorrect notes.

items.name: Track of Life
items.description: Two musical notes overlapped, while one hung at the edge of the score, as if it would fall at any moment.

items.name: Fantastic Symphony
items.description: Melodie told her students that everything had its own song. Listen carefully to hear every dancing note.

items.name: Dream Navigation
items.description: The students cheered as the wilting plant thrived again, budding quietly in the sound of music.

items.name: Missing Curse
items.description: Melodie waved her wand and chanted a spell to move the misplaced notes. A gentle song echoed in the room.

items.name: Rejoicing Snow
items.description: The girl's dress twirled like a flower blooming in the snow. People were transfixed by the perfect dance and music.

items.name: Starlit Foliage
items.description: For the Night Festival, the girl would be dancing under the largest adorned tree lit for the whole night.

items.name: Earnest Present
items.description: Cheers and claps surrounded her after a song. A small figure pushed out of the crowd and lunged into her arms.

items.name: Ursine Cuteness
items.description: The girl felt as if she were dancing on a cloud and saw a snow bear coming to life and nodding at her approvingly.

items.name: Vivid Fairytale
items.description: The audition was a week before the Night Festival. She practiced and sewed her dress with carefully picked clothes.

items.name: Guiding Pearl
items.description: Overworked, she caught a cold from the wind. Fortunately, her friends got her to the hospital in time.

items.name: Silvery Jingle
items.description: Tomorrow was the Night Festival. Disappointment almost crushed her as she walked in the sound of holy carols.

items.name: Moonlit Gaze
items.description: The messenger brought a pile of packages, from a portal speaker, CDs, sweets from her hometown to starry ribbons.

items.name: Nocturnal Glimmer
items.description: Her friends and family cheered her up. She wiped away tears as an idea slowly formed in her mind.

items.name: Brilliant Festivity
items.description: She felt her unfinished dress and the audition poster still lying on the table, when a knock broke the silence.

items.name: Snowflake Charm
items.description: Her students stared as Verssia calmly waved her wand, until waterdrops froze into snowflakes floating in the air.

items.name: Gale of Snow
items.description: It was time for the students to practice. Some recalled her steps and started practicing, while some needed help.

items.name: Crystalline Shine
items.description: 'Don't rush,' Verssia slowed her movements to show the details, 'Move in order and chant the spell accurately.'

items.name: Frostland Fantasy
items.description: The students would continue to discuss what they learned. They all felt that Verssia was actually very gentle.

items.name: Silent Promise
items.description: Thankfully, Verssia came to the rescue. She shielded the nervous student behind and melted the icicles with a wave.

items.name: Gentle Croon
items.description: 'Sorry, Ms. Verssia... I failed.' Verssia patted him on the shoulder, 'It's always good to try, so don't be afraid.'

items.name: Magic of Silence
items.description: 'Imagine elements of water gathering at the tip of your wand and freezing...' She guided her students to feel magic.

items.name: Effulgent Snow
items.description: Glimmering snowflakes were reflected in the students' eyes. The breathtaking view seemed to have stopped time.

items.name: Chapter of Nature
items.description: Verssia carefully guided every student. With each chant of the spell, snowflakes bloomed in the classroom.

items.name: Sparkling Prayer
items.description: Suddenly, someone screamed. A nervous student lost control and accidentally made dangerous, sharp icicles.

items.name: Frozen Splendor
