items.description: With Verssia's encouraging words, the student calmed down and waved his wand again—a perfect snowflake bloomed.

items.name: Snowy Night Magic
items.description: The Magic Academy Fantasies has been a hit since its publication. Verssia is one of the most liked characters.

items.name: Frosty Shrine
items.description: Vianna would listen to their wishes in the sea of flowers and send the emissary of snow to spread her blessings.

items.name: Meandering Peaks
items.description: Since then, the townsfolk would bring flowers to the foothills during the Night Festival to thank the Goddess.

items.name: Echoing Stars
items.description: Children have whimsical dreams while others pray for their loved ones... Each tugs at Vianna's heartstrings.

items.name: Blessed Snowflake
items.description: The Goddess blessed everyone in town, but when the festival ended, she heard a girl's disappointed sigh.

items.name: Pious Heart
items.description: 'If only I could give this flower to the Goddess!' the girl had the sincerest wish that reached the snowy peaks.

items.name: Midnight Breath
items.description: The girl didn't deliver the flower in time. I should visit her instead! Vianna made up her mind with a smile.

items.name: Starlight Vision
items.description: The peaks glowed silently as the girl slept soundly in the warm room, a sweet dream awaiting her.

items.name: Crystalline Frost
items.description: The girl spent all day preparing flowers for others to offer the Goddess and missed the festival herself.

items.name: Rosy Redolence
items.description: The exquisite bag is the first New Year's gift: elegant design and romantic colors adorned with fragrant roses.

items.name: Dual Space
items.description: Their collaboration ignites the show, and Chilu's new song Echo makes the best response to the audience's passion.

items.name: Carefree Sway
items.description: Starlet guessed the girl was a poacher and challenged her to a styling contest, asking to set the birds free.

items.name: Guardian of Blooms
items.description: Surprised but not offended, the girl explained that she was a healer who helped animals hurt by poachers.

items.name: Entrapped Wings
items.description: Starlet noticed the caged birds were badly hurt, their wounds covered in white gauze. They needed protection.

items.name: Carefree Sway - Hidden
items.description: Maybe the stars answered her prayer or the forest heard the birds. The girl cried when Starlet returned in time.

items.name: Guardian of Blooms - Hidden
items.description: The girl ground the Whispergrass and fed it to the birds. As their eyes lit up again, they both relaxed.

items.name: Entrapped Wings - Hidden
items.description: Starlet waved goodbye to the girl and the birds and looked at the stars. Maybe they didn't lead her astray this time.

items.name: Wonderland Parade
items.description: Ms. Bunny's notebook gradually became a source of wonders, like a dreamland full of whimsical ideas.

items.name: Fluorescent Mirage
items.description: The girl sitting quietly in a coffee shop could be Ms. Bunny lost in imagination. What would the next story be like?

items.name: Ethereal Vision
items.description: Ms. Bunny invited Starlet to the troupe's new show. Beautiful scores guided the audience into a world of fantasies.

items.name: Poem of Tomorrow
items.description: Applause erupted at the end of the show. It was so amazing that Starlet decided to stay and watch the next one.

items.name: Wonderland Parade - Maple
items.description: Starlet always gets lost on her journeys, but thanks to that, she's made friends and has lots of stories to tell.

items.name: Fluorescent Mirage - Maple
items.description: Starlet's stories gave Ms. Bunny new ideas. She wrote them down in her notebook but refused to show Starlet.

items.name: Ethereal Vision - Maple
items.description: It wasn't until the new show that Starlet knew that Ms. Bunny wrote it for her, named The Lost Seer and Her Friends.

items.name: Poem of Tomorrow - Maple
items.description: The seer's journey put smiles on everyone's faces, and Starlet had a new story to tell—her experience in the troupe.

items.name: Bear Cookie
items.description: Ennie invited Starlet to dinner. Starlet was on cloud nine among toy bears after having the cream of mushroom soup.

items.name: Whispers of the Night
items.description: Ennie spoke gently, 'Sleep, for your journey is in the dreams.' Starlet thought dozily that she sounded magical.

items.name: Fluffy Camaraderie
items.description: When Starlet opened her eyes, two toy bears were waving at her. They tugged her sleeves, inviting her to the castle.

items.name: Bear Cookie - Foamy
items.description: Starlet thought for a while and said, 'I like myself and my life. Besides... I don't know this prince.'

items.name: Whispers of the Night- Foamy
items.description: The next day, Starlet bid farewell to Ennie, who offered her a toy bear to accompany her on her journey forward.

items.name: Fluffy Camaraderie - Foamy
items.description: Starlet patted the bear's fluffy head and whispered, 'Thank you, but I think they'd prefer staying with you, Ennie.'

items.name: Spring Firecrackers
items.description: 'Bid goodbye to the last year with fireworks and cheer! Is that thunder? No, it's my firecrackers of good wishes!'

items.name: Bunny Cheers
items.description: The toy bunnies Ruby and Kane were Luluko's first fans. Their long ears danced to her singing as if cheering her on.

items.name: Stage of Excitement
items.description: In the brilliant neon lights and waves of cheers, Luluko took a deep breath and stepped onto her dream stage.

items.name: Perfect Vigor
items.description: When she was a kid, Luluko saw an idol's performance on stage. The gorgeous dress and bright smile captivated her.

items.name: Childish Imitation
items.description: Dressing up in a sheer curtain and dancing with a rolled-up magazine—it was young Luluko's favorite game.

items.name: Heart of Passion
items.description: Brighter than the stars was Luluko's smile. Her shared joy and energy must have reached the cheering audience.

items.name: Childhood Vision
items.description: Tears of joy replaced days of anxiety when she got a reply from the idol project. Her dream was finally coming true.

items.name: Perfect Rendition
items.description: As the audience chanted for an encore, Luluko smiled with tears in her eyes and wished the song would never end.

items.name: Scattering Wish
items.description: Luluko wasn't disappointed with no more spotlights, because those glow sticks would shine on in her heart.

items.name: Radiant Sweetheart
items.description: No more rolled-up magazine, Luluko grabbed the microphone and made her intro—I'm Luluko, and welcome to my show!

items.name: Stellar Bloom
items.description: Her time as a trainee wasn't always fun. After being asked to do it again, she'd hide and cry. Then... try again!

items.name: Tomorrow's Reunion
items.description: The manager took Luluko's phone to stop her from going on Tide. Her schedule was packed the next day!

items.name: Zephyr Murmur
items.description: It's dark and time to go home. The leaves rustle in the wind and sing a lullaby. Explore the autumn in warm dreams.

items.name: Glacé Memory
items.description: Myra felt happy for her. She gave her a big bar of coffee chocolate and wished the best for her new life in Cicia.

items.name: Hazelnut Biscuits
items.description: Linno seemed hesitant outside, so Myra invited her in. She said she wanted to confess her feelings to her crush.

items.name: Cream Gummies
items.description: 'Why not give him handmade chocolate?' Myra helped Linno make a heart-shaped chocolate and wished her good luck.

items.name: Cream Honey
items.description: 'Momo, there's no fish-flavored chocolate!' 'Fine. Let's try mint, strawberry and this lemon flavor together!'

items.name: Luscious Cocoa
items.description: The day was coming to an end. Myra was preparing to close the shop when a pink-haired girl and her cat came in.

items.name: Midwinter Bloom
items.description: She trudged in the snow in threadbare shoes and blazed a trail on the perilous northern peak.

items.name: Fragrant Dawn
items.description: It was not until dawn that she saw the red plum trees blooming for miles, covering the precipice in a dreamy brocade.

items.name: Brocade of Dreams
items.description: She clenched her teeth and prayed for the remainder of the trip. She was so close when she fell and blacked out.

items.name: Splendid Grace
items.description: A decade passed, and it was winter again. She walked alone in the snow, but this time, the trail was beaten and firm.

items.name: Crystalline Snow
items.description: She woke up in a warm, dry cave. The plum blooms had shriveled, leaving only one petal in her hand.

items.name: Fading Scent
items.description: With no floral fragrance, the red blooms on the peak were actually handkerchiefs with exquisite embroideries.

items.name: Nostalgic Dream
items.description: Despite the howling storm, she took out a red handkerchief and tied it with a ribbon to a withered branch.

items.name: Dream Bubbles
items.description: She was Carpia, with gorgeous golden and red scales exactly like the one in the story, but she always lazed around.

items.name: Crimson Jade
items.description: The koi fish began to ask if it was really what they wanted. It was a path to success, but also filled with pain.

items.name: Tender Illusion
items.description: In their training, the red koi and golden koi met a new friend who always stayed in the corners and never socialized.

items.name: Sunlight Dazzle
items.description: Carpia made two friends, even though she looked reluctant. They practiced together and shared pearls and snacks.

items.name: Gemmed Glimmer
items.description: The river was drying. The koi fish were too small to notice it at first, and the river was the whole world to them.

items.name: Bejeweled Fan
items.description: The red koi came to help, so Carpia asked her, too. She wanted to protect the others so they wouldn't get hurt.

items.name: Lucent Felicity
items.description: Carpia asked why she wanted to become a Loong. The golden koi shed a tear and answered she wished to see the sea.

items.name: Tailored Breeze
items.description: That night, Carpia let the snowy moonlight shine on her and leaped over one towering wave after another.

items.name: Tune of Devotion
items.description: Every koi fish has its reason to be a Loong. Through countless trials, they struggle and challenge themselves.

items.name: Euphonic Serenade
items.description: The koi fish that turned into a Loong had never left. She'd seen every mountain and sea and returned to the river.

items.name: Earnest Promise
items.description: Carpia used her Loong power to clear the sludge from upstream. It all went back to normal as the water returned.

items.name: Rippling Reverie
items.description: It wasn't until the golden koi got hurt that they realized the river was drying out. Time was changing everything.

items.name: Transient Eternity
items.description: A giant Loong appeared, with a solemn voice echoing under the moon, asking if she was ready to leave the river.

items.name: Shadow of Destiny
items.description: Greed misled the once-wise nobleman. He abused his power and wealth, gilding even the floors of his manor.

items.name: Dauntless Wings
items.description: The girl in the tower believed in Verka's lie until one day, an injured falcon brought a blood-stained family emblem.

items.name: Frigid Blaze
items.description: She thought it could be a clue. Following the emblem, she found her father's old subordinate and learned the truth.

items.name: Effulgent Leaf
items.description: The starving population and the truth of her father's death. With seething rage, she set out on a journey of revenge.

items.name: Pristine Glory
items.description: A few days ago, she faked a report about an uprising in another region to lead Verka away from the castle.

items.name: Silent Recital
items.description: As the castellan, she ordered the banishment of Verka's family, which was carried out by her close followers.

items.name: Blazing Splendor
items.description: But it was far from enough. Rofona didn't have enough wealth or power if Verka returned with his army.

items.name: Glimpse of Yore
items.description: Verka's reaction was unexpected. His letter seemed calm—he thought she was coerced by her father's followers.

items.name: Triumphant Return
items.description: The hubristic man was still stuck in the past. The web of lies he wove for Rofona eventually ensnared him as well.

items.name: Fearless Oath
items.description: 'Verka took our wealth, and I'll get it all back for you!' Rofona swore an oath to her followers at sunrise.

items.name: Midnight Blizzard
items.description: Darlene would come to the park every night after that. Like an unspoken agreement, the violin would play.

items.name: Snowfall Promise
items.description: The wait felt endless in the snow. Darlene was about to give up when the man shielded her with a black umbrella.

items.name: Vow of Life
items.description: Seeing Darlene's tears, he couldn't hide his feelings anymore, 'I'll protect you from now on. You won't wait again.'

items.name: Snowfall Moment
items.description: A welcome party held him up. He was out of breath after running in the snow, begging for Darlene's forgiveness.

items.name: Silent Aspiration
items.description: Darlene loved writing, but her work left her no time to put ideas to paper. Yet tonight, he wanted to be her reader.

items.name: Lingering Chorus
items.description: Darlene listened as he played, while he read all her poems. They were each other's first audience.

items.name: Snow-Night Oath
items.description: A lily always lay on the bench she sat on. Darlene would turn her gaze to the violinist playing with flushed ears.

items.name: Midwinter Comfort
items.description: Darlene sent her poems to publishers, and the violinist signed up for the open recruitment of an orchestra.

items.name: Pristine Feeling
items.description: Darlene found fame with her beautiful writing, while the violinist impressed everyone with his amazing skills.

items.name: Sacred Inscription
items.description: The day Renata left, birds surrounded her like always as she leapt by the old tree, oblivious to the glowing runes.

items.name: Immortal Saga
items.description: She woke up before the birds and slept cradled by vines. One day, the envoy whispered, 'Call me Mother.'

items.name: Ligneous Sanctum
items.description: One day, as Mother brushed Renata's hair, she said, 'It's time. You're ready for your three missions.'

items.name: Primeval Sentiment
items.description: Renata came to the first impoverished country. Following Mother's instructions, she gave them fertile grounds.

items.name: Sylvan Tales
items.description: People in the second country were brave but reckless. Renata crafted the sharpest weapons for them as told.

items.name: Caged Wish
items.description: The third country was obsessed with magic powers. Renata taught those with potential what she learned from Mother.

items.name: Hillside Smelter
items.description: When Mother heard Renata murmur in her sleep she felt lucky to be by her side, the look on her face seemed uncertain.

items.name: Starlit Splendor
items.description: Renata rushed back and saw golden runes glowing by the tree. Worried, she ran to Mother but was pushed away instead.

items.name: Spiritual Sigh
items.description: Renata somehow felt worried seeing people in their euphoria, but it faded when birds brought a gift from Mother.

items.name: Wilderness Elegy
items.description: Fertile land couldn't defend itself; weapons led to war; magic broke the balance of power. The countries collapsed.

items.name: Surreal Dream
items.description: The birds carried lights to the outside world, sharing warmth and calmness with those struggling in hatred and war.

items.name: Midnight Reverie
items.description: In the safe haven of a comfortable dream, time loses all meaning, leaving only two inseparable hearts.

items.name: Snowfall Vow
items.description: A sweet kiss melts the winter chill as snowflakes fall, forming two hearts forever entwined.

items.name: Ardent Passion
items.description: A red rose witnesses fiery love on a snowy night, its imprint eternal and unyielding.

items.name: Mirror of Time
items.description: The mirror belongs to the castle and the Star Seer. Unfortunately, there's nothing she needs to know through it.

items.name: Frosty Splendor
items.description: On the balcony, Hirst leans casually on the sofa with a book in his hands, but his gaze lies somewhere else.

items.name: Seasonal Cycle
items.description: Starlet lies in a tall and fluffy bed in the well-decorated bedroom, frowning as if debating something important.

items.name: Florescent Shadow
items.description: As candlelight flickers in the church of the Pigeon Kingdom, the Holy Maiden prays on her knees with her closed eyes.

items.name: Sparkling Dew
items.description: In Apple Federation, the magician bows in thunderous applause and cheers as colorful confetti bursts and falls.

items.name: Splendid Vestige
items.description: As stars illuminate every corner of the continent, ripples spread in the mirror, showing images from afar.

items.name: Anecdote of Time
items.description: The vision in the mirror becomes a blur of falling stars and fading moonlight, leaving only silent darkness.

items.name: Fate in Mirror
items.description: In the forgotten corner, time turns into ripples in the mirror. Only blooms and springs sing rhymes of yore.

items.name: Herald of Spring
items.description: The flower said: I'd seen others looking for the garden but leaving in disappointment. Did you also come from afar?

items.name: Iridescent Garden
items.description: The traveler sat by a stone pillar. To her surprise, there was power left in the wilted vines where a flower budded.

items.name: Vernal Eternity
items.description: The traveler was tired, thinking the dead garden was fate's prank, telling her that all her efforts were in vain.

items.name: Temporal Reflection
items.description: The traveler couldn't answer that. Her journey began so long ago, and she'd left footprints all over the world.

items.name: Aromatic Prelude
items.description: The traveler wandered the world and saw prosperity and desolation. The initial joy of traveling had long faded.

items.name: Floral Rhetoric
items.description: The flower waited, swaying in the frigid gale as if it'd be blown away the next second. The traveler answered yes.

items.name: Florid Companion
items.description: A gust of wind blew the flower into the traveler's palm. It asked: Will you stay? We can create another spring.

items.name: Garden Strings
items.description: But the traveler was too tired. She stared at the desolation, unsure of an eternal spring. Would there ever be one?

items.name: Sprouting Verdure
items.description: The flower said: Sorry, spring had long left. Take your rest and leave. You may find an eternal spring elsewhere.

items.name: Eternal Tendrils
items.description: The fairy was long gone, but she left a way to preserve spring. The traveler decided to stay and rebuild the garden.

items.name: Garden Rhapsody
items.description: But she didn't leave and felt the vines with warmth in her gaze. She'd walked too long for the promise of spring.

items.name: Locks of Felicity
items.description: Herbal wine is the goddess’s favorite, filled with the scent of spring, symbolizing hope and prosperity.

items.name: Aureate Splendor
items.description: As the fireworks bloom, the goddess blesses the world with peace and prosperity and wishes for abundant times ahead.

items.name: Fortune Cauldron
items.description: A fortune sprite gifted her a cauldron to share blessings and wishes as she serves as the new year’s guardian.

items.name: Heavenly Auspice
items.description: The snake goddess prepares for all wishes—reunion, love, health, wealth, or luck—for the coming year.

items.name: Nephrite Wish
items.description: Firecrackers awaken the sun lord as people don new outfits, ready to embrace a prosperous new year.

items.name: Brimming Vigor
items.description: After Miu landed, the bloated toast slowly shrunk and turned into a warm light, leaving only the sweetness of butter.

items.name: Faith in Tomorrow
items.description: 'I'm sure you've made it to school on time. Hope the magic helped. And don't sleep late again. —Bakery Owner'

items.name: Tales of Fortune
items.description: It all happened so suddenly that Miu thought she was dreaming. She shook the empty bag and found a note inside.

items.name: Toast Magic
items.description: Riding the giant piece of toast, Miu finally made it to school before the last moment.

items.name: Fondness Overload
items.description: Miu is a character in Morning at the Bakery. It's a children's book about a bakery owner using magic to help kids.

items.name: Fireside Tea
items.description: After preparing melted snow and tea leaves in the yard, Roro brought more fruits to treat her guest.

items.name: Fragrance in Snow
items.description: The snow died down, but Roro was still worried. If her guest didn't come, she'd bring some treats to the mountain.

items.name: Flimsy Dream
items.description: After reading about brewing tea with melted snow, Roro climbed the mountain to collect some—but slipped and fell.

items.name: Bundle of Snow
items.description: As she brushed away the snow, a flurry little creature stuck its nose out and rubbed the snow off of her cheeks.

items.name: Snowland Fairy
items.description: Roro was surprised to see her guest had arrived—a ferret was waving at her on the unlit stove, taking it for a seat.

items.name: Enwreathing Mist
items.description: The ferret followed Roro wherever she went. It watched with its head tilted, then led her to a secret plum forest.

items.name: Crucible Haze
items.description: Roro lifted the ferret away and lit the stove. Soon, a pleasant scent wafted out of the pot of snow and tea.

items.name: Scented Snowfall
items.description: Roro gathered snow with the smell of plum blooms and invited the ferret to tea tasting. To her surprise, it nodded!

items.name: Dormant Warmth
items.description: The ferret followed Roro home before bidding its goodbye. Roro watched until snow covered its tiny footprints.

items.name: Emerald Resplendence
items.description: At sunset, the ferret rubbed on Roro's fingertip and scampered away—perhaps they'd meet again the next day.

items.name: Banquet Vestige
items.description: A waiter walked to Allison with drinks. She took one and saluted to someone behind the crowd.

items.name: Stairs of Glory
items.description: Like that, Allison got away from the crowd. Beside the elegant spiral stairs, a waiter invited her to the lounge.

items.name: Glowing Spectacle
items.description: Everyone turned their gaze to the middle-aged man. Allison's next investee? They wondered and gathered around him.

items.name: Urban Neon
items.description: The marble floor reflected the neon lights and stars outside, as an intoxicating aroma filled the room.

items.name: Amber Whisper
items.description: Her assistant put a coat on her and whispered, 'We found proof that her design got stolen. Are you helping her?'

items.name: Aureate Daze
items.description: Allison doesn't mind bootlickers. She knows wealth attracts vultures like carcasses. They'll never forget the taste.

items.name: Emerald Canticle
items.description: 'This is my newest design. What do you think?' the young man smiled flatteringly, 'Nothing beats it!'

items.name: Scented Treasure
items.description: 'Of course.' the young man apologized. 'You must have more than this.' Allison didn't mind, 'I'll take them all.'

items.name: Cosmic Symphony
items.description: Allison raised her eyebrow, 'I run a legitimate business, sir. The tax I paid is enough to build three Times Towers.'

items.name: Empyrean Shine
items.description: Lives fell to the empress's wrath. Blood on the guillotine didn't dry for months and the blade split time and again.

items.name: Lakeside Arcade
items.description: The girl was invited to the palace with respect. She felt no joy or sorrow, so nobody could see through her.

items.name: Frosty Willow
items.description: There was no more secret in the world. The girl needed no excuse or proof, for she knew it all.

items.name: Cosmic Liberation
items.description: But the empress didn't ask her everything. The girl was confused as to why the empress pretended to not spot a lie.

items.name: Purge of Evil
items.description: The empress smiled, no longer young, 'You know the world, but not people.' Then she added, 'It's not a bad thing.'

items.name: Ravine Echo
items.description: As time passed, the once vigorous empress aged. She lay in bed, only her eyes still as bright as usual.

items.name: Serene Luster
items.description: Before she made her choice, the new empress came to butter her up, 'If you're tired, you can return to Frostleaf.'

items.name: Timeless Finesse
items.description: Instead of explaining, the empress talked about other things that fascinated the girl even though she knew them all.

items.name: Curious Virtuosity
items.description: She sighed after a while, 'Leave if you don't want to.' The girl was confused. She thought she wanted her to stay.

items.name: Misty Cirrus
items.description: 'Do you want me to help the new empress?' the girl asked, even though she shouldn't stay. The empress hesitated.

items.name: Drifting Cirrus
items.description: Frostleaf disappeared over time, leaving only a handful of small lakes scattered over the map.

items.name: Meteor Whisper
items.description: 'Go home, before the stars all fall. You need rest.' Starlet nodded and then shook her head. She couldn't promise it.

items.name: Verdant Canto
items.description: Her teacher pushed the Stellar Codex toward her, 'We'll be waiting here, like today, and you'll find your way back.'

items.name: Scentful Slumber
items.description: Starlet was beckoned over to her teacher. She stood there as her teacher flipped through the Stellar Codex.

items.name: Clouded Echo
items.description: 'You must be tired after a long journey.' The teacher pulled Starlet to sit by her—a memory she didn't recall.

items.name: Resplendent Stars
items.description: As Starlet closed the door and turned around, she saw the ship Lilith Star flowing in the sea wind.

items.name: Vision of Innocence
items.description: At dawn, she sat with Amphithea News flapping in the wind, the date on which already leapt to months later.

items.name: Garden Adventure
items.description: The past, present and future were marbles scattered on the ground to her. There was no point in finding a pattern.

items.name: Lingering Memory
items.description: There had to be something to base reality on. Starlet felt the Stellar Codex and tried to sort out her mind.

items.name: Luminous Starlight
items.description: Would her past and future selves help with her current wish? When Starlet looked up again, the sky had turned dark.

items.name: Stellar Coronation
items.description: She seemed to have caught the star's tail for a brief moment. Would it be her way home or lead her astray again?

items.name: Eternal Blessing
items.description: Brenda would lie on the armor during breaks, wiping her sword while babbling on about palace anecdotes.

items.name: Drifting Petals
items.description: Bloody roses bloomed all over the Royal City. Brenda who grew like a sprouting tree hastened past the hedgerow.

items.name: Nocturnal Echo
items.description: The girl's sword accurately hit between the breastplates with a clang. She cheered, ignoring the pain in her hand.

items.name: Crimson Edge
items.description: Brenda commissioned a heavy sword as advised. The hilt was engraved with the same patterns as the armor.

items.name: Innocent Wonder
items.description: Brenda defended her kingdom with her sword. Under her leadership, they fended off invaders again and again.

items.name: Pristine Vision
items.description: The armor spun around and showed Brenda a blooming red rose on the tip of the blade, 'Well done, Brenda.'

items.name: Iridescent Twinkle
items.description: The king died after a raid at night. Fire and smoke of war spread across the kingdom in place of red roses.

items.name: Pristine Oath
items.description: She knew the soldiers must have felt the same. The armor exhausted its soul, sharing its power with everyone.

items.name: Frigid Silence
items.description: Blue decided to look for White. The spirits studied the travelers' books for three days before seeing her off.

items.name: Fluorescent Era
items.description: White usually returned after a few days, so the spirits grew worried when she didn't return for months this time.

items.name: Vow of Loyalty
items.description: When Blue said that, White would sigh with a smile and let her wrap around her arm as they watched the clouds surge.

items.name: Veiled Moon
items.description: The human world was much more lively. She followed a pleasant smell and found the sweet cake she read in the books.

items.name: Nephrite Charm
items.description: Blue tilted her head in confusion when asked to pay, so the vendor offered her a small piece resignedly.

items.name: Enwreathed Ridge
items.description: The human world was not as dramatic as the books. Their lives were simple but colorful as they worked and rested.

items.name: Hazy Precipice
items.description: Spirits don't eat these. Blue thought to herself, but drooled over it. How could the humans make such delicacies?

items.name: Emerald Shimmer
items.description: Humans feared the unknown, nature and whims of fate, but they were also brave, living as if they were never afraid.

items.name: Lotus Verdure
items.description: Blue remembered what her sister told her. Spirits grew up in rain and storms, but never had to worry about death.

items.name: Godsbane Oath
items.description: She was no envoy of the gods but a fallen angel, cursed with eternal life, bound by trees and mountains.

items.name: Mirror of Miracles
items.description: As the candles dim, the vision in the mirror fades in ripples. The sound of the gates opening echoes in the corridor.

items.name: Banana Satchel
items.description: She always wears a banana-shaped satchel. Some say inside is delicious candy, while some say interesting stories.

items.name: Floating Clouds
items.description: People were told where the medicine came from. Since then, the wild cranes have become a symbol of the ancient city.

items.name: Dreambound Whisper
items.description: The final stop was the Crane's dwelling place. The wind rustled the reed leaves, and a crane stood in the water.

items.name: Cheerful Breeze
items.description: A cup of morning tea carries the scent of lemon groves, each breath filled with nature's calm and hidden delight.

items.name: Blazing End
items.description: Why did he leave? Drawn by beauty, he was burned by the fire within. An insecure soul can never face the flame.

items.name: Lost Memory
items.description: Helen recalled her mythic namesake—both trapped by beauty, their fates chosen by a world beyond their control.

items.name: Drowning Dream
items.description: She dreamed of fire roaring through an ancient city. Its light in her eyes, and the illusion of beauty vanished.

items.name: Time Glimmer
items.description: Helen stepped into the spotlight. Her red dress flared like fire with each spin, burning away every unseen chain.

items.name: Flicker Mirage
items.description: Beauty was never the sin—it was desire and illusion that fed the blame. Rumors only revealed their fragile souls.

items.name: Mirror Gleam
items.description: At the banquet, Helen nodded with a calm smile—he was a stranger now. But in his eyes, longing still lingered.

items.name: Dreamlike Flutter
items.description: A butterfly landed on the girl's shoulder before flying to the roses, fascinating her with its glittering wings.

items.name: Flitting Butterfly
items.description: Does love always feel so bitter-sweet? She believed that she'd met the one and wished to fall in love sooner.

items.name: Untold Feelings
items.description: It might be time to confess her feelings amidst the butterflies and blooms, but the girl didn't know how.

items.name: Earliest Blossom
items.description: A cold wave swept across the town. The roses that were blooming yesterday lost their colors in the gale.

items.name: Springtime Wonder
items.description: Butterflies huddled around the roses in the bitter cold, each thin wing shielding the blooms from the wind.

items.name: Devout Prayer
items.description: She prayed for the roses to survive the night and for the butterflies to leave for warmer lands.

items.name: Prismatic Wings
items.description: The girl tried to keep every bloom warm while the butterflies danced around, unaware of the approaching danger.

items.name: Colorful Flickers
items.description: Under the warm sun, the girl danced with the butterflies amidst the roses, creating their romantic fairytale.

items.name: Bunny Pawns
items.description: Unlike the bunny pawns on the chessboard, Bena was surprised to find out that she didn't have to follow the rules.

items.name: Ingenious Move
items.description: In the blink of an eye, a giant hand placed Bena on a black-and-white chessboard. Around her were bunny pawns.

items.name: Monochrome Dream
items.description: 'It's just a dream.' Bena nodded cheerfully, 'I'll be your soldier and guard every inch of the kingdom for you.'

items.name: Silent Midnight
items.description: Bena led the white bunnies to knock off their enemies one by one, like a light shining through the silent dark.

items.name: Soldier's Glory
items.description: Bena took down the enemy rooks, captured their king, and earned her queen's praise, 'You're an excellent soldier.'

items.name: Charging Blade
items.description: Bena never got a bunny chessboard. She was excited that she could finally have one, but she was also worried.

items.name: Unbreakable Oath
items.description: A designer created the bunny chess after a whimsical dream. Bena loved it but could never afford one.

items.name: Supreme Praise
items.description: 'You can have me now.' The queen agrees, 'Tomorrow afternoon, visit your favorite thrift shop. I'll wait there.'

items.name: Fairytale Waltz
items.description: The queen seemed to have misunderstood. Bena did win, but it had nothing to do with being an excellent soldier.

items.name: Fairytale Twirl
items.description: Every move on the chessboard calls for meticulous planning, but in the land of dreams, the only rule is to have fun.

items.name: Astral Weave
items.description: They stood shoulder to shoulder under the fireworks, like how they once crawled under one blanket in their dorm.

items.name: Galactic Dazzle
items.description: Tabisha couldn't help but yelp with joy. Like stars, the fireworks cast happiness and blessings for the night.

items.name: Resplendent Blaze
items.description: Three, two, one—the moment she opened her eyes, she saw a sky lit by fireworks as brilliant as a sea of flowers.

items.name: Dancing Shimmer
items.description: The memories intertwined but never faded. They shared a knowing look, laughing heartily just as before.

items.name: Wondrous Serenade
items.description: Their memories of every adventure, every clash and mix of inspirations, seemed ever so vivid and never lost in time.

items.name: Fulgent Stars
items.description: Tabisha's friends dragged her off the terrace and gathered the guests to reveal their wedding gifts.

items.name: Reminiscent Stars
items.description: Tabisha looked in the mirror to put on a glistening necklace and cracked up seeing her friends make faces.

items.name: Sweet Lullaby
items.description: In the gentle breeze under the stars, Tabisha tossed the bouquet of happiness as everyone cheered.

items.name: Effulgent Daze
items.description: 'Our dearest friend, between the stars and the sparks, we weave for you a never-fading dream—a life full of love.'

items.name: Dream Companion
items.description: Elanie leans back in her shell chair, dreaming of the sea—dolphins at play, fish gliding beside her.

items.name: Free Voyage
items.description: Elanie turns off her jellyfish lamp and closes her eyes—wishing to hear the sea's whisper in her dreams.

items.name: Starlit Whispers
items.description: At school, wishes go in drift bottles. Send them afloat—some say the water will make them come true.

items.name: Neon Ray
items.description: In pajamas, Elanie leans on her bed. Moonlight touches her photo wall—the leaping manta ray looks so free.

items.name: Sea Treasures
items.description: Elanie leaves her curious friends and heads to the riverside, carefully writing her long-held wish.

items.name: Mist Drop
items.description: The bottle floats away. If my wish won't come true, Elanie thinks, then go see the sea for me.

items.name: Gleam Shell
items.description: Elanie begins her drift bottle shopping—glass jars, scented paper, rainbow stars, and ribbons for a perfect wish.

items.name: Prism Glow
items.description: 'Could it be true?' Elanie wavered. 'But imagine the bottles reaching the sea!' Her friend's eyes sparkled with zeal.

items.name: Glimmer Sprite
items.description: One clear night, Lumi rose with the waves. The tide whispered, and the sea breeze carried distant laughter.

items.name: Bottled Wish
items.description: Lumi uncorked the bottle. Inside, a child had written: “I want to grow up and explore the world’s end!”

items.name: Crystal Hope
items.description: A drift bottle washed up before Lumi, moonlight glinting on its glass. Curious, she wondered—what could be inside?

items.name: Stardust Gleam
items.description: But Madam Orca never stayed long—she loved the surface more than the deep. Lumi wondered, what could be up there?

items.name: Shell Whisper
items.description: Where is the world's end? In the deep sea, or beyond the sky? Strange thoughts, yet they fascinate her.

items.name: Pure Whisper
items.description: Some letters hold first love, some brief wonders, but most carry heartfelt wishes from their senders.

items.name: Tide Relic
items.description: Since that night, Lumi rises whenever moonlight glows bright, opening drift bottles to read the wishes within.

items.name: Dream Net
items.description: Lumi is enchanted. The letters paint the human world vividly, making the quiet sea below feel dull in comparison.

items.name: Egg Wonder
items.description: The bunnies are always looking for eggs, but they seem to have never thought how to bring them home.

items.name: Bunny's Birth
items.description: 'Mom, what's the world like beyond the fields?' 'No bunnies in our family have traveled that far, my child.'

items.name: Burgeoning Wonder
items.description: 'I heard there are crows envious of your red eyes, hungry beasts, and mountains and rivers standing in your way.'

items.name: Sprouting Wish
items.description: Reba always leaped on the mound to stare at the horizon where the sun sank, wondering about the world beyond.

items.name: Colorful Journey
items.description: She traveled outside the fields to the mountains. There were hungry wolves and squirrels adventuring with her.

items.name: Dandelion Yellow
items.description: 'But I want to see it!' One night, Reba followed the dandelions' seeds on a secret adventure of the unknown.

items.name: Flourishing Wish
items.description: The garden grows fragrant with the wishes. It is said to be a mysterious ritual that turns wishes into flowers.

items.name: Blossoming Dream
items.description: Flore asks her customers to write down their wishes with a smile. The floral-scented notes seem to hold secrets.

items.name: Guardian of Hope
items.description: Ten years ago, the town was destroyed by merciless floods. People thought it had no hopes of reconstruction.

items.name: Mellow Glow
items.description: Now, Florawishes bloom still. The girl who lost her parents in the floods has built a garden upon the ruins.

items.name: Zephyr of Dawn
items.description: Florawishes are beautiful hopes, but without Flore's care, how could those buds bloom in the end?

items.name: Dashing Grace
items.description: No setbacks or hardships can deter her. She will always chase her dreams with the same determined, fearless passion.

items.name: Emissary of Romance
items.description: A pink bowtie and ribbons around the tail! Whisper sweet words of romance and be the star of the ceremony.

items.name: Kitten Whimsy
items.description: A gift inspired by The Star-Struck Kitten, the interesting fairytale that sparked the love between the newly-weds.

items.name: Sea of Roses
items.description: Each rose, wet with dew, emits a rich aroma, as the wedding dress leaves a gentle kiss on it when the bell rings.

items.name: Fluttering Heart
items.description: Countless worries woke Nightwisp up from her respite. The girl's woeful wish stirred up waves in her heart.

items.name: Cocoon of Love
items.description: The girl buried her innocent feelings deep in her heart, hoping for the gods to watch over the one she loved.

items.name: Hazy Passion
items.description: Nightwisp saw shapes of souls and traveled dreams and reality to listen to every girl's unspoken love.

items.name: Endearing Murmur
items.description: 'May your love shine eternally like the moon and guide your path.' The moon cast its glow upon the girl's face.

items.name: Tranquil Repose
items.description: Nightwisp reached out, almost touching the tears on the girl's cheeks, but was afraid of waking her up.

items.name: Entwined Dreams
items.description: Dreams change like a kaleidoscope: from cities bustling like a never-ending movie to nature teeming with lives.

items.name: Heartfelt Prayer
items.description: Even if everyone faces the end alone, the memories that they share with those they love still shine true.

items.name: Spotless Heart
items.description: A stage manifested before the girl's eyes. The person she held dearly wished that she'd achieve her dream there.

items.name: Hazy Remembrance
items.description: The girl dreamed of a heartbreaking departure. A familiar figure moved farther away as she waved her hand.

items.name: Blazing Serpent Soars
items.description: Legends say the serpent, sacred to fire, soars where the deity descends, bringing fortune to the world.

items.name: Rites of Gilded Flame
items.description: At year-end rites, twelve brocade drums thundered as masked priests danced with bronze bells around the altar.

items.name: Crown of Grace
items.description: The high priestess danced alone atop the altar, each final step aligning perfectly with the Flame Wyvern star.

items.name: Chime of Grace
items.description: On the altar, a jade scepter gleamed as flames spiraled from the cauldron marked 'Serpent Fire Brings Eternal Light.'

items.name: Serpent in Firedance
items.description: Solemn priests poured wine at the divine tree's roots; flames burst forth like a spirit serpent leaving its lair.

items.name: Jade Sparks
items.description: Palace musicians struck bronze chimes in a flowing rhythm, echoing the Flame Wyvern deity's eternal power.

items.name: Torch of Order
items.description: A 100-foot bronze tree stood at the altar's center, hung with lamps and etched with the Flame Wyvern star chart.

items.name: Amber Omen
items.description: The sky cracked open, bleeding amber light. Lirain's charms spun wildly, sensing the storm long before the town did.

items.name: Featherlight Shade
items.description: Her father's parting gift swayed in the breeze, waiting—so afraid of rain. Lirain turned back, sprinting home.

items.name: Raining Bells
items.description: She rang the bell, ignored... Until the first winds shattered rooftops, sending the town fleeing underground.

items.name: Floodwalker
items.description: Rain-drenched linen, water rising past her ankles. She reaches for the severed string, the charms barely holding on.

items.name: Seaside Bloom
items.description: Lirain lived alone by the sea, as her father wandered the lands. The townsfolk, warm and kind, became her family.

items.name: Gentle Refuge
items.description: The storm passed, leaving the town unscathed, its guardian gone. The old oak vanished, and with it, Lirain.

items.name: Stormproof Joy
items.description: Father brought home two sun charms, their cotton smiles warmed by light. 'With these, you'll never fear the rain.'

items.name: Harbor Reunion
items.description: A ship docked at last—Lirain ran to the pier, where her father stood, weary yet smiling, the sun on his back.

items.name: Secret Medkit
items.description: Nurse Bubblin is unique, overlooking discarded pills and pretending not to see Elva sneaking by during night shifts.

items.name: Quiet Reverie
items.description: The next day, her friend was gone. Bubblin's sigh held regret: 'Elva's surgery came sooner than expected.'

items.name: Timeless Escape
items.description: Elva left behind notes like maps—true to her explorer's heart. Heeding them, Moony stood before the iron door.

items.name: Whispered Dreams
items.description: Cold lights flickered beyond the door. Elva smiled from the operation table, pure and serene, untouched by memory.

items.name: Scarless Fate
items.description: That empty smile haunted Moony. Elva had become a blank slate, wiped clean of everything they once shared.

items.name: Fading Ink
items.description: 'You won't be punished tonight. Go back.' The words were kind, but Moony only shook her head.

items.name: Bright Spark
items.description: Someone grabbed Moony's hand mid-sprint. Bubblin's eyes shone with worry as sweat dripped down her face.

items.name: Cure's Secret
items.description: Moony hid Elva's notes. Now, she had to escape too, before the surgery. There was no one left to trust but herself.

items.name: Blank Experiment
items.description: Bubblin hesitated, then smiled. A final touch on Moony's cheek, a quick swipe of a keycard—the door clicked open.

items.name: Love's Prescription
items.description: Night fell as Moony slipped through corridors. The hospital exit was within reach, but she was spotted.

items.name: Chaotic Pulse
items.description: The children loved Bubblin who listened. She soothed their worries, weaving their wildest dreams into stories.

items.name: Velvet Choice
items.description: One night, Elva burst in, breathless—'Run! This place isn't...' But hands grabbed her, cutting the warning short.

items.name: Clamorous Blaze
items.description: Her plumed crown ignites the night, sending the fire of freedom through the rejoicing city amidst all the noises.

items.name: Stellar Iridescence
items.description: The city celebrates the night with the heat of the sun. The stars shimmer in the sky with a golden, splendid luster.

items.name: Crescent Dazzle
items.description: Through a thin layer of clouds, the moon casts its light upon the girl, shimmering in the shape of a star orbit.

items.name: Feathery Phantom
items.description: As the tail feather brushes the masks, the night devours the shadow of her dance, turning the dark into a carnival.

items.name: Aurora Blossom
items.description: The flowers and leaves sway in the breeze at dawn, as if whispering the hopes and expectations of spring.

items.name: Youthful Secret
items.description: A pair of earrings shaped like tiny locks recalls a chest of youthful diaries, a must-have for vintage style lovers.

items.name: Dewy Fragrance
items.description: Alina believed Grandma's story and scattered petals in the lake. The ripples seemed like the fairy's whisper.

items.name: Flowery Shades
items.description: At 16, Alina left to study in City Oren. In dreams, she'd see the flowers and ripples that she missed dearly.

items.name: Redolent Glow
items.description: A glowing blue bloom turned into shimmering sparks the moment she touched the water, weaving an ethereal dream.

items.name: Amidst Blooms
items.description: She returned years later to the same blooms and lake. Only Grandma's voice was nowhere to be heard.

items.name: Reverie of Wings
items.description: In the bleak palace, the girl covered in dirt and scars moved closer, her eyes set on the broken sword by the throne.

items.name: Timeless Pledge
items.description: The young Inara loved the garden of astral roses, where her mother would gently tell her stories of the stars.

items.name: Arbitrary Throne
items.description: The kingdom turned into ruins with people imprisoned in fear, but none caved in and betrayed the princess.

items.name: Crown of Sword
items.description: The demon had eyes in the shadows, searching for the royals. She dodged them, her hand gripping the dim thorny sword.

items.name: Soundless Grace
items.description: The sword beamed as it pierced the palm, turning the demon's eyes into dust. 'I hereby summon the morning star!'

items.name: Swirl of Blooms
items.description: The thorny sword with astral roses glowed in her hand, while butterflies flitted about in starry twinkles.

items.name: Midnight Starbeam
items.description: Illuminating the dusty ruins, thorny vines sprouted from Inara's wounds, merging with the thorns on the sword.

items.name: Twinkling Murmur
items.description: I'm willing... to sacrifice all for my people. Inara whispered, a heart pounding with endless passion and power.

items.name: Trial of Thorns
items.description: 'To summon the morning star, you must pay the price. Are you willing to forever suffer such pain?' a voice asked.

items.name: Cuddle Mate
items.description: A cat-paw mic glowed. Her voice filled the stream. Cheers flickered onscreen—her fans' love never faded.

items.name: Particle Burst
items.description: More than a livestream—it's a harbor of warmth. Fleeting joy, yet heartwarming moments linger forever.

items.name: Virtual Cube
items.description: Golden pixels build a dazzling virtual world. Every 'Little Fish' brings joy to the fans who stand by them.

items.name: Prism Flash
items.description: Orange, blue, purple lights dance to the beat. Comments leap like musical notes—audiences' heartfelt cheers.

items.name: Glitz Wish
items.description: Day two brings a famed singer—voice like crystal springs. Requests flood in as tender melodies carry the night.

items.name: Meow Pulse
items.description: Games she loved feel fresh in Little Fish's hands. Late at night, she shares the thrill and joy with the stream.

items.name: Chroma Patch
items.description: She savors 'Little Fish's' voice—sometimes bright, sometimes soft—smiling at each warm fan interaction.

items.name: Sugar Oath
items.description: A new stream begins. She waits as tonight's shy “Little Fish” prepares to solve a cube on screen.

items.name: GameCharm
items.description: In the “Little Fish” stream, even classes come alive. Professors join in, learning turns fun and engaging.

items.name: Meowtel Receiver
items.description: As she conquers the final challenge, cheers flood the screen—a shared dream chased, a breath released.

items.name: Glitch Quest
items.description: 4x4, 5x5, one-handed, blindfolded—each harder than the last. Tension builds as viewers cheer her on with hope.

items.name: Code Pop
items.description: Once a star dancer, now standing after surgery—can she reclaim the rhythm of her soul?

items.name: Neon Mirage
items.description: 'Little Fish's' stream—now a kaleidoscope of warmth. Watching others bloom, her own spark quietly reignites.

items.name: Meow Charge
items.description: Each stream inspires fans. Magicians debut new tricks, and photographers share tips—all through “Little Fish.”

items.name: Starlight Index
items.description: 'For races abroad,' she whispers—click, click, click—a cube conquered between hope and fear.

items.name: Byte Bloom
items.description: She signs up as the next “Little Fish” and, while waiting to stream, repeats the dance she once knew by heart.

items.name: Best Cheer Squad
items.description: One photo captured Nikki's adorable smile, another had great composition. Choosing was difficult for Momo!

items.name: Best Friend Forever
items.description: I always introduce myself solemnly, 'I'm Momo, Nikki's best friend, and I'll accompany her anywhere.'

items.name: Future Daydreams
items.description: Nikki and I talked again about the legendary kingdom of grilled fish. I believe we'll find it one day!

items.name: Leisurely Moments
items.description: I was close to reading the words at the top... Wow, I'm as tall as the sign! Nikki always knows what I need.

items.name: Vivid Chic
items.description: Every bow was specially designed and adjusted repeatedly. Of course, I provided careful guidance!

items.name: Meowgical Clip
items.description: Nikki thinks the hairclip is as cute as me... Denied! Its cuteness is a hundred grilled fish behind mine!

items.name: Sweet and Cool Vibe
items.description: At the last second, Nikki put on this special necklace. I certify it completes today's outfit.

items.name: Colorful Memories
items.description: Journeys have surprises, but with Nikki's experience and my cleverness, we can handle anything.

items.name: Celestial Melody
items.description: After that, Lainie often slipped into the sanctuary unseen. Her life was hunger and cold, no hymns or sacred songs.

items.name: Vow in Bloom
items.description: Outside the halls, nobles squandered while slum children survived by stealing. Lainie spoke of it without sorrow.

items.name: Crown of Seasons
items.description: The sanctuary wept in prayer, yet never reached out. For the first time, Isua doubted its flawless light.

items.name: Tear of Ephemera
items.description: With Lainie's help, Isua secretly gave food to poor children. She even asked to fund shelters with sanctuary gold.

items.name: Earnest Blessing
items.description: The sacred halls watched their heir in silence. Soon, Isua's freedom was gone, and contact with Lainie was forbidden.

items.name: Radiant Crown
items.description: The sanctuary grew into a burden on the land. Wealth poured in. King and beggar alike bowed beneath its shadow.

items.name: Sacred Benediction
items.description: Years later, she was crowned anew. She knew pain still lived in the world—but vowed to protect those close to her.

items.name: Elegy for the Lost
items.description: She left there at last. What she saw was fire and ash—her homeland now torn by the enemy's war—so she acted.

items.name: Arcane Pact
items.description: Meluthiel's power drove the invaders back. In the cheering crowd, she saw Vanessa again—now a brilliant commander.

items.name: Veil of Dusky Mist
items.description: How long had it been? When young Vanessa arrived, time rushed in—and the blooming garden withered.

items.name: Lustrous Stream
items.description: Furious, Meluthiel confronted her. Vanessa must restore every flower before she'd be allowed to leave.

items.name: Heartlight for the Lost
items.description: So much time had passed. Meluthiel hadn’t even apologized. What had happened since she came here?

items.name: Forsaken Lament
items.description: The girl kept her promise and sailed away. The flowers bloomed, but Meluthiel felt no joy this time.

items.name: Shackles of the Shade
items.description: Go… just go. Meluthiel thought. Go see the world as it is now—see what still remains, or has been lost.

items.name: Frost Lotus
items.description: In fall, Lynn gifted crème brûlée; in spring, Linsy returned a frost lotus. White graced Lynn's garden.

items.name: Newborn Star
items.description: The two grew close, always seen together. As the design contest neared, Lynn's sketches shone like a rising star.

items.name: Faded Echoes
items.description: In the ruins, only one frost lotus remained. Linsy designed a white gown with a full-bloom frost lotus at its heart.

items.name: Bloom in Ruins
items.description: A jealous rival set the fire—designs were burned, and Lynn lost her sight for the colors she once mastered.

items.name: Tender Hope
items.description: Onstage, she exposed the culprit and shared her vision: Flowers will still bloom even in a world washed of color.

items.name: Mystic Pact
items.description: When the last rose finally bloomed, Vanessa asked Meluthiel to keep her promise—but another test awaited.

items.name: Lanternlit Path
items.description: A boat made of aged cedar, sealed with amber oil, bore a lantern to light her way beyond the mists.

items.name: Vessel of Fate
items.description: 'Vanessa, many paths lead to the garden, but only a boat built by your hands can carry you beyond the mist.'

items.name: Farewell in Bloom
items.description: Vanessa labored tirelessly. When the boat touched water, silent ripples spread—she prayed time was not too late.

items.name: Oaths Beyond Measure
items.description: The garden withered at the touch of an outsider; the witch said: 'When the last bloom returns, you may leave.'

items.name: Thorns Bloom Bright
items.description: Vanessa soon found the witch not as feared; in the scent of tea, Meluthiel began to linger more and more.

items.name: Crimson Amber
items.description: The witch indulged Vanessa's curiosity, teaching her spells like turning roses to gems, treating her like a pupil.

items.name: Edge Over Heart
items.description: The garden revived, but a storm clouded Vanessa's heart; war still looms, haunting her sleepless nights.

items.name: Echoes of Chimes
items.description: That night, the moon stayed silent as time began to flow; the witch stood watching while Vanessa sailed away.

items.name: Splendid Glimmer
items.description: Colors are never confined to clothes. They can be a rain of lights, dyeing the sky hues of splendor.

items.name: Radiant Starlight
items.description: Like a comet, the girl lives to be the brightest version of herself, her existence a manifesto of confidence.

items.name: Wayward Cadence
items.description: She believes in one thing in life: fear no judgment and do whatever you want. Nothing changes her decision.

items.name: Colorful Decoration
items.description: Passionate dancing gives life to wild imagination. Even the colors on the streets seem to be dancing to the beats.

items.name: Nautical Memory
items.description: She fell asleep on the showcase and woke up to see an old photo in the logbook showing familiar faces.

items.name: Oceanic Whisper
items.description: She thought it was a dream until she found a conch in her palm, fine salt falling from its hard shell at her touch.

items.name: Redolent Impression
items.description: Pies made of fruits and edible flowers are the most popular, sold out as soon as they hit the shelves.

items.name: Basket of Wishes
items.description: Food carries the best wishes of its makers. Its purpose is to bring people happiness and satisfaction.

items.name: Crusty Moment
items.description: Take one bite of the shiny, fragrant crust—the taste reminds one of a wheatfield rolling in the golden sunshine.

items.name: Elegant Lotus
items.description: Lights ripple on her skirt; lotus blooms surround the boat. For a moment, the girl feels she is in an immortal realm.

items.name: Melody of Dusk
items.description: It should be time to return, yet she lingers. The misty landscape unfolds before her, too beautiful to leave behind.

items.name: Misty Rainfall
items.description: Mountain weather shifts fast. Blue skies suddenly turn gray. Before she reacts, raindrops fall onto her bamboo hat.

items.name: Blossoms of Jade
items.description: Rain drapes the boat like soft silk. Everything turns misty. Through layers of lotus, she continues her journey.

items.name: Ripples of Heart
items.description: Raindrops strike the pond. Frightened fish flee to the depths, leaving lotus blossoms swaying in slanted rain.

items.name: Lotus Flower Jade
items.description: Lotus leaves blend with distant hills. Petals blur in the rain, tinting even the raindrops pink.

items.name: Tender Moment
items.description: The girls share a smile. Capri sits by the window, feeling the warmth as her fatigue slowly fades.

items.name: Sweet Aroma
items.description: Rian brings a white peach oolong milk tea. Soft foam floats pink peaches, releasing gentle tea and fruit scents.

items.name: Sweet Sip
items.description: This is her favorite winter drink. One sip spreads sweetness in her mouth, sparking endless bright ideas.

items.name: Tender Moment - Coffee
items.description: 'Your bow reminds me of coffee foam. Did you design it?' 'Yes! I love making all kinds of bows!'

items.name: Sweet Aroma - Coffee
items.description: Simple, familiar design can be grasped quickly, giving winter outfits a soft, airy charm.

items.name: Sweet Sip - Coffee
items.description: Capri takes a sip, surprised by its taste. Praise flows, and her new friend blushes at her delight.

items.name: Tender Moment - Cheese
items.description: On competition day, Capri walks confidently on stage, showing a sweet winter outfit inspired by Rian's drinks.

items.name: Sweet Aroma - Cheese
items.description: Capri shares her design concept, describing how Rian's drinks brightened her long, valuable school days.

items.name: Sweet Sip - Cheese
items.description: They may part in the future, but shared drinks and ideas warm their hearts like a winter hearth.

items.name: Heartbeat Transmission
items.description: She wanders through endless space. 'Maybe one day I can do this in real life,' she thinks, pressing the warp button.

items.name: Morning Routine
items.description: 'Ahem, let's see what's in the papers today.' 'Momo, why are you doing an impression of Dad?'

items.name: Leisure of Fishing
items.description: She once went fishing with her father, who laughed and wiped her face dry when the fish splattered her with water.

items.name: Natural Whimsy
items.description: She found a set of old fish toys and was surprised when her father remembered all the names she gave them.

items.name: Gravity of Heart
items.description: She stepped beyond the system, slipping free from its intricate web. She became a fragment of 'scattered data.'

items.name: Secret Mark
items.description: Such a state could never last long. The austere girl darted through narrow passages to an unremarkable door.

items.name: Circuit of Light
items.description: Heimdal passed rows of virtual screens to the center. Others looked up from their work, greeting her knowingly.

items.name: Enigmatic Field
items.description: The heavy door sealed. Heimdal unclasped her wristband and tossed it into a chest of discarded restraints.

items.name: Gravity of Heart - Silence
items.description: 'That sweet little pink-haired girl? Ah… I regret not meeting her sooner. Perhaps I should invite her here myself.'

items.name: Secret Mark - Silence
items.description: Heimdal said nothing, knowing it was only Xuni's jest. Arms crossed, she stared at the numbers on the screen.

items.name: Circuit of Light - Silence
items.description: Tapping her arm, Heimdal mapped a new plan, believing innovation and opportunity would come from her mind.

items.name: Enigmatic Field - Silence
items.description: Numbers raced acrouss the screen, finally settling on a figure. Yet it was still insufficient to free the land.

items.name: True Companions
items.description: With her dearest friend, the girl was never alone. They gathered radiant gems together, grinding them into pigments.

items.name: Warm Memories
items.description: A gentle breeze swept across the field. Fresh shoots sprouted. The girl dabbed her canvas with lively green hues.

items.name: Where Sea Meets Sky
items.description: Waves delivered a conch to the shore, echoing tales of mermaids and birds, and love that spanned ocean and sky.

items.name: Fragrant Sketch
items.description: As she painted the waterfall, the glittering spray and drifting mist stirred her memories of wandering in the forest.

items.name: Phantom Blossoms
items.description: Flowers stretched along the city's edge. Familiar figures flickered. Were they illusions, or echoes of longing?

items.name: Magic of Color
items.description: The sun poured molten gold upon the sky. With bold strokes of fiery orange and red, she painted its dazzling glow.

items.name: Lines of Frost
items.description: The wind carried a song of freedom, snow gleaming in cold light. She traced winter's patterns with silver strokes.

items.name: Brush of Dreams
items.description: The palette still bore wet paint. She dipped her brush in vivid hues, filling the canvas with joy and emotion.

items.name: Neon Nocturne
items.description: The lights shimmered like a dream. Emboldened, her strokes grew freer, blending neon brilliance with the night sky.

items.name: Wings of Dreams
items.description: The journey was not yet over. Every unfinished curve and line became the most beautiful mark of eternity.

items.name: Glazed Wonder
items.description: She painted her dreams, dipping brush into the most brilliant colors and leaving memories that never fade.

items.name: Radiant Wings
items.description: No shadow could dim her vision. With passion in her heart, she would paint a new world with every stroke.

items.name: Messenger in Green
items.description: The green bird led him through the mist to a vast bamboo grove. The swaying leaves whispered like voices in the dark.

items.name: Emerald Veil
items.description: The scholar lost his way in the fog. Just as he faltered, a bird broke through the haze and perched on his shoulder.

items.name: Moss-Covered Stone
items.description: A maiden in green appeared. She seemed both a shadow of light and a slender stalk of bamboo come to life.

items.name: Fragrance of Nature
items.description: They brewed tea by the spring. The scholar came to record world's tales. The maiden smiled, telling her own story.

items.name: Bitter Moon
items.description: 100 years ago, a white-robed gentleman visited here. As he spoke of his dreams, the maiden was captivated.

items.name: Frosted Orchids
items.description: The gentleman was soon to leave for an official post, saying it was a perfect time for great minds to shine.

items.name: Butterfly Under Moon
items.description: Hearing this, the scholar sighed, sympathy for the gentleman's fate and his unfulfilled promise to the maiden.

items.name: Gathering Clouds
items.description: He never returned. When she finally cultivated and left the grove, he had long died in prison, undone by intrigues.

items.name: Stillness of Night
items.description: Nourished by the bamboo grove, the maiden could never leave. The gentleman promised to return once he was settled.

items.name: Shifting Lights
items.description: The scholar left in thought, recording all he saw. As he set down his brush, he seemed to hear bamboo rustle again.

items.name: Birdsong Reverie
items.description: The girl hummed a Lilith ballad, pacing gracefully. Her melodious song echoed with the cheerful chirping of birds.

items.name: Feathered Horizon
items.description: 'Would this be too deliberate?' Bobo shook her head, the wheat swaying beside her. Birdsong sparked inspiration.

items.name: Hazy Cloudshadow
items.description: A girl-shaped cloud passed. As its shadow passed, Bobo worried again: 'What if she doesn't even notice me...?'

items.name: Golden Field Sky
items.description: 'Hello! I think I lost my hairpin. Could you help me out?' Bobo rehearsed her opening line to the cloud.

items.name: Tranquil Verse
items.description: Her singing softened into a murmur. She stopped, gazing at the distant horizon, thoughts colliding freely.

items.name: Pearl of Clarity
items.description: Pretend to mistake her for someone else? Invite her to the fountain or the bar? All sounded strange!

items.name: Emerald Gleam
items.description: 'If only there wasn't a mission,' she sighed. Bobo loved the Wheat Field. She loved everything about this place.

items.name: Clear Pool Ripples
items.description: Bobo's thoughts drifted. She couldn't focus on her task, nor could she fully immerse herself in the scenery.

items.name: Journey Through Time
items.description: Her vision blurred, then refocused on striking pink. At the end of the path, a pink-haired girl entered her world.

items.name: Timeless Ode
items.description: Sky and fields composed the backdrop of the meeting. A bird flew by, marking the beginning of their story.

items.name: Phoenix's Call
items.description: 'Everyone, please hear me out.' Lunar was gentle yet resolute. 'If we retreat, what becomes of the citizens?'

items.name: Clinking Jade
items.description: Trap or opportunity? Debate raged. Lunar remained silent. The letter in her hand felt as heavy as a thousand weights.

items.name: Afterglow Radiance
items.description: 'What of the Cloud Empire? How shall we withstand the northern cavalry? How can we surrender our homeland?'

items.name: Celestial Wings
items.description: Lunar touched the Nebula Dual sword, recalling Princess Miror repelling the enemy under the sky ablaze with rainbows.

items.name: Pearl-Bearing Feather
items.description: The Cloud City buzzed with activity again. Silk mills operated at full capacity, producing uniforms for the soldiers.

items.name: Gilded Radiance
items.description: Lunar declared, 'From today, every resource of my family will be devoted to the battle until the enemy is defeated.'

items.name: Pearl Splendor
items.description: Guided by stylists, soldiers launched relentless assaults against the League Tyr for a chance at survival.

items.name: Luminous Pearl
items.description: In a moment of advantage, the former Lilith Prime Minister, for reasons unknown, invited Lunar to a duel.

items.name: Heavenly Strings
items.description: 'I vowed to become the greatest designer, to end the war…' Lunar murmured to the wind.

items.name: Emerald Cape
items.description: At dusk, stylists regrouped in silence. By now, the city was cut off from food and water, hanging by a thread.

items.name: Golden Ornaments
items.description: Lunar once again led the soldiers into battle, but couldn't break Tyr's defenses and were forced to retreat.

items.name: Gemlike Splendor
items.description: She looked around at the exhausted faces. Ignoring the mayor's protests, she accepted the challenge.

items.name: Crimson Glow
items.description: This was a protracted war. Silk and dye rapidly depleted inside; Northern reinforcements continued to arrive.

items.name: Jade Chimes
items.description: The looming clouds finally broke into a torrential rain. Swords in hand, Lunar ascended toward the shadow of fate.

items.name: Iridescent Crystal
items.description: Yvette was the last to leave the office. She turned off the lights and stepped into the dim stairwell.

items.name: Journey's Treasure
items.description: Crouching by the wall, Yvette muffled her sobs. The crushing pressure and relentless workload nearly suffocated her.

items.name: Phantasia Lumina
items.description: A shadow appeared, offering a bunny cookie. Yvette looked up. It was the Prime Minister, always so gentle to her.

items.name: Traces of Emotion
items.description: 'Not sure who left it on my desk. I just brought it along,' Nidhogg said calmly, his voice as steady as a mountain.

items.name: Lingering Affection
items.description: Yvette ate the cookie, its sweetness melting on her lips and easing the gloom in her heart.

items.name: Carefree Nocturne
items.description: The Tea Party opened at last, with young designers shining on stage and their works drawing eyes across Miraland.

items.name: Fragrant Whispers
items.description: Thanks to Yvette's efforts, another designer who had once declined finally agreed to attend.

items.name: Ripples of Time
items.description: This morning's rain left tiny pools under the rosebushes, and drifting petals rippled across them.

items.name: Enchanted Tea Party
items.description: The round table held delicate treats, tea fragrance filling the garden. At Ace's arrival, all rose to greet her.

items.name: Whispering Blooms
items.description: The conversation flowed: hair ornaments in Oren, boat rides on the Renner, and a visit to the Cecily Art Museum.

items.name: Courtyard Fragrance
items.description: A gentle breeze carried perfume over the gowns as the girls whispered, cheeks bright with joy.

items.name: Hymn of Blossoms
items.description: A noble girl, acquainted with Ace, sat beside her and murmured, 'You finally came… I thought you wouldn't.'

items.name: Dreamtide Reverie
items.description: The head maid glanced from a faint carpet mark, adjusting Ace's attire. 'Princess, please avoid anything dangerous.'

items.name: Whispered Trust
items.description: Amid the music, Ace held her friend's hand. 'It's just a small disagreement with my sister, not the rumors.'

items.name: Fragrant Hours
items.description: Travels always bring fresh wonders. Soon, all were caught up in Ace's lively tales, laughing and gasping.

items.name: Laughter of Days Past
items.description: 'But I can't shake this… You're too calm. Why just smile? Hey, Ace, don't do anything reckless…'

items.name: Tender Glance
items.description: 'That's good… Some even said the Queen would throw you into the River Varna!' Ace laughed at her friend's relief.

items.name: Melodies in Bloom
items.description: The band played a familiar tune, the same Ace and Elle once played as children, stirring memories.

items.name: Dreamborne Drift
items.description: She hid the arrowhead in her sleeve and glanced at the card: 'An adventure awaits tonight. Be prepared.'

items.name: Feather Whisper
items.description: On the woodland path, sunlight scattered through leaves. Strangers passed Iset, their chatter fading into the breeze.

items.name: Blooming Hues
items.description: 'Here, sister. Fresh flowers I just picked for you!' A voice rang by her ear, as warm and gentle as a spring morning.

items.name: Bell of Blessing
items.description: The wind brushed Iset's hair, carrying the answer: the pink-haired girl was safe, chasing her dream steadily.

items.name: Gem on Feather
items.description: When Iset regained her composure, she found herself holding a flower. But the girl had gone before she could respond.

items.name: Petals in Dew
items.description: The soft bloom brushed Iset's hand, its petals flowing beneath the sunlight. It reminded her of that girl.

items.name: Feather Whisper - Flame
items.description: 'Several priestesses have replied with assent. The rite will be held soon.' Dalia brought the good news to Iset.

items.name: Blooming Hues - Flame
items.description: A sigh misted into the cold air, veiling the merriment. Iset could sense the weighing on the young man before her.

items.name: Bell of Blessing - Flame
items.description: Yet opportunity often arrives with upheaval. What path lies ahead? Iset looked back the way she had come.

items.name: Gem on Feather - Flame
items.description: The celebration reached its peak. People danced to honor the bounty of nature and the splendor of life.

items.name: Petals in Dew - Flame
items.description: 'Many changes have come... I must thank you and that girl. Because of you, our tribe did not miss this chance.'

items.name: Frostbound Echo
items.description: The Imperial Army and League Tyr cannot rely on the stalemate. Time for planning slips away fast.

items.name: Resolute Valor
items.description: They walked through narrow alleys to a tavern door. Agata pushed it open: 'Perhaps someone here can lend us aid.'

items.name: Frostbound Echo - Triumph
items.description: Fafnir set down his glass, shrugging with indifference. 'Friend among the Iron Rose? I hardly think so.'

items.name: Resolute Valor - Triumph
items.description: The wind screamed through the narrow alley. Louie left the tavern, setting out on a new journey.

items.name: Tranquil Pastures
items.description: Snow slipped from the base. A hollyfinch trembled beneath it—spring's herald, now weak from the endless freeze.

items.name: Joyful Whimsy
items.description: She removed her scarf, gently wrapping the bird, warming it with her own body heat. Then came a quiet, muffled sob.

items.name: Petals in White
items.description: She stepped to the windmill's core and spotted a golden blur—trapped between icicles, a thumb-sized glowing sprite.

items.name: Quiet Muse
items.description: She passed out from the cold. The freed sprite spread its wings, unleashing magic. Ice melted. The windmill turned.

items.name: Fields Aflutter
items.description: In the spinning light, the girl saw her grandfather's image merging with the windmill.

items.name: Sunlit Verses
items.description: The sprite's wings were stuck between icy gears. Afraid to hurt it, the girl used her warmth to melt the ice again.

items.name: Full Bloom Charm
items.description: 'No storm is too fierce, no cold too cruel. Spring always blooms for a kind heart,' her grandfather's voice echoed.

items.name: Woven Wings
items.description: The hollyfinch puffed its chest and sang a song. The sprite summoned warmth. The girl's body stirred to life.

items.name: Reedleaf Vintage
items.description: Days passed——green turned to gold, then snow. She kept losing, but her blade grew from three moves to thirty.

items.name: Stormwoven Reed Hat
items.description: In the clash of blades, she began to read his moves. Each parry now held a hint of guidance in its sharp reply.

items.name: Cirrus Sword
items.description: Years flew by. After training, Moyun was ready. Before she left, her master gave her a sword—its name: Yunxiao.

items.name: Bamboo Bind
items.description: From then on, she trained with her sect—dawn to dusk, blade to moon. Under her master's care, her skill soared.

items.name: Verdant Veil
items.description: One rainy spring, Moyun finally struck the branch down. Surprise flickered in his eyes—then turned to pride.

items.name: Leafbound Dream
items.description: The swordsman laughed and left; Moyun followed. Warm wine waited—they drank, the cold outside forgotten.

items.name: Verdant Oath
items.description: 'Face it tomorrow?' The rain split with steel as the swordsman drew his blade. 'Gladly, Master,' Moyun replied.

items.name: Bladewash Ale
items.description: Ten years, one sword. Moyun roamed far, found beauty, made friends, and upheld justice across the martial world.

items.name: Windbound Journey
items.description: The winds carried lost travelers toward the unknown. Faint tribal chants reached her from afar.

items.name: Desolate Glow
items.description: This secluded tribe moved with the changing seasons. Here, Lant gradually let go of the worries she carried.

items.name: Afterglow of Day
items.description: The dusk was the gentlest moment. The sun sank beyond the horizon, and the curling smoke blurred with the wind.

items.name: Moment Captured
items.description: A bird streaked across the sky; moving sand and light intertwined. Lant pressed the shutter, catching the moment.

items.name: Faded Trace
items.description: Wind-eroded cliffs bore the marks of time. Rock carvings had long faded, like the growth rings of this land.

items.name: Best Companion
items.description: Seeing a chest of untouched fabrics, everyone exchanged looks and pulled out their prepared design sketches.

items.name: Flicking Ears
items.description: Each style seemed worth trying, but for the journey ahead, a cloak was the most fitting choice.

items.name: Fairy Tale of Time
items.description: Thus, Momo's new outfit was born! A yellow cloak like the old one, but looser, adjustable, and more comfortable.

items.name: Fluffy Tail
items.description: 'Since we're at it, let's make one for Nikki too!' Thus, Nikki got her own adorable loungewear.

items.name: Falling Feathers
