items.description: An unknown tune echoed beneath the dome. At the stage appeared not the rumored ghost, but a beautiful black swan.

items.name: Nocturne of Night
items.description: At the stroke of midnight, the rotted curtain suddenly opened. A music box began to turn on its own.

items.name: Whispered Notes
items.description: The swan spread its wings and danced with the music. Hidden among seats, the children watched wide-eyed.

items.name: Gleam of Moonlight
items.description: The swan suddenly dove at the intruders. Yet in that instant, the children saw only a pair of tearful eyes.

items.name: Thorns of Wings
items.description: The white tutu was consumed by nightmares. The troupe vanished, leaving behind only whispers of wraiths and curses.

items.name: Curtain's Fall
items.description: The children had heard countless frightening tales, yet the so-called wraith didn't attack them.

items.name: Ballad of Chains
items.description: The girl stunned the world, yet became a tool for profit. She danced day after day, but could never escape.

items.name: Fluttering Expectations
items.description: On the grass, a girl clutched chalk, doodling on a small board. Momo clapped: 'Nikki, that's lovely!'

items.name: Moment of Wishes
items.description: The girl smiled, lifting her design sketch with care. 'Here, it's for you! Carry it with you on your journey ahead!'

items.name: Fragrant Whispers
items.description: The doors of memory opened once again. Nikki bid farewell to her past, moving with the scent of grass and breeze.

items.name: Blossoms Aglow
items.description: Memories shimmered in her eyes. Nikki nodded firmly: 'Mm… I may not have succeeded yet, but I've never given up!'

items.name: Dawnlit Melody
items.description: 'Eh? Who are you…?' The younger Nikki tilted her head, puzzled. 'You look just like me—are you me, all grown up?'

items.name: Verses in Bloom
items.description: The child brimmed with joy, peppering questions, 'Where will we go? Will we really wear such beautiful gowns?'

items.name: Crystal Rose
items.description: 'In the journeys ahead, we'll wear splendid dresses and meet many wonderful friends like Momo, cheering for us.'

items.name: Rose Reverie
items.description: Nikki opened her eyes. Momo snoozed at her side as fields sped past the window. Her journey was still unfolding.

items.name: Unreal Domain
items.description: This prism is special. Through it, she sees the other side of ocean with flowers, birds, sunshine. Another world.

items.name: Stardust Sands
items.description: Layla had only seen the Desolate Island, where stars accompanied her, gentle, yet unreachable.

items.name: Crumbling Illusions
items.description: She saw girls in the prism, just as lonely and lost as herself. Without the power of witches, what will they do?

items.name: Prism Realm
items.description: But every girl seemed to hold her own small magic, unworn by mundane routines and each shinning like a star.

items.name: Mirage Lock
items.description: One day, a girl wrote words that appeared distorted in the prism. Layla finally deciphered: 'Break the prism.'

items.name: Reflected Shadows
items.description: More girls used twigs, brushes, and stones to form the words again and again. Silent, yet their message spoke loudly.

items.name: Crystalized Years
items.description: When she opened her eyes again, she was no longer on the island. Beside her was dew-kissed flowers in sunlight.

items.name: Emerald Isles
items.description: After seeing the other side, island life felt unbearably lonely. The images in the prism blurred with her tears.

items.name: Divine Decree
items.description: Billions of stars hang high, chanting like waves. Break the prism. Break it. But fear crawled through Layla's heart.

items.name: Creation at Fingertips
items.description: Layla finally decided to break the prism. The glass shattered like a fading dream and she fell into a deep sleep.

items.name: Labyrinth of Night
items.description: Layla only had stars for company. The prism was her link to another world. Once broken, she'd be alone again.

items.name: Reflection in the Box
items.description: 'You gave me courage,' Layla thanked them. 'Us?' The girls exchanged looks, 'We haven't done anything.'

items.name: Sunny Voyage
items.description: The energy of dice runs out. The plane lands at the forest edge, where there's a sad bear holding a wilting flower.

items.name: Booming Starcloud
items.description: A waterfall blocks them. Bunny rolls the dice. Engines roar as Rosy bursts through the water, laughing all the way.

items.name: Adventurous Checkers
items.description: Rosy boards the plane with excitement. It takes off trailing streams of rainbow colors. A new adventure begins.

items.name: Bunny Bubbles
items.description: Rolling the dice, Rosy flies far once again. On her voyages, she hears tales from camels and sings with whales.

items.name: Innocent Blooms
items.description: Water collected from the waterfall revives the flower. The bear dances joyfully and gives Rosy his treasured dice.

items.name: Colorful Brushes
items.description: 'I don't want to say goodbye, but it's time to end the game,' Bunny smiles. 'When you wake up, come and find us!'

items.name: Cloudy Lullaby
items.description: The plane lands near a cliffside castle, where an old owl serves tea, inviting Rosy and Bunny to rest in the garden.

items.name: Bubble Blaster
items.description: Time passes, and Rosy grows up, yet her childhood dreams linger. One day, she notices a call for events at the park.

items.name: Blazing Radiance
items.description: 'Must we surrender to League Tyr?' A young stylist asked tentatively after silence.

items.name: Lumen Unspoken
items.description: From that day on, something changed in Elena. She still sat on the rocks, gazing far into the ocean's deep blue.

items.name: Flicker in Dusk
items.description: People started avoiding her. No one spoke of it, but fear crept in—a nameless, instinctive unease.

items.name: Gaze Beyond Time
items.description: Since then, no tide ever threatened the village again. Peace returned, and the girl on the reef faded from memory.

items.name: Dirge of the Deep
items.description: One night, Elena heard the call again. She left with the stone and the book, vanishing into the sea mist.

items.name: Eyes of Divinity
items.description: When they looked at her in the sea wind, she seemed like someone else. Her eyes were like the dark, endless ocean.

items.name: Coffer of the Void
items.description: The stone on the book began to glow. Startled awake, Elena touched it—and heard an ancient voice in the void.

items.name: Starwave Sail
items.description: She took out her easel and brushes, carefully marking reefs, currents, and islands, creating her first sea map.

items.name: Luminous Butterfly
items.description: Returning to town, she recounted her adventures. Townsfolk gathered around, fascinated by the unknown ocean.

items.name: Mystic Scroll
items.description: The exquisite map hung in the council hall. Seeds of exploration sprouted as adventurers set sail again.

items.name: Abyssal Navigator
items.description: A butterfly appeared in her dream again, flying toward distant seas, just as she faced unknown challenges.

items.name: Whimsy Wings
items.description: As the map improved, more ships departed. Explorers and traders thrived, and the once-quiet town prospered anew.

items.name: Final Stroke
items.description: All admired her courage yet worried for her. She untied the ropes, raised the sail, and waved to those who cared.

items.name: Gleaming Verse
items.description: The butterfly still danced in her dream. Her gaze fell on the reef-strewn seas that were still uncharted on her map.

items.name: Azure Startrail
items.description: Her voyages were sung by bards, and townsfolk praised her courage and daring on the open sea.

items.name: Fading Haze
items.description: Someone claimed to have found a special bird from Qingqiu, but it turned out to be a normal dove in disguise.

items.name: Azure Sea Whisper
items.description: Distant sails appear faintly in sparkling waves. Watching the horizon while sitting under the parasol is pure joy.

items.name: Cloud Iridescence
items.description: At dusk, beams of light peek through clouds in soft golden hues, like a cup of honey-orange iced tea.

items.name: Icy Orange Juice
items.description: Tangy-sweet orange and ice are always the best match. A hint of mint adds even more cool freshness.

items.name: Magical Garden
items.description: Camille's garden flourishes under her care, green and bountiful. Everyone loves to come here to pick their produce.

items.name: Veggie Hairpin
items.description: One day, a weary traveler arrives at the garden, drawn by its lush crops, and asks to rest for a while.

items.name: Fragrant Bloom
items.description: Camille welcomes him and offers some fruit to refresh him. In return, he gives her a bag of seeds before leaving.

items.name: Colorful Fruits
items.description: 'No one has been able to grow these before. Perhaps you, skilled gardener, can make them bloom,' he says.

items.name: Skilled Handplant
items.description: The birds chirp, 'Give up! Give up! Don't waste your time!' But she shakes her head and tends to the seeds with care.

items.name: Basket of Fresh Delights
items.description: By next spring, the seeds finally sprout, sending long vines up the fence and bearing clusters of unripe tomatoes.

items.name: Whimsical Kettle
items.description: The fruits grow bigger than pumpkins, glowing red and hanging proudly. 'The biggest tomatoes ever!' people marvel.

items.name: Sweet Dream
items.description: Maybe it could grant wishes. But Bebena felt it shouldn't be trapped in a glass tank for that.

items.name: Summer Girl
items.description: As nets came out to catch the stranded Dreamfish, Bebena stood, pulled off her shades, and said: 'Beat me first!'

items.name: Dewdrop Charm
items.description: The crowd stared at the girl in shock—someone gasped, 'It's Bebena, that trending stylist everyone's talking about!'

items.name: Color Clash
items.description: The tale of the Dreamfish was hard to resist—just a legend, perhaps, but some still believed it might bring luck.

items.name: Starfish Murmurs
items.description: Bebena gently lifted the Dreamfish, settled on her flamingo float, and drifted as it slipped into the sea.

items.name: Swift Flash
items.description: When she bought the convertible, Abby chose this bold color——each mile toward freedom rekindling her joy.

items.name: Coconut Breeze
items.description: At sunset, Abby stops, barefoot on the shore, savoring the sea breeze and sweet, cool coconut air.

items.name: Summer Bliss
items.description: Leaving the shore, Abby met a painter—vibrant hues on canvas, her heart unfurling like a bloom.

items.name: Sharp Vision
items.description: By the fire, music lit Abby's heart. She danced with the band, then slept beneath a sky full of stars.

items.name: Nature Muse
items.description: Art answers the heart and nature. Remembering this, Abby's pencil meets paper—her spark quietly returns.

items.name: Poetic Notes
items.description: Abby captures each fleeting moment in her sketchbook—messy, lively lines that trace her journey and growth.

items.name: Cool Sip
items.description: The numb self is gone, swept away by the journey's breeze. Abby sips her drink, calm and free in the golden light.

items.name: Lake Dream
items.description: Soft rain veils the world like a filter—fantasy needs no sharp lines. Countless rains shaped her bond with the lake.

items.name: Rain Bloom
items.description: Each rainfall draws her to the ripples. Nature taps its rhythm, and her heart follows, dreaming with every drop.

items.name: Ripple of Memory
items.description: Melutin thought long—loud or quiet scenes passed her mind. In the end, she chose the small lake outside her window.

items.name: Serenade in Rain
items.description: A drifting heart was suddenly pulled. Before Melutin knew it, “Registration Successful” flashed on the tiny screen.

items.name: Abyssal Hues
items.description: To Melutin, it was music she loved—and a mirror of quiet days. Even the plainest moments held a hint of shining joy.

items.name: Emblem of Dreams
items.description: On slow afternoons, she creates freely. Each small joy is “ideal” made real in daily life.

items.name: Unspoken Vow
items.description: Months later, Rain Over the Lake by virtual idol Ruither went viral—its gentle tune and lyrics touched many.

items.name: Prism Interlude
items.description: In the song, people rediscovered quiet emotions lost in daily life—like stars softly glowing in a dark night sky.

items.name: Luminous Prologue
items.description: On quiet afternoons, Melutin wrote by the window. Stuck for words, she looked to the shimmering lake.

items.name: Sapphire Oath
items.description: Rain Over the Lake marked Melutin's start as a songwriter. Years on, she still remembers the nerves of hitting send.

items.name: Forsaken Echoes
items.description: Back then, Aria didn't grasp what “monster” meant to the villagers. She just felt hurt—and vanished with a spell.

items.name: Mossy Traces
items.description: She escaped and sat by the stream, fixing her hair and tail. The villagers saw her and shouted, chasing her off.

items.name: Wispfire Glade
items.description: Joy from escaping faded fast. Stuck in a trap, Aria thought, the world’s too complicated—maybe I should go home.

items.name: Abandoned Spire
items.description: Such trials wouldn’t stop her. Aria had learned the spells—and that night, she reached the human world at last.

items.name: Luminous Solitude
items.description: The young woman was different—her gentle, bright eyes reminded Aria of the moon in Qingqiu's mist. She took Aria in.

items.name: Hushed Cosmos
items.description: She cared for Aria and made chicken soup. Smelling it, the little fox lit up, tail wagging with joy.

items.name: Unstill Depths
items.description: Aria gifted the young woman her jade pendant. They became close friends—sunbathing, picking mushrooms after the rain.

items.name: Phantom Fire
items.description: Aria thought it just another day, skipping after her aunt's shadow as she left the lively human world.

items.name: Wavering Exile
items.description: Her eyes stayed kind, but tears shimmered. Aria didn't understand goodbye—she just wiped them away.

items.name: Jade Veil
items.description: The human girl had clever hands; Aria, in contrast, was clumsy. Her playful ways often made the girl laugh.

items.name: Spirit Tail
items.description: The elders of Qingqiu found out. Soon, Aria's aunt took her home, but she promised to return when she could.

items.name: Celestial Azure
items.description: Since then, Aria explored with caution, doubting her choice to leave Qingqiu—until she met a young woman.

items.name: Oneiric Tail
items.description: On her way home, Aria passed a sunlit meadow. Girls laughed in the grass—she thought, we were like that once too.

items.name: Petalfall Ephemera
items.description: War came before the bloom. Bevelyn fled with her vase, past smoke and farewells, as fire swallowed her town.

items.name: Shattered Moon
items.description: After countless tries, Bevelyn's vase was born one rainy morning—perhaps her one perfect creation.

items.name: Dew Blossom
items.description: Through war, perfection kept Bevelyn going—until a child's scream. She turned; a hoof hung in the air, ready to fall.

items.name: Silent Verse
items.description: Without pause, she raised her vase. Instinct moved faster than thought—even she was surprised.

items.name: Renascence Vow
items.description: Beneath shattered glass, a seed took root. Though it grew on a battlefield, untended, the flower still bloomed.

items.name: Sigh & Shine
items.description: The child was saved, but the perfect vase lay in pieces—scattered in the dust, now worth nothing at all.

items.name: Lilac Sonata
items.description: No time for sorrow—the vase was gone. Bevelyn grabbed a single shard and hurried back on the road.

items.name: Scented Time
items.description: This time, what drove her wasn't a need to protect perfection, but something deeper—something she couldn't yet name.

items.name: Fragrant Past
items.description: Most of glassmaster Bevelyn’s work is lost to time, yet the shattered vase is still remembered.

items.name: Roseate Berries
items.description: People chat over local cuisine and toast to a wonderful holiday, forgetting all worries in cheers and laughter.

items.name: Dessert Spirit
items.description: The girl's eyes light up the moment she sees the lovely earrings. She slips them on, brightening the special holiday.

items.name: Summer Sparkle
items.description: Before the holiday ends, enjoy a cool glass of coconut water! Let its sweetness linger as a lasting memory of the summer~

items.name: Stellar Moment
items.description: As the sun sets, Jinyi closes her notebook full of notes, wipes away sweat, and runs to her friends at the pier.

items.name: Time of Silence
items.description: Aunt Liu wants a couch, Uncle Chen is selling his shop... She notes everything that has happened on Iris Street.

items.name: Spectacular Life
items.description: Grown-ups ask curiously what the kids are discussing, but they all cleverly beat around the bush.

items.name: Starry Glitter
items.description: One morning, the grown-ups wake up to find a newspaper titled Iris Daily lying quietly at their doorsteps.

items.name: Unbridled Zest
items.description: Info on leases, discounts, lost pets... The handwriting may be childish, but the design is creative and full of doodles.

items.name: Manifesto of Time
items.description: The phone rings at the Star Weekly's office. 'You want to talk to Chief Editor Jinyi? Sorry, her schedule is full...'

items.name: Sunset Glamor
items.description: Ten years passed in the blink of an eye, and neon lights now shine along the Iris Street lined with tall buildings.

items.name: Windfall Surprise
items.description: As friends share the gifts from Jinyi, one taps her on the shoulder, asking, 'How's it going? Still too busy?'

items.name: Glorious Road
items.description: With everyone's praise, a dream starts budding in her heart, waiting to one day sail away to a bright future.

items.name: Echoing Memories
items.description: The girl steps out of a taxi, with shopping bags in her hands and a cellphone held between her ear and shoulder.

items.name: Cosmic Exploration
items.description: She mused about whimsical inventions, dreaming of a jetpack to soar to great heights where clouds and stars entwine.

items.name: Sea of Starlight
items.description: Wumei imagined herself as a shepherdess on vast grasslands, running with sheep friends like her little Lambie.

items.name: Signal of Aries
items.description: What wonders lie in the boundless sky? No one suffers sleepless nights there, and stars spend each evening laughing.

items.name: Woolen Whispers
items.description: Wumei felt that Lambie understood her. The little sheep gazed back at her, and its ears would twitch in reply.

items.name: Engine of Fantasy
items.description: The meteor shower never came. Only a few faint stars scattered across the night. This wasn't what she imagined.

items.name: Shadow Court
items.description: Fury burned in Kasim's eyes. Zahra showed no fear, sounding the horn—her long-awaited call for revenge.

items.name: Dreaming Lights
items.description: Hooves closed in. Zahra cloaked herself in her mother's starry veil, fading into shadow, unseen by the hounds.

items.name: Hanging Moon
items.description: Zahra slipped into the palace. Her veil parted like mist—her blade flashed, piercing Kasim's heart.

items.name: Silent Nightfall
items.description: From despair grew resolve. Zahra returned to a city ruled by Kasim's hounds, its glory lost to fear and blood.

items.name: Golden Gleam
items.description: Shadow was her shield. Zahra gathered loyal hands in secret, weaving a cold, burning web of vengeance.

items.name: Midnight Glow
items.description: Horns rose like Kasim's final song. He lunged—steel flashed, but the blade struck his own traitor's heart.

items.name: Still Night
items.description: 'Kasim is dead! Lay down your arms!' Zahra's voice rang out as dawn broke through the clouds.

items.name: Luminous Gold
items.description: Veiled in shadow, she forged her blade in blood and wrath. Yet she ruled with wisdom. All sang her name—Zahra.

items.name: Gleaming Stream
items.description: With map and pack, Dalf and the little one set off. The fish bid farewell, and the stream rushed ahead to scout.

items.name: Fairytale Guest
items.description: Dalf stroked the little one's back and said, 'I know stories of rivers and lakes. Let me help you find a new home.'

items.name: Flowing Waters
items.description: To Dalf, lakes were painters sketching the sky and rivers were travelers racing to the sea. Every puddle was unique.

items.name: Gentle Waves
items.description: They met a stream tossing the little one off balance. Dalf chuckled, 'It seems we need to find calmer waters.'

items.name: Swaying Petals
items.description: They arrived at a tranquil forest marsh. A pudgy axolotl released bubbles, then floated up and shook its head.

items.name: Unknown Realm
items.description: The little one's kin arrived at their new home. To thank Dalf, they picked the most beautiful flowers for her.

items.name: Crystal Gleam
items.description: The little one swam joyfully, blowing happy bubbles toward Dalf, 'This is the place! Our new home!'

items.name: Fragrant Ripples
items.description: On hot days, the little one would swish its tail, stirring ripples and breezes to bring Dalf a touch of coolness.

items.name: Dreamer's Companion
items.description: Blossoms encircled Dalf, merging into a romantic sea of flowers conveying gratitude to the girl.

items.name: Thief's Invitation
items.description: 'Good night. May the moon and stars grant you sweet dreams.' With a graceful leap, the girl got on a hot-air balloon.

items.name: Heartbeat Heist
items.description: On a city rooftop, roses rained down. Two wary factions looked up as a figure slid down the balloon's rope ladder.

items.name: Momo Balloon
items.description: The balloon was reportedly crafted after a cheerful late-night talk between the Troupe's prop master and its leader.

items.name: Under the Moonlight
items.description: Countless heart-shaped balloons erupted to blur the crowd's sight. She seized the treasure swiftly.

items.name: Nocturnal Fantasia
items.description: A fragrance drifted on the wind as ornate invitations fluttered down like snow, revealing the thief's next move.

items.name: Starlit Trace
items.description: A cheer broke the quiet. The Troupe saw Milia clutching props, dashing to the rehearsal hall.

items.name: Free Spirit
items.description: With keen senses to track lost treasures and achieve goals, the girl bows to no power, chasing only what's amusing.

items.name: Dazzling Moment
items.description: As the lights dimmed, a spotlight split the dark. Cloak flared, and Milia, the Phantom Thief, stepped into glory.

items.name: Prelude to Tomorrow
items.description: The girl toyed with a gem, watching the factions quarrel on the rooftop. She laughed to herself.

items.name: Finale in Splendor
items.description: Countless clever touches wove into a stunning show, Milia's effort gifting a feast for the eyes.

items.name: Glimmering Starlight
items.description: Starry sky mirrors in her eyes, igniting a light that sees through all things. Past vows stirred within her soul.

items.name: Astral Hush
items.description: The path unfolds in silence. She steps forward as starlight floods her trail, whispering waves of distant warmth.

items.name: Veil of Stars
items.description: Stars fade and bloom in endless rhythm, stirring tides of light. The distant horizon glows with radiant promise.

items.name: Distant Stardust - Glow
items.description: Stars burn bright in the silent sky, tracing the unexpected fate, shattering into dust, and reborn in the fall.

items.name: Infinite Cosmos - Glow
items.description: Stars cast their light across distant space. Even the most ordinary night is a miracle of the universe, she thought.

items.name: Starlight of Memory - Glow
items.description: Even only for a fleeting moment, the twinkling stars left the most brilliant memories amidst the dark.

items.name: Starlit Drift
items.description: Even in the sea of fallen worlds, a glimmer of hope remains—hidden in stardust, glowing on forgotten paths.

items.name: Sleepless Abyss
items.description: The young woman stumbles on—past shattered stars, through collapsing despair—racing toward the night sea's far shore.

items.name: Lucent Dream
items.description: Silent waves crash as she reaches the shore. Breath held, starlight blooms in her palms—alive with infinite dawn.

items.name: Secret of Innovation
items.description: Star Weekly is a famous magazine in Lotusville. Its founder Jinyi is known for her progressiveness and great vision.

items.name: Afternoon Tea Break
items.description: Clink! Lottie set down the teapot a little too hard, nearly toppling the tea tin. Bono sighed, paw to his forehead.

items.name: Detective Bono
items.description: Bono was a true detective: steady, calm and sharp. No clue, no matter how small, could escape his watchful eyes.

items.name: Lady's Etiquette
items.description: 'Mind your manners...' Bono began, as Lottie shoved her hat down over unruly hair and tore open the letter.

items.name: Curious Enigma
items.description: Madame Dupont wrote in distress from her manor. Her treasured gem brooch had vanished, leaving her sleepless.

items.name: Silent Testimony
items.description: Lottie soon won the hearts of the staff. The head maid said the Madame's kitten, too, had disappeared recently.

items.name: Elegant Style
items.description: Bono found the cat on the cupboard, batting the brooch like a toy. Madame gave it an affectionate, helpless pinch.

items.name: Vivid Encounter
items.description: Lottie found the grieving Madame in the garden. Her witty comfort brought a smile, lifting the gloom bit by bit.

items.name: Secrets Unveiled
items.description: Bono's investigation revealed some clues: tiny paw prints on the table, snagged curtains, a slightly opened window…

items.name: Tea-Time Whispers
items.description: Mystery solved. Sunlight bathed the procelain cups. Busy detectives? Now, they're tea-sipping lady and gentlemen.

items.name: Retro Reflection
items.description: Lottie and Bono compare notes in the hall. Paw prints, fabric snags, the missing cat… Could the culprit be…?

items.name: Graceful Poise
items.description: Lottie narrowed her eyes in comfort. Solving cases is delightful, but so is a warm cup of tea under the sunshine.

items.name: Purehearted Moments
items.description: Lottie always keeps her cheerful sincerity. With that open heart, she often uncovers the most useful clues.

items.name: Verdant Terrace
items.description: From Lantis's poise and grace, people gradually guessed her true identity, yet chose to guard the princess's secret.

items.name: Veil of Dawn
items.description: A relentless plague swept through the kingdom. Windows and doors were shut tight. The bustling streets fell silent.

items.name: Crystal Dewfall
items.description: Ignoring all pleas, Lantis drove the carriage meant for her safety straight toward a mysterious, perilous valley.

items.name: Verdant Gleam
items.description: The horse carried Lantis back. Unconscious, she still clutched the withered lantis flower and its seeds.

items.name: Golden Radiance
items.description: Amid sheer cliffs bloomed the flower she sought. She climbed on, rocks tearing her hands, yet she never paused.

items.name: Glistening Teardrops
items.description: Even if it was a myth, Lantis vowed to find the flower bearing her name, risking everything for a thread of hope.

items.name: Dawnlight Veil
items.description: People cheered the kingdom's salvation and rejoiced at Lantis's awakening. Her tale was passed down through ages.

items.name: Petal Heartlock
items.description: Irena's words float like feathers. Lonna sees a sea of roses as fairies bring a chest with her long-awaited health.

items.name: Radiant Verses
items.description: Dawn and dusk pass. Encouraged by Irena, Lonna lifts the watering can, watching sunlight turn droplets into rainbows.

items.name: Garden Fragrance
items.description: With Irena's support, Lonna finally steps from the room and sows fragrant flower seeds into the soft courtyard soil.

items.name: Clustered Blossoms
items.description: Sitting among flowers, Irena holds Lonna, telling her tales of bees or humming songs about the blossoms.

items.name: Prelude of Breeze
items.description: How to check humidity, prune leaves, and care for buds… Irena is both a skilled gardener and a gentle guardian.

items.name: Leisurely Daydreams
items.description: On the night the last bud blooms, Lonna waits patiently, watching fairies surround a flower spirit beneath the moon.

items.name: Waltz of Roses
items.description: Time passes quietly. Buds fill the branches, and now Lonna can crouch to watch them grow herself.

items.name: Tender Secret Vow
items.description: Moonlight pours down, briefly revealing the flower spirit's face. It is Irena, with her warm smile and tender eyes!

items.name: Splendid Poem
items.description: Morning breeze drifts through the garden, carrying the story. Each blooming rose becomes a tender poem in time.

items.name: Rosy Zephyr
items.description: The roses bloom hundreds of times. In a sudden wind, Rosalina sees her teacher close her eyes with a gentle smile.

items.name: Romantic Paean
items.description: The song embraces the flowers like the spring's gentle touch. Finally, the slumbering roses start to bloom.

items.name: Scentful Wings
items.description: Maybe love, companionship and music can awaken the spring. They embrace the girl playing the violin, like invisible wings.

items.name: Redolent Dew
items.description: People know Rosalina, but not her teacher, who was as brilliant, yet had never left a rose garden in her life.

items.name: Blooming Promise
items.description: Rosalina asks every doctor but finds no cure. She can only watch as her teacher's life wilts away.

items.name: Vivacious Lilt
items.description: It could be for nothing, but Rosalina starts playing in the garden. A melody as sweet as spring flows through the air.

items.name: Glorious Variation
items.description: Her teacher insists on returning home. She'd stare outside the window at the roses that still refuse to bloom.

items.name: Unfinished Tune
items.description: Rosalina thinks of the Sound of Spring. Countless musicians tried for many years, but none could succeed.

items.name: Decadent Banquet
items.description: The girl's fate transformed. Shadows from the past fire seemed to vanish as the lady led her into sunlight.

items.name: Traces of Memory
items.description: Noble life was arduous. The lady hired top teachers for Audrey. Heavy etiquette had to be mastered from scratch.

items.name: Flickering Candlelight
items.description: Every child hoped to be adopted by her. This noble lady chose Audrey from the orphanage's many expectant children.

items.name: Curtain of Fate
items.description: In a poor orphanage, Audrey met an elegant, luxuriously dressed lady who captivated the children.

items.name: Scattered Pearl Light
items.description: Audrey blossomed under strict tutelage into the beautiful, elegant, and clever renowned Flower of the Kingdom.

items.name: Fleeting Old Dream
items.description: By day, Audrey was graceful, but in dreams, she remained the little girl crying in the burning village.

items.name: Glistening Moon
items.description: Audrey's grand coming-of-age ceremony was witnessed by nobles. Afterwards, her adoptive lady revealed a secret.

items.name: Eternal Star
items.description: From then, revenge burned. The air again smelled of scorched earth and blood. She never forgot that night.

items.name: Sweet Dirge
items.description: She received the Duke's invitation. Audrey stored the card, knowing her final grand feast was about to begin.

items.name: Elegy of Years
items.description: Audrey felt increasingly tormented, often wanting to knock on the lady's door and ask: what did I mean to you?

items.name: Unspoken Omen
items.description: She attended more banquets, thriving from years of training, quickly becoming the events' indispensable soul.

items.name: Rosetone Oath
items.description: Audrey executed her plan steadily. The lady never interfered, making her suspect this was exactly what she wanted.

items.name: Rosefire Doom
items.description: The great fire was a noble's plot, not natural. Fate's gears turned. Audrey looked up but saw not a single star.

items.name: Blood and Tears
items.description: The bell chimed, and the banquet began. The crystal chandelier refracted lights, like thousands of stars scattered.

items.name: Blossom of the Grand Court
items.description: Her noble adopter needed an heir, not a daughter. It wasn't love, but an artist sculpting a masterpiece.

items.name: Ripples of Time
items.description: Flames spread from somewhere unknown. Chaos ensued as crowds fled. Only Audrey walked forward, calm and unhurried.

items.name: Silent Dreams
items.description: She stepped over the motionless Duke, paused amidst the chaos, and calmly took a pastry.

items.name: Gloomy Night
items.description: 'Why waste it?' she laughed, settling gracefully. She had never forgotten the days when hunger clawed at her.

items.name: Toll of Extinction
items.description: The raging flames mirrored the village fire years ago, grimly equalizing commoners and nobles alike.

items.name: Delusive Feast
items.description: A familiar voice called her name: 'Audrey!' She glanced back. The figure in her eyes was unmistakably known.

items.name: Echo of Memory
items.description: The ever-graceful lady rarely showed such an expression. Disheveled and stained, she moved through the flames.

items.name: Guttering Candle
items.description: Sin and hatred dissolved in ashes as city bells echoed. 'What did I mean to you?' Audrey already held the answer.

items.name: Curtain of Destiny
items.description: In the flames, the lost soul found salvation. The Flower of the Kingdom bloomed amidst blood and fire.

items.name: Sweet Trap
items.description: Sweet cakes and wine. Love, hatred and desire swirling like a stormy sea... Are you ready to join this feast?

items.name: Curtain Unraised
items.description: The world has cold spectators, and perfect role-players. On fate's stage, tragedies and comedies shift endlessly.

items.name: Fleeting Luminescence
items.description: 'Does this path bring happiness?' Such doubts often make us hesitate and wall us away from the joy we seek.

items.name: Momo's Delicious Adventure
items.description: People are celebrating the festival at the fair! Follow the smell of malt and find Momo in a pile of food!

items.name: Creamy Foam
items.description: The glass brims with creamy foam. Take a gulp and indulge in the crisp and rich smell of malt—another one!

items.name: Country Celebration
items.description: People smile with hope amidst the cheerful songs. Put on the traditional green felt hat and join the celebration!

items.name: Gourmet Snack
items.description: Get in line for the special smoked sausage. Top-notch taste with crispy casings and juicy meat.

items.name: Fluffy Puppy
items.description: Every morning, Pete wakes the girl with his wet snout and warm breath and then wags his tail to play innocently.

items.name: Fate's Weave
items.description: Seeking, guiding, unspooling fate—she says every answer is woven into the vast sea of stars.

items.name: Midnight Lament
items.description: The silence breaks: a hooded man enters, greed flickering in his eyes even in the dark.

items.name: Dream Mirage
items.description: She pushes the coins aside, tracing the crystal as starlight shapes a lonely, trembling figure.

items.name: Zephyr's Oracle
items.description: 'Evil… Perhaps, in this kingdom, there is nowhere to hide.' Her voice drifts like a far-off wind.

items.name: Crossroads of Night
items.description: He ignores her warning. Enraged, he shatters the crystal ball, a knife flashing toward her.

items.name: Radiant Nightfall
items.description: A beggar's cane blooms into a sword; beneath the cloak, royal silver armor and a solemn face.

items.name: Gleaming Shadow
items.description: In a blink, she stands outside. He lunges and misses—the blade meets an approaching figure.

items.name: Glimmering Compass
items.description: 'Fortune-teller,' he demands, 'prove your gift. Use your compass to find me a truly safe haven.'

items.name: Evening Benediction
items.description: 'May starlight always guide you.' She touches the blade, then becomes a bird and vanishes into night.

items.name: Star's Miracle
items.description: When calm returns, the knight turns to her. She lifts a hand—broken starlight mends the crystal.

items.name: Warm Romance
items.description: 'Feeling a bit chilly…' The traveler sips coffee, letting warmth and food chase away fatigue and cold.

items.name: Fluffy Wishes
items.description: The painter stays at a mountain inn, pondering new works in the hot springs to bring the scenery to more people.

items.name: Marine Fantasy
items.description: Upon closer look, her smile is blurry on the phone, but the flowers are perfectly clear… Fidira laughs hard.

items.name: Heartfelt Snapshot
items.description: A faint blush rises on the young man's ears as he lifts his phone, capturing the girl sipping coffee, unaware.

items.name: Romantic Tea Time
items.description: 'Look, I caught a cute little fish!' she shows him a photo of him and a clownfish looking at each other.

items.name: Azure Windowpane
items.description: Snap! Lost in the underwater world, he turns, eyes wide, and Fidira giggles, snapping several more photos of him.

items.name: Graceful Dart
items.description: Their meeting is still a bit away. Imagining his delight seeing the fish makes Fidira's heart even sweeter.

items.name: Joyful Whispers
items.description: A familiar figure appears, the well-dressed young man hurries over, his hand trembling slightly from nerves.

items.name: Threads of Love
items.description: Noticing him eyeing her necklace, she leans closer for a better view. He blushes at her beauty, waving his hands.

items.name: Elegant Essence
items.description: A playful thought sparks. Fidira takes out her phone and aims it at her boyfriend, absorbed in watching the fish.

items.name: Seeing Starlight
items.description: As expected, his eyes light up as he sees the magical underwater world, like a lake reflecting sparkling stars.

items.name: Aromatic Moments
items.description: Fidira knows the café menu by heart. Her vivid, personal commentary brings a smile to his face.

items.name: Key to Charm
items.description: In the final photo, Fidira strikes a 'Yay' pose, fish swimming behind her, while he gazes at her with gentle focus.

items.name: Phantom Spirits
items.description: What's he doing? Kuro is puzzled. He holds the poster and lags behind the group, trying not to draw attention.

items.name: One-Eyed Specter
items.description: Ah! Is he pretending to be a monster? Kuro suddenly realizes and glances again, thinking he's actually quite cute!

items.name: Illusory Shadows
items.description: The group dwindles as monsters vanish into the whirlpool. The boy moves on, hearing the witch's voice before home.

items.name: Otherworld Path
items.description: At the crossroad of the otherworld, energy flows chaotically, yet lost souls sense the path home clearly.

items.name: Crimson Haze
items.description: 'Hmm?' Kuro pauses, noticing a curled human shadow cast by the moonlight at the corner ahead.

items.name: Flowing Heartstream
items.description: His breath quickens, faint sobs escaping. Clearly alarmed, he seems to have entered this world completely unprepared.

items.name: True Guidance
items.description: He looks around, eyes landing on a worn poster on the wall. He tears it down and presses it against his face.

items.name: Illusionary Trail
items.description: 'Oh!' 'Awoo!' 'Clatter!' Strange little monsters respond one by one, their chaotic minds awakening in Kuro's magic.

items.name: Frightful Shackles
items.description: A human drawn here… Kuro walks on, glancing at him. Though his face is hidden by the poster, he is clearly a boy.

items.name: Lingering Wraith
items.description: Kuro notices the boy shiver, watching her through his fingers. He stands slowly but doesn't follow right away.

items.name: Starlight Trace
items.description: 'Stay close! Once we pass the crossroad, you'll see the door home!' Kuro teases. 'Lose track and you wait ten days!'

items.name: Flickering Crimson
items.description: 'We will meet again… Humans call it fate, I hear. But I think it might also be a curse of the white moon!'

items.name: Quantum Microcore
items.description: The new defense module, Norsen, known as the 'Phantom of the Void,' secures all data in the abandoned file center.

items.name: Autonomous Consciousness
items.description: Norsen learns quickly, analyzing each enemy attack and instantly devising the optimal defense strategy.

items.name: Data Seal
items.description: Enemies strike again with mixed methods; data floods in like tides, triggering piercing system alarms.

items.name: Error Code
items.description: Data streams back into the attackers' systems. Error codes surge like snowflakes, instantly crippling their devices.

items.name: Precision Analysis
items.description: Calm and swift, Norsen dissects attack patterns and sources. Every data set and signal falls under her scan.

items.name: Cyber Phantom
items.description: Meanwhile, Norsen's playful ghost face suddenly appears on the enemy screens, laughing at their foolishness.

items.name: Ghostly Lantern
items.description: Don't be fooled by the warm glow! Mischievous ghosts hide behind it, waiting for their next game of trick or treat.

items.name: Prophecy of Night
items.description: They say on a certain night, stars and moon fade away as the veil of night covers all… And the ghosts awaken.

items.name: Sweet Trick
items.description: A bag full of surprises. Go ahead and pick one! Will you take the clever bunny doll or the sweetest candy inside?

items.name: Crown of Legacy
items.description: A crimson glow flickers in the distance. Riene advances, but a skeleton with its crown askew blocks her path.

items.name: Flawless Heartwing
items.description: Facing madness with her last hope, resisting claws with a broken blade, Riene strikes the undead crown in one blow.

items.name: Sword of Valor
items.description: The slumbering miracle awakens. The dim gem flickers in Riene's scarred hands, its crimson glow breathing to life.

items.name: Choice of Glory
items.description: Curse of the undead echoes in the dark. Riene pauses and kneels solemnly, lifting the kingdom's long-lost treasure.

items.name: Bloodwing Journey
items.description: 'I sacrificed all, yet could not save it…' laments the undead, calling the crown a shackle, the gem a tombstone.

items.name: Scarlet Vow
items.description: The undead vanish silently. Riene grips the gem and sword, knowing it's not the end, but the dawn of a new journey.

items.name: Shadowed Thorns
items.description: In autumn, the young man regained his health. Before leaving, he gave Riche a diamond and promised to return for her.

items.name: Eternal Petals
items.description: Young love filled Riche's heart, making her ignore his fine clothes and sword, which were unfit for a village man.

items.name: Midnight Dreamshade
items.description: Soon, moved by Riche, the youth let his guard down. They wandered through the fields, watching the sunset together.

items.name: Silent Spirit
items.description: The duke plotted an assassination, but years of nobility had made Riche cautious. Her innocence had long since faded.

items.name: Duskfall Light
items.description: Villagers held a feast for them with gifts and blessings. They danced late into the night like a fairy tale ending.

items.name: Fading Dreamwing
items.description: His temper wore her down, and he soon grew bored of her commoner background. Their love eventually turned bitter.

items.name: Aesthetic Riddle
items.description: A year later, the youth returned in fine clothes bearing a family crest. It turned out he was a wealthy young duke.

items.name: Crystal Vision
items.description: If the story ended there, everything would remain lovely and memories shine forever. Yet life is never so perfect.

items.name: Eyes of Longing
items.description: Former lovers clashed. Darkness swallowed fond memories. Amid the intrigue, the duke ultimately lost his life.

items.name: Void Whispers
items.description: The duke's portrait was replaced with a new one of Riche, elegant yet cold, her gaze shining like a diamond.

items.name: Silent Wanderer
items.description: Shivering, Riche asked, 'Wasn't there a painting?' The butler shook his head. 'Never. Perhaps it was your dream.'

items.name: Artistic Riddle
items.description: Riche woke, eager to turn her dream into a horror novel. Before leaving, she paused at the empty wall.

items.name: Azure Flame Shade
items.description: The traveler loses track of the path in the moonlight. Where to next? The answer glimmers at the end of darkness.

items.name: Myriad Phenomena
items.description: Seeing all truths and illusions dulls life. Fate fascinates only in the unknown, so she seals the all-seeing eye.

items.name: Homeward Promise
items.description: Follow the trail of golden petals back to the warm, familiar light. See if the one you miss has grown well.

items.name: Playful Disguise
items.description: For today's meeting, a perfect plan: grab a grinning pumpkin, make the strangest face, and step through the door!

items.name: Soul Symphony
items.description: Dressed in bright colors, we sway through the streets. Music rises. Our love and memories make us eternal.

items.name: Autumn Brew
items.description: Autumn gathers the year's labor. Fruits ripen with fragrance as gentle winds whisper blessings to everyone.

items.name: Warming Light
items.description: Banners sway at dusk. The scent of food opens the feast. Friends lift their drinks, laughing under the golden glow.

items.name: Day of Harvest
items.description: The earth stays silent, yet it rewards all labor with golden fruits. People see the same joy of harvest.

items.name: Karma Chains
items.description: He realizes something and struggles up. Ignoring the sweat soaking his clothes, he runs off without looking back.

items.name: Moon of Insight
items.description: Good or bad? Shiro turns, gazing at the high moon, calm as ever. Before the story's final chapter, no one can know.

items.name: Nocturne City
items.description: Shiro, Follower of the Moon, watches him in silence. Another reckless human has arrived in the city, she thinks.

items.name: Obscure Rain
items.description: Whoosh—A white barrier comes between him and the moon. He regains focus slowly and sees a pure white umbrella.

items.name: Ghostly White
items.description: The pupil shimmers with bizarre colors. Past, present, and future flow within, making one forget to breathe.

items.name: Dustweb Trap
items.description: In the next moment, the boy collapses, clutching his chest and gasping. If he saw his face, he'd know how pale he is.

items.name: Dirge of Ruins
items.description: After a while, or maybe just a moment, a gust of wind stirs, and the girl's gaze falls toward its source.

items.name: Drifting in Mist
items.description: The girl stays silent, watching him until he looks up. The chaotic energy calms, and everything falls silent.

items.name: Skeletal Wings of Time
items.description: The girl in white descends from the sky, landing atop the streetlight. Behind her, a pair of bone wings slowly folds.

items.name: Entangled Realm
items.description: The breeze stops; stillness falls. The gears of fate turn as the girl finds a gap in the cage of the white realm.

items.name: Wings of Bygone Age
items.description: Legends say that on starless nights, you should avoid the white moon's gaze, or you'll be drawn into another world.

items.name: Joyful Melody
items.description: Sunset lingers while torches light the night. The crowd flows like a lively river into the square.

items.name: Starcatcher
items.description: The child brings back the pumpkin, apologizing. Stars sparkle, and the pumpkin looks like a full autumn moon.

items.name: Autumn Glow
items.description: A playful child knocks a basket. Pumpkins roll down the path. He leaps and stops its journey.

items.name: Autumn Promise
items.description: Flickering fire warms everyone. Loxie flits like a happy bird, and all praise her pumpkins.

items.name: Life Like a Play
items.description: At the premiere, crowds marvel at her charm, weep at her trials, and cheer the perfect ending, as always.

items.name: Waves of Clamor
items.description: Questions ring on. With the mic in hand, she means to give rehearsed answers, yet a weariness rises within.

items.name: Blooming Wings of Heart
items.description: Before countless cameras, gentle Ivanna suddenly flicks her hair and smiles, a mischievous grin beyond the script.

items.name: Flickering Glow
items.description: She recalls the role that chose to flee a gilded cage. A bold, playful idea sprouts in her heart.

items.name: Brilliant Moment
items.description: Like a swift bird, she darts past the stunned crowd, leaving all behind, her hair flying like a classic slow motion.

items.name: Impromptu Performance
items.description: 'Thank you for the support. The bonus scene will be shown by me~' She waves, lifts her skirt, and runs away.

items.name: Unfinished Script
items.description: The story on the screen ends, but Ivanna's own vivid, real chapter has just begun.

items.name: Final Curtain
items.description: 'THE END' lights the screen. Thunderous applause erupts as Ivanna steps onto center stage to roaring cheers.

items.name: Fragrant Eaves
items.description: It is her favorite fairy tale. Each morning, a girl with a flower basket hops in the forest, sharing scents with all.

items.name: Breezy Voyage
items.description: Miss Sparrow decorates her house with flowers. Mr. Fox puts them on his tail. Grandma Rabbit makes cakes with them.

items.name: Fragrant Basket
items.description: She thinks all night and slips The Girl with the Flower Basket into a large envelope, with a flower bookmark inside.

items.name: Fragrant Eaves - Dream
items.description: Mr. Fox pulls out a pretty straw hat from nowhere, places it on Lulu, and adds a beautiful flower to the brim.

items.name: Breezy Voyage - Dream
items.description: Lulu stands amid her animal friends, gazing at her reflection. Her cheeks flush pink, eyes sparkling with delight.

items.name: Fragrant Basket - Dream
items.description: The basket is already overflowing with flowers from her animal friends. Lulu laughs. It's time for photos!

items.name: Lucky Knits
items.description: Waiting for the studio to set the scene, she weaves a headband, green and full of her hopeful excitement.

items.name: Wishes Captured
items.description: Finally, her appointment arrives. Nervous, Kashira enters the studio. The moment she opens the door, she's stunned.

items.name: Pinecone Gift
items.description: Could this be time-travel magic? Behind the plain little door lies a vast, tranquil forest!

items.name: Lucky Knits - Berry
items.description: The forest feels like a natural maze. She follows the squirrels, weaving vines and branches to find the perfect spot.

items.name: Wishes Captured - Berry
items.description: Sitting beneath a tree, she hugs a squirrel and smiles at the camera. The flash captures her most cherished fantasy.

items.name: Pinecone Gift - Berry
items.description: Like waking from a dream, she leaves the studio thrilled and reluctant to go. She's already imagining the next scene!

items.name: Vintage Chic
items.description: She opens the studio door. The dress hanging on the rack is dreamlike, flawless under any scrutiny.

items.name: Silent Memories
items.description: When she stands before the mirror, she sees a woman seemingly step out of the past, embodying timeless elegance.

items.name: Ripples of Past
items.description: Neon signs flicker over bustling streets, echoing a century-old splendor. The perfect setting sparks her inspiration.

items.name: Flickering Shadows
items.description: Everything pulls her into an era of centuries ago. She no longer hesitates, ready to embark on a journey to the past.

items.name: Grace Preserved
items.description: The photos capture not just an elegant figure in a vintage gown, but a bygone era hidden in the busy streets.

items.name: Vintage Chic - Violet
items.description: Beneath the hat, carefully styled hair forms gentle curves, reviving the elegance and refinement of that era.

items.name: Silent Memories - Violet
items.description: Crystal chandeliers shed light over stacked champagne cups. Gowns spin with the music. Light shimmers near her ears.

items.name: Ripples of Past - Violet
items.description: Pearls are no longer just an ornament. Their sheen becomes the most striking color of the vintage scene.

items.name: Flickering Shadows - Violet
items.description: She's gradually captivated by the studio. The camera is her only audience, capturing every moment of her in the era.

items.name: Grace Preserved - Violet
items.description: The carefully woven dream nears its end. After the shoot, she sighs. This truly is a place that 'realizes any dream.'

items.name: Inspired Glow
items.description: The crowd is thrilled by her inspiration, yet she quietly fades from the world. Rumors stir: another fleeting show.

items.name: Captured Beauty
items.description: Three years later, a collection appears. Buds on ice, smiles in deserts… Miracles were born in those silent years.

items.name: Dreams in Bloom
items.description: The flash sparkles like stars. Freya walks the red carpet. Flowers on her gown bloom as before, now known by all.

items.name: Journey Treasures
items.description: Applause fills the air. People admire her rare talent, inspirational touch, and her courage to travel the land.

items.name: Dream Chaser's Proof
items.description: People may get tired of the cliché of beauty, but there are countless views worth recording in the wrinkles of time.

items.name: Peaceful Melody
items.description: 'Miracles are not created by me, but live on their own,' she says firmly. 'I'm fortunate enough to witness them.'

items.name: Dazzling Starwish
items.description: The golden trophy glimmers in her hands. She strokes its base, knowing this night is a new prologue, not an end.

items.name: Jingle Star Bell
items.description: The Christmas Eve party is about to start. Momo hesitates, 'Huh, is this Nikki? Did she change her hairstyle?'

items.name: Honeyed Affection
items.description: Momo decides to bake a cake for Nikki with soft chiffon, rich cream, and fresh berries. It's the sweetest gift of all!

items.name: Radiant Dreamscape
items.description: Gems scatter like stars; feathers dance at hem. She holds her breath. No wonder this studio 'makes all dreams real.'

items.name: Floating Whispers
items.description: Most wondrous are the floating mannequins, dreamlike guests bowing midair, ushering her to the dress.

items.name: Luminous Horizon
items.description: The narrow stairwell is filled with fabric; needles glide as if alive. Inspiration rests in every corner here.

items.name: Stairs of Wishes
items.description: She can hardly believe her eyes. Moonlight turns to cool silk; air becomes soft tulle. Fantasy becomes reality.

items.name: Frosted Feathers
items.description: The gown is exquisite, yet something is missing. Fingers brush gems as the young designer falls into thought.

items.name: Hymn of Blossom
items.description: Rejected sketches return to her mind, along with late nights before blank paper. She fears drawing the first line.

items.name: Mind Voyage
items.description: Light becomes butterflies swirling around them. The muse embraces Gloria, and new ideas light up her eyes at once.

items.name: Starlit Misty Isles
items.description: A phantom descends the long stairs… It's the muse as Gloria imagines, winking like a longtime friend.

items.name: Marvelous Muse
items.description: Her needle flies with ease. Hazy visions turn real as the gown gains details unique to Gloria.

items.name: Silvered Feathers
items.description: The studio adventure becomes her dearest memory. She hopes to realize others' dreams with her design.

items.name: Swaying Blossoms
items.description: Celia stood amid her friends, winking at her grandma in a rocker. The kindly elder smiled and nodded in praise.

items.name: Messenger in White
items.description: With a flick of her wrist, little Celia skipped a pebble. A silver arc danced on the lake, and she cheered.

items.name: Blooming Secret Haven
items.description: White, fragrant flowers lined the shore. Grandma walked with Celia hand in hand. Her hug also carried the soft scent.

items.name: Dreamlike Lakeside
items.description: Sometimes she dreams of the lake, her friends, grandma's embrace, and cool drops on cheeks, vivid even after waking.

items.name: Innocent Bud
items.description: Independent and steadfast. She learns the flower's meaning as an adult, but the one to share it with is long gone.

items.name: Old Dream Encounter
items.description: Life's toil carved lines in Grandma's hands. Yet she still drew beautifully, teaching her light, shadow, and colors.

items.name: Words of Affection
items.description: Changed into her dress, Celia sits by the lake. The shimmering water glows like the warm memories grandma left her.

items.name: Fragrant Petal Drift
items.description: Golden flecks ripple on the lake. Celia stands in the frame, skirt lifted by the breeze. Hmm… Something is missing.

items.name: Heart's Radiance
items.description: Tears fall as memories embrace her. Though time changes all, love and blessings never truly leave her.

items.name: Bloom in Heart
items.description: 'Flowers may wither and lakes may dry, but the cherished happiness makes life no longer lonely or desolate.'

items.name: Cherished Moments
items.description: Birds fly in, bringing a delicate dress and hopping by the camera. Thinking of old times, she pulls herself together.

items.name: Butterfly in Blossoms
items.description: She never seeks reward, helping the suffering as she can, unaware that such kindness builds the steps of her ascent.

items.name: Veiled Haze
items.description: Though upset by her leaving, people see her off with blessings, like watching geese destined to migrate south.

items.name: Glimmering Chrysanthemum
items.description: For years she bears no leaves or blooms, only withered branches entwined, yet the old man still tends her with care.

items.name: Dew-Kissed Branch
items.description: The old man runs a street shop. His handmade sweets always draw children, whose laughter rouses her from long dreams.

items.name: Emerald Droplets
items.description: 'Plants have hearts too,' he murmurs, as if to her. 'All are guests in this world; feelings can connect.'

items.name: Mossy Path
items.description: She understands a sick granny's moans, tears of a girl forced from school, and a woman's sigh at an empty rice jar.

items.name: Moonlit Hidden Bloom
items.description: A tale spreads through town: The chrysanthemum that never blooms houses a kind spirit who aids the distressed.

items.name: Clear Azure Waters
items.description: She leaves herbs for the granny, tuition fees for the girl, rice for the poor. Seasons pass; she helps more.

items.name: Shattered Pearls
items.description: One evening, lights glow in the sea mist. A ship crosses the eerie sea, and a young sailor comes before Tano.

items.name: Seashell Throne
items.description: Perhaps no one can make it. Tano forgets the vow. In a deity's long life, kingdoms rise and fall like dust in wind.

items.name: Eternal Echo of Tides
items.description: Tano studies him in surprise. His life is fragile, yet he alone defeats the tides. By the pact, she hears his wish.

items.name: Brilliant Hymn
items.description: The sailor comes from a distant land, ruined by war. He begs for wealth and power to save his shattered home.

items.name: Starry Sand Chant
items.description: A breeze ripples the sea as he speaks of his dreams. Moved by his vision, Tano fills his ship with treasures.

items.name: Phantom in Long Night
items.description: Her dull eternity gains a spark. Tano grants his wish. Gratitude fills his young face as he vows a gift in return.

items.name: Timeworn Soul
items.description: Again and again he takes advantage of her, learning even a goddess can be deluded. The seed of greed takes root.

items.name: Sacred Treasure
items.description: His desires grow harder to satisfy, and Tano indulges them all, until he asks for divine power and eternal life.

items.name: Fateful Tide Song
items.description: Soon he returns through the mist with gifts. His people thank the goddess and craft offerings with care.

items.name: Terrace in Blossoms
items.description: The world is a map waiting for color. Erin lifts her brush, marking destinations ahead and dreaming of new sights.

items.name: Floral Echoes
items.description: Hearing that she'll travel, friends joke about getting postcards. She nods seriously, keeping the promise in mind.

items.name: Fragrant Touch in Dream
items.description: The brave young traveler stumbles at first, lost on strange platforms and streets, yet meets many kind souls.

items.name: Dews on Blossoms
items.description: A granny brings her soup. An innkeeper slips a hand-drawn map into her bag. A fellow traveler gives her a lucky coin.

items.name: Warmth Remembered
items.description: Warm moments scatter like starlight on her journey. Beyond scenery, brief and sincere encounters stay with Erin.

items.name: Springtime Verses
items.description: She records each sight and shares them with friends in postcards. Erin feels they aren't apart, but travel together.

items.name: Flourishing Blooms
items.description: Spring's first breeze wakes the world; Erin returns home. Time, the best gardener, fills the terrace with blooms.

items.name: Fragrance of Dream
items.description: Laughter stirs the lily of the valley by the window, peering at the warm light and smiling faces in the room.

items.name: Past Floral Years
items.description: The puppy softly whimpers and leaps from Ava's arms, as if this new world brings it joyful comfort.

items.name: Classic Grace
items.description: Back then, she studied alone in a strange city. Buried in work and introverted, she never had close friends.

items.name: Elegant Old Times
items.description: It jumps onto the sandalwood chair, wagging its tail. Its lively cuteness leaves Ava momentarily dazed.

items.name: Warm Bliss
items.description: During a field trip, she rescued the little puppy curled in a box. Since then, it had become her constant sunshine.

items.name: Bright Wishes
items.description: Click! The camera captures the moment. The puppy perches on the armrest. She can't help smiling, stroking its head.

items.name: Refined Melody
items.description: Playing on the grass, she lies with the puppy, watching the sunset. Colors of inspiration fill her eyes.

items.name: Thoughtful Charm
items.description: Flash! The second photo. She lowers her eyes and pours the tea, and the puppy sits nearby, forming a serene scene.

items.name: Cup of Fragrance
items.description: After graduation, she is lost and uninspired. The puppy jumps, tugging her skirt, urging her outdoors again.

items.name: Together Always
items.description: Caring for the puppy makes Ava's life orderly. Walks and exploration bring her new scenery and a few friends.

items.name: Verdant Vines
items.description: 'Keep going. Your real surprise lies deeper!' Bobo winks and takes Nikki's hand. 'This time, we're with you!'

items.name: Fragrant Whirl
items.description: Ribbons on the garden gate dance in the breeze, greeting Nikki as she walks the path with a heart full of anticipation.

items.name: Blossom Radiance
items.description: A familiar figure hides behind the hedges. It's Debbie! She runs over and gently tucks blooms onto Nikki's dress.

items.name: Spring Courtyard Steps
items.description: Light, cheerful music drifts from afar. Curious, Nikki follows the melody around the garden's bend.

items.name: Starlit Brilliance
items.description: The record turns softly. Mela stands by the gramophone, smiling gently as she nods a warm greeting to Nikki.

items.name: Breeze's Soft Murmur
items.description: What other surprises await? Heart brimming with joy, Nikki slips past the bushes, and her view suddenly opens wide.

items.name: Floral Hymn
items.description: Gauzy drapes sway in the warm wind. Girls gather around a long table of treats, their laughter echoing through the garden.

items.name: Gorgeous Moments
items.description: By the window stands Ace, dressed as a knight. She turns at Nikki's voice and waves with a radiant smile.

items.name: Pure Heart's Melody
items.description: At the garden's center stands a flower-decorated window. Sunlight streams through, scattering colors in Nikki's eyes.

items.name: Devotion's Tribute
items.description: Beside the flower, Ransa sets out delicate desserts. Sherry stands near her, a bit shy, yet soft-eyed and gentle.

items.name: Heartfelt Verse
items.description: 'Our birthday girl is here!' Bestt and Besan link arms with Nikki. 'Do you like the surprises we made for you?'

items.name: Beauteous Years
items.description: Joy warms her heart. In the glow of candlelight, Nikki smiles, believing her wish will surely come true.

items.name: Sweet Rendezvous
items.description: The delicate desserts sit on the shelves. With permission to help themselves, guests eagerly take a cream tart.

items.name: Perfumed Hours
items.description: Many praise the studio's floral tea. Fragrant and sweet, one sip instantly lifts the spirit and calms the mind.

items.name: Grand Overture
items.description: After the shoot, every guest finds a small silk-tied cart at the door, a gilded letter resting quietly atop it.

items.name: Blooming Passage
items.description: Rich aromas fill the porch, warm lamps sway gently. It marks the end of a dream and the start of a fresh life.

items.name: Sweet Rendezvous - Grace
items.description: Savoring the desserts, guests relive the date with themselves, memories, or the future, smiling softly.

items.name: Perfumed Hours - Grace
items.description: The tea is always perfectly warm, wisps rising like a delicate veil, separating dream from reality in a subtle haze.

items.name: Grand Overture - Grace
items.description: 'Thank you for visiting! May this time bring you real joy and fulfillment, and we look forward to our next meeting.'

items.name: Sunlit Snow Bridge
items.description: Her zhu sound rises and falls, like a gurgling spring, or clashing swords. Time passes unknowingly in her melody.

items.name: Sound of Drifting Snow
items.description: Lang Shuang carries her qin to the plum garden. Suddenly, clear zhu sounds of a girl reach her, like shattered jade.

items.name: Blossoms Frozen in Ice
items.description: Feelings are hidden in melody. Not knowing the girl's name yet, she wishes to meet, know and harmonize with her.

items.name: Moonlight on the Hill
items.description: A kindred heart is always rare. The two feel close at once. One plays qin, the other strikes zhu, perfectly in sync.

items.name: Affection in Chords
items.description: Later, they both become famous, yet separated often. Lin Yao is always busy, drifting through feasts and banquets.

items.name: Colorful Inspiration
items.description: Looking at her friend's back, Mimi feels confused, realizing she has forgotten to offer her treasured herbal tea.

items.name: Exquisite Craft
items.description: How much effort is needed to make clothes that fit? Thinking her work might never be worn, Mimi feels a bit sad.

items.name: Creative Spark
items.description: 'I have an idea!' Miss Rabbit's eyes light up. She says she needs to prepare and rushes out before Mimi can ask.

items.name: Whimsical Pom-pom
items.description: After breakfast, Mimi hears a noise outside. She opens the door and finds Miss Rabbit with a group of forest friends.

items.name: Graceful Etiquette
items.description: 'Is it true you have the most beautiful clothes?' The curious crowd peeks inside, eyes sparkling with hope.

items.name: Unique Design
items.description: The lively elephant lifts a hat, the quiet bird touches a sheer cape, and the shy bear gently asks to try on a suit.

items.name: Thread of Vine
items.description: 'Sure!' Mimi adjusts the bear's suit with needle and pins. Soon, it fits him perfectly. Everyone claps in delight.

items.name: Ribbon of Time
items.description: Seeing interest in her work, Mimi's joy overcomes nerves as she invites everyone in. The room fills with laughter.

items.name: Innocent Companion
items.description: Mengyao takes in the town. The little bear lifts her over shining lakes, candy lanes, landing at an ice castle.

items.name: Everbloom Ice Flowers
items.description: Dwarfs tip their hats, a princess by the lake smiles, and a bard strums verses. Snow drifts down; all feels magical.

items.name: Tender Magic
items.description: A ball fills the castle. Guests warmly welcome her, guiding her step by step to dance in the sparkling lights.

items.name: Dazzling Ice Crystals
items.description: Amid laughter and lively music, she smiles. The little bear holds her hand as they dance through the crowd.

items.description: When the Lord of Kindred gifted it to that boy, it was not surprised. The desire for power blinded it.

items.name: Fire of New Moon
items.description: The boy is now holding the sword in hand, carrying the burden of sin and glory. He steps into a no man's world.

items.name: Starry Night Robe
items.description: The night is gloomy and the past is like a flash. Only the shiny blade is breaking the mark of time.

items.name: Return to Dust
items.description: The power from the sharp blade is boiling in the blood. The respect from the people is like an invisible chain.

items.name: Slaughter Whimper
items.description: It is an answer to his desire. If the chain of fate comes with endless bound, the chain shall be broken!

items.name: Chant of Youth
items.description: Searching for the truth in the dark and witnessing the glory in history. Who writes down the best moments?

items.name: Rippled Chord
items.description: The golden strings play the memories of the past, the touching melodies, and sometimes turn into pleasant whispers.

items.name: Frosted Moon

items.name: Snowy Feather
items.description: When friends and foes both are gone, she travels alone. A cup of wine may be worthy enough for a story.

items.name: Moonlight Ride
items.description: She doesn't have too many divine things around but the golden litter, which houses her when she's drunk.

items.name: Free Way
items.description: She calls herself Beyond Bamboo and learns swordsmanship in mountains and drinks with poets. She never feels so free

items.name: Jade Eardrops
items.description: She once had a bosom friend that they drunk all night. Now the past is all gone except this pair of eardrops.

items.name: Oblivion Blade
items.description: As the swordsman left, she forged the sword soul into a sharp blade. Its edge cut all the past away.

items.name: Poetic Wine
items.description: The poet is old and the last bit of inspiration dissolves into the wine bag, full of aroma.

items.name: Shiny Hair Accessories
items.description: Shiny hair accessories embellished around the ear.

items.name: Red Gold Fragrance
items.description: Stylish and delicate earrings, which glisten as you walk.

items.name: Elegant Handbag
items.description: A unique mix of traditional printed textures and modern, stylish handbag structure.

items.name: Soul Resonance
items.description: All the audience throw their hands up high in the sky. The music draws people from all over the world closer.

items.name: Starsea Carnival
items.description: Under the starry sky, beautiful makeup shines a brisk light, answering the jumpy lights of the glow sticks.

items.name: Hand Drum Ring
items.description: The brisk hand drum melts in the unstoppable rhythm. She closes eyes and indulges herself in this audio feast.

items.name: Sweet Story
items.description: Interesting stories and sweet desserts are all sold out. Ms. Coco prepares to move on to the next port.

items.name: Star Foam
items.description: Oar hits the water and foams rise like flowers, making the sea a dessert too. Will it be sweet like the stories?

items.name: Golden Sea Foam
items.description: The first sunlight dyes the water golden, like the gold leaf on the ice cream. Mr. Mint hails sun from the bow.

items.name: Officer Seagull
items.description: When the weather is bad, Mr. Mint can always tell the direction. 'Ga-ga-' Maybe he can talk with the seagulls?

items.name: Mr. Mint

items.name: Softly Snuggle

items.name: Strange Mushroom

items.name: Starlight of Gem

items.name: Squirrel Star

items.name: Target Locked
items.description: Had a bicker with your friends? Don't worry. This pair of dolls from Squirrel Star will guard your friendship.

items.name: Mechanical Gun
items.description: The Hunt Gun is a badge from the shop owner. Though she takes so many dolls, many new customers come for her.

items.name: Lucky Hunter
items.description: Please borrow me some of your luck! Sister from Squirrel Star! All the kids want to have a handshake with her.

items.name: Prey Mark
items.description: Targeting the doll, Feno carefully adjusts the position. Now! Feno presses the button and fishes the toy out.

items.name: A Hundred Percent Hunter
items.description: No doll can escape the clutch of Feno. Be it the chubby panda or slippery box... Feno always can find a way.

items.name: Squirrel's Tail
items.description: Like a squirrel who hoards pine nuts, Feno loves collecting all kinds of toys. They are her loyal friends.

items.name: Glittering Feather
items.description: As she gains fame, more people noticed her past. Countless reporters asked, but she always answered with a smile.

items.name: Emerald Love Poem
items.description: Her charming voice narrates stories of love and hatred. The story's end can always make a sentimental girl cry.

items.name: A Song of Youth
items.description: Some say the story in the lyric is her own past, otherwise, how can she sing so devotedly?

items.name: Past Obsession
items.description: The past just means so little to her now. She always sings for one thing--to realize the beautiful dream.

items.name: Beyond Hesitation
items.description: She saw friends who buried themselves in the memory and never wake up, but she knew there is no salvation in that.

items.name: Dream Echo
items.description: From the phonograph, the familiar song flows out slowly. All the painful past has become the mellow wine.

items.name: Treasured Old Dream
items.description: A toy bear on the desk. Listen carefully, and you may hear the happy cry of the girl when she received the gift.

items.name: Real and Virtual
items.description: Finally, I came to the mirror. I raised my hand and she lifted her hand. I moved a step back and she smiled at me.

items.name: Ruins of Age
items.description: I heard the cry when I was born, the noise of my parties and, after all the pages, the declaration of the doctor.

items.name: Return of Souls
items.description: I slung the lamp to the mirror with all my strength. As the sound came, countless memories crowded in

items.name: Flame Requiem
items.description: I heard my mother's sob, my father's sigh. They lit up a white candle and sealed my last soul in this ancient mirror.

items.name: Night Dew Bead
items.description: I clean the house room by room. Dining room, study, bedroom, all the dust on memories have to be cleaned.

items.name: Silver Long Hair
items.description: I lived many years in the old house. I wash my hair with cool well water and comb it with silver ornament.

items.name: One-lamp Room
items.description: Thousands of years passed, but I'm still here, in this little square world.

items.name: Morning View
items.description: After that, it seems like the bird can find its way back. It visits her from time to time and keeps twittering.

items.name: Gift of Swallow
items.description: The bird she saved grows up gradually. Event with some dew on its wings, it can still create swirling wind.

items.name: Fly Towards Spring
items.description: It is getting cold outside and the bird has not visited her for days. Hope it won't be as nervous as before.

items.name: Mind Curse

items.name: Gentle Moonlight

items.name: Holy Rose
items.description: Sharaman is willing to exchange the fabrics of the monastery for the safety of the refugees.

items.name: Sparks of Light
items.description: Sharaman is checking how much food she has left in the cellar. She wishes that the war can end sooner.

items.name: Simple Resolution
items.description: The God will punish you if you force your way in.' Sharaman's fearless expression stopped the soldiers.

items.name: Soul Repentance
items.description: Sharaman puts on her white Nun suit and holds the white plaster god statue in front of her chest.

items.name: Night Prison
items.description: The innocent citizens have no idea why the war starts. Thestruggle of power will only bring endless pain.

items.name: Butterfly of Darkness
items.description: God... Please forgive me...' After finishing the words, the soldier is finally released from his suffering.

items.name: Twinkling Promise
items.description: The people of the monastery sing the Song of Peace together but the guns are still being fired on the battlefield.

items.name: Regretless Promise
items.description: Sharaman and the refugees bury the soldier together. They leave a bunch of sunflowers on his grove.

items.name: Dream Chasing
items.description: She never missed any of the army band's shows. She enjoys the incredible performance of the girls.

items.name: Worthy Honor

items.name: Shining Moment
items.description: She throws her baton into the air and it returns to her hand as flowers fly and the people starts to cheer.

items.name: Within Reach
items.description: During the celebration party, she still smiles from her heart although she is a bit disappointed.
