items.description: She finishes every move without any trouble and it's the last time she performs on the stage. Who will be the next?

items.name: Worthy Honor·Memory
items.description: She sees the familiar face again during the rookie competition. She is sure that the girl can do a better job.

items.name: Shining Moment·Memory
items.description: A new year of celebration has come. The girl holds the baton in front of the honor guards.

items.name: Within Reach·Memory
items.description: Although they have never met and communicated, the inheritance is already passed on. No word needed.

items.name: Diamond Invitation
items.description: Although it's buried deep in my heart, I want to become someone like my mother. Her nimble hands are perfect.

items.name: Floral Feather
items.description: My memory about father fades away. He is always busy. Even when he is at home, he is thinking about his business.

items.name: Eye of Jewel
items.description: My father will never forget about my birthday. I still have the earrings he gifts me when I was ten years old.

items.name: Early Light
items.description: I still remember that my father holds a big birthday party when I was 10 years old. Many people wished me the best.

items.name: Lost Time
items.description: I remember that it was a sunny morning. My parents said they were leaving and I begged them to bring back a gift.

items.name: Gentle Dream
items.description: My father pat my head gently and I felt happy in my mother's warm hug. I stood in front of the door.

items.name: Diamond Invitation·Gorgeous
items.description: The next moment, the smiling guests changed their expressions. Their terrifying faces looked like the devils.

items.name: Floral Feather·Gorgeous
items.description: After that, I wake up many times from my dreams and there are still tears on my cheeks.

items.name: Eye of Jewel·Gorgeous
items.description: The earrings are glowing under the moon and the designs have piled up. Luckily, I'm a talented designer.

items.name: Early Light·Gorgeous
items.description: I decided not to think too much and just focus on my design. It is a beautiful and vast ocean.

items.name: Lost Time·Gorgeous
items.description: I want to study at the best designer school in the world and explore the world to look for inspiration.

items.name: Gentle Dream·Gorgeous
items.description: At 18, I can finally explore the world. The place I lived for years can never be related with the word 'home'.

items.name: Diamond Invitation·Rare
items.description: I'm no longer naive and aggressive. When the praise and honor finally come, I already don't care.

items.name: Floral Feather·Rare
items.description: I try to communicate with the guests in a polite way. Suddenly, it feels like that I travel back in time.

items.name: Eye of Jewel·Rare
items.description: On the back of the earrings, the last character of my nameis engraved on them. Tears start running down my face.

items.name: Early Light·Rare
items.description: I put the fresh flowers into the vase this morning and the familiar melody is echoing in my ears. The room is cold.

items.name: Lost Time·Rare
items.description: Time flies. I'm no longer the little girl who had nothing. People will never know how hard I work.

items.name: Gentle Dream·Rare
items.description: I think I've lost some things forever, but it seems like they are still with me in a different way.

items.name: Diamond Invitation·Crimson

items.name: Floral Feather·Crimson
items.description: I return to the place where I spent my happy childhood and arrange it as the old time. And I hold a big party.

items.name: Eye of Jewel·Crimson
items.description: I announce that I'm back and listen to them wishing my the best. Fake or not, I don't care.

items.name: Early Light·Crimson
items.description: The bed time stories my mother tells me finally turn into magic spells as the time passes.

items.name: Lost Time·Crimson
items.description: Time can solve everything. I just stand there and realize that I no longer care about a lot of things.

items.name: Gentle Dream·Crimson
items.description: The kid in front of me looks excited. The kid is guessing what tonight's bed time story will be.

items.name: Golden Road

items.name: Abyssal Chant

items.name: Star Invoker

items.name: Eye of Dawn
items.description: Before the dawn, it is the endless darkness and the freezing air. However, the Sun always has mercy.

items.name: Dust of Mundanity

items.name: Spirit Hymn
items.description: The gate to another world has been opened, all your sins and evil thoughts will be forgiven by the God of Death.

items.name: Sound of Dawn
items.description: As the noise disappears from her ears, she closes her eyes in a borderless golden ocean.

items.name: Glory of Darkness
items.description: Sometimes, darkness is here to compliment that ray of light. Darkness is cruel and desperate.

items.name: Eternal Spirit

items.name: Descending Carol

items.name: Chant of Light
items.description: The Goddess who brings light to the Wasteland. You shall bring happiness and peace to the land.

items.name: Eternal Light

items.name: Kiss of Dawn
items.description: The light penetrates the thick clouds and kisses the cheek of every wasteland resident. It is the kindness of God.

items.name: Floating Blossom
items.description: When she was a girl, she used to sit on a rock, and watch the sun set. The dim light falls upon the flower.

items.name: Gate of Reincarnation
items.description: The God favors no one. In its eyes, no matter if it is the vast universe or the world, everything is traceable.

items.name: Song of Miracle
items.description: She turns around and walks to the golden ocean in the luxurious outfit made with the feathers of the birds.

items.name: Rush of War
items.description: She remembers her tightly closed eyes and the pain from the needle that is pushed into her body.

items.name: Power of War
items.description: She remembers her teammates with blank expressions on their faces and the badges forged by blood.

items.name: Gale Confinement
items.description: It is so cold that no matter what she does, the coldness still pierces through her body like a sharp blade.

items.name: Abyssal Trace
items.description: She buries her face between the knees. Her face is covered with scars. The scars are marks left by the war.

items.description: In the girl's dark pupils, there are gun smoke, terrifying invaders, the relatives who have passed away.

items.name: Martyr of Massacre
items.description: Rita watches the girl wipes the tears off her face and puts on the armor made with pain and darkness.

items.name: Flourishing Flowers

items.name: Silks and Satins

items.description: Mask made of pure gold shines to the campfire, while the fragrance of wine fills the air with cheers and claps.

items.name: Musical Golden Bell

items.name: Reflected Galaxy

items.description: As the girl dances, the flower patterns on her dress fly and fall into people's hand to become fruits.

items.name: Praise Song
items.description: People praise the Goddess for the promising oracle as the girl holding the torch go on spreading the blessing.

items.description: The maiden plucked the dewy hibiscus and wore it in her hair. The fragrant flower gave her a more delicate look.

items.description: If I may, please tell me your sorrows and joys. Then, perhaps I can sing the song better to cheer you up!

items.name: Glowing Wings
items.description: Coco has a pair of semi-transparent wings, like a brilliant halo. She is small but she is important to many people.

items.name: Chilly Sleep Talk
items.description: Your stories have made me know what is emotion, but now I am still unable to sing those emotions out.

items.description: When Nikki takes photos, she feels the sound of the sea is echoing in her ears.

items.name: Elegant Lobster
items.description: What a unique experience. Nikki cannot help thinking what would this designer create the next time?

items.description: Though it's hard to believe, this backpack has become a hit and it's out of stock somewhere.

items.name: A Pleasant Surprise
items.description: This is a letter for her. Since she went here alone, she has never received a letter. Life is worth the wait.

items.name: Chaser
items.description: Holding a stack of letters, Joy can't help thinking about how long she hasn't received a letter herself...

items.name: Expression of Care
items.description: 'Thx for delivering letters for us! My whole family is happy to see the letters. You are so important to us.'

items.name: Autumn in a Letter
items.description: There is a dry orange flower with the smell of sunshine in the envelope. What a leisure autumn day!

items.name: White Chapter

items.description: He feels he has done something wrong. She might already know what he thinks. But what would she think of him now?

items.description: I'm confident I won't lose to anyone in this swimming class!

items.description: To talk with the mermaids smoothly, I also learned diving. But... I'm not sure how to talk underwater.

items.description: To find a way to become a mermaid, I dived in the ocean of books.

items.description: The shooting star glides across the sky, and I make a wish.

items.name: Friend of Light
items.description: She services justice amid the chaos and disorder of fate. She brings results without the need to explain to anyone.

items.name: Starry Embrace
items.description: Some are relieved by death. Others earn lasting fame through it. She gently takes these souls away for a rest.

items.name: Stars Embrace Comet

items.name: Dust Settles
items.description: Some trample on others for their momentary glory. She makes the final judgment in the presence of the moonlight.

items.name: Moon Court Trial
items.description: All people will move toward the inevitable end. However glorious one’s life is, one can’t escape from death.

items.name: Crescent Moon
items.description: The fate string of her bow points to the darkness, and the glow of the new moon will put an end to all evil.

items.name: Enemy of Darkness
items.description: If justice cannot be served, she will practice it. She is the faith of many people, a light of hope amid a storm.

items.name: Flow of Time

items.name: Flicking Dreams

items.name: Fish Swimming in Clouds

items.name: Fleeting Years

items.name: Tracking Ages

items.name: Dust on the Sleeves

items.name: Passionate Gesture

items.name: Strong Will

items.name: Golden Blade

items.name: Sweet Wise Voice

items.name: Dream Untainted
items.description: Her voice and chiming bells sweep over snowy fields and frosted roofs, carrying hope and blessings into every window.

items.name: Emerald-Filled Gaze
items.description: Winter fades into spring again. Cold winds soften, buds appear, and the coming festival becomes everyone's favorite talk.

items.name: Crisis in the Mist
items.description: The official laughs on TV, reflected in her icy gaze. Acting now would alert him; her precise plan is already set.

items.name: Bright as Sun
items.description: In that instant, understanding forms. Morton and Carol pose as lovers, their gazes soft with practiced affection.

items.name: Warm Sun Prelude
items.description: Spring winds blow as birds sing. Elno paints the vivid scene before her. A fluffy shape peeks out from behind a tree.

items.name: Little Witch's Journey
items.description: When news from afar bursts in, she thinks it's fate's cruel joke. 'Fiona, I entrust the troupe to you.'

items.name: Little Devil's Dream
items.description: The acclaimed play opens for a limited time in Oren City. Crowds from across Miraland come for this dreamlike show.

items.name: Bunny Companion
items.description: As if inviting her, the bunny hops ahead, then looks back at Elno. Smiling, she rises and follows it into the woods.

items.name: Colorful Invitation
items.description: The bunny stops at a patch of soft earth and paws at it lightly. Understanding, Elno digs and uncovers a colorful egg.

items.name: Lush Green Fields
items.description: By a babbling stream lies the first egg, with a small basket of fresh carrots beside it. Their sweet juice makes Elno smile.

items.name: Playful Bunny's Eggs
items.description: 'Are you playing an egg hunt game with me?' Elno laughs. The bunny nods hard, then dashes into the forest and vanishes.

items.name: Whimsical Egg Nest
items.description: The girl dreams of becoming an artist. She paints spring colors onto the eggs, turning them into brilliant works of art.

items.name: Grand Invitation
items.description: The cast returns for bows. Applause surges like waves for the performance, echoing through the wild night.

items.name: Illusory Stage
items.description: Laughter drives the story forward. Each character wanders through their own maze, blind to fate's tightening threads.

items.name: Interlude Illusion
items.description: When truth surfaces and the curtain falls, the audience realizes fate has fooled them all.

items.name: Masks of Illusions
items.description: Old scripts feel outdated. Fiona writes a new one and builds a temporary stage for an unprecedented show.

items.name: Starlight Magic
items.description: On opening night, crowds arrive in waves, each taking a role: musician, knight, or wandering ghost.

items.name: Fate's Opening Act
items.description: All lose themselves, unsure who is performer or guest, as someone guides them to fate's whirlpool.

items.name: Unfinished Enigma
items.description: A ghost plays a lively tune. A maiden sings of love by her window. Carefree nobles whirl at a grand ball…

items.name: Fool's Carnival
items.description: Disguised in their roles, they join the tale, drawing tasks from the governor and immersing themselves in the show.

items.name: Enchanted Theater
items.description: The fading troupe finds new life, brighter than before. It all begins with Fiona's all-or-nothing choice.

items.name: Peculiar Theater
items.description: Watching the crowds, Fiona understands: life is ever-changing, like the theater. Tomorrow's turn may begin today.

items.name: Gentle Morning Breeze
items.description: It is a cute little bunny, watching in awe as it hops closer to her. Elno smiles, careful not to startle the tiny spirit of nature.

items.name: Glory of Past
items.description: She stands before the old theater, hearing echoes of past songs. Her uncle's life's work now faces closure.

items.name: Spring Day Reverie
items.description: From that day on, every afternoon the bunny appears on time, quietly staying by her as she paints bright spring scenes.

items.name: Springtime Encounter
items.description: The second egg rests on soft grass. She picks up a bunch of flowers nearby, petals brushing her fingers with sweet scent.

items.name: Springtime Poem
items.description: Elno finds the last egg beneath her favorite tree. The bunny holds it, wearing the blue dress Elno once gave as a gift.

items.name: Fancy Dreamland
items.description: Joy knows no limits, and vivid shows unfold. Are you audience or performer? Both deserve to be fully enjoyed!

items.name: Forgotten Theater
items.description: Her uncle loved theater but never business. New amusements steal the crowd, and the old troupe fades.

items.name: Tender Slumber Tale
items.description: Elno decides to give her new friend a gift. She makes a dress by hand, its blue hem like a clear spring afternoon sky.

items.name: Vivid Spectacle
items.description: The curtain rises. Fix your gaze! The spinning orbs hide secrets; in a blink, they turn into cotton candy and chocolate!

items.name: Shadows of Past
items.description: The troupe couldn't wait for miracles and quietly left. The hopeful light in her uncle's eyes dimmed.

items.name: Treasure Hunt Game
items.description: She sets the gift before the bunny, but it suddenly darts away in fright. 'Did I scare it?' Elno wonders, guilt creeping in.

items.name: Mist in Mirror
items.description: She gazes into the mirror, an idea forming. If all seems trapped in a plight, why not gamble once more with fate?

items.name: Light Footsteps
items.description: The next afternoon, as Elno packs up her tools, the familiar fluff runs from the fields and gently rests its paws on her knee.

items.name: A Moment of Humor
items.description: No dull moments. Every prop brings a surprise! Even simple boots makes a cute, quirky sound at just the right time.

items.name: Vivid Performance
items.description: A festival of absurdity and lies is perfect for a bold show. Fiona decides to make it the troupe's new beginning.

items.name: Cunning Trap
items.description: Behind every perfect smile lies a sly prank. Be careful not to fall into the trap of dazzling words.

items.name: Adventure Eve
items.description: Cecilia is a lively and brave cat living in the forest, who loves taking afternoon naps and going on fun adventures.

items.name: Tip-Tap on Leaf
items.description: Cecilia decides to wait behind the burrow first. But what if Miana still doesn't like cats and refuses to take her gift?

items.name: Home Underground
items.description: 'We must be friends now!' Cecilia brings a small cake to Miana's home and knocks on the door.

items.name: Woodland Ballad
items.description: The mouse peeks her head out to see the inviting cake. The cat by her door smiles, 'Shall we go on an adventure together?'

items.name: Fragrant Sonnet
items.description: Cecilia is an adventurer who dreams of traveling to every corner of the forest, but this time, she's in big trouble.

items.name: Little Blessing
items.description: Plants can become dangerous traps in the rainy season. Cecilia loses her balance and rolls to the edge of a cliff.

items.name: Kitten Charm
items.description: A branch catches Cecilia in midair. She meows with fear, her head still dizzy and ears flattened in panic.

items.name: Friendship Bond
items.description: Carried by the wind, Cecilia floats safely to the ground on the dandelion glider, but Miana runs off once again.

items.name: Bluebell Dream
items.description: What now? Cecilia holds onto the branch in despair, and then she sees the small yet powerful figure that is Miana!

items.name: Curvy Tail
items.description: Tying large leaves with dandelions, Miana leaps between branches and ties the handmade glider to Cecilia's tail.

items.name: Pitter-Patter on Leaf
items.description: The rain stops! Drops of water roll from the leaves into the soil, as sunlight paints them a light shade of gold.

items.name: Secret Dwelling
items.description: Miana dislikes cats for their excessive energy and curiosity. She's never thought she'd cross paths with Cecilia.

items.name: Forest Chorus
items.description: Tender shoots break through the soil, flowers bloom, and the forest awakens. In the breeze, nature sings a song of life.

items.name: Woodland Whispers
items.description: In the fairytale Cecilia's New Friend, Cecilia has friends all over the forest. Now she's made a timid yet brave new friend!

items.name: Woodland Dawn
items.description: How does the story end? The joyful cat and brave mouse become friends and go on adventures in the forest together.

items.name: Sylvan Fantasy
items.description: Everyone loves Cecilia. She's made friends all around the forest, except for little Miana the mouse, who lives in her burrow.

items.name: Sunlit Breeze
items.description: One day, Cecilia hears an angry squeak and runs over to see the little Miana defending herself against a huge bird.

items.name: Cheese Epistle
items.description: The greedy bird wants to take Miana's grains. Cecilia lunges to scare the bird away and turns to see Miana gone, too.

items.name: Woodland Ramble
items.description: That's understandable. After all, Miana has always hated cats and runs away the moment Cecilia shows up.

items.name: Kitten Whims
items.description: Cecilia waits with her chin on paws, her heart floating like a cloud with anticipation... How will Miana react?

items.name: Clement Time
items.description: Flora runs a fireworks shop. On the colorful packaging are different signs of emotions represented by each firework.

items.name: Time of Euphoria
items.description: When the sun rises, Flora delivers her potion to the girl and suddenly gets an idea for a new firework.

items.name: Somber Night
items.description: She's always had the same dream where a woman sings with a lilt, her dress fluttering like swallowtail wings.

items.name: Blessing Sparks
items.description: Fireworks spark different emotions with each magic potion. This one... 'Bang!' It takes away sadness and brings joy.

items.name: Secret Silver Dust
items.description: Flora is a witch born with a gift for fire magic. For her, creating magical fireworks is a delight.

items.name: Nocturne Spectacle
items.description: A girl walks into Flora's shop. She comes to town for the fireworks but doesn't expect to live to see the next show.

items.name: Tales of Magic
items.description: Instead of the magic ingredients and herbs, the witch only wants Flora's magical fire broom to soar into the sky.

items.name: Radiant Bloom
items.description: The girl loves fireworks like Flora loves the magic. She wants to fulfill the girl's dream and help her regain her health.

items.name: Astral Guard
items.description: Flora promises to hold a grand firework show for the girl and secretly decides to cure her before the show.

items.name: Dream Spiral
items.description: She opens an old grimoire and stirs the brew of marigold and unicorn tears three times anticlockwise, but it explodes.

items.name: Iridescent Starlight
items.description: After her last crucible explodes, Flora props the grimoire back under the desk and flips open her witch contacts.

items.name: Magic Effulgence
items.description: Like a rosy nebula or a river of stardust, the fireworks glow brilliantly as if the gods parted the night's veil.

items.name: Veiled Elegance
items.description: The woman wears a familiar dress with a veil over her face. Somehow, she feels the woman's gaze upon her across the crowd.

items.name: Hazy Enigma
items.description: 'With blooms her voice drifts away, Like butterflies fluttering to stay.' The woman sings the song from her dream.

items.name: Forlorn Lilt
items.description: Tears roll down her cheeks before she realizes it. The woman bows to her, as if in thanks or farewell.

items.name: Soothing Moonlight
items.description: The figure fades away as swallowtails flap their wings under the moon, leaving her alone in the abandoned theater.

items.name: Hummed Refrain
items.description: That night, she dreams she is a Cloud designer, only known for the swallowtail butterfly dress she designed for a friend.

items.name: Final Elegy
items.description: Her friend treasured the dress. It witnessed her rise to fame and watched as she stepped onto the grandest stage.

items.name: Fluttering Grace
items.description: However, flames of war spread to the town. The songstress still decided to go on stage and perform for the enemy.

items.name: Cascading Sparkles
items.description: Sitting on the porch of the fireworks shop, the cured girl looks up with anticipation when the town bell tolls.

items.name: Dazzling Spectacle
items.description: Trade it with her beloved broom? Flora hesitates, but the girl's hopeful gaze reminds her of the brightest firework.

items.name: Nebulous Vision
items.description: She grows curious about the woman. Why would someone from a century ago sing in her dreams at night?

items.name: Evanescent Dream
items.description: Her song bought time for townspeople to escape. She listens and finally meets her friend's gaze as the song ends.

items.name: Fleeting Memory
items.description: She wakes up in the peaceful town. For a moment, she seems to catch a glimpse of a figure in a butterfly dress.

items.name: Mystic Butterfly
items.description: Following her dream, she found the abandoned theater. It's said people can still hear singing on moonlit nights.

items.name: Sunkissed Zephyr
items.description: Sadness, joy, and sorrow... Flora explains to the customers that each firework here contains a different emotion.

items.name: Floral Ballad
items.description: Most of them think it's a joke, but when the fireworks light up the sky, cherished feelings and memories wash over them.

items.name: Silky Memories
items.description: The moon and stars pale in the light of the dazzling fireworks. People watch quietly as the firework named Nostalgia blooms.

items.name: Ephemeral Splendor
items.description: She seems to see a butterfly as she passes the door, and the world transforms into a bustling theater.

items.name: Alchemist Rune
items.description: Tourists travel from afar for the fireworks and are astonished by their magical effects, but Flora smiles mysteriously.

items.name: Lingering Shadow
items.description: Someone shows her seat and serves tea. The hall dims, leaving only the moonlight shining upon the center of the stage.

items.name: Meeting Cuteness
items.description: The first time Lily saw a panda was on TV. She was seven and didn't know what that was, thinking it was a dog.

items.name: Gilded Tune
items.description: Golden glitters were cast upon the warm dessert shop. Lilisa hummed while decorating a cake.

items.name: Aureate Chapter
items.description: Bell was born in a seaside town where the sea breeze blew past every morning, carrying the seagulls' singing.

items.name: Buoyant Spirit
items.description: In the game Star Explorer, you are a new space explorer waiting to unlock routes and explore the unknown.

items.name: Rippling Glimmer
items.description: The sunrise dyed the ripples golden as the water lilies drifted in the glimmers. It was her long-awaited vacation.

items.name: Crescent Frost
items.description: Qingyan grew up in a remote temple in the mountains. Only the tolling of bells and a pond of lotuses accompanied her.

items.name: Frostbound World
items.description: As she slowly grew from a lotus to a human, Lotus could always feel a familiar presence. It was her only friend.

items.name: Abyssal Fracture
items.description: Between the worlds of the living and the dead, spider lilies bloom in scarlet red like thousands of eternal flames.

items.name: Abyss of Yin and Yang
items.description: The soul servants are created by Huashu with spells to record human lives and preserve them in the study.

items.name: Devout Incantation
items.description: Only the pure-minded could see a star existing in all time and space, shining constantly despite the cycles of life.

items.name: Saintfall Echo
items.description: In the divine flood, the girl awaited her end in prison when suddenly her childhood friends rushed in and held her.

items.name: Devout Incantation
items.description: Only the pure-minded could see a star existing in all time and space, shining constantly despite the cycles of life.

items.name: Saintfall Echo
items.description: In the divine flood, the girl awaited her end in prison when suddenly her childhood friends rushed in and held her.

items.name: Starry Prelude
items.description: The legendary perfumer announced she was her greatest work even before her birth, but unexpectedly, also her last.

items.name: Childish Fairytale
items.description: When she had just gained consciousness, she knew about the silver-haired girl. She was born for her.

items.name: Childhood Wonder
items.description: As time passed, Kimi grew up and realized that dreams were just dreams and toys could never truly come to life.

items.name: Viridescent Rebirth
items.description: The transparent vessel holds soil of yore. Where and when was it from? It doesn't matter, nor does anyone care.

items.name: Resurgent Twigs
items.description: She closes her eyes with the bones in her arms, memories and love supporting her, life and freedom calling her soul.

items.name: Shallow Drift
items.description: The first time she opened her eyes, she was drawn to the strong emotions in the singing and tried joining in.

items.name: Cloudward Wings
items.description: After each song, Albert would promise to return the next day. 'After all, singing with you matters to me.'

items.name: Wordless Echo
items.description: An eternal bloom sits silently under the glass cover, its petals kissed by the morning sun, frozen in a gentle time.

items.name: Wordless Echo - Rain
items.description: After graduation, Korina joined a famous studio. Life was busy and not what she expected, but it made her tougher.

items.name: Distant Snowland
items.description: In the exhibition hall is a guard figurine in a red and black uniform. The introduction unfolds a forgotten story.

items.name: Distant Snowland - Legacy
items.description: The lady reached for the brim of its hat, brushed off the dust as her grandma used to, and tucked it into her pack.

items.name: Gleaming Fields
items.description: In the brightly lit exhibition hall, a time-worn fairytale book lay quietly in the corner. On it sat a little bear.

items.name: Gleaming Fields - Matcha
items.description: The girl grew unsatisfied with her stories, breaking the castles and tearing the perfect facades to make them real.

items.name: Soundless Rain
items.description: Her funeral ended on a rainy late-autumn afternoon. The nameless painter died in a dingy, damp basement.

items.name: Almond Amber
items.description: She goes to the coffee shop called Sunset every evening and watches the sun sinking down in an orange glow.

items.name: Bathe in Sunrise
items.description: As the sun rises, birds chirp and the world awakens. The girl adjusts her hair, grabs her bag, and leaves home.

items.name: Dreambound Hills
items.description: As the sun shone through the leaves on the mossy trail, Kaoru unfolded the map and ventured into the magic forest.

items.name: Tangerine Jam
items.description: In the tangerine sunset, Kaoru pick fresh ingredients and made the most delicious tofu pot with Master Goose's help.

items.name: Exuberant Glee
items.description: It's a holiday, and Chunxun has just moved into her new place. She's meeting with her friend to shop for the spring.

items.name: Panda Headband
items.description: But how could Mom bear to disappoint Lily? Two black ears on the fluffy headband and round pandas on each side!

items.name: Sailing in Books
items.description: Lily's biggest wish is to see a real panda. She decides to study hard and aim to become a panda caretaker!

items.name: A Cozy Sweet Spot
items.description: The sheep wished the boy happy birthday, who stared in surprise with a look of excitement glistening in his eyes.

items.name: Unforgettable Bond
items.description: Lilisa decided to leave town in case her secret was revealed. The boy came to stop her before she could leave.

items.name: Freedom's Shore
items.description: No one should be limited by their identity or talent. The town protected Lilisa so she could have a future.

items.name: Berry Tart Clouds
items.description: All magicians must serve the royal family. Lilisa would be punished severely for her pursuit of freedom.

items.name: Tender Aroma Magic
items.description: White cream spewed out into a fluffy sheep. It raised its sleepy eyes and bleated softly.

items.name: Delicate Croissant
items.description: The sheep rose to its feet and started dancing on Lilisa's palm, chasing the boy in cheerful steps.

items.name: Cirrus of Snow
items.description: Her cream magic became a secret between Lilisa and the town. She showed them more magic outside of work.

items.name: Cloudtop Dreams
items.description: Sweet cream danced in the air, turning into various images: sheep running on a ranch and slumbering on the cloud.

items.name: Mellow Relish
items.description: Lilisa treasured her time as a baker in the small town, but one early morning, she was robbed of this special joy.

items.name: Artful Touch
items.description: On a shopping trip, Lilisa saw someone familiar. She tried to hide her track, but the person still noticed her.

items.name: Sweet Adornments
items.description: Soon the royal guards came to the remote town. They put up notices looking for a magician who fled here.

items.name: Sweet Dreaming Lamb
items.description: None of their questioning and interrogations went anywhere. Lilisa could finally reopen her shop after the crisis.

items.name: Serene Dream
items.description: The townsfolk decided to work together to protect Lilisa—to repay the joy she brought to their life.

items.name: Secret of Aroma
items.description: Lilisa decided to take a risk for everyone. Together they fooled the guards into believing she had left town.

items.name: Hovering Seagull
items.description: Bell told the seagulls all about his troubles, while the seagulls offered their advice from a unique perspective.

items.name: Ripple Break
items.description: The boy flew up to the cloud with the seagulls where lakes abounded. They played games and forgot all worries.

items.name: Soothing Breeze
items.description: Bell remembers that special day when his hat suddenly floated and his bowtie became a seagull's wings.

items.name: Mint Cerulean
items.description: The seagulls surrounded Bell and held the boy by his shirt with their beaks. Together they flew to the azure sky.

items.name: Dream Venture
items.description: The wings flapped in the wind, leading Bell to the unknown world, as sheets of paper flew out from his backpack.

items.name: Tender Feathers
items.description: Bell could now understand the seagulls' singing. He greeted his seagull friends and patted their white wings.

items.name: Wonder Revisit
items.description: Seagulls pecked at bread crumbs he dropped as the sea wind blew. Bell quietly wished for another beautiful dream.

items.name: Jade of Youth
items.description: Soars like a loong, wild flame unchained. Youth carved in jade, in glory sustained.

items.name: Adventure Helmet
items.description: You are still on your way after commissions and routes, as endless stars witness your intrepid expeditions.

items.name: Peachy Freshness
items.description: Finally, Peacho stared at the blue planet through the dark porthole as tears rolled down her cheeks. She was home.

items.name: Ample Harvest
items.description: The wind writes verses in dewdrops as summer opens the earth's journals in the sweet fragrance of fruits.

items.name: Idyllic Saunter
items.description: Since the first seed sprouted, Caroro has been imagining a fruitful harvest and rejoicing over every small change.

items.name: Fruitful Verdure
items.description: Caroro carefully tends every seedling as green spreads across the field and fills its heart with happiness.

items.name: Celebration Horn
items.description: People gather and dance to the beats of the trumpets and drums, as passion spreads to every corner of the city.

items.name: Indulgent Leisure
items.description: Forget your worries and go hiking with friends! Listen to nature's singing and watch butterflies flutter with grace~

items.name: Rejoicing Croak
items.description: 'Of course! Glad you like it! See you again tomorrow morning.' The frog leapt cheerfully and left.

items.name: Verdant Stage
items.description: The frog took a bow and was about to jump into the lake when she asked, 'Will you sing again tomorrow?'

items.name: Frolic Frog Beret
items.description: For the next few days, she came to the lake to listen to the frog sing. The frog said it was a concert only for her.

items.name: Fresh Dewdrop
items.description: On the last day, she bade her farewell, saying she had to return to the city and couldn't hear its songs again.

items.name: Emerald Reverie
items.description: The frog didn't know what a city was, but still sang a farewell song. Its lively croaks echoed in her heart.

items.name: Floaty Bubble
items.description: Her cute and refreshing design won rounds of applause at the contest. The frog's singing echoed again in her mind.

items.name: Virescent Ripples
items.description: The frog theme added life and childlike fun to the design, making it lovable and delightful like the Frog Song.

items.name: Pellucid Foam
items.description: She planned to visit the lake again, but the journey was too long and too costly, so she had to put it off.

items.name: Sugar Sweet Whisper
items.description: The melody echoed in her dreams until she saw the poster for a design contest, offering a prize enough for her trip.

items.name: Coruscating Lantern
items.description: On a hazy rainy night, Qingyan was spacing out when she heard the sound of water. A girl waded across and sat by her.

items.name: Cosmic Triviality
items.description: The wind rustled the trees in the falling rain. 'Think of me as the spirit of these lotuses.' A smile bloomed on her face.

items.name: Glazed Enigma
items.description: The girl had pure, ethereal eyes unlike any Qingyan had ever seen. She hesitated before asking, 'Who are you?'

items.name: Unsoiled Lotus
items.description: Qingyan told the girl about the locked painting and how she still missed the feeling of creative freedom.

items.name: Glimmering Fireflies
items.description: The brief encounter felt like a dream, so she picked up her brush again to recreate the lotuses and the girl's smile.

items.name: Unburdened Heart
items.description: Qingyan did everything she could to help and even sold all her paintings, except for one hidden deep in her case.

items.name: Mistborn Splendor
items.description: Time on the mountain was peaceful until days of heavy rain flooded the town, leaving the people homeless.

items.name: Wintry Breeze
items.description: The last proof of Lotus vanished, but despite the passing of time, Qingyan still remembered that smile in the pond.

items.name: Aureate Marvel
items.description: The lasting rain cast shadows of despair. That night, all the lotuses suddenly bloomed, a familiar figure among them.

items.name: Hushed Mountain
items.description: The girl might have a name, but Qingyan never probed and just called her Lotus, as she had requested.

items.name: Ingenious Karma
items.description: She watched the blooms with Lotus under the moonlight. The girl said, 'Paint what you want, not what you're told to.'

items.name: Cinnabar Grace
items.description: Qingyan grew skilled in painting as more sought after her works. Still, she continued practicing daily by the pond.

items.name: Will of Destiny
items.description: After the night, the rain and flood finally stopped. Qingyan heard a gentle whisper as the lotuses swayed in the sun.

items.name: Brilliance Doomed
items.description: The emperor heeded a jealous minister's words and feared Huashu's achievements. She was framed and died in prison.

items.name: Cosmic Awakening
items.description: Her first life, Huashu was born in war, and with her martial skill, led armies to countless victories.

items.name: Register of Souls
items.description: In her second life, Huashu traveled around to heal the poor at no charge and saved many lives.

items.name: Myriad Fates
items.description: To save the souls from the cycle of suffering, Huashu was willing to use up her powers and fall into endless samsara.

items.name: Wistful Dismay
items.description: Still, some diseases were incurable. The families blamed Huashu and drove her out. Eventually, she died on the road.

items.name: Ceaseless Dreaming
items.description: In her third life, Huashu weaved her passion and hopes for the world into exquisite embroideries.

items.name: Stolen Renown
items.description: However, a jealous competitor stole and altered her embroideries and published them, earning fame and fortune.

items.name: Lonesome Bloom
items.description: After a hundred lives, Huashu learned sorrows and regrets and transcended them, her pride and will unchanged.

items.name: Secular Troubles
items.description: Secular troubles hide the truth of the world like a fog. Life is a game full of enigmas and deceptions.

items.name: Causality Chaos
items.description: The rich and powerful ruled the world, while kindness was repaid with evil. The world was in a mess of injustice.

items.name: Phantom Blossom
items.description: The kind-hearted is led before Huashu as she asks with a smile, 'Will you trade this life for peace in the next?'

items.name: Order Unseen
items.description: The world rewarded the evil and talentless while the good was ignored. Such unfairness cuts to her heart like a knife.

items.name: Fleeting Grandeur
items.description: Huashu gathered evidence and sued the thief. The truth eventually came out, but rumors followed her like a ghost.

items.name: A Vein in Jade
items.description: As bells under the eaves chime in the wind, a faint light shimmered between the bookshelves of her study.

items.name: Celestial Guidance
items.description: No wandering souls remain. Kindness is blessed; the wicked fear retribution. It's a peace paid with Huashu's sacrifice.

items.name: Nirvana Blaze
items.description: Bathed in dewdrops gathered from the white rose garden, the mute girl was washed of all dust and turned snow white.

items.name: Brilliant Precept
items.description: 'Peris is your name, for you are the chosen intercessor. Silent you may be, your hands will weave salvation for all.'

items.name: Empyrean Pledge
items.description: Peris lived at the top of the temple in the smell of spices and herbs and wore jeweled gold symbolizing her divinity.

items.name: Fateful Astrolabe
items.description: Grateful for the gods' love, Peris fulfilled her duty, believing she'd pass the spindle of fate to everyone else.

items.name: Engraved Aphorism
items.description: Each night, she knelt before the oracle slab, tracing with her fingertips until blood formed constellations.

items.name: Blessing of Genesis
items.description: On Saints' Day, Peris recited divine words with hundreds of gestures like fluttering doves, praying for the believers.

items.name: Meteor Dream

items.description: Hecate was again suspended beside the chandelier. She noticed a special glint in Violette's eyes as she smiled.

items.name: Sleepless Mirage

items.name: Thorned Rose Crown

items.name: Witch's Heart

items.name: Sparkling Wings

items.name: Enigma of Time

items.name: Crimson Shadow

items.name: Oath of Centuries

items.name: Cheerful Colors
items.description: She rushes back inside to pin her rainbow hair clip in place. Her journey wouldn't feel complete without it.

items.name: Hymn of the Dawn

items.name: Drowsy Blooms
items.description: 'I haven't managed to relax since returning to Lilith. I hope to explore its changes with the people closest to me.'

items.name: Messenger of Love

items.name: Sanguine Oath

items.name: Scarlet Oath

items.name: Crimson Pact

items.name: Serene Lullaby

items.description: 'Shh, don't let the moon see us!' Ruby wraps all of them up in her blanket and slips safely through the bushes.

items.name: Tender Support
items.description: The blanket flies Ruby to the moonlit forest. The wind gives her a playful push, and she falls into a pile of pillows.

items.name: Velvet Wonder
items.description: The pictures in the book suddenly come alive: as the brook babbles and leaves rustle, the blanket flies up with Ruby!

items.name: Crown of Knowledge
items.description: Seeing Ruby slip, the bunnies jump over and the books clatter to the ground. Ruby laughs in the scattered books.

items.name: Roundy Rounds
items.description: A bunny cheers. 'Thank you, clever and brave adventurer! Here, these magic glasses won't let you miss anything.'

items.name: Starry Bliss
items.description: Another bunny takes out a shiny brooch and shows it to Ruby. 'This is a badge of courage to remember this night!'

items.name: Explorer's Light
items.description: The rising sun shines on Ruby's sleeping smile as she holds the book, the torch turned off and lying quietly beside her.

items.name: Adventurer's Key
items.description: Ruby looks at the bunnies and then the shimmering forest before nodding firmly and striding to the mystic land.

items.name: Symbol of Wisdom
items.description: The bunnies are too short to reach the magic fruits atop the tree. Ruby stacks her books into steps. Problem solved!

items.name: Childhood Wonder Tale
items.description: Ruby rubs her eyes and remembers last night: she left footprints in every corner of the forest with her two bunny friends.

items.name: Childlike Reading
items.description: Ruby hurries and takes the book and torch out of bed, in case her mom finds out about her secret adventure!

items.name: Serene Adventure
items.description: She rarely opens herself up. Now she's passing by the garden with a frown, so anxious that the flowers shrivel.

items.name: Vivid Imagination
items.description: She reads the book until her eyelids grow heavy. Suddenly, she realizes the first words of each line form a sentence!

items.name: Breeze of Fragrance
items.description: The evening breeze shakes down a white veil of magnolia petals, filling the air with a refreshing fragrance.

items.name: Autumnal Verses
items.description: The swing slows to a stop. She picks up leaves as souvenirs for the trip, and the breeze blows like a distant dream.

items.name: Graceful Prelude
items.description: The servant prepares a table of pastries, confident it'll cheer her up. The strawberry cake is the girl's favorite!

items.name: Tea Party Daydream
items.description: The girl wakes up to a cute black toy bunny in her arms and jumps out of bed, her eyes shining with excitement.

items.name: Nebular Lullaby
items.description: 'A fun secret hides within!' the friend who gives Ruby the book says. 'Find it, and you'll get an amazing gift.'

items.name: Heart of Magnolia
items.description: The trees stretch in various forms and glow white under the moon as dewdrops shimmer on the petals.

items.name: Meadow Zephyr
items.description: Dandelion seeds drift in the golden autumn sunshine. Brushing off her dress, she sets off along a familiar trail.

items.name: Bunny's Game
items.description: But she stops by the pastry table only for a moment and apologizes to the servant. She's not in the mood for it.

items.name: Cotton Clouds
items.description: Ruby finishes her homework, changes into her pajamas, and takes a deep breath before carefully opening the book.

items.name: Moonlit Sentiments
items.description: Clouds part in the wind as the moon casts its light upon the earth, steeped in the intoxicating scent of magnolia.

items.name: Gentle Harmony
items.description: Golden leaves snap with each step, like a response to her arrival. She opens her arms to feel nature's embrace.

items.name: Glass Fairytale
items.description: The girl shuts the door and rolls in a bed of toys. Designer's Tea Party starts soon, but she hasn't decided on a theme…

items.name: Moment of Comfort
items.description: 'More fun hides in this forest. Come with us! Our adventure is just starting!' the bunnies invite her again.

items.name: Striped Quest
items.description: Ruby holds her breath and whispers, 'Shine the brightest light in the night on the book to start an adventure!'

items.name: Butterfly's Repose
items.description: As the sky clears, a butterfly perches on a branch, following the fragrance and sinking into a long dream.

items.name: Sunlit Promenade
items.description: A red-tailed squirrel curiously observes the human as she smiles. It blinks and jumps back into the bushes.

items.name: Unspoken Wish
items.description: The nervous and insecure girl fell into a dream: a black bunny salutes her in a garden with its gates ajar.

items.name: Covert Voyage
items.description: She opens the door and tells the servant outside, 'Please give me the biggest slice of strawberry cake!'

items.name: Wandering Whims
items.description: Ruby thinks for a while, scurries out of bed, finds a torch, and burrows under her blanket with the book.

items.name: Callow Journey
items.description: In quiet darkness, Ruby turns on the torch, lighting up the pages and her face. She feels the book slightly warm.

items.name: Vivid Verdure
items.description: A lively green sweeps the mountains and turns the world anew, filling each breath with infinite hope and life.

items.name: Pink Heartsong
items.description: As the fog clears, the pink-haired girl and her friends solve another puzzle hidden in time and share a smile.

items.name: Tender Breeze
items.description: Miata stayed in bed and watched the empty house, lonely and bored all day, until her parents brought her a puppet.

items.name: Wilted Dreams
items.description: The basement of the castle is quiet but exquisitely adorned. A girl slowly appears in the mirror in the dim light.

items.name: Flourishing Vines
items.description: The ancient trees whisper in the wuthering wind. In the moonlight, the little elf Lumiel walks into the woods.

items.name: Radiant Hymn
items.description: Sandra opens her eyes in dead silence and finds herself in ruins, gray sunlight slipping through her fingers.

items.name: Fading Sunset
items.description: In the breeze, flowers bloom like an unfading dream. All lives and deaths play upon the stage of endless fate.

items.name: Meadowbound Bunny
items.description: The four-leaf clover chooses a fluffy bunny as the messenger of luck. Life returns to the ground where it bounces.

items.name: Vernal Message
items.description: The breeze carries the first letter of spring in fresh blooms. The secret meadow of four-leaf clovers awaits you.

items.name: Dappled Sunshine
items.description: Clovers bask in dappled sunlight filtered through the leaves. This isn't the destination, but the beginning of luck.

items.name: Fortune Blessing
items.description: The bunny messenger hops over amidst the grass and gently drops a four-leaf clover shimmering in a visitor's palm.

items.name: Candid Expectation
items.description: As the sea waves lap the shore, the girl wishes that the world thrives with life and goodness stays forever.

items.name: Gleaming Feathers
items.description: An elf pats her on the shoulder and the world changes: a lake glimmers under the moon in the forest shrouded in mist.

items.name: Miracle Wand
items.description: In a blink, she falls into a fantasy world of desserts and candy, holding a magic wand with a glittering gem.

items.name: Dream's Shore
items.description: The lake sparkles as an iridescent gem falls into the girl's palm. It feels warm with a wondrous power.

items.name: Rosy Memories
items.description: She looks down and sees her past reflected on the water: her most treasured adventures and memories.

items.name: Innocent Prayer
items.description: Miata realized the puppet was trapped in a weak body like hers. 'Don't worry. I'll help you!' She gently hugged her.

items.name: Fingertip Healing
items.description: After waking up, Miata became more positive about treatment and started learning to fix the cracks on the puppet.

items.name: Everlasting Bond
items.description: During her treatment and study, Miata also sang, painted for the puppet, and even sewed it a dress like her own.

items.name: Lost Reminiscence
items.description: Who is Roxanne? She is smart, beautiful, elegant, and kind... The girl would use every good word on Roxanne.

items.name: Lavish Chronicle
items.description: But unlike the other marionettes, she can come here in her mind, all thanks to the wisdom of her last owner, Roxanne!

items.name: Glorious Shadow
items.description: Roxanne built this perfect living room. She'd been feeling unwell then, and this room could keep away other forces.

items.name: Era of Lost Glory
items.description: With all her love and strength, though she's gone, the mirror can still carry her will and bring her back to old times.

items.name: Elegy of Roses
items.description: The last human she knew was Roxanne. Roxanne came here every day for tea and to tell her about the outside.

items.name: Drifting Blossom Rain
items.description: Roxanne started to miss their meetings. She'd return days later and then weeks, until the girl was the only one here.

items.name: Whispered Emotion
items.description: Sometimes she feels she's heard something, a song Roxanne used to play here... Is there a ball somewhere?

items.name: Nightmarish Curse
items.description: The girl looks down at her hands. Time doesn't leave marks on her, as if the world had forgotten about her.

items.name: Aromatic Tea
items.description: She prepared a pot of scented tea as usual and waited until it went cold, but Roxanne never showed up again.

items.name: Visitor from the Wind
items.description: Lumiel's never been interested in the lake. She isn't keen on crossing its mighty owner just for its view.

items.name: Redolent Realm
items.description: No elves seem to be living here. Lumiel looks down, frustrated, when a glimmering figure appears on the lake.

items.name: Spotless Heartlight
items.description: She only remembers this magical lake in the forest after she hurt her wings and none of the healers could help her.

items.name: Echoing Expanse
items.description: Will she be rejected for coming uninvited? Lumiel enters the forest and watches the moonlight shimmer on the lake.

items.name: Floral Chapter
items.description: The figure looks kind and quiet, but Lumiel feels nervous and explains that she just wants to visit the lake's owner.

items.name: Drifting Chant
items.description: Sabrina knows all about the lake and forest but only smiles when Lumiel asks how she knew the lake's owner.

items.name: Spiraling Destiny
items.description: Sabrina's body will break soon after she leaves the lake. She looks sad for the first time when she tells Lumiel about it.

items.name: Wilted Memories
items.description: The tranquil forest rustles under silver moonlight. Sabrina's gaze is as gentle as when they first met.

items.name: Misty Waters
items.description: As the moon shines on the lake, Lumiel holds Sabrina's hand and asks, 'I'm leaving. What can I do for you?'

items.name: Turning Seasons
items.description: Maybe Sabrina also wants to leave but can only stay here day after day. The world outside is but a distant dream.

items.name: Forsaken Ground
items.description: Sandra searches the endless ruins for clues. The world around her is like a still painting, silent and lifeless.

items.name: Barren Order
items.description: On a warm afternoon, Sandra's owner brushed her hair, saying, 'Protect humans and the world, like how you protect me.'

items.name: Distant Prospect
items.description: Memories flow as Sandra remembers that even her name came from her most important owner who started it all.

items.name: Endtime Afterglow
items.description: As if freed from Pandora's box, it all flashes back to her: the promise, humans, friends... and her owner.

items.name: Glittering Feathers
items.description: The world of flowers unfolds like an anonymous gift from her, but she has yet to know her body is changing.

items.name: Prelude of Visions
items.description: Unlike other perfect 'creations', Sandra was almost recycled at first and didn't even have a consciousness.

items.name: Echoing Promise
items.description: Their promise guides Sandra again as she musters what little strength is left to nourish the lifeless world.

items.name: Faint Heartsong
items.description: Flowers bloom on the once arid ground with Sandra's care. A hope of life returns to the ravaged ruins.

items.name: Lingering Vestige
items.description: Sandra slowly understands and adapts to human life. She even keeps a flower on her desk like the other humans.

items.name: Anchored Memory
items.description: She doesn't know why humans do it, but in their history, flowers stand for life and hope. So they must be good.

items.name: Radiance of Hope
items.description: Without her owner's care, her power drained repeatedly. When she couldn't grow plants, she fell into dormancy.

items.name: Mechanical Wing
items.description: The frozen land starts to thaw as plants sprout from the soil with the hope of new life. Then, flowers begin budding.

items.name: Verdant Pinesong
items.description: The little puppet said nothing, but when Yao fixed her body again, she saw tear stains on her cheek under the moon.

items.name: Ephemeral Vision
items.description: Wei Yao had performed in many places. If plants could become spirits, it was no surprise that a puppet could too.

items.name: Operatic Verses
items.description: The clothes cheered the puppet up, but her condition worsened. Her body would break even while sitting on her seat.

items.name: Vivid Illusion
items.description: She tried to fix the puppet, but whatever she used soon wore out, so she made clothes to cheer her up.

items.name: Scent of Rosy Clouds
items.description: How hard could it be to fix a puppet? Yao put the puppet in her backpack and started traveling to find a cure.

items.name: Transient Delight
items.description: The puppet protested, 'You're not my master! Stop it! It's impossible!' Yao tapped her wooden head. 'Quiet.'

items.name: Flickering Heart
items.description: They traveled through wind and snow. The puppet complained, sharp-tongued as ever, yet slowly let her in.

items.name: Waving Blossoms
items.description: Finally, a recluse revealed the puppet was an enchanted marionette, and the cure might lie where she was born.

items.name: Dance in Harmony
items.description: The marionette murmured, 'I don't really need a new body. You'll have no friends once I'm gone. I can stay.'

items.name: Lush Greenery
items.description: Wei Yao entrusted a traveling merchant with the marionette, who held her finger and refused to say goodbye.

items.name: Rhythm of Luck
items.description: It is said a four-leaf clover shimmers with good luck. Searching for it is a chance encounter with fortune.

items.name: Iridescent Magic
items.description: On a quiet night, the book by the girl's pillow suddenly glows. She falls on gentle starlit clouds in a dream world.

items.name: Botanic Reverie
items.description: That night, Miata fell into a dream where her puppet waited quietly by a tea table surrounded by blooms.

items.name: Chilly Moonlight
items.description: Legend has it that a quiet lake lies deep in the forest, shimmering in the wind. Yet few have ever ventured there.

items.name: Bygone Haze
items.description: Maybe the world had ended as prophesied. Sandra searches her memories, finding only static.

items.name: Vernal Harmony
items.description: Miata never had any friends since she was always sick in bed, so she gladly agreed to join the special tea party.

items.name: Spectacular Night
items.description: The place is empty and the girl in the mirror clearly doesn't belong here. She looks stiff, as if not used to her body.

items.name: Sylvan Luster
items.description: The little elf has heard many tales about the lake. Some say it belonged to a powerful elf and can restore everything.

items.name: Emerging Clouds
items.description: Her body neared collapse from immense power. Yao made her one last outfit and took her to the garden.

items.name: Mistbound Sorrow
items.description: She sighs in relief after checking her impeccable smile, then straightens the flowers in her hair and brushes her hem.

items.name: Blooms of Yesterday
items.description: It was a fine day, so Yao decided to drag the wooden box she got from the pawnshop out of her warehouse.

items.name: Netherworld Dance
items.description: She holds a new cup of tea and feels a numbing heat. She can't help but wonder: Will Roxanne come today?

items.name: Dazzling Blossoms
items.description: She regretted it right after paying. The box seemed old and not valuable at all. She opened it nonchalantly.

items.name: Rustling Leaves
items.description: New leaves dance in green waves in the breeze, exchanging secrets and whispers in the endless rustles.

items.name: Untainted Wish
items.description: She ascends the cloud stairway step by step and opens the door of mysteries into the salty sea breeze on a beach.

items.name: Unmatched Bonds
items.description: Miata and the puppet tasted desserts amidst the flowers and shared their secrets. Friendship bloomed soon.

items.name: Lightless Dawn
items.description: When was the last time she saw Roxanne? A week ago, a month, or before that? Isn't she a little too late?

items.name: Splendid Sparkle
items.description: Sabrina tells Lumiel to come by when it's the full moon, for the moonlight imbues the water with the power to heal elves.

items.name: Silent Watch
items.description: Data damaged. Memory lost. What remains in her soul is the promise of a reunion, but who promised it to her?

items.name: Wilderness Wander
items.description: The wind from afar brushes her skin as her body slowly merges with the world. She feels it but doesn't panic.

items.name: Sylvan Wonder
items.description: Follow it all the way to the end of the meadow to witness a miracle: countless four-leaf clovers sway in the wind.

items.name: Dreamward Journey
items.description: The girl gazes as the sea glitters in a dreamlike pink hue at sunset, and ocean waves and seagulls sing a cheerful song.

items.name: Etched Memento
items.description: Miata noticed the cracks in the puppet. It couldn't leave the garden, run or laugh, but only sit quietly at the table.

items.name: Silenced Moments
items.description: The light flickers with the girl's silhouette. A mysterious force brought her here, maybe as a miracle, or a curse.

items.name: Floral Pursuit
items.description: As Lumiel's wings heal day by day, she talks to Sabrina and learns she has been here all along for the lake's power, too.

items.name: Lingering Crimson
items.description: She looked at the battered puppet who suddenly shook her head and said, 'I'm not a puppet. I'm a marionette!'

items.name: Eternal Pact
items.description: Her body sleeps in a distant monastery in Lilith, like many other marionettes, only alive thanks to the magic powers there.

items.name: Dreamlike Serenity
items.description: Maybe she's the owner of the lake? Basking in silver moonlight, she smiles kindly at Lumiel with a gentle gaze.

items.name: Moonrise Elegy
items.description: One day, Sandra suddenly feels the world is too empty and lifeless. Humans can't live in a world like this.

items.name: Mortal Ordeal
items.description: She pieced together the puppet's body and sank into thought. What's a marionette? A puppet spirit, maybe.

items.name: Redolent Heartspring
items.description: The elf leaves, determined to find the lake's owner for Sabrina. She spreads her wings and soars into the night.

items.name: Adrift Springlight
items.description: A new day comes, and Sandra starts sowing hope again. She repeats it day by day until color returns to the world.

items.name: Ephemeral Mirage
items.description: Was Wei Yao her owner? The little marionette didn't know. Maybe she can ask her when they reunited.

items.name: Mirrorborne Splendor
items.description: Time seems endless. Roxanne has never come for another dance. Luckily, she's been growing stronger lately.

items.name: Whitemoon Reverie
items.description: Trixie was well-known on this street. She was elegant, beautiful, but naughty. Every day, she proudly patrolled her turf.

items.name: Focused Listening
items.description: The nun opened a hospital. Trixie had learned enough to understand how patients were invited for treatment.

items.name: Misty Gloom
items.description: She saw a nun who found the flute that was always playing in the attic. No one had heard the sound before Trixie did.

items.name: Hushed Mystery
items.description: They lay in black boxes underground that Trixie thought only the dead slept in. The good news is that they live long.

items.name: Fated Capture
items.description: She saw the patient wrapped in a black dress. She was so sick that she could barely walk down to the basement.

items.name: Surreal Scheme
items.description: She saw a magician walk in and the flute say something to him. After a power surge, he left a toy and stormed out.

items.name: Reality in Haze
items.description: Trixie grew tired of the servant changing every few decades. She shook her tail and gazed at the moon.

items.name: Black Cat's Game
items.description: A brown-haired girl picked up the toy. Wasn't it a royal possession? But the cat queen allowed it, seeing her worry.

items.name: Black Cat's Prank
items.description: A pink-haired girl left behind a ruby. Trixie looked closer and felt the flute sound become slower and gentler...

items.name: Summoned Covenant
items.description: The cats avoided humans in all conflicts, while hunters dared not enter the monastery and waited outside.

items.name: Soundless Chase
items.description: But her allies and hunters disappeared one by one. Trixie's memories became hazy. She felt something was off.

items.name: Urban Stealth
items.description: Trixie saw many young nuns and watched them grow old and then meet their end. She looked up at the moon.

items.name: Troubling Chatters
items.description: The other cats didn't like her, but she had a loyal servant: an old nun who was her housekeeper, chef, and doctor.

items.name: The Cat's Tea Party
items.description: Trixie pulled pranks and was most proud that she stole a gem ring of power and wealth from the white cat.

items.name: Charming Trickery
items.description: The old nun wept when she gave her the ring. The monastery was saved from being torn down by the lord.

items.name: Nocturnal Stealth
items.description: She became the rich cat queen of the monastery, with soft beds, countless toys, and dozens of loyal servants.

items.name: Devious Poise
items.description: The white cat sent hunters after her, but who cares? Trixie stretches in the sun as maids prepare her desserts.

items.name: Sunlit Puppet Dream
items.description: Years later, the recovered girl returned to her dream garden, where the puppet with no more cracks smiled at her.

items.name: Sunlit Puppet Venture
items.description: Years of love and companionship filled the puppet's cracks and Miata's heart. Together they ambled in the flowers.

items.name: Tender Reverie
items.description: The girl remembers dancing with Roxanne years ago, their skirts unfolding like slowly blooming flowers.

items.name: Undying Vines
items.description: Her gaze drifts away with memories as she whispers, 'If you see the lake's owner, thank him... and say hi for me.'

items.name: Gilded Prayer
items.description: Someone is brushing her hair in her dreams. Her owner? Sandra tries to catch his hand, but wakes up to sunlight.

items.name: Eternal Moonlight
items.description: As the convoy traveled closer to her birthplace, she hid the clothes Wei Yao made for her, lost in confusion.

items.name: Shining Guardian
items.description: Her friends smile as she casts her own magic: a melody of happiness sounds as balloons and ribbons sway in the wind.

items.name: Covert Conjuring
items.description: They bided their time and swarmed in when Trixie left the kingdom. Luckily, she had many allies helping her.

items.name: Silent Pursuit
items.description: Trixie had been in the monastery for too long. She saw the deaths of the white cat and the old nun in her memories.

items.name: Urban Dive
items.description: In those memories, she saw too many forgotten visions. Stories gently flowed in like a bubbling stream.

items.name: Windswept Plume
items.description: Her owner insisted on keeping her. At first, Sandra often malfunctioned, which was quite a headache for her owner.

items.name: Finale of Visions
items.description: In the wind's whispers, Sandra hugs herself and recalls their promise, waiting for the world to rejoice again.

items.name: Mechanical Dreamwing
items.description: The past is so vivid in dreams, where people talk and laugh in a world so alive that she feels happy only watching it.

items.name: Lingering Longing
items.description: Wei Yao said nothing and refastened her falling parts. She bid farewell to her and promised they'd meet again.

items.name: Sky of Rosy Clouds
items.description: After that, Wei Yao wrote a new story about a young ranger and a living puppet who adventured together.

items.name: Worldly Shelter
items.description: A poem reads: Broken hearts find solace in fate's design. All are but passing guests through trials of time.

items.name: Roseate Murmur
items.description: The damage to her marionette body heals slowly. Now she has more time to wait for Roxanne and tell her off.

items.name: Dance of Eternity
items.description: She'll ask Roxanne to host a grand, perfect ball with roses and music, meant only for the two of them forever.

items.name: Midnight Drift
items.description: Trixie fell asleep to the sound of the flute. A special night, she thought. I'll wake early tomorrow for more fun.

items.name: Shimmering Glimpse
items.description: When the sunlight slowly skims over the garden where dewdrops roll down and flowers bud, Daisy wakes up.

items.name: Ethereal Ballad
items.description: Thunder broke the peace at sunset. Shalom remembered the flowers she had left drying and rushed out.

items.name: Mellow Meadow
items.description: The breeze carries flowers toward the horizon. Tawny runs down country trails as grass brushes against her ankles.

items.name: Perceptive Touch
items.description: Daisy can sense the weakest life and capture the smallest change in plants. She tends every plant in the garden.

items.name: Radiant Rebirth
items.description: Her friend, a quiet marionette, has a simpler task. She strolls around and decides what to plant where.

items.name: Wilting Rhymes
items.description: Daisy gradually grows curious and starts to speculate. Her friend's identity doesn't seem so simple.

items.name: Fragrant Memento
items.description: The look of joy flashed across her face when she saw Shalom. She explained sincerely that she was a marionette.

items.name: Spotless Wonder
items.description: Her grandma once told her a fairytale about a marionette who had a pure soul and was a girl's best playmate.

items.name: Mellow Hope
items.description: Shalom brought the marionette home. The garden basked in the moonlight and flowers danced for the guest.

items.name: Sunshine Whisper
items.description: Tawny is different. Like a fish returning to water, she preferred the countryside breeze to the dull city life.

items.name: Poetic Aroma
items.description: Her parents don't have time for her. Only the marionette who once tutored her mother is her most reliable companion.

items.name: Sheltered Memory
items.description: The marionette has been with her since she could remember. This tutor's greatest ability is to make her feel safe.

items.name: Romantic Chords
items.description: The marionette catches up soon despite her unhurried pace. Tawny turns around and throws herself into her arms.

items.name: Windswept Garden
items.description: Tawny doesn't know her much and wonders if she can make wilted flowers bloom again or talk to birds.

items.name: Kindred Blossom
items.description: The rain started pouring, and then she saw a strange girl at the corner, drenched and curled under the eaves.

items.name: Permeating Aroma
items.description: As sparrows chirp beneath the azure sky, Tawny looks back and waves at the figure strolling behind. 'Come here!'

items.name: Distant Frostnight
items.description: Daisy has a colleague who has long lived with her in the vast garden. They both serve the garden's owner.

items.name: Unfurling Whispers
items.description: Half human and half elf, Daisy has an affinity with plants, while her coworker is a marionette blessed with life.

items.name: Empty Chronicle
items.description: Daisy is frustrated with human servants' fleeting existence. Only the marionette shares with her a similar span of life.

items.name: Fluttering Petals
items.description: Shalom didn't want trouble, but worried the girl needed help. At least I should leave an umbrella, she thought.

items.name: Serene Hedge
items.description: The elegant tutor smiles as her eyes curve into crescents and says gently, 'Slow down. Don't fall.'

items.name: Silent Company
items.description: Time flies by. They watch flowers bloom and wither like two giant trees standing together through rain and shine.

items.name: Timeworn Traces
items.description: Shalom was startled to see the body twisted at an uncanny angle, its fingers marked with a dappled wooden texture.

items.name: Tranquil Dawn
items.description: Her family moved to the countryside after her father offended a noble. Her parents shut themselves in all day.

items.name: Ethereal Ballad - Sunny
items.description: The dampness after rain drained the magic in her, but she couldn't feel it, fully captivated by the starlit flowers.

items.name: Mellow Meadow - Weave
items.description: Her mother came from a family of marionette makers, but never spoke of the tutor's origin despite her curiosity.

items.name: Perceptive Touch - Decay
items.description: So, she whispered to the marionette, 'I don't think you're a servant.' Seeing her surprised eyes, she smiled smugly.

items.name: Radiant Rebirth - Decay
items.description: The marionette blushed, her eyes wide. Instead of answering, she lowered her head and fussed over her dress.

items.name: Wilting Rhymes - Decay
items.description: Daisy didn't push further. Since then, they've been tending the thriving garden together with a shared secret.

items.name: Fragrant Memento - Sunny
items.description: She didn't notice the passing of time until the magic in her stagnated, so she decided to say goodbye to her friend.

items.name: Spotless Wonder - Sunny
items.description: The marionette finally found the old sea of flowers, but her friend was gone. She'd withered too, leaving only a seed.

items.name: Mellow Hope - Sunny
items.description: The next morning, only a photo was left on the table: the marionette and the girl in a sea of flowers under the stars.

items.name: Sunshine Whisper - Weave
items.description: She clears her throat. 'I've got a present for you, tutor!' Tawny's heart feels ready to burst in her chest.

items.name: Poetic Aroma - Weave
items.description: A mannequin stands in the room with an elegant dress, adorned with flowers blooming in the countryside.

items.name: Sheltered Memory - Weave
items.description: 'I made it myself!' Tawny blushes and gazes at the tutor in anticipation, fully sincere. 'Do you like it?'

items.name: Romantic Chords - Weave
items.description: The marionette clearly wasn't expecting it. After a long pause, she steps forward and hugs the girl. 'Thank you, Tawny.'

items.name: Windswept Garden - Weave
items.description: Tawny designed, drew, and sewed each flower with care, leaving a bloom of splendor upon the dress for her tutor.

items.name: Kindred Blossom - Sunny
items.description: Shalom didn't know how to treat the unusual guest. She paced outside with cake and water until she noticed her.

items.name: Permeating Aroma - Weave
items.description: The marionette had a far longer history and seemed to have accompanied her mother through a youth like her own.

items.name: Distant Frostnight - Decay
items.description: The marionette is mostly quiet, but her emotionless eyes always light up with joy when she sees beautiful plants.

items.name: Unfurling Whispers - Decay
items.description: Like a sunflower chasing light, she likes the warm sun and often faces it up to feel the sun's touch with a happy smile.

items.name: Empty Chronicle - Decay
items.description: She sits by the window when it rains, listens to the pitter-patter on the leaves, and shakes her legs to the beat.

items.name: Fluttering Petals - Sunny
items.description: 'Thank you for the food. If you don't mind, may I tell you a story?' Hearing it, Shalom nodded with a smile.

items.name: Serene Hedge - Weave
items.description: She taught Mother to read and write, too. Mother must've been easier to care for, quiet and reserved, unlike me.

items.name: Silent Company - Decay
items.description: The garden feels like a gift, plants tailored to the marionette's tastes. Daisy thinks this may be the answer.

items.name: Timeworn Traces - Sunny
items.description: A lost marionette was taken in by a girl. They became friends and shared days of joy, until her master took her back.

items.name: Tranquil Dawn - Weave
items.description: Tawny leads the tutor by the hand to a cabin, mysteriously opens the door, and turns around with a bright smile.

items.name: Endless Golden Sands
items.description: When travelers lose their way in the desert at night, Atina would show up with a lantern of stars to guide them.

items.name: Moonlit Promise
items.description: As a child, Princess Yongan often fell ill. Her mother would always pray, 'May the Goddess bless my daughter.'

items.name: Solar Brilliance
items.description: Alia grew up behind palace walls and manicured hedges, yet her eyes always drifted to the doves soaring above.

items.name: Silver Night Plume
items.description: She and her lover longed for the view beyond the sand blessed by the stars, but a sandstorm broke their dream.

items.name: Lantern of Starlight
items.description: The travelers' look of gratitude moved Atina. Even the light in her hand seemed to glow brighter with it.

items.name: Gleaming Moonlight
items.description: The storm ceased. Atina opened her eyes to an empty expanse and wailed as she helplessly searched the silent sand.

items.name: Sand Sea Chimes
items.description: But she never saw her lover again. One day, she met a traveler lost at night and immediately offered help.

items.name: Dreamseeker's Path
items.description: Atina didn't believe her lover was gone and searched the sand day and night, hoping her lover would find a way back.

items.name: Moonlit Glamor
items.description: They restored peace on the border. As the crowds cheered on their return, she reached for the jade that wasn't there.

items.name: Jadelit Radiance
items.description: In an important battle, she was trapped in enemy ranks due to false information, and an arrow aimed at her heart.

items.name: Sunken Moonlight
items.description: At the last moment, a white light burst from her chest and broke the arrow. The jade at her chest crumbled into dust.

items.name: Silken Crescent
items.description: In her dream, armies gathered beneath a sea of fluttering banners. She stood in armor as the woman fastened her helm.

items.name: Pellucid Chime
items.description: The woman wished her a triumphant return and vanished. When Yongan awoke, the jade charm was aglow.

items.name: Pristine Jade
items.description: The jade dimmed by the day from rich green to murky gray. She worried but couldn't spare a thought amidst the war.

items.name: Windborne Clouds
items.description: For years, Yongan led her army across the country and always turned the tide in the end, as if protected by a higher force.

items.name: Supreme Authority
items.description: Alia didn't know what to do when the heavy crown settled on her head, marking the end of her carefree days.

items.name: Divine Edict
items.description: Alia entered her sister's study and learned to manage state affairs, finding it far harder than riding or fencing.

items.name: Stairs of Coronation
items.description: Even the closest sisters drift apart. To Alia, her once kind and patient sister became a graceful, distant heir.

items.name: Cosmic Brilliance
items.description: With the outbreak of war came news that her sister had fallen in battle. Then, Alia was made the new crown princess.

items.name: Glorious Crown
items.description: Alia was surprised to see simple notes written all over her sister's books, which enlightened her with just a few words.

items.name: Pearly Yesterdays
items.description: She remembered when she'd come here to play with her sister, who'd hold her and teach her to read every word.
