items.name: Effulgent Nights
items.description: Since then, Alia seemed like a different person. She stopped attending lavish balls and drifted apart from her friends.

items.name: Transient Mirage
items.description: The past and present meet in this moment. Even time can't take away what has become a part of life.

items.name: Scroll of Splendor
items.description: Alia learned to discuss and issue policies and earned the people's trust. Bards wrote songs to praise her.

items.name: Royal Principle
items.description: Her behavior was impeccable in front of everyone. The tutor praised her, saying Alia grew more like her sister.

items.name: Scarlet Paean
items.description: Alia ascended the steps to the throne when she suddenly thought of her sister amidst the somber music and cheers.

items.name: Majestic Grandeur
items.description: Alia studied her notes over countless nights, as if following her sister's footsteps in the snow when they were young.

items.name: Drifting Starlight
items.description: Atina the Star Priest holds a lantern of blessed stardust that shines for eternity, even in the darkest night.

items.name: Starlit Twilight
items.description: Whether they're starving, in danger, or shivering in the cold, there's hope as long as they see the lantern of stars.

items.name: Pristine Moonbloom
items.description: She told Yongan that she was born in the jade, blessed by the moon, and awakened by her mother's love for her.

items.name: Aureate Oath
items.description: Like other young royals, Alia liked horse riding and fencing, enjoyed music, and squandered her time at balls.

items.name: Aureate Reign
items.description: The kingdom basks in golden sunshine as doves soar into the sky. This is what Alia and her sister guard with their lives.

items.name: Astral Mantle
items.description: After dark, Atina would set out with her light and feel the wind lash against her cheeks as her hair shimmered gold.

items.name: Luminous Heartglow
items.description: Travelers came and went in the desert, and Atina's name spread among them. Some called her the Lantern Goddess.

items.name: Sparkling Wish
items.description: At seven, Yongan received a jade charm before her mother departed for war. A Queen of the Night was carved into it.

items.name: Reminiscent Echo
items.description: People thought Alia was nothing like her sister, the heir bound by strict rules and rarely smiling.

items.name: Unstained Spirit
items.description: Yongan couldn't see her mother much since the war broke out, but a woman always kept her company in her dreams.

items.name: Moon Palace Dream
items.description: Excelled in strategy and archery as a youth, she volunteered to lead the army when unrest returned to the border.

items.name: Gilded Branches
items.description: Atina walked over dunes and didn't miss a single sound. The starlight in the lantern glowed like a beacon of hope.

items.name: Radiant March
items.description: There was an open and flat cliff in the desert that basked in starlight, where one could sleep beside the stars.

items.name: Celestial Snowfall
items.description: She caressed the jade and fell asleep before leaving for war. As the jade glowed, she fell into a different dream.

items.name: Tides of Splendor
items.description: To Alia, her sister's life was trimmed like the royal garden, orderly but dull. She wondered how she had endured it.

items.name: Frostbound Grace
items.description: With the woman by her side, Yongan always felt safe. She slowly recovered and resumed sword practice.

items.name: Prosperous Reign
items.description: She remembered another side of her sister, who taught her riding and galloped with her across open fields.

items.name: Aureate Adventure
items.description: Her light guided travelers lost in the desert. She still looked for her lover, but no longer traveled only for that.

items.name: Flowing Moonlight
items.description: Yongan ascended the throne after her mother's death. That night, the woman came to her, glowing like a goddess.

items.name: Night of Starlight
items.description: Atina woke from her dreams in tears to a dark expanse of sand. She wiped her tears and walked into the night.

items.name: Eternal Sentry
items.description: Her lantern glowed brighter by the day. People would see the reassuring light from far across the dunes.

items.name: Frostwoven Veil
items.description: Yongan watched as the woman faded into light, like the moonlight on the night before her mother left for war.

items.name: Dreambound Chimes
items.description: 'I should go now.' The woman sighed at dawn and brushed the new empress's hair. 'Good girl, you've grown up.'

items.name: Ode to Return
items.description: Atina felt a pat on her shoulder and recognized the person in one glance. She opened her arms to hold her lover.

items.name: Hazel Fantasy
items.description: Lilico took over her grandma's bakery. Every morning, a rich fragrance wafts out, awakening the street.

items.name: Illusory Years
items.description: Gilda stared out of her window at the trees and blue sky. They became her only memory of the outside world.

items.name: Dreamlike Time
items.description: A secret was revealed in an interview: the composer of all these sea songs had never actually seen the sea.

items.name: Chestnut Voyage
items.description: One night, Lilico was half asleep when she heard a small voice anxiously calling to her, 'Lilico! Lilico! I'm here to help!'

items.name: Gourmet Overload
items.description: The wind chime rings whenever a customer comes in. Most of these regulars have watched Lilico grow up.

items.name: Choco Memory
items.description: 'A good mood matters most in a bakery!' the small voice said firmly. Lilico remembered it even after waking up.

items.name: Whimsical Baking
items.description: 'Your grandma always hummed while working the dough.' Aunt Martha said, 'Her smile would cheer me up, too.'

items.name: Delightful Promise
items.description: The old mailman pats Lilico on the head. 'Follow that voice in you. A happy Lilico can do anything she wants.'

items.name: Ardent Trace
items.description: Lilico tries to hum her grandma's favorite tune as the dough softens, filling her mind with joy and happiness.

items.name: Redolent Moment
items.description: Lilico picks up a freshly baked chestnut bun, and Aunt Martha's daughter cheers. 'It's like the one Mom used to buy!'

items.name: Sparkling Parade
items.description: Later, the lonely girl met a new friend, an adventurer. This town was only a stop on her long journey.

items.name: Tidal Echo
items.description: 'What's the real sea like?' Gilda poured her passionate and hopeful imagination into heart-warming songs.

items.name: Cloudless Azure
items.description: The sun shone on the piano like a bright dream. Leaping notes formed a tune. It was her best imagination of the world.

items.name: Galactic Brilliance
items.description: They became close friends over a few days. The adventurer told Gilda amazing stories of a world she'd never seen.

items.name: Starry Serenity
items.description: Gilda accepted the gift as if it were a letter from the sea. She put the conch to her ear, hearing the sea's whisper.

items.name: Surging Echo
items.description: Her songs were spread to a wider audience. The listeners were touched and felt the author's deep love for the sea.

items.name: Misty Serenity
items.description: At this moment, the sound of the tide merged with colorful fantasies. The conch glittered like a dream.

items.name: Bygone Seafoam
items.description: After seeing her friend off, Gilda wrote a song. Musical notes leapt like sea waves in a kaleidoscope of dreams.

items.name: Sincere Serenade
items.description: Before her friend flew away on another journey, she gave Gilda a gift: a white conch with an iridescent sheen.

items.name: Serene Cosmos
items.description: The sea was an endless blue, more vast than Gilda imagined. Waves rolled in and broke into white froth by their feet.

items.name: Wandering Stars
items.description: Gilda shared a smile with her friend at the seashore. The rushing waves sounded like the conch she once heard.

items.name: Chestnut Daydream
items.description: The little bakery is packed with customers. Lilico finally smiles as she watches everyone share fresh bread.

items.name: Chestnut Whisper
items.description: Lilico twirls around after closing the shop, and the chestnut toy she made with her grandma twitched behind her.

items.name: Azure Reverie
items.description: Unlike her peers, who traveled in groups, Gilda seldom left the house and had to rest at home due to her illness.

items.name: Sapphire Tide Song
items.description: The adventurer took a look at her checklist. She hadn't completed a top priority: take her friend to the sea!

items.name: Sapphire Overture
items.description: They arrived at the shore on an early morning after a long trip. The fog was clearing as seagulls hovered above.

items.name: Shimmering Waves
items.description: Gilda would often read travel journals and trace the shores in the pictures, imagining the feel of a sea breeze.

items.name: Baking Secret
items.description: The plump chestnut bun was her grandma's signature and holds the town's fond, delicious memories.

items.name: Comforting Promise
items.description: Lilico fails to recreate the exact taste however she tries. Her chestnut bun lacks the special sweetness she loves.

items.name: Creamy Caramel
items.description: What went wrong? The rising time or oven temperature? Lilico sighs, still not finding the answer yet.

items.name: Enduring Tenderness
items.description: From then on, Gilda wrote many songs about the sea, some like fog blanketing the waters, others like ocean waves.

items.name: Hazelnut Affection
items.description: Lilico attempts to knead the dough like her grandma used to do, confused and frustrated.

items.name: Eternal Stanza
items.description: She loved the sea. It was always a deep blue expanse with waves lapping the shore and sails drifting like doves.

items.name: Twilight Aria
items.description: No gorgeous views of the sunset could distract Claire, not the rosy clouds, shimmering sea, or sparkling beach.

items.name: Seafoam Whispers
items.description: Hanna recalled her route: palm trees, beach chairs, an ice cream truck. The beach was her last stop in the search.

items.name: Coastal Search
items.description: Claire patted Hanna on the shoulder and helped her recall where she'd been. 'I'll help you find it. We'll get it back.'

items.name: Iridescent Vision
items.description: The beach was dyed orange as the sun sank lazily below the horizon. The girls searched every corner of the beach.

items.name: Sweet Star Wish
items.description: Claire blinked her sore eyes and suddenly caught a sparkle in the sand. She rushed over. '...Hanna! Come over here!'

items.name: Dreamweaving Shovel
items.description: Claire waved goodbye to Hanna in the moonlight. Next morning, Claire found a few sparkling shells on her front steps.

items.name: Midsummer Trend
items.description: She gazed at the shells, their prismatic colors shifting in the sunshine like a dazzling kaleidoscope.

items.name: Seashore Fantasy
items.description: An anxious-looking girl was searching around and whispering to herself. Claire waved at her and walked over.

items.name: Seashell Hunt
items.description: Claire learned that the girl named Hanna had lost a bracelet here and had been retracing her steps to look for it.

items.name: Estival Breeze
items.description: Marina loves music and always hears notes leaping in her mind. They form lines and weave into melodies.

items.name: True Meowsic
items.description: A yellow-caped cat and his best friend pass by as the breeze carries her hum to them. 'Meowza! This is true meowsic!'

items.name: Sapphire Bayside
items.description: Marina was so engrossed in the music that when she realized it, the bus was already slowing to the terminal stop.

items.name: Unbound Soaring
items.description: Marina had to get off the bus and wait for the one home. Then she glimpsed a clear, unclouded stretch of azure sky.

items.name: Chorus of Freedom
items.description: It's a harbor at the edge of the city, where seagulls hover over the azure ocean. Marina slowly took in the view.

items.name: Azure Moment
items.description: Sea waves and birds sang a chorus of nature, finally soothing Marina's nerves after days of anxiety.

items.name: Impromptu Journey
items.description: Marina put on her earphones and played the unfinished song. The sound of ocean waves brought her inspiration.

items.name: Summer Seagull Song
items.description: In the contest, Marina sang her new song about the ocean and freedom while her friends accompanied her.

items.name: Sunlit Ripples
items.description: Marina formed a band with her friends at school, who encouraged her to write down melodies in her mind and sing.

items.name: Lilting Tune
items.description: The school was holding a music contest soon, so Marina's band decided to sign up and write a new song for it.

items.name: Rhythm of Inspiration
items.description: Unexpectedly, Marina hit a writer's block. She looked for inspiration and only came up with a mediocre melody.

items.name: Footprints of Youth
items.description: Her friends cheered her up, but their expectation weighed down on her. Writing music became a burden for her.

items.name: Shimmering Glimpse - Decay
items.description: Daisy took a long time to verify her guess. She watched the marionette the way she watched the plants every day.

items.name: Summer Tide Song
items.description: People say it's a special song. When it plays, you'd see an endless ocean with hovering seagulls in a summer breeze.

items.name: Mountain Morning Mist
items.description: 'Summer is perfect for travel!' Before the morning mist fades, Nicole arrives at the inn with stunning seaside views.

items.name: Luscious Time
items.description: Click and refresh. Three, two, one, order! 'Congrats! You've ordered the limited winter sweets box from Chocolove!'

items.name: Cheery Rhythm
items.description: In the sudden rain, Aya enters the grocery store she often visits, waves at the clerk, and heads for the drinks.

items.name: Perpetual Peace
items.description: The empress reigned for sixty years and created an era of peace and prosperity with remarkable achievements.

items.name: Roseate Spiral
items.description: An anonymous design contest is in full swing in Apple Federation. Some of the best works are trending online.

items.name: Peaceful Night
items.description: 'Nicole, let's catch fireflies!' Following her friend's playful idea, she enjoys a summer night aglow with lights.

items.name: Lemon-Kissed Summer
items.description: 'What a cute bag! Is it a dumpling?' 'It's a lemon! See the leaves on it?' 'Either way, it's adorable!'

items.name: Vanilla Lemon Dream
items.description: Lemon, vanilla, milkshake... Nicole instantly falls for this ice cream. Its cool sweetness refreshes the summer heat.

items.name: Lemon-Scented Encounter
items.description: 'Make a wish!' A meteor streaks across the sky. Nicole closes her eyes, hoping for a romantic encounter someday.

items.name: Lovely Encounter
items.description: The fireworks festival never disappoints. Though fleeting, each brilliant bloom leaves a lasting memory in every heart.

items.name: Gentle Sea Breeze
items.description: At a seaside inn, Nicole gazes at the stars beyond the glass roof. The soothing waves lull her into a dream.

items.name: Full of Sweetness
items.description: '5-star donut!' she praises. 'The cheese cream helps balance the bitterness of the unique dark chocolate. Yum!'

items.name: Starry Candy
items.description: Sylvette tries the chocolate biscuit stick, caramel toast, cinnamon roll, and votes the biscuit stick as the best.

items.name: Circle of Wonder
items.description: 'Thanks for watching my review! Chocolove is a great independent brand. Support them if you're interested!'

items.name: Perfect Palate
items.description: 'Mossia is a genius baker!' Sylvette says sincerely. 'You feel rich and powerful emotions when you taste her works.'

items.name: Sugar Hooks
items.description: Chocolove sells out after Sylvette's video. For the first time, Mossia shares her inspirations on camera.

items.name: Scrumptious Jam
items.description: 'My ideas came from my memories of home.' She smiles. 'I hope Chocolove reminds you of the tastes of Wasteland.'

items.name: Colorful Sucrose
items.description: After filming, Sylvette takes out the sweets from the gift box. She usually shares them with her neighbors.

items.name: Quirky Inspiration
items.description: In the humid wind, Aya hums off-key and heads home with a shopping bag. Something good's about to happen!

items.name: Casual Charm
items.description: Aya feels a pat and turns to see her friend back from her trip! Dragging a suitcase, she makes a silly face at Aya.

items.name: Free Imagination
items.description: Her friend came back early just to fulfill Aya's small wish—to watch the fireworks show tomorrow with her best friend.

items.name: Future Course
items.description: They talk and laugh until Aya suddenly thinks of something and opens her bag, revealing two bottles of seltzer.

items.name: Striped Impression
items.description: Puddles still dot the road, and leaves glisten with fine droplets. The girls skip along hand in hand, laughing as they go.

items.name: Eternal Serenity
items.description: The world had faded behind her. Ahead stood a graceful girl, her robes drifting as if she might ride the wind away.

items.name: Gilded Palace Screen
items.description: The young empress followed the song into a jade palace where phoenixes danced to celestial music.

items.name: Ethereal Haze
items.description: The girl was playing the sheng in an ethereal halo. Her lips curved in a smile when she saw the young empress.

items.name: Phoenix Chirp
items.description: The young empress sat by the girl as the music cleared her mind of all worries: war on the borders and court disputes.

items.name: Celestial Harmony
items.description: In the lingering music, the young empress curled before the jade stairs and fell soundly asleep.

items.name: Luminous Cloudveil
items.description: Whenever the empress lost her sleep, the ethereal music would play, guiding her to dreams in the jade palace.

items.name: Heaven-Crafted Jade
items.description: The sun woke the young empress. She realized she had been sleeping in her own bed and finally felt refreshed.

items.name: Lucid Spirit
items.description: The once lost young empress learned to handle state affairs and gradually took on a fitting air of majesty.

items.name: Lilting Sheng Tune
items.description: The music faded as the empress no longer lost sleep, the songs now only a distant dream to her.

items.name: Purehearted Note
items.description: 'A string of brown footprints was left on the floor. As I wiped them away, I realized they looked like latte art.'

items.name: Tender Inspiration
items.description: 'I got the idea for the backpack from a claw machine. He clung to it and stared at the toys, his tail swaying happily.'

items.name: Furtastic Party
items.description: 'Fluffy kittens were lined up in the claw machine as if in a welcoming queue. Some resembled him on a closer look.'

items.name: Purrfect Delight
items.description: 'We put in coin after coin and finally got the one we wanted. We shared a glance and laughed together.'

items.name: Sweet Getaway
items.description: At a seaside café, colorful treats line the shelves. As golden wind chimes ring softly, Nicole steps into a magical world.

items.name: Cartful of Sweetness
items.description: Sylvette watches the interview as the girl introduces her brand with a warm smile. Wait, isn't that her new neighbor?!

items.name: Sweetheart Shopper
items.description: The bell rings. Mossia leans on the door frame and winks at Sylvette. 'I'm trying a new recipe. Wanna try?'

items.name: Rejoicing Youth
items.description: The glass door reflects the girl's damp hair and glistening eyes, but this small hiccup hasn't ruined her mood.

items.name: Meowgical Companion
items.description: The designer wrote at the end that her companion turned the most ordinary moments into precious inspirations.

items.name: Wondrous Companion
items.description: The letter moved many people, who shared pictures of their cats and heartwarming moments of their own.

items.name: Candied Trap
items.description: As a dessert reviewer, Sylvette never misses the release of any new sweet pastry and always orders right away.

items.name: Peachy Mood
items.description: Aya runs her fingers along the bottles and stops at one. It's her best friend's favorite seltzer.

items.name: Wind-Kissed Verdure
items.description: The aged empress fell into a daze when a sudden ethereal song played, reminding her of a forgotten memory.

items.name: Ribbon Wonder
items.description: A cute cat-themed outfit emerges from the fierce competition and captures all judges' hearts with its fluffy charm.

items.name: Fondant Clash
items.description: Sylvette loves Chocolove. Its creator Mossia is from Wasteland and has unique visions in every design.

items.name: Beyond Azure Skies
items.description: The empress was crowned young. Complex state affairs, both within and beyond the court, kept her up at night.

items.name: Sheng Tune Prelude
items.description: Decades passed in peace as the empress's hair turned gray. She knew her fate as the familiar music played.

items.name: Ethereal Elegance
items.description: She closed her eyes with a serene, hopeful smile, having fulfilled her duty and finally come to rest.

items.name: Meowgical Melody
items.description: The outfit as expected wins the contest. As per the rules, the winner must share their inspiration.

items.name: Candy Fairytale
items.description: 'Ding-dong! Fresh sweets delivered!' She sets up the cameras, unboxes the package, and starts Episode 36!

items.name: Melodic Guidance
items.description: One night, the young empress tossed and turned when she heard a familiar, soothing lilt like a babbling spring.

items.name: Dreambound Encounter
items.description: As the clouds parted in an ethereal melody, the girl reached out to the empress, guiding her beyond.

items.name: Berry Frosting
items.description: Under the limelight, the host opens the winner's letter that tells the story of a girl and her cat in a yellow cape.

items.name: Chantilly Blend
items.description: 'It's Sylvette's Sweet Hour! Today I'm trying the winter-exclusive box from Chocolove. Let's get started!'

items.name: Sunshine Memories
items.description: 'Refreshing mint mixed with sweet peach… one sip can brighten your day,' her best friend used to say to Aya.

items.name: Trail of Pawprints
items.description: 'The idea for the coat came from one morning when I made myself a cappuccino and asked him to behave.'

items.name: Seaside Wander
items.description: The sand is soft beneath her feet, and seashells shimmer faintly. Nicole pauses to admire the world bathed in sunset.

items.name: Frosting Glee
items.description: The first is a special donut. One bite, and the mixed smell of dark chocolate and cheese fills her with happiness.

items.name: Gleeful Pace
items.description: On a sudden impulse, Aya buys two bottles. The rain stops, and the sun breaks through the clouds again.

items.name: Moonward Stride
items.description: She was so transfixed by the heavenly tune that she stood up and followed it barefoot outside her palace.

items.name: Pounceful Memories
items.description: 'I returned to find him licking the milk foam, startled by the bitterness of the coffee, and knocking over the mug.'

items.name: Autumn-Water Grace
items.description: The girl in the clouds was strikingly pure and otherworldly, as if the essence of heaven and earth lingered in her gaze.

items.name: Distant Fragrance
items.description: Crowds gather for the garden's annual Lotus Festival. A gentle breeze ripples the pond as the blossoms sway.

items.name: Distant Fragrance - Jade
items.description: Their bloom lasts only a short period, yet the whole city gathers here, reluctant to miss this fleeting beauty.

items.name: Distant Fragrance - Fragrant
items.description: As lotus season draws to a close, the place grows quiet. But for gardeners, the year's work is far from over.

items.name: Distant Fragrance - Splendor
items.description: Most visitors come to the Sweet Garden to admire the lotuses. Many also come to buy them.

items.name: Music at Night
items.description: Golden dusk envelops the quiet town, and passersby hear beautiful music from the Atlees' home.

items.name: Music at Night - Warmth
items.description: People think beautiful things are fragile, but the girl remains perfectly calm when she learns the truth.

items.name: Music at Night - Hidden
items.description: As the harvest season arrives, joyful news reaches the town: Musette shone like a star at the concert.

items.name: Silent Wilds
items.description: Clock hands turn slowly as tiny gears interlock. Ancient craftsmanship shines in this workshop.

items.name: Silent Wilds - Glow
items.description: People don't understand Susie. Her expertise can give her fame. Why does she return to her small-town home?

items.name: Silent Wilds - Core
items.description: Susie's workshop gains fame over time. Even people outside of town bring treasured items for her to repair.

items.name: Blossom Trail
items.description: Spring breezes return. As peach buds awaken, Yaobi slowly opens her eyes to the warm sunlight.

items.name: Blossom Trail - Rare
items.description: Migrating birds herald spring, and blossoms bloom once more. Yaobi has grown into a graceful young woman.

items.name: Blossom Trail - Epic
items.description: The narrow cave gradually opens up. Bathed in light, she finds herself before an entirely different world.

items.name: Blossom Trail - Fantasy
items.description: Peach blossoms bloom year after year. She has grown into the kind, beautiful woman she once dreamed of.

items.name: Blossom Trail - Spirit
items.description: Gentle moonlight bathes the peach trees, each petal glowing softly. Their faint fragrance fills the peaceful night.

items.name: Roaring Blaze
items.description: People met on the road sat by the crackling bonfire as one traveler began to share a bizarre experience.

items.name: Shrouded Rainforest
items.description: The mysterious folk live in a misty rainforest. Born of the essence of nature, they are agile and keen.

items.name: Exuberant Rainforest
items.description: Scholars uncovered the world's secrets, while artisans invented machines to arm human armies.

items.name: Fragrant Dusk
items.description: The whole town knew Jalifah. Clever and sociable, she always brought the finest goods from afar.

items.name: Timeless Redolence
items.description: Stories of her kind deeds spread farther than her business. Her soul glittered brilliantly like gold.

items.name: Surging Clouds
items.description: In ancient times, there was no order to the sun and moon. People lived in chaos with unpredictable weather.

items.name: Rising Mists
items.description: A measure of time must be created first to establish order. She turned her experience into an hourglass.

items.name: First Light
items.description: Far in the frozen north, tales tell of a little town and a tree with crystal branches tipped with snow.

items.name: Moonlit Snow
items.description: 'I exist to answer sincere prayers. A greedy heart can never grasp the strength of true bonds.'

items.name: Effulgent Emerald
items.description: Oases dot the sands like emeralds as bells ring in the wind. This is Ariya's blessing as the Goddess of Nature.

items.name: Emerald Luster
items.description: Gentle power flowed through her as knowledge filled her mind. She learned the envoy was a greedy mage.

items.name: Legend of the Loong
items.description: After a millennium of cultivation, a jiao faces an ascension trial. Yanyue fights hard but falls, barely alive.

items.name: Rose-Tinted Clouds
items.description: Sunlight sleeps beyond the clouds. Roses bloom along the corridor. Pink fog drifts through, warm and fragrant.

items.name: Leisurely Day
items.description: Today's itinerary: a morning stroll through historic alleys, then a visit to lavender fields in the afternoon.

items.name: Rosy Hopes
items.description: Confined to the ward, Corinne presses against the window. That little hill stands nearby but out of her reach.

items.name: Warm Spring Day
items.description: A soft sound echoes from an alley in Lor River City. Yuan closes the herb shop's back door and heads uphill.

items.name: Pink Rhythm
items.description: She runs her fingers through her long hair and ties it up again and again, trying to ignore her racing heart.

items.name: Shadowed Butterfly Dreams
items.description: Dots of light float through the night. An airy butterfly flutters through starlit dreams, stopping on her fingertip.

items.name: Verdant Leisure
items.description: Countless lotus poems fade from the garden walls with time. Only timeless verses remain in people's hearts.

items.name: Heaven's Nectar
items.description: The lotus knows nothing of the names people give it. It simply blooms and fades with the seasons as flowers do.

items.name: Jade Heart
items.description: Visitors admire the lotuses. The flowers simply bloom beneath the sun, unconcerned with their gaze.

items.name: Verdant Leisure - Jade
items.description: Some build fortunes through the lotus, while others lose everything. Every blossom seems to carry a story.

items.name: Heaven's Nectar - Jade
items.description: Yet the lotus cares little. Whether in a celestial pond or a mountain pool, it blooms all the same.

items.name: Jade Heart - Jade
items.description: After the visitors leave, moonlight drapes the lotus petals in the garden like a delicate veil.

items.name: Verdant Leisure - Fragrant
items.description: Legend tells of gardeners skilled enough to make a hundred different lotuses bloom on the very same day.

items.name: Heaven's Nectar - Fragrant
items.description: Every lotus here is both nature's gift and the fruit of human craftsmanship. Each is a wonder born of both.

items.name: Jade Heart - Fragrant
items.description: Summer slips away, and the lotuses fade. Yet no sadness lingers here. They await their next blooming season.

items.name: Verdant Leisure - Splendor
items.description: The lotus is also valued as medicine. After its blooming, roaming peddlers collect its flowers, leaves, and seeds.

items.name: Heaven's Nectar - Splendor
items.description: The lotus cares little whether it grows in a pond or a pot. Even amid the bustle, it blooms with all its beauty.

items.name: Jade Heart - Splendor
items.description: A small pond sits in the courtyard, where koi glide beneath the lotuses, gazing up at a blooming flower.

items.name: Windward Swallow
items.description: But the truth cannot stay hidden forever. She receives an invitation to the Federation's premier concert.

items.name: Poetic Expression
items.description: The Atlees are proud, yet troubled. They are not ready to explain their daughter's misfortune to her.

items.name: Accent Note
items.description: The night deepens. She looks up at the full moon. Moonlight spills gently across the landscape, like a painting.

items.name: Changing Keys
items.description: At that peaceful moment, the door suddenly swings open. Musette turns to see her parents' worried faces.

items.name: Windward Swallow - Warmth
items.description: Three days before her departure, the girl puts down her music score and walks into the street.

items.name: Poetic Expression - Warmth
items.description: The sky, the lawn, the people... this is a gentle and quiet town. Even without color, it never feels bleak.

items.name: Accent Note - Warmth
items.description: She returns home and makes the final note on her score. 'Music can color every blank corner of the world.'

items.name: Changing Keys - Warmth
items.description: Beauty is no fragile crystal, but a resilient strength. The Atlees cry as they say farewell to their daughter.

items.name: Windward Swallow - Hidden
items.description: A swallow may dream beneath the eaves, or spread its wings and chase the wind toward a wider world.

items.name: Poetic Expression - Hidden
items.description: 'She is Musette. She doesn't wish to remain in a dream.' Her parents offer only this vague reply to reporters.

items.name: Accent Note - Hidden
items.description: Thousands of miles away, music flows from a decrepit church. Poor children gather around the girl as she plays.

items.name: Changing Keys - Hidden
items.description: Her music seems to soothe their illnesses. It is a mysterious power, yet not unknown... It comes from love.

items.name: Moonlit Flight
items.description: People admire forests, yet overlook their growth. Despite doubts, she becomes the master's apprentice.

items.name: Innocent Promises
items.description: Training is tedious. Some apprentices forget their dreams, only recalling them beneath the night sky.

items.name: Mystic Adventure
items.description: The mechanical palace in their hearts still stands, but its light fades. Only Susie keeps moving forward.

items.name: Mechanical Chest
items.description: Susie spends countless quiet nights with her toolbox, calculating each number as gears click beside her.

items.name: Idealistic Hymn
items.description: In her early years, Susie's modest creations are often overlooked amidst other more dazzling designs.

items.name: Glorious Heart
items.description: Others' doubts are but a breeze, stirring leaves but never changing Susie's resolve.

items.name: Mechanical Glow
items.description: Susie becomes the most valued apprentice of the mechanist. But she turns down offers and returns home.

items.name: Moonlit Flight - Glow
items.description: Susie often faces doubts. She could create grand works, yet chooses to help her townsfolk with daily needs.

items.name: Innocent Promises - Glow
items.description: Susie simply completes her work. She fixes machines for the villagers, making their old friends shine again.

items.name: Mystic Adventure - Glow
items.description: Since joining the workshop, Susie's dream has never changed: to help her hometown with her own hands.

items.name: Mechanical Chest - Glow
items.description: With this simple wish, Susie begins her journey. From apprentice to workshop owner, she always knows her path.

items.name: Idealistic Hymn - Glow
items.description: Susie's mother is also a talented engineer. She remembers seeing her mother busy with designs as a child.

items.name: Glorious Heart - Glow
items.description: Her mother teaches her: grand creations may attract attention, but machines exist to improve lives.

items.name: Mechanical Glow - Glow
items.description: Maybe that belief is what caught the Master Mechanist's eye. Susie's return helps her village solve many problems.

items.name: Moonlit Flight - Core
items.description: The girl does not leave when the work is done. Soon, people realize she is Susie's first apprentice.

items.name: Innocent Promises - Core
items.description: Susie agrees to her request. The girl reminds Susie of herself before the Master Mechanist, all those years ago.

items.name: Mystic Adventure - Core
items.description: Memories remain vivid. Her mother taught Susie the meaning of machines, and now she can pass it on to others.

items.name: Mechanical Chest - Core
items.description: Susie's workshop grows, and she chooses apprentices with one belief: helping people live better.

items.name: Idealistic Hymn - Core
items.description: Through ordinary tasks, Susie creates countless little miracles. More people come to her workshop.

items.name: Glorious Heart - Core
items.description: People no longer call her 'the Master Mechanist's apprentice.' Her works are now as famous as her teacher's.

items.name: Mechanical Glow - Core
items.description: The sapling has grown into a towering tree, sheltering others. This is the greatest meaning machines give her.

items.name: Celestial Peaches
items.description: Her sister is a physician often called down the mountain to treat patients, while she gathers and stores herbs.

items.name: Drunk on Flowers
items.description: 'When I grow up, I'll become a physician just like you!' she declares, making her usually stern sister smile.

items.name: Sunlit Peaches
items.description: Chasing butterflies, she skips across a stream. A peach blossom lands on the water, filling spring with color.

items.name: Celestial Peaches - Rare
items.description: Yaobi is never allowed to wander far. No beasts roam here, but its rugged terrain can easily lead her astray.

items.name: Drunk on Flowers - Rare
items.description: One day, Yaobi loses her way in the mist, but her years in the mountains soon lead her to a cave to rest in.

items.name: Sunlit Peaches - Rare
items.description: A breeze drifts from deep within the cave. Curious, Yaobi follows it... Could there be another world beyond?

items.name: Celestial Peaches - Epic
items.description: 'You must be hungry.' The girl in front of her offers her a ripe peach. 'Eat this first, then we'll take you home.'

items.name: Drunk on Flowers - Epic
items.description: Yaobi has never tasted such a sweet peach. Juice bursts forth, filling her with its fresh fragrance.

items.name: Sunlit Peaches - Epic
items.description: A warm breeze brushes her cheek. She wakes with a start, still sitting in the courtyard with a letter at her side.

items.name: Celestial Peaches - Fantasy
items.description: A dusty little girl looks at Yaobi shyly. 'I got lost in the mountains. Could I have some water?'

items.name: Drunk on Flowers - Fantasy
items.description: Yaobi stares at her in surprise. For a moment, she sees her younger self, also lost in the mountains years ago.

items.name: Sunlit Peaches - Fantasy
items.description: 'Is this a fairyland?' she wondered. She was almost afraid to fall asleep, fearing it would all vanish like a dream.

items.name: Celestial Peaches - Spirit
items.description: Cicadas sing through the summer night as a cool breeze carries the scent of peach blossoms.

items.name: Drunk on Flowers - Spirit
items.description: 'Really?' the little girl says with a shy blush. 'But I think this place is already a Peach Blossom Haven.'

items.name: Sunlit Peaches - Spirit
items.description: Was her journey real, or just a dream? Yaobi cannot tell. But this little courtyard is her own haven.

items.name: Crystal Heart Fountain
items.description: The ice-blue earring twirls as the girl steps lightly under the hanging bow, and the bell creates clear rhythms.

items.name: Primal Longing
items.description: The girl let the traveler rest in a dry, warm cave and gathered herbs for him every day.

items.name: Wayward Spirit
items.description: She often visited him while he rested. Stories of heroic warriors and clever merchants always engrossed her.

items.name: Ferocious Fang
items.description: 'Later, I grew to understand her.' The traveler pokes the fire. 'The forest might be lonely, but it was her home.'

items.name: Robust Physique
items.description: The girl didn't appear the next day. Ready to leave, he found food and water left beside his belongings.

items.name: Echoing Chirp
items.description: Serpents had tough scales and sharp fangs, so agility alone wasn't enough. How could they reclaim their land?

items.name: Broadleaf Thicket
items.description: At seventeen, Nadia met a traveler with a rucksack and hiking pole, who cleared bushes with practiced ease.

items.name: Sunlit Glade
items.description: Nadia grew up listening to stories of the rainforest and set her heart on leading her people back home.

items.name: Fluffy Ears
items.description: The clan gathered around the traveler, listening to his stories of crossing seas and seeing the world.

items.name: Whispering Wind
items.description: The traveler showed them fascinating objects from the outside world, from a golden compass to a jeweled dagger.

items.name: Shimmering Vision
items.description: The traveler spoke of bustling bazaars in city-states, oases in deserts, and exciting adventures across azure seas.

items.name: Dazzling Wonder
items.description: He told them of human civilization. But how did humans survive and prosper without claws or fangs?

items.name: Prismatic Brilliance
items.description: Nadia met all kinds of people in strange kingdoms. Clever merchants could negotiate any deal.

items.name: Aureate Radiance
items.description: Fascinated by the traveler's stories, Nadia could almost see the world beyond the rain and fog of the forest.

items.name: Languid Respite
items.description: Despite the elders' warnings, Nadia took human form and ventured beyond the rainforest.

items.name: Peak Mastery
items.description: Curiosity took root in Nadia's heart like a seed and eventually grew into an irresistible urge.

items.name: Runes of Wisdom
items.description: Nadia realized humans held the key to defeating the serpents. Reclaiming their land was no longer a dream.

items.name: Drifting Serenade
items.description: On a quiet afternoon, the cubs listened to tales as Nadia rested on a bough, swaying her tail.

items.name: Gleaming Hope
items.description: Under Nadia's lead, they embraced the outside world, reviving their forest with human wisdom.

items.name: Lush Foliage
items.description: They surrounded the traveler, but he greeted them warmly as if nothing was unusual.

items.name: Ancient Trade Port
items.description: After learning the truth, the City Lord banished the aristocrat and granted Jalifah half his amassed wealth.

items.name: Jade-Tinted Ripples
items.description: Jalifah let the servant follow the aristocrat's plan while she prepared another batch of spices for the Lord.

items.name: Splendid Curios
items.description: The aristocrat couldn't wait to report her when her boat docked, unaware that he was walking into his own trap.

items.name: Dreamlike Redolence
items.description: Jalifah told the Lord someone had ruined her other batch meant for the people and asked him to investigate.

items.name: Glamorous Poise
items.description: Her brilliance also led to jealousy. Eyeing her wealth, an aristocrat hatched a despicable plan.

items.name: Lustrous Pearls
items.description: The aristocrat sent a servant to buy her exquisite goldware, then replaced it with gold-painted copperware.

items.name: Ambrosial Boon
items.description: Jalifah once helped the servant when he was down on his luck, so he revealed the aristocrat's entire plan.

items.name: Resplendent Glow
items.description: In court, the aristocrat accused Jalifah of passing off copperware as gold. Jalifah calmly sent for a witness.

items.name: Aureate Brocade
items.description: When the truth came out, the crowd cheered for Jalifah as the aristocrat faced punishment for his scheme.

items.name: Delicate Clasp
items.description: The resentful aristocrat sent a servant into Jalifah's caravan to spoil the spices she was selling to the Lord.

items.name: Lavish Splendor
items.description: Lies cannot hide the truth. Jalifah revealed hidden marks on her goods, while the copperware bore none.

items.name: Glamorous Charm
items.description: Merchants still follow Jalifah's wisdom: 'Wealth, like water, must flow. Still waters fade; flowing fortunes grow.'

items.name: Shimmering Pearls
items.description: The trade routes she blazed crossed seas and deserts, bringing wealth and prosperity along the way.

items.name: Starlit Tranquility
items.description: A deity woke up to the sound of prayers. She pitied human suffering but didn't know how to save mortals.

items.name: Resplendent Light
items.description: Above, the weather changed at her will. She had never experienced chaos nor understood what they wished for.

items.name: Unceasing Devotion
items.description: With curiosity and sympathy, she shed her crown and descended upon the mortal world as an ordinary girl.

items.name: Stellar Radiance
items.description: The weather was fine when she came. Villagers welcomed her and shared their forecasting methods.

items.name: Time's Reverie
items.description: But the night stretched on. Fear and insecurity spread among the villagers, and soon a storm hit the village.

items.name: Gilded Blue Amber
items.description: Food rotted in the rain while hunger loomed. Villagers had to brave the dark to hunt.

items.name: Distant Shadows
items.description: 'If only we could foresee the sunrise and ensure crops grew, so no hunter had to go out in the dark.'

items.name: Sands of Ages
items.description: Hearing their wishes, the deity bade farewell and returned to her temple to bring order to days and seasons.

items.name: Sincere Paean
items.description: She had never experienced chaos or suffering and thought mortals were happier than herself.

items.name: Reverent Prayer
items.description: After dark, people sat around fires to talk and share food. Their joy even moved the deity herself.

items.name: Unceasing Prayer
items.description: People rejoiced, for the sun and moon rose in harmony, and they no longer feared prolonged darkness or heat.

items.name: Stellar Refulgence
items.description: Children grew healthy as day and night followed their order, and farmers sowed and harvested by season.

items.name: Reverie of Time
items.description: People built a temple on the highest hill for the deity's blessing and prayed for the order and hope she brought.

items.name: Spirit's Blessing
items.description: She looks at the praying girl and raises her hand. A gentle light flashes, restoring color to her pale, weary face.

items.name: Ancient Tree Spirit
items.description: Her gown is made of pure white snow and ice, drifting behind as she walks, scattering snowflakes everywhere.

items.name: Crown of Hope
items.description: Her presence fills the town with warmth and hope. Each year, the square hosts a grand festival for her.

items.name: Jade-Green Crystal
items.description: People send her ice sculptures of vivid animals and grand palaces, filled with their heartfelt blessings.

items.name: Sacred Gleam
items.description: She adorns the town with ice magic. Ice flowers dangle from rooftops as crystal ice arches rise.

items.name: Tender Vigil
items.description: She has answered too many prayers and now must sleep. People guard her tree in shifts. Someone is always there.

items.name: Spring Herald
items.description: Against dark magic, people stand with weapons raised. She is their guardian and their dear and trusted friend.

items.name: Jade-Kissed Ice
items.description: An evil mage hungers for her power. He lurks in the dark. The vigilant people catch him before he strikes.

items.name: Healing Spell
items.description: The people's sincere care is her best medicine. She smiles. 'But there is something more urgent right now.'

items.name: Lasting Blessing
items.description: The battle wakes her from slumber. She rises, drives back the darkness, and bathes the people in healing light.

items.name: Pure Radiance
items.description: The town holds another festival. The spirit sings with the people, offering a pure and wonderful blessing.

items.name: Ethereal Cloudscape
items.description: Silk and jewels were offered to the envoy, but he continued to ransack households for more.

items.name: Radiant Harmony
items.description: No more dancing around bonfires. Ariya gazed at the sky, thinking the deities shouldn't do this to people.

items.name: Hills and Dales
items.description: He said the tribe should serve him perfectly, or the deities would punish them with disaster.

items.name: Morning Serenity
items.description: Later, he demanded they offer up children as slaves. Ariya confronted him with her people and cast him out.

items.name: Celestial Resonance
items.description: Enraged, the envoy cast a cruel spell: if they didn't kill the disrespectful one, the tribe would suffer for eternity.

items.name: Blessed Grace
items.description: Maybe the deities heard her prayer. Moments later, Ariya rose into the air, overlooking the vast world.

items.name: Enigmatic Fate
items.description: From that day on, the sun scorched, and the desert stretched wherever Ariya's tribe migrated.

items.name: Starlit Serenity
items.description: The wind carried rain afar, breathing life into everything and blessing her people living by the water.

items.name: Whispering Hills
items.description: She recounted the envoy's sins and her people's suffering. 'It must change, even at the cost of my life.'

items.name: Glimmering Chime
items.description: The people didn't blame Ariya, but she couldn't bear their suffering. She left quietly on a starlit night.

items.name: Brilliant Sunrise
items.description: Seeing her people panic after her disappearance, Ariya sent the truth as a breeze brushing their cheeks.

items.name: Yanyue the Jiao
items.description: That night, she releases Yanyue into the stream and whispers, 'Go. Be free. May we both find where we belong.'

items.name: Delicate Coral
items.description: Yanyue thinks she's met a girl shining like a pearl, ambitious and seeking more than comfort.

items.name: Dawnlit Silhouette
items.description: Yanyue uses her remaining energy to take human form. She finds the girl on a rocky trail, a pack on her shoulder.

items.name: One of a Kind
items.description: The traveling girl grows into a legendary florist. Yanyue returns each spring to see her shining pearl.

items.name: Legacy in Bloom
items.description: She shares her garden freely. Whoever follows the scent to her is welcomed and offered all her knowledge.

items.name: Unheard Tidings
items.description: Yanyue hears no news of her for five years. Some say she vanished seeking seeds; others say she rose into the sky.

items.name: Floral Grace
items.description: She searches high and low, but never sees her friend again. The unspoken goodbye traps her heart and soul.

items.name: Blossom's Devotion
items.description: Spring comes again. In a daze, Yanyue sees her once more, the girl vowing to her mother to be the best florist ever.

items.name: Sunshower Tears
items.description: She stays in the garden her friend left until it becomes a landmark, with her flowers blooming in every home.

items.name: Moon Palace Pestling
items.description: 'Like this?' Momo turns to Yutu, the rabbit herbalist master. 'Wonderful!' Yutu nods with a smile.

items.name: Blessed Clouds
items.description: The bright moon bathes the world in silver as auspicious clouds bring blessings to all with cheer.

items.name: Ruler of Spirits
items.description: Between practices, Nadia discussed tactics with her clan's advisors to gain a timing advantage.

items.name: Heavenly Runes
items.description: Amid devout chanting, smiles lit up every face. Perhaps the deity, too, would smile at such a blissful sight.

items.name: Breeze's Message
items.description: A wounded bird drops into the royal garden, white feathers thick with grime. Its cry tells of ruin in the north.

items.name: Tender Verse
items.description: Rosalia's father spares her state affairs. She's too soft-hearted and frail to guard the frontier like her sister.

items.name: Fragrant Hedge
items.description: A sudden disaster strikes the north. The nobles argue endlessly. She holds the bird and gently touches its wing.

items.name: Rosy Horizon
items.description: Still, she wants to help. Like blossoms over barren land, she moves through shelters and dazed crowds.

items.name: Fragrant Messenger
items.description: Rosalia visits the camp again. People have packed their belongings and are returning to where they fled.

items.name: Radiant Grace
items.description: She brings medicine to the sick, wraps wounds, and gives water and bread to crying children. At dusk, she sings.

items.name: Scarlet Devotion
items.description: A field can wither overnight. But plant a seed of hope, and fierce courage will take root in every soul.

items.name: Traces of Bloom
items.description: Birds call out with bright voices. Their healed wings spread wide, carrying hoped-for good news from the north.

items.name: Sunglow Ballad
items.description: The sunset glow marks not the end of a journey, but the start of the next one. Let bonfire ballads fill the air.

items.name: Dreamy Memories
items.description: Her camera quietly captures every memorable moment, turning them into treasures to be cherished.

items.name: Dreamer's Path
items.description: Corinne is now a well-known hiking blogger. Her photos feature rivers, peaks, and her ever-bouncy bunny.

items.name: Verdant Journey
items.description: Sun spills across the slopes as she crests the peak, bunny on her head. 'We really made it up a mountain!'

items.name: Dreambound Steps
items.description: Corinne shyly shares her hiking dream. Her parents cheer her on and buy her hiking boots, a pack, and poles.

items.name: Glimmering Clouds
items.description: She dresses her bunny in mini hiking gear to bring it along. It gave her the courage to face treatment.

items.name: Packed and Ready
items.description: Through grueling treatments, Corinne transforms. Pale cheeks turn rosy. Her limbs grow firm. She finds real power.

items.name: Mark of Bravery
items.description: Her world widens step by step. On her coming-of-age day, she stands beneath the hill she once watched.

items.name: Spring Hiking Poles
items.description: Corinne breathes in the wild scent. Step by step, she climbs. She pauses now and then to rest.

items.name: Fresh Sprouts
items.description: A spring storm breaks. Yuan hugs her basket close. Through the leaves, she glimpses a hidden little courtyard.

items.name: Gatherer's Return
items.description: Yuan shields her basket and dashes to the eaves. A girl opens the gate with a soft smile and invites her inside.

items.name: Bamboo Brew
items.description: Yuan enters to find shelves lined with dried herbs. The girl takes a handful and brews Yuan a steaming cup of tea.

items.name: Rippling Blossoms
items.description: The girl offers to show Yuan the little herb garden out back. Only then do they notice the rain has stopped.

items.name: Gentle Elegance
items.description: They chat about herbs. Yuan shares her herbal knowledge as the girl explains their growth patterns.

items.name: Flourishing Foliage
items.description: Fine rain wets her hair. She places the herbs into her basket and weighs her options. Maybe it's time to head back.

items.name: Sweetheart Signal
items.description: After a simple conversation, she returns the umbrella to him and tries to say more, her cheeks flushing.

items.name: Starlit Moment
items.description: 'Wait! We...' he calls to her. As they lock eyes, their hearts beat in sync, beginning their love song.

items.name: Hidden Fountain
items.description: In a quiet corner, green lotuses wait to bloom. Only careful eyes can appreciate their understated beauty.

items.name: Celestial Dew
items.description: Pristine lotuses bloom like snow upon the lake, cradled by emerald leaves in graceful splendor.

items.name: Lotus Dream
items.description: Pink lotuses gently unfurl their petals, like shy children slowly opening up and showing their true selves.

items.name: Blush in Dew
items.description: Along the busiest lakeshore, red lotuses bloom in dazzling clusters. Quiet elegance is not their nature.

items.name: Dream of Haven
items.description: Nourished by sun and rain, peach buds on the branches blush pale pink, just like her youthful cheeks.

items.name: Dream of Haven - Rare
items.description: One herb is still missing. A letter from her sister includes a new prescription, but she can't find the final ingredient.

items.name: Dream of Haven - Epic
items.description: One of them notices Yaobi in surprise. 'Oh! Who are you?' Before she can answer, another asks, 'Are you lost?'

items.name: Dream into Haven - Fantasy
items.description: Though her sister seems stern, Yaobi knows her heart is gentle. She waits day after day for her return.

items.name: Dream of Haven - Spirit
