items.description: Luckily, they find him in time! Otherwise, it would have been hard to face these waters alone!

items.name: Intrepid Pioneer
items.description: They finally reach somewhere calmer, but the force disappears, too. Paopao wonders how to move on.

items.name: Little Beauty
items.description: 'Blub, blub, blub, bubbles drift away~ Swish, swish, swish, waters softly sway~ Rise and shine~ Let's swim and play~'

items.name: Serene Drift
items.description: Little Beauty lowers her eyes and hums softly. Slowly, a soft glow surrounds her, sending ripples outward.

items.name: Rippling Mirage
items.description: Before she knows it, her voice draws little sea creatures close. They clap to the beat and even dance.

items.name: Celestial Grove
items.description: 'You sing so well!' 'I've never heard such a beautiful voice…' 'It's gentle but powerful!' Everyone praises her.

items.name: Ethereal Jewels
items.description: Seeing her worried look, the fish and sea jellies eagerly offer ideas on how Little Beauty can find her friends.

items.name: Snow-Kissed Blooms
items.description: Little Beauty is surprised. A cat can swim in the sea, too? This world must be so different from hers!

items.name: Distant Windsong
items.description: Little Beauty soon realizes what makes this world different: 'Here, pure feelings are very powerful.'

items.name: Sentimental Longing
items.description: 'We can ask around.' 'Let's find the Whale! He knows everything!' 'I've got a horn. Its sound carries really far!'

items.name: Ephemeral Cirrus
items.description: Everyone shakes their heads except one fish, who says he saw a strange cat in a yellow cloak swimming nearby.

items.name: Mange Snake
items.description: Mange Snake burns with rage yet keeps his calm. 'Why do you say that? Have you ever seen a dragon?'

items.name: State of Peril
items.description: Mange Snake is pleased, but before he can gloat, an older fish says, 'This guest doesn't seem like a dragon.'

items.name: Surging Storm
items.description: 'Dragons haven't appeared in ages. You resemble one from a legend. Perhaps you'll become one someday.'

items.name: Pursuit of Desire
items.description: Mange Snake's threat sends the fish fleeing, except for the one he caught. Suddenly, a vortex appears.

items.name: Glimmering Ripples
items.description: Mange Snake notices that this vortex differs from the one that brought him here and senses familiar forces.

items.name: Celestial Ascension
items.description: 'Is that so?' Mange Snake lunges right up to the fish and bares his fangs. 'Tell me everything you know!'

items.name: Hidden Threads of Fate
items.description: 'Wait! I haven't even heard the legend yet!' Rolling waves carry Mange Snake out of this strange world.

items.name: Drizzle-Woven Waves
items.description: The coastal folk warn Eve. 'Never enter the deep during a storm. Thunder is the sea's warning.'

items.name: Ocean Dirge
items.description: The deity keeps vigil at the rift, so the world remains in order, civilization rises again, and mortals live in peace.

items.name: Waverider Ballad
items.description: With Momo's help, Paopao finds the right way. Soon, he hears a familiar voice singing. 'It's Little Beauty!'

items.name: Waverider Melody
items.description: Pure, powerful forces converge into a small, clear vortex floating in the water. It is the passage home.

items.name: Rosy Moonlight
items.description: The sea is peaceful. Little Beauty appears out of nowhere, but the fish and sea jellies only watch curiously.

items.name: Heartbound Lullaby
items.description: Little Beauty looks over in surprise and sees a cat in a yellow cloak swimming toward her with Paopao.

items.name: Heartbound Echo
items.description: 'Let's open the passage home!' Little Beauty sings again. Her voice and Paopao's power form a new vortex.

items.name: Gleaming Grandeur
items.description: A vortex brings him to another underwater world. Paopao looks around as the current urges him on.

items.name: Pearl of the Vast Sea
items.description: Little Beauty asks if anyone has seen any other newcomers. She's worried… Are Paopao and the others here, too?

items.name: Commonplace Soul
items.description: A mysterious vortex appears. One step closer, and he is sucked right in. 'It's a trap!' Mange Snake thinks.

items.name: Sapphire Memories
items.description: Summer holds so many memories, especially of the sea. Real moments by the sea, or just hazy dreams of it…

items.name: Sunlit Years
items.description: Following the current, Paopao soon meets a school of fish. They huddle together, arguing about something.

items.name: Ruthless Greed
items.description: Beautiful fish swim leisurely around him. As he observes the world, they watch him too, just as curious.

items.name: Abysmal Thunder
items.description: Mange Snake's greatest dream is to become the Dragon King and rule the world. 'I'll do anything for it!'

items.name: Waves in the Breeze
items.description: People stroll the beach while children chase each other. The wind and twilight paint a timeless scene.

items.name: Dreamward Carp
items.description: 'Hey! Where are you from?' a little fish asks, spotting Paopao. 'Another world, I think…' Paopao hesitates.

items.name: Hazy Expanse
items.description: Mange Snake fixes his gaze on one fish. He puts on a friendly smile and asks kindly where he is.

items.name: Swirling Seafoam
items.description: She decides to sing with all her heart. If Paopao and the others are nearby, they will surely respond!

items.name: Stormlit Clouds
items.description: Dense mist smothers the sea, lightning weaving through it. As if calling to her, the lightning tugs at her soul.

items.name: Spirited Endeavor
items.description: The gentle current suddenly turns wild and chaotic, tossing the fish around. Paopao feels dizzy, too.

items.name: A Life Unfulfilled
items.description: The fish's answer is of little help. Mange Snake stays calm and asks if any other strangers have appeared.

items.name: Ocean's Chant
items.description: From childhood, green lightning has flashed through her dreams. The deep calls to her, where her soul belongs.

items.name: Brilliant Vigor
items.description: Paopao is a kind, brave carp. He owns the Gold Scale. 'My heart is strong like the iron. It is indestructible!'

items.name: Crystal Azure Waves
items.description: Little Beauty is good at singing. Her singing can heal life in the sea. 'Let the song give me powers!'

items.name: Uncanny Oddities
items.description: The fish shake their heads. A young fish stares curiously and whispers, 'Are you a dragon? I've never seen one…'

items.name: Graceful Encounter
items.description: She loves frost and rose elements. Ice is pure, roses burn bright, and their contrast shapes her best work.

items.name: Drifting Plume
items.description: She keeps chasing the secrets of color matching. Each breakthrough brings her closer to the town in her dreams.

items.name: Gleaming Harmony
items.description: She steadies herself on the cloud and gazes at the town. The cloud catches her wish and carries her to the border.

items.name: Butterfly-Kissed Rose
items.description: She peers at the statue and freezes. Its face mirrors her own. Then an elegant woman gently waves her over.

items.name: Gentle Echo
items.description: The crystal ball opens. The square overflows with roses, heavy with scent. They surround a fine and lovely statue.

items.name: Heartfelt Tidings
items.description: She loses sleep after winning Apple's Ten Elite Designers. The first sunlight finds her before dreams do.

items.name: Frostblossom Hymn
items.description: She unveils her masterwork. Crystal frost and bright roses dance across the dress, twinkling wondrously.

items.name: Pure White Lullaby
items.description: She opens her eyes, still wrapped in the dream. On her empty table lies a single rose covered in glistening frost.

items.name: Crystal Isle
items.description: She wakes with her heart racing. The dream town feels close, familiar, and somehow bound to her.

items.name: Snowbound Visions
items.description: At the Elite Design Academy, her insight deepens. She hones her vision and develops a style of her own.

items.name: Crystal Fragrance
items.description: The princess enters secret realms that reject all others. She crosses rifts in time and lives many lives.

items.name: Mark of Hope
items.description: Misty layers veil a skirt scattered with roses. She made it for the contest, but it won acclaim far beyond the event.

items.name: Youthful Heart
items.description: She drifts off, happy and content. In her dream, she rides a rose-covered cloud and spots a tiny town.

items.name: Graceful Moment
items.description: The woman shares the statue's story: a bold princess who journeyed far to seek the meaning of beauty.

items.name: Song of Night
items.description: Strife characterized the history of the Cloud Empire. No one cared about the princess except the Lantern Spirit.

items.name: Whimsical Invite
items.description: When humans slumber in the dark, nightmare catchers roam the sky freely and listen to dreams from afar.

items.name: Fantasy Pact
items.description: Batsy gives the girl a pair of bat wings. Now she can fly anywhere without being carried away by the cloud.

items.name: Breezy Adventure
items.description: On her way to school, the girl closes her eyes and imagines being a cloud, riding the wind to her distant dream.

items.name: Sunlit Leisure
items.description: A warm, cozy afternoon is best for desserts. As if dipped in honey, the sun even turns waiting into a delight.

items.name: Aurous Bell
items.description: 'From an ordinary office worker to an elegant noble, begin your transformation with this hit manga!'

items.name: Aurous Whisper
items.description: 'Rosalie.' The girl turns, tearing up. Luckily, their names are the same. 'What did you see?' the prince asks.

items.name: Silent Moonshade
items.description: As the lead ballerina, Olina draws in a huge crowd for every show. A simple, light leap wins waves of applause.

items.name: Moonlit Hush
items.description: Startled, the apprentice asks shakily, 'You're alive?' But before Olina can answer, he runs out screaming.

items.name: Black-and-White Drama
items.description: Sheila gets an excited invite from a friend: a midnight maze adventure! Dressed up, she rushes to the venue.

items.name: Nocturnal Birdsong
items.description: The Empress had achieved much and was admired by all. Everyone wanted her life to be perfect without regrets.

items.name: Lotus Lantern
items.description: Another ten years had passed, and she was now the sovereign of the land while the emperor had disappeared.

items.name: Flower of Time
items.description: The princess only cared about the trees in her yard, so when the power struggle began, she was left alone.

items.name: Inner Tranquility
items.description: The days when her life was all about music were over. Now, she had to read the esoteric articles.

items.name: Pearl Radiance
items.description: The wind swept by, but the grove was empty. By dawn, she left the yard and stepped into the whirl of the world.

items.name: Skyward Gaze
items.description: She asked it whether her choice was right. It didn't answer because they both knew there was no other choice.

items.name: Everlasting Glow
items.description: A fire broke out in the palace. She stood outside and saw the fire destroy everything, including the lantern.

items.name: Stream Melody
items.description: She wasn't troubled by the incident, even though her most cherished treasure had been destroyed.

items.name: Millennial Flow
items.description: As time went by, she became tough and composed. And people realized that she could be a serious threat.

items.name: Nocturnal Batling
items.description: Batsy packs her things and gets ready. What nightmares will she catch tonight to feed the little bats?

items.name: Nightmare Captor
items.description: Batventure Night is a popular fairy tale in Lilith. The protagonist Batsy can catch nightmares and guard dreams.

items.name: Windward Echo
items.description: Her pointy ears are as sharp as a bat's. All she needs to do is twitch them to catch every sound in dreams.

items.name: Dreamcatcher Plumes
items.description: Batsy has a magical case to help her catch nightmares. She always wipes it with a fine cloth to keep it shiny.

items.name: Dreamland Boundary
items.description: As the portal to the dream world opens, she makes her grand entrance. Oops! Almost slipped on the cloud…

items.name: Somber Midnight
items.description: Batsy hums as she patrols at night, when she hears a sob. A girl trapped in a nightmare frowns and murmurs.

items.name: Drifting Phantom
items.description: The pumpkin lantern the girl made with her mom turns into a huge cloud, carrying her into a dark forest.

items.name: Endless Enigma
items.description: Howling ghosts from her cartoon books scare her so much that she can't say a word until she sees Batsy.

items.name: Midnight Frenzy
items.description: As for the naughty ghosts... Don't worry. They're trick-or-treating. Batsy shares the marshmallow with them.

items.name: Dream Reversal
items.description: It's almost dawn. Batsy pats her full case, glances at the little girl smiling in her dreams, and flies away.

items.name: Brisk Whimsy
items.description: Youth blooms like a flower. The girl refuses to let it pass her by and decides to turn it into beautiful verses.

items.name: Future Preface
items.description: In the dawn's light, a new chapter of youth begins. Write down your story about dreams from the first page!

items.name: Dreamward Prologue
items.description: Passing the classroom windows, the wind grazes the girl's fingertips as she writes, heralding a season of hope.

items.name: Fruitful Sparkle
items.description: You take the sweetest strawberry and leave me the biggest blueberry! Sharing doubles the happiness~

items.name: Roseate Splendor
items.description: Except for the occasional scream in her head, the rose-filled manor with all its luxuries fascinates the girl.

items.name: Monochrome Fantasy
items.description: Everyone at the manor is surprised by the noble lady's changes. The harder she tried, the worse it got.

items.name: Colorful Comic
items.description: Between etiquette lessons, beauty training, and gossip-filled teas, she only rests when the stars are out.

items.name: Mirrored Mirage
items.description: The voice shrieks at first, but once she realizes it's better to offer advice, she becomes the girl's mentor.

items.name: Gorgeous Perfection
items.description: 'I'd rather go back to work!' Frustrated, she wanders around and catches the prince cheating on her.

items.name: Crystalline Luster
items.description: Now the girl wants to scream, too! Why is this happening at the manor? The prince sees her and strides over.

items.name: Treasured Reverie
items.description: The voice in her head urges her, 'Fill your eyes with tears! Pretend you're in love with him and heartbroken!'

items.name: Glistening Glory
items.description: 'Can't let him fool more girls! Right, Miss Rosalie?' After a pause, the voice replies, 'Let's expose him!'

items.name: Hollow Rose
items.description: Puppets can't speak or feel anything. They just follow routines, swirling and leaping with a smile day after day.

items.name: Cagebound Vines
items.description: Bound by strings, she taps the floor in ballet flats. The stage is a glamorous prison where cheers cage her heart.

items.name: Resonant Concerto
items.description: She repeats the same dance until the curtain falls. Then the puppeteer hangs her on a rack in the corner.

items.name: Murky Murmur
items.description: The puppeteer regularly replaces the loose joints and worn strings, but the work is no easy task for the old man.

items.name: Tender Fetters
items.description: As the lead dancer, she must be perfect. The old puppeteer retires, entrusting her to his apprentice.

items.name: Threadborn Memory
items.description: Feeling honored, the apprentice checks Olina's joints and rearranges her strings more carefully than ever.

items.name: Unbound Night
items.description: One night, on a whim, the apprentice loosens the strings on Olina. 'You must be tired, too. Take some rest.'

items.name: Straying Vines
items.description: She tears herself free from the tangled strings, pushes open the theater door, and steps into the moonlight.

items.name: Echoing Zephyr
items.description: As Olina breathes in the chilly air, she stands on tiptoe and leaps under the moon onto her own stage of freedom.

items.name: Shadowy Space
items.description: 'Tricksters, no escape!' A lanky ghost leans out, sticking out its tongue. Now, her friend is startled too.

items.name: Heart of Whimsy
items.description: A little ghost peeks around the corner. Sheila pulls out her homemade candy popper, scaring it into a run.

items.name: Forest Breeze
items.description: Nobody knew when the Spirit appeared in the lantern. It had stayed with her on her desk for years.

items.name: Moonlit Bamboo
items.description: It was said that she always kept a lantern on her desk. And she'd often take a stroll in the forest with it.

items.name: Batdream Mirage
items.description: 'Batsy is a professional nightmare catcher!' Wait, no. The girl adds, 'The best, most hardworking one!'

items.name: Dreamward Wings
items.description: Batsy then pulls off a wisp of golden cloud for the girl to taste: it's a sweet and puffy pumpkin marshmallow!

items.name: Lovebound Oath
items.description: She wakes up to a rich aroma when a voice erupts in her head: How could you nap on the couch!? So unladylike!

items.name: Decadent Charm
items.description: Rosalie's acting fools the prince. Seeing his smug face, she clenches her fist: she has to expose him herself!

items.name: Roseate Proposition
items.description: People are enamored, but no one knows her secret: she is not flesh and blood, but a carefully carved puppet.

items.name: Tangled Ballet
items.description: 'Am I alive?' Olina looks at the closed curtain. For the first time, she feels a heartbeat—a pull not from the strings.

items.name: Batwing Fantasy
items.description: The venue is packed with people in quirky outfits and bold makeup. Sheila struggles to pick out her friend.

items.name: Turbulent Times
items.description: Control, or be controlled. The princess chose to fight her way out, but this path was bound to be difficult.

items.name: Dawn of Youth
items.description: The sun casts its warm and radiant light through the clouds. The girl looks up as the purest smile blooms.

items.name: Sugared Cheesecake
items.description: Sugar is sparkling magic, like stardust sprinkled over a cake, sweetening every girlish dream.

items.name: Illuminated Vision
items.description: The path to the future is laid out as she wishes for freedom and courage to chase all the possibilities in life.

items.name: Sugary Adventure
items.description: The pâtissier covers the desserts in rainbow-hued frosting. The colors turn the world into a wonderland.

items.name: Moonlit Night
items.description: Nothing was known about her, except that she always kept the lotus lantern her mother had left her on her desk.

items.name: Twin Shadows
items.description: The little bats are very particular. Ordinary food is too bland for them. They only eat humans' nightmares.

items.name: Azure Cruise
items.description: Youth is an empty sketchbook. No matter how inexperienced, fill it with color and create your own unique art.

items.name: Cloudlike Puff
items.description: One bite, and the cream sweeps you up like a soft, fluffy cloud, taking you on a sweet adventure in the sky.

items.name: Ballad of Thorns
items.description: Olina is used to cheers but has never felt real human kindness. She looks up at the apprentice on her own.

items.name: Puppeteered Fantasy
items.description: Intricate spheres form her joints, and cheers replace her pulse. Countless strings help her stand and move.

items.name: Pact in the Mist
items.description: Teasing each other, the girls soon reach the exit. The staff award them bat badges for completing the maze.

items.name: Midnight Mystery
items.description: Suddenly, a giant bat shadow appears. She is startled as her friend giggles, holding a prank prop.

items.name: Reed on the River
items.description: Living in peace didn't seem too bad. She immersed herself in music and felt calm in her mind.

items.name: Witch's Expedition
items.description: Nightmares vary, too. An extremely horrifying one is like a luxury feast, enough to satiate their hunger.

items.name: Untethered Dream
items.description: Pack your dreams into your bag and set out with hope, no matter how rough the road ahead may be.

items.name: Chocolate Charm
items.description: Fresh fruit wrapped in a thin chocolate crust. Every bite is a mix of rich cocoa and refreshing fruit. One more, please!

items.name: Aromatic Saunter
items.description: What's wrong with taking a nap after work? She tries to protest, but wait... Why is someone talking in her head?

items.name: Crimson Capture
items.description: As the orchestra plays the first note, the puppeteer pulls the strings. Olina leaps onstage and starts her dance.

items.name: Phantom Flight
items.description: The maze echoes with eerie sounds, and ghosts drift about. The girls grin, join hands, and dash inside.

items.name: Serene Water
items.description: The emperor laughed, seeing his younger self in her. From then on, she rose, unshaken by the storms of court.

items.name: Weeping Romance
items.description: Rosalie looks around and realizes she's become a noble lady, while the real one is screaming in her head!

items.name: Summer Cityscape
items.description: After finishing her cold soda, the girl waves to her friend behind the counter. 'I'm off! See you tomorrow!'

items.name: Fatebound Summer
items.description: The girl can't help but chuckle at Hazel. Drinking cold sodas, they sit by the store window and talk till late.

items.name: Rich Soymilk
items.description: Riko believes happiness tastes like sweet strawberries, and the occasional sourness makes it even better.

items.name: Redolent Recipe
items.description: With treats packed and a strawberry-themed outfit on, she sets off for a strawberry-sweet date!

items.name: Scentful Dewdrop
items.description: Beyond the vine-covered gates lies a lush green patch. Through the plants, she observes the overgrown manor.

items.name: Fragrant Nectar
items.description: Camilla doesn't put the candelabrum back after wiping it clean. She knows it's worth a year's tuition.

items.name: Night of Oblivion
items.description: In a war long ago, Tura was shattered into hundreds of pieces. Wind howled through her soul like a sigh.

items.name: Night of Illusion
items.description: No matter what, Kelly is the one who summoned her. If she dies... Tura would lose all honor among demons!

items.name: Foggy Waters
items.description: Kelly was once a girl's favorite doll. Her body was made of soft cotton. Her pale blue dress had pretty lace.

items.name: Vivid Vibrance
items.description: Ribbons twirled, danced and fell on smiling faces, adding to the fun of the surprise-filled party.

items.name: Puppy Sprint
items.description: One day, Hazel receives a new order for 'a cure for loneliness.' She stares at it and ponders for a long while.

items.name: Brisk Ride
items.description: The fan whirs in the room as Buddy naps on the floor. Hazel hums and starts work. She's got a good idea.

items.name: Speckled Time
items.description: Years ago, Hazel was a quiet girl who always sat alone in the park, watching the beautiful sunset hues.

items.name: Safe Sentry
items.description: She was lonely but didn't know how to make friends. Then she chanced upon a mysterious express delivery service.

items.name: Pink Bubble Gum
items.description: Though skeptical, Hazel placed an order. She didn't wish for much—just to not watch the sunset alone.

items.name: Temporal Whisper
items.description: One afternoon, a quirky girl stopped before her, holding a chubby puppy and smiling at her in the sunset.

items.name: Metallic Chic
items.description: When the girl left, Hazel offered to continue the job for her. They shared a smile as Buddy rolled around.

items.name: Delightful Boon
items.description: The girl became Hazel's first friend. She learned the city's many secrets: discounts at night and delicious sodas.

items.name: Velvety Puff
items.description: 'Nothing beats strawberries and cream!' she says happily. 'Unless it's one extra layer of strawberries!'

items.name: Flavorful Selection
items.description: As a fan of strawberries, Riko loves putting them in her designs. Friends always say she's like a strawberry cake.

items.name: Beary Special
items.description: Ding! The aroma fills the room as Riko takes a deep, contented breath, her heart swelling with happiness.

items.name: Strawberry Smoothie
items.description: Riko's rule for yumminess: no need to be perfect. Just the right amount of sweetness and a hint of sour!

items.name: Redolent Chronicle
items.description: Camilla brushes aside the vines from the sculpture. Then it opens its eyes as the sun brings warmth to its cheeks.

items.name: Evershining Gate
items.description: Startled, Camilla takes a step back. The woman steadies her. 'Sorry, I didn't expect anyone to come.'

items.name: Sylvan Exuberance
items.description: The woman says she's been guarding the manor for years, waiting for its owner's return, but it never happened.

items.name: Vernal Prelude
items.description: Every day after work, Camilla comes to the gallery to talk to the woman about sculpture and revel in the art.

items.name: Luxuriant Harmony
items.description: She says the owner was a generous lady passionate about art who would want to help artists like Camilla.

items.name: Crown of Temptation
items.description: The woman's eyes light up after hearing Camilla's story. She holds her hand and leads her into the art gallery.

items.name: Relics of Time
items.description: The woman knows every anecdote about the art there and shares her thought-provoking opinions with her.

items.name: Taboo Fruit
items.description: She cleans the house as her footsteps echo through the hallway, where dust covers the gold candelabra.

items.name: Fated Bestowal
items.description: A piece of jewelry is enough to fund an artist's study for years. Such a pity it's all collecting dust here.

items.name: Glimmer of Dreams
items.description: Camilla thinks she's met a kindred spirit. One day, the woman plucks the reddest apple and passes it to Camilla.

items.name: Timeborn Blossom
items.description: The manor's been deserted for years, so no one would notice if anything went missing. The woman winks at her.

items.name: Emerald Memory
items.description: In the sweet aroma of the apple, she tells Camilla about the treasures that no one has touched in years.

items.name: Echoes of Fate
items.description: 'Using tricks to summon a demon?' Tura smiles spitefully. 'Perfect. I'll use your soul to restore my power!'

items.name: Essence in Bloom
items.description: Seeing her summoner, Tura falls silent. The doll can offer her nothing, with her old cotton body and patchwork.

items.name: Crimson Reflection
items.description: Long sleep has not restored Tura's power. She needs a strong soul now. Her summoner should've been ready.

items.name: Slumbering Years
items.description: Tura looks at her. One eye is glass, the other... a button?! For demon's sake! Where is the soul demons love most?

items.name: Eternal Darkness
items.description: Tura realizes Kelly's soul could fall apart at any moment. Even a clever demon like her is helpless to stop it.

items.name: Afterlife Whispers
items.description: Kelly never expected to summon a demon. She gazes sadly at the magic circle. 'It seems I got it wrong.'

items.name: Darkened Judgment
items.description: Tura rages, 'I'm the strongest of my kind! Are you mocking me?' Kelly hesitates, 'So you can mend a soul?'

items.name: Embers of Carnage
items.description: Tura's brow twitches. What does that mean? What is a demon feared on battlefields worth to this doll?

items.name: Blood Moon of Void
items.description: The self-proclaimed all-powerful demon hesitates. 'I-I know 30 ways to cook a soul!' Quite a feat for a demon!

items.name: Deepest Wish
items.description: So this is how deals with demons work? Kelly thinks, then cautiously says, 'Please help me mend my soul.'

items.name: Crimson Covenant
items.description: 'The payment is my whole soul, if that's enough. I have nothing else to give.' The doll lowers her head.

items.name: Crimson Accord
items.description: What a hopeless bargain. 'Hmph. I'm very picky about souls... We'll talk once yours is repaired!'

items.name: Mystic Stagecraft
items.description: 'Eyes can be troublesome.' Materials are hard to find, so Kelly finally ends up with two eyes of different sizes.

items.name: Desolate Journey
items.description: Much later, Kelly draws a legendary magic circle said to summon souls. It may be her last hope of repair.

items.name: Patchwork Wishes
items.description: The witch mends Kelly with special thread. Finding no pale blue cloth, she makes Kelly a black-and-white dress.

items.name: Luminous Hope
items.description: 'You must mend your own soul.' Moonlight falls as the witch, now a black cat, leaps to the window.

items.name: Tale of the Night
items.description: After who knows how long, her fingers move, then she utters a few sounds. She then stumbles into human life.

items.name: Unfallen Tears
items.description: Kelly never searches for her owner. She seeks a way to mend her soul, poring over books on strange magic.

items.name: Strange Companion
items.description: A crimson light flares. Kelly summons Tura, a demon even more battered than herself. Their luck is truly awful.

items.name: Lingering Elegy
items.description: Kelly holds the doll in her arms. Someone seems to have held her this way long ago. Her soul begins to heal.

items.name: Cunning Magic
items.description: Dusk falls over the cottage, but for the witch, a new day has just begun. The black cat stretches and joins its friend.

items.name: Old Castle Adventure
items.description: 'Legend says a witch's castle lies in the dark forest. Kids who wander in will...' 'Does she have candy?' '...I guess.'

items.name: Flames of Memory
items.description: People open albums and share stories of the past. Though gone, their loved ones are never forgotten.

items.name: Flowers of Reunion
items.description: Orange flowers glow like warm lanterns in the night, lit by love and longing to guide the departed home.

items.name: Veil of Life and Death
items.description: The veil between life and death separates loved ones across fate's divide, yet never hides memories.

items.name: Wish Express
items.description: Maybe one day, the girl will continue the delivery service, and everyone will receive a cure for loneliness.

items.name: Strawbeary Sweet
items.description: When friends ask Riko about her future plans, she answers with hope, 'Make everyone happy!'

items.name: Beary Sweet Cheese
items.description: Her friends share a look and laugh. Some hold Riko's hand, while some wink at her. 'We are already happy!'

items.name: Garden Breeze
items.description: Someone is paying Camilla generously to clean the manor. Though puzzled, she takes the job anyway.

items.name: Garden of Epiphany
items.description: She eventually sets the candelabrum down after a long pause. Then, she seems to hear a surprised chuckle.

items.name: Desolate Shadows
items.description: Her friend pieces Tura back together and wraps her in bandages. She can only hope Tura wakes someday.

items.name: Black Cat Whimsy
items.description: 'Behave today, okay~' The witch stirs the sweet brew, adds a dried fish, and says, 'The kids' candy isn't done yet!'

items.name: Pulsing Sunshine
items.description: The street lamps light up in the evening breeze. Her pink ride pulls up, with a familiar paw print on the box.

items.name: Ethereal Rhymes
items.description: Camilla loves art. Lines and lights amaze her. She spends the summer working to pay for a famed school.

items.name: Serene Verses
items.description: When Camilla returns to the garden, the woman is gone. She never appears again, not even on Camilla's last day.

items.name: Placid Sonnet
items.description: Before leaving, the girl stands in the evening breeze when an apple drops into her palm. It still tastes as sweet.

items.name: Entrusted Wishes
items.description: Buddy, the paw-print's creator, stays with Hazel. Its name is so ordinary that countless dogs would answer to it!

items.name: Refreshing Cream
items.description: When friends invite her to a spring picnic, Riko doesn't hesitate: strawberry cake, of course!

items.name: Echoes of Nightmare
items.description: They were always together. The girl woke to kiss her cheek each morning and slept with her under the stars.

items.name: Bewitched Lore
items.description: Two battered souls set off together. They cross snowy mountains and silent streets, seeking to mend themselves.

items.name: Bewitched Whispers
items.description: One day, Kelly finds an abandoned doll in a roadside dump. Like her, it has a hollow button for an eye.

items.name: Warm Anchor
items.description: Hazel knocks on every door with Buddy, delivering lost music boxes, letters, hometown noodles…

items.name: Strawberry Mille Crepe
items.description: Stirring fresh milk and flour, Riko pictures the look of happiness on her friends' faces. She loves it the most.

items.name: Flickering Memories
items.description: Love gave Kelly a soul. She learned joy and sorrow, but over time, she sensed the girl's feelings had grown complex.

items.name: Unswerving Pursuit
items.description: The girl's wish is granted soon. Hazel knocks on her door, Buddy in one arm and a chubby puppy in the other.

items.name: Dream Shuttle
items.description: Almost everyone knows it's no ordinary delivery service. She not only delivers items but also grants wishes.

items.name: Dotted Magic
items.description: Riko handpicks strawberries for the cake, only to realize she's been snacking on the rest and left just a few.

items.name: Pale Poetry
items.description: Tura has slept in the dark for ages. The war ended, friends fell, her kind faded... It all became an empty dream.

items.name: Phantom Reverie
items.description: One day, a witch picks her up. 'Oh?' The witch studies the battered doll, surprised. 'You have a mind?'

items.name: Silent Farewell
items.description: One day, the girl's friends visited. 'You still play with dolls?' one teased. The girl's face turned bright red.

items.name: Urban Parable
items.description: Hazel loves her job. Seeing her clients smile when she delivers their packages always fills her with joy.

items.name: Strawbeary Mousse
items.description: The toy bear Riko puts by the counter seems hungry, too. Strawberry cake or mochi? She finds it hard to decide.

items.name: Recounted Past
items.description: The marble sculpture speaks of past glory. Now it's weathered by time and overgrown with vines.

items.name: Dance with Demons
items.description: 'I'll stay with you,' Tura coaxes. 'You summoned me, yet gave me nothing to do or pay. That's not fair.'

items.name: Weathered Keepsake
items.description: Her love burned away, leaving shame and disgust. Watched by others, she threw her old doll outside.

items.name: Dreambound Rendezvous
items.description: 'I'll open a sewing shop and mend their bodies,' she says. The demon shrugs. Kelly always does odd things.

items.name: Secret Spell Boots
items.description: The black cat struts gracefully past stacks of spellbooks, casually brushing its tail against its friend's wrist.

items.name: Fateful Premonition
items.description: Camilla can't help but wonder what the owner was like. What stories of love or hate lie buried in the manor?

items.name: Eerie Dreamscape
items.description: A light pierces the dark. Tura opens her eyes to find herself floating on a mirror marked with a magic circle.

items.name: Soulbound Echoes
items.description: Kelly's mind was hazy. She felt animals tear at her limbs, her dress stain, and crows peck out her eyes…

suits.name: Fairy Tale of Star and Moon
Treasure in the Sea of Clouds
